job.title: Production Manager, Axios Live (Part-time Temporary)
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. Axios Live brings our journalism to life through dynamic, high-quality live experiences that spark meaningful conversations across business, politics, technology, and culture.

We’re looking for a part-time, temporary Production Manager to join our team, a hands-on technical producer who ensures flawless, high-caliber event execution across Axios’s public and branded experiences. 

Why It Matters: This role is central to delivering Axios’s smart, efficient, and creative approach to live events. As Production Manager, Axios Live, you’ll lead technical production and on-site execution for mainstage programs, filmed receptions, and other editorially driven events. You’ll serve as the connective tissue between creative vision and real-world production — translating concepts into precise, high-quality experiences that reflect Axios’s standards of excellence.

Go Deeper: This is a part-time role requiring approximately 15 - 20 hours per week for 8 weeks with the potential to extend the term. The Production Manager will manage technical planning, vendor execution, and on-site operations. This role requires an agile, solutions-oriented producer who thrives in live, fast-paced environments and balances technical precision with editorial sensitivity. Core responsibilities include:

Technical Production & On-Site Execution

  • Lead on-site technical execution for Axios Live events, including audiovisual systems, lighting, staging, livestream, and broadcast operations.
  • Create graphics with Adobe After Effects. 
  • Serve as show-caller and stage manager for various Axios Live event products. 
  • Coordinate site-specific builds, talent rehearsals, and technical run-throughs.
  • Oversee vendor setup, show cues, asset management, and technical execution to ensure seamless, brand-aligned experiences.
  • Support rapid post-event wrap processes, including media clipping and delivery to editorial and marketing teams.

Vendor & Logistics Management

  • Manage all pre-event logistics, timelines, and technical deliverables across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Coordinate production vendors, venue teams, and freelance technicians to ensure Axios standards are met.
  • Create floor plans in collaboration with the operations team. 

Worthy of your time: We’re looking for an experienced, technically skilled producer who embodies a calm, solution-oriented presence and thrives under pressure.

  • 6-8 years of experience in event production, with a focus on A/V systems, livestream, and show execution.
  • Strong understanding of live event and technical workflows, including rigging, lighting, comms, and streaming platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with show-calling, stage management, and backstage coordination.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple events simultaneously while maintaining precision, extreme attention to detail, and quality deliverables.
  • A “can do” and team-centered attitude with a positive approach to quality work. 
  • Strong ability to work independently on specific projects.
  • Excellent communication and time-management skills.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments and solving technical issues in real time.
  • Knowledgeable in production documentation (Run of Show , Tech Flows, Shoflo, Asset management)
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Wrike, Airtable) 
  • Experience in Adobe products, specifically Adobe Premiere & After Effects.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when required.

Contract details: 

  • Target engagement period: 8 weeks with the potential to extend.
  • Compensation: 
    • Pre-Production Hourly -$38.50-$44.00/hour (15-20 hours per week)
    • On-Site Flat Rate - $1,500/day (12-hour day)

job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster on what matters. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help scale the systems that power Axios’ core products.

Why it matters: At Axios, we deliver news that’s clinical, trustworthy, and informative — reaching millions of readers every day. As a Software Engineer, you’ll help power the services, APIs, and data flows that make our audience-facing products fast, reliable, and scalable. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across disciplines to build resilient systems that embody Axios’ commitment to clarity and make our readers smarter.

Responsibilities:

As a Software Engineer, you’ll develop high-quality, reliable services in a Golang and Python codebase, ensuring performance and stability across Axios’ publishing and delivery platforms. Key responsibilities include:

  • API development: Design, implement, and maintain scalable REST APIs to power Axios products.
  • Service reliability: Build and optimize backend services using Golang and Python, ensuring they are resilient, performant, and maintainable.
  • Data modeling: Design and evolve database schemas and performant queries to support new features and business requirements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with front-end engineers, quality engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Testing & quality: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; contribute to Axios’ quality efforts by ensuring backend systems are covered with automated tests.
  • Performance & observability: Monitor system health, contribute to our logging/metrics implementation, and proactively improve performance and scalability.
  • AI fluency: Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or other assistants to accelerate development, improve code quality, and explore creative solutions.
  • Continuous improvement: Participate in code reviews, propose improvements to architecture and practices, and stay up to date with evolving backend technologies.

  • Experience: 2–5+ years in backend or full-stack development, with hands-on experience in Golang and/or Python.
  • API expertise: Strong understanding of designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Databases: Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL) and ORMs (e.g., Gin, Django)
  • Testing: Experience with unit and integration testing in Golang and/or Python, and a mindset of embedding quality into development.
  • Performance & scalability: Awareness of common patterns for scaling backend services and optimizing performance.
  • AI tooling: Comfort using tools like GitHub Copilot or Claude Clode as part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally in an agile environment.

  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with performance testing or load testing of backend services.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Manager, Conversion

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Audience Conversion team at People Inc. leads marketing strategies that acquire new audiences and convert unknown users into known. We are seeking a passionate and data-driven Senior Conversion Manager to develop, lead, and execute strategies that drive high-quality user acquisition across a range of brand products and initiatives.

This role builds direct connections between our brands and audiences. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds trust with cross-functional partners, and translates data and insights into clear, actionable strategies.

The Senior Conversion Manager will lead, manage, and optimize acquisition strategies for assigned brands, including efforts to grow subscription memberships, newsletter subscribers, app downloads, event ticket sales, and other audience growth programs. This person will own on-site conversion strategies from concept through execution, while continuously reporting on performance, learnings, and opportunities for improvement.

This role will oversee acquisition efforts across on-site marketing placements, interactive quizzes, sweepstakes, partnerships, and other conversion channels. The Senior Conversion Manager will work closely with an Audience Retention and Lifecycle Strategist to grow active subscribers and deepen subscriber engagement.

This position is part of a unified Conversion team and will collaborate closely with Product, Growth, brand leadership, and editorial teams. Success in this role requires a strategic, forward-thinking mindset, strong analytical skills, excellent communication, and the ability to lead through collaboration.

Hybrid 3x a week- (DSM or NYC) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

  • Conversion Strategy: Lead the development and execution of audience conversion strategies that drive new newsletter subscriptions and other key acquisition goals. Build Audience Conversion roadmaps for assigned brands, contribute to vertical and brand planning, launch new acquisition programs and levers, execute A/B tests, and share performance results, insights, and learnings on an ongoing basis.

  • Performance Analysis: Monitor, analyze, and report on the performance of conversion initiatives to ensure goals are met. Translate data into actionable insights, identify opportunities for optimization and growth, and communicate recommendations clearly to stakeholders.

  • Operations and Project Management: Build and manage campaigns within marketing technology platforms. Oversee QA, timelines, stakeholder feedback, and approval processes with strong attention to detail to ensure high-quality execution.

  • Best Practices: Stay closely connected to industry news, emerging trends, and audience growth innovations. Conduct internal and external program audits and deliver insights, recommendations, and best practices that strengthen conversion performance.

  • Collaboration and Partnership: Build strong, trusted relationships with brand leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. Proactively anticipate partner needs, offer strategic recommendations, and deliver high-quality work across multiple internal teams, including General Managers, Editorial, Design, Data, Product, Growth, and Audience Retention and Lifecycle counterparts.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelors and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 4-6 years experience in acquisition or growth marketing 

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in performance analysis and data-driven decision making

  • Proven track record of driving subscriber and/or email acquisition

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence stakeholders

  • Strong project management skills

job.title: Business Supervisor
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support an exciting account. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote. 

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives and approved strategy.

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.
  • Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

  • Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
  • Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

 

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $83,000 - 100,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Senior Director - Product Marketing & Market Intelligence
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

We're looking for a Senior Director, Product Marketing & Market Intelligence to lead a modern product marketing organization and help us see those opportunities first. You'll own how SoundCloud understands its market and turns that understanding into product and growth decisions. This is not a traditional product marketing role: you'll build SoundCloud's market and audience intelligence from the ground up, shape product and monetization strategy, and serve as the voice of creators and fans inside the company.

Reporting to the Chief Growth & Marketing Officer, you'll build and lead a team of Product Marketers and act as the strategic bridge across Product, Marketing, Community, Partnerships, and Executive Leadership.

In your first year, you'll build the engine that helps SoundCloud truly understand its audiences — the jobs-to-be-done frameworks, audience intelligence, and Voice-of-Customer programs that become the foundation for everything Product Marketing does, from strategy to positioning to launch. Success looks like a PMM organization that consistently influences product and business decisions — and becomes a durable source of strategic advantage for SoundCloud.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days/week in our NYC office.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Shape product and business strategy as a strategic partner to leadership, including recommendations on consumer narratives, packaging, and monetization, some of the highest-leverage decisions at the company
  • Define positioning across creator, fan, AI, subscription, and monetization experiences, in close partnership with Brand, Creative, and Communications
  • Lead go-to-market strategy for major launches, defining audiences, positioning, and launch tiers, and owning the awareness-to-adoption-to-retention metrics that define success; own GTM strategy, positioning, and audience definition, partnering with marketing teams on channel orchestration and execution
  • Build SoundCloud's market and audience intelligence function — tracking trends and competitive moves across music, AI, and the creator economy, and turning them into executive briefings, forecasts, competitive intelligence, and opportunity calls that sharpen how we compete
  • Own creator and fan insight, drive audience segmentation and sizing, build always-on feedback loops, partner with Community on creator councils and advisory panels, and translate what you learn into recommendations Product and Business act on
  • Build and develop a high-performing PMM organization, establishing a modern operating model and raising the strategic influence of the function across the company

Experience and Background:

  • 10+ years across product marketing, product or growth strategy, or consumer, marketplace, and platform businesses
  • A track record of leading product marketing teams and influencing product strategy, not just supporting launches
  • Deep experience with market and audience research and competitive analysis — and a habit of turning it into data-backed decisions
  • Deep understanding of consumer products, marketplaces, creator platforms, subscriptions, or social ecosystems
  • Exceptional storytelling and executive presence across complex, cross-functional organizations
  • Relentless curiosity about people, markets, and culture, with a real passion for music and creators

Maintains accurate records, strengthens reporting discipline, closes compliance gaps, and improves processes that support accountability and consistency.

Position Overview

The Executive Producer at WFTV in Orlando, FL will manage a team of TV producers and writers while working with, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors to create dynamic newscasts in one of the top newsrooms in the country. The EP crafts the look of the shows, manages story count, flow and placement of every story. They set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news and the speed and style in which we get it on the air whenever news breaks. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment. The EP assists in all aspects of leading and managing a team such as establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations and works closely with fellow managers to craft and execute successful strategies and newscasts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Ensure product stays on brand.
  • Manage breaking news.
  • Copy edits stories in newscasts to ensure they are on target with research objectives.
  • Manages story count and placement. Must be intimate with the rundown. Manage story count vs. big story coverage.
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with producers and conducting newscast critiques.
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast.
  • Ensures the product stays on brand. Holds producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery.
  • Manages breaking news. Ensures that we are on the air quickly. Monitors the execution in the control room. Facilitates drills to ensure talent is up to speed.
  • Innovate to match research as viewing behavior changes.
  • Executes live-streaming strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms.
  • Works closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast.
  • Crafts newscasts look by working with the Creative Services Department.
  • Holds writing seminars and trains new employees.
  • Must fill in line producer as needed

 

Administrative – 10%

  • The EP leads and manages a team of TV and digital producers, writers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors.
  • Assists in establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations.

  • A combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers.

  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms 
  • Must be a good teacher and leader 
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
  • Must be well read on current affairs and have a wide range of working knowledge and understanding of general interest subjects. 
  • Must be able to understand research and execute on the findings.

Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

At Warner Music Group, our Strategic Finance team serves as the analytical engine that drives both our high-level business strategy and day-to-day operations. By extracting actionable intelligence from core financial data, the team partners seamlessly across Warner Music’s Central Functions, Recorded Music, and Music Publishing to uncover deep business insights. Ultimately, Strategic Finance sits at the forefront of the company, mapping the financial dynamics and emerging trends that are actively shaping the future of the global music industry.

Your role:

As the Data Scientist for Strategic Finance, you will act as the crucial link between our financial strategists and the Technology department. A key part of your mission is collaborating closely with the technology engineers and data scientists who are building our state-of-the-art predictive forecasting platform, ensuring the tool perfectly aligns with business needs. Alongside this, you will deploy modern AI solutions to automate complex financial workflows and transform ambiguous, disparate data into standardized, cohesive datasets—moving the department away from fragile legacy spreadsheets and toward a highly automated, self-service data ecosystem.

Here you’ll get to:

• Partner closely with Technology and Affiliate Finance teams to gather requirements, design, and deploy a robust financial forecasting and planning tool that supports WMG's long-term modeling.
• Spearhead AI and automation initiatives to eliminate manual bottlenecks and streamline workflows across Strategic Finance.
• Enforce data integrity within Strategic Finance by collaborating with data management teams to architect datasets and automate rigorous quality controls.
• Work directly with senior finance collaborators to clarify complex problems and build the right analytical or technology-based approaches using large, dynamic datasets.
• Act as the trusted liaison between Strategic Finance, Technology, and data platform collaborators to ensure all technical solutions perfectly align with business priorities.

About you:

• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of hands-on, practical experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), Python-based automation, internal app frameworks (Streamlit), BI/reporting tools, workflow automation platforms (Airtable), and AI-assisted development tools.
• Experience helping teams adopt new tools, new processes, and more modern ways of working while staying grounded in business realities.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and implement data science projects with minimal supervision.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and model development.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks and statistical tools.
• Strong understanding of SQL and working with large datasets.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical collaborators.
• Strong problem-solving abilities, with a bias towards action and a proactive approach to finding opportunities and challenges.

We’d love it if you also had:

• Familiarity with the streaming music landscape or other digital media
• Experience in finance transformation and EPM implementation
• Knowledge of accounting concepts and revenue recognition principles


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

This position serves as the national journalism leader for the organization, cultivating and maintaining relationships with leaders in the journalism industry, journalism education and funding communities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead the development and execution of journalism education programs, philanthropic initiatives, and strategic priorities that advance the mission of the Scripps Howard Fund and Foundation.

  • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with journalism organizations, academic institutions, funders, donors, and industry leaders to strengthen journalism talent pipelines and expand program impact.

  • Serve as a recognized leader and subject matter expert in journalism education and philanthropy, providing insights, recommendations, and thought leadership on industry trends, opportunities, and emerging needs.

  • Collaborate with internal, board, and external stakeholders to develop and implement innovative initiatives that support current and future journalists and advance the profession.

  • Represent the Fund and Foundation in industry associations, conferences, and external partnerships, promoting the organization's leadership in journalism and journalism education.

  • Monitor and evaluate program and grant performance by reviewing outcomes, impact metrics, and grantee reports, and provide recommendations to enhance effectiveness and alignment with strategic objectives.

  • Oversee key journalism programs and special initiatives, including the Scripps Howard Journalism Awards, internships, experiential learning opportunities, and other mission-driven projects.

  • Lead and develop the journalism education team by providing strategic direction, coaching, performance support, and resource planning to ensure high-quality program execution and achievement of organizational goals.

  • Prepare comprehensive board reports and present key updates, outcomes, and strategic recommendations during board meetings.

  • Ability to collaborate, influence and build effective partnerships across institutions, organizations and associations.

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships

A little bit about our team:

The Brand Partnerships and Commercial Licensing Department at Atlantic Music Group is responsible for all outreach to brands, advertising and entertainment marketing agencies with the ultimate goal of aligning the label and our artists with branded campaign and partnership opportunities.

 

Your role:

You will cultivate brand partnerships for the company and Atlantic's diverse roster of top-notch artists with the goal of:  a) creating impactful campaigns and promotions to increase consumption of our artists’ music; b) raising the profile of our artists and the Atlantic Music Group brand; and c) offsetting costs by funding our creative marketing campaigns, artist visuals and promotional events.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Devise and pitch brand partnership deals and campaigns for all artists on the Atlantic Music Group roster to amplify the artist's presence in the marketplace, increase consumption of the artist's music and garner revenue for the artist and label. Campaigns that range from traditional NIL/endorsement deals, to video product placement deals, tour sponsorship and activations, partner funded pop-up activations, paid social media posts, performance opportunities, etc.

  • Cultivate and maintain key relationships with brand marketers, talent, marketing and influencer agencies to garner income for artists, revenue for label and amplify album marketing campaigns; lead team outreach to the multicultural brand marketing community.

  • Work with product managers, digital and social marketers, the fan engagement team, streaming, creative & visual services, radio promotion, and publicity departments to develop creative marketing strategy and plans as needed for all artists on the roster.

  • Work closely with the artist and management team to execute all partnership deliverables.

  • Work with artist legal teams and label business affairs to contract all deals.

 

About you:

  • 7+ years of experience in label, management or agency brand partnerships, or brand management

  • You have excellent communication skills

  • You have the ability to manage multiple tasks and yield results

  • You possess competitive negotiating skills

  • You bring a positive disposition to the team and are eager to collaborate and build relationships

  • Skilled at cold calling new clients and pitching creative ideas (internal/external pitches)

  • Strategic thinker

  • Organizational and financial management skills

  • Ability to work in fast-paced environment with relatively short deadlines

The Recommendations team ships ML-powered features that connect 200M+ users with music they'll love. 

You'll own features end-to-end: from understanding user needs with Product and Design, to architecting data pipelines processing billions of events, to building and shipping production ML systems that balance performance, cost, and user experience. This means working across BigQuery (trillion-row datasets), Airflow orchestration, real-time serving infrastructure (BigTable), APIs, and constant collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, and Platform teams.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop, test, and productionize ML and LLM-based systems serving real users
  • Design and build end-to-end ML pipelines, including data, features, training, and serving
  • Make technical decisions considering cost, latency, complexity, and maintainability 
  • Navigate distributed systems (BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, DynamoDB) to build reliable, scalable solutions
  • Set up monitoring, A/B testing, and metrics frameworks to measure real user impact
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines, ML models, and distributed systems
  • Contribute to technical strategy and team best practices
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier to work at 10x the speed of traditional methods

Experience and Background:

  • 1-2+ years building ML systems in production - you understand the difference between a model that works in Jupyter and one that serves millions of users
  • 4+ years of software engineering experience - you write production code, not just notebooks
  • Strong Python and Scala (or Java/JVM) skills, with experience writing scalable, production code
  • Experience building and deploying ML models end-to-end (data, training, serving, monitoring)
  • Experience building and deploying LLM-based features in production
  • Familiarity with integrating LLMs into ML systems (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation, model serving)
  • Understanding of shared ML architecture across domains (e.g. search and recommendations)
  • Strong focus on data quality and correctness, and how upstream data impacts downstream models and user experience
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (BigQuery, Spark)
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS/GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with distributed data processing and ETL pipelines (Airflow, Spark)
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

job.title: Senior Manager, Audience Intelligence
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Senior Manager, Audience Intelligence leads Sony Music Canada’s audience insights function, delivering data-driven intelligence that informs campaign planning, audience growth, fan engagement, and direct-to-consumer strategy across the organization. The position currently manages 1 direct report and reports into a broader regional team spanning the U.S, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

This role focuses on transforming audience, streaming, social, and commerce data into actionable insights that support artist development, release strategy, CRM initiatives, and fan monetization opportunities.

The Senior Manager plays a critical role in measuring release and campaign performance, uncovering audience trends, to build a more unified view of the fan journey from streaming discovery and social engagement through to owned-channel interaction and commerce conversion.

This is a highly collaborative role for an analytically driven individual who is passionate about music, fan behaviour, and the evolving music data and distribution ecosystem.

What you'll do:

Analytics & Audience Insight Development

• Collaborate with Commercial Partnerships, Marketing, A&R, the Executive team and Audience Intelligence teams with real-time insights to inform artist signings, campaign planning, optimization, and post-campaign analysis.
• Collect, analyze, and interpret audience data across streaming platforms, physical sales, social media, paid media, CRM, and D2C commerce channels.
• Conduct deep-dive analyses into audience behavior, fan demographics, psychographics, and engagement trends to support targeting and segmentation strategies.
• Identify emerging audience opportunities, cultural trends, and high value fan segments that can inform artist marketing and growth strategies.
• Manage product release forecasting and audience trend analysis for domestic and international frontline and catalogue priorities.
• Deliver ad-hoc analysis to support the needs of the business, assist with other projects and process improvement initiatives as required.

D2C, CRM & Fan Lifecycle Intelligence

• Lead audience measurement and performance reporting across Sony Music Canada’s direct-to-consumer ecosystem, CRM programs, and owned fan acquisition initiatives.
• Analyze customer behavior, conversion trends, retention, and purchase activity to inform D2C strategy and optimization.
• Develop frameworks that map audience pathways between streaming engagement, social interaction, CRM acquisition, and commerce conversion.
• Partner with digital and marketing teams, and D2C stakeholders to identify opportunities for fan acquisition, audience re-engagement, lifecycle marketing, and conversion growth.

Reporting, Visualization & Operational Excellence

• Build and evolve scalable dashboards, KPI scorecards, and reporting frameworks tracking campaign performance, audience growth, streaming trends, CRM engagement, and D2C performance.
• Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business intelligence for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Assist with funding requests (e.g., Ontario Music Investment Fund), support new business development, and handle ad hoc data or reporting requests from key departments.

Who you are:

• 5+ years of experience in analytics, digital marketing, audience insights, or performance reporting (music, entertainment, media, or e-commerce preferred).
• Proficiency in analytical languages such as SQL and/or Python is considered a strong asset.
• Experience with analytics and BI tools including Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI and Shopify analytics.
• Experience with music and audience platforms including Luminate, Spotify for Artists, Apple Music For Artists, Amazon Music For Artists, YouTube Analytics and Chartmetric.
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience working across multiple datasets.
• Strong communication skills to build trusted relationships and translate data into actionable business insights.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and collaborative with strong follow through.
• Creates an environment where direct reports can perform, grow, and contribute at their highest level
• Navigates a fast-changing industry while helping their team to adapt.
• Fosters a culture where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone can contribute
• Understands how decisions impact artists, audiences, and business performance
• Passion for music, fan culture, digital platforms, and audience behavior.

What we give you:

 

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives 
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like health and dental group insurance, life insurance, short and long-term disability plans, group RRSP pension program, tuition reimbursement, health and lifestyle benefit plan and an EAP program. There’s also time off over winter break

job.title: Senior Analyst, Corporate Services FP&A
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A Little Bit About Our Team 

The Corporate Finance Department at WMG oversees the Company’s financial operations in partnership with WMG’s labels, business units and corporate functions. The team is responsible for financial planning and analysis, budgeting and forecasting, management reporting, accounting oversight and financial compliance across the Company. 

Your Role 

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Corporate Finance, the Senior Analyst will play a hands-on role in the management of centrally managed Corporate functions and Recorded Music functional areas. 

You will take ownership of key day-to-day budgeting, forecasting, reporting and accounting activities for Corporate functions. Acting as a key finance partner, you will help department leaders understand their financial performance, lead their budgets and make informed business decisions. 

This is a hands-on role offering broad exposure to the financial operation of a global music company, regular interaction with finance and non-finance stakeholders, and the opportunity to develop within a collaborative, high-performing team. 

Here You'll Get To:. 

  • Own key monthly close activities for Corporate functions, including preparing accruals, reclasses and intercompany journal entries. 

  • Work closely with the Shared Service Center and other Finance teams to ensure costs are accurately recorded in the general ledger and align with Company policies. 

  • Prepare comprehensive month-end reporting packages and monthly forecast materials, including analysis of material spend and variances against budget, forecast and prior year. 

  • Partner with Corporate function leaders and budget owners to understand financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and maintain accurate forecasts.

  • Support the annual budget, monthly forecasting and long-range planning processes, including the development and maintenance of supporting financial models. 

  • Compile and analyze Corporate spend information used in senior-management, Board and external reporting materials. 

  • Provide financial oversight of operational activities, including invoice coding and submissions, vendor setup, purchase order tracking, commitments and project cash-outflows.

job.title: Correspondent, Technology, APAC
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is looking for a talented, experienced and versatile reporter to join our Business team to cover technology in Asia. The contest between the United States and China for technological supremacy – spanning artificial intelligence, semiconductors, robotics and other emerging fields – is one of the defining stories of our time. We are looking for a journalist who can break news from companies and governments across Asia and translate complex technical developments into clear and compelling journalism for a broad audience. A firm understanding of the geopolitical context to technology is necessary. China will be central to the beat, reflecting its importance to the region and the global economy. 

The ideal candidate is an energetic and determined beat reporter who thrives on competition and ambitious storytelling. The role calls for a rich mix of scoops, breaking news, analysis, explainers and enterprise reporting that reveals the forces reshaping technology, business and geopolitics. Although the reporting will begin in Asia, stories must draw wider global connections. The reporter will work closely with correspondents around the world and collaborate across Business, International, Breaking News, Video and Graphics, contributing to articles, live coverage, newsletters, audio, visual journalism and other formats.

This role will be based in the APAC region; the location of the role will be discussed with the recruiter during the interview process. The role will be part of the Technology Team on the Business Desk. 

Main Responsibilities:

  • Follow news, events and cultural trends on your beat to determine, in conjunction with your colleagues and editors, themes worthy of coverage as breaking news, day news or as enterprise 
  • Must be as comfortable and enthusiastic reacting to immediate breaking news as you are writing thoughtfully and deeply about events and issues 
  • Write medium- and long-term enterprise and the occasional entertaining feature.
  • Deliver scoops and exclusive news
  • Build a network of sources that will inform rich and original news articles and features
  • Contribute to and sometimes be the lead correspondent on live briefings, writing briefing-length stories and providing live coverage
  • Cover news accurately and efficiently; maintain and cultivate news sources and contacts; obtain information through interviews, observations and research
  • Present facts and analysis in clear written form and in conformity with Times style, length and other requirements, and developing high-impact stories from the broader themes that underpin incremental news developments 
  • Write on deadline; receive and react to feedback and edits 
  • Collaborate closely and regularly with reporter-researchers who are partners in reporting, translation and story scouting  
  • Commit to The New York Times’s strategy, ethics, standards and mission for both themselves, their team, stringers and colleagues
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Our ideal candidate has:

  • A bottomless curiosity about the world and a love of news and storytelling
  • A self-evident commitment to the power of tough and fair reporting
  • An ability to produce stories that are crisply written and well organized, framed to draw in busy, scrolling readers and delivered in language that is accessible
  • A striving passion for professional development and the ability to learn from everyone around them
  • A collaborative, genuine and independent spirit that takes satisfaction in not only their own growth but the success of their team and colleagues 
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in reporting roles

Why it matters: This role will provide essential administrative support to the Founders Office, helping keep personal logistics, travel details, expenses, family needs, and other recurring tasks organized and moving with care, discretion and strong follow-through.

job.description:

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Sync Partnerships Director to join UnitedMasters!

What You'll Do

  • Identify, qualify, and close new customer accounts  to achieve and exceed sales targets
  • Develop account plans to increase adoption and grow key accounts.
  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers and client champions in key accounts.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies tailored to key accounts.
  • Manage pipeline to keep forecasts and deals status effectively communicated across the organization.
  • Shape complex deals and negotiate contracts to closure, working closely with legal teams
  • Create a meaningful presence for the company in related industry events.
  • Partner with UnitedMasters’ Music, Product, and Marketing teams to analyze market trends, deepen understanding of customer needs, refine unique selling propositions and continually improve messaging.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and competitive landscape

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven ability to set goals and work cross-functionally to establish a strong market presence and revenue.
  • You have a track record in contributing to culture, process and cross-functional collaboration to enable business success.
  • Ability to travel and host events to nurture and deepen client relationships

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience and extensive relationships selling campaign-based and/or program-based programs to Creative / Content / Marketing departments. 
  • Proven network of contacts across Creative / Content / Marketing landscapes in Advertising, Sports, Digital Publishing, or Media within the US with a proven track record closing deals.
  • Passionate about all genres of music and constantly evaluating new trends in the ever-changing music landscape
  • Distinct point of view on where the industry is heading and ability to inform how UnitedMasters can leverage its position in culture and independent music distribution to build sustainable competitive advantages in sync.
  • An empathetic problem solver who is closely attuned to our company’s values and those of the independent artists we serve.
  • You are an entrepreneur at heart: You are driven and self-directed. You are confident and energized about building through new stages of growth.                                                                          

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Music Industry, or a related field.
  • Mastery of CRM software, such as Hubspot or Salesforce
  • Deep experience in selling Music to Creative Teams with a track record of success

About UnitedMasters, Inc. 

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.title: Content Protection Representative
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

Universal Music Group’s Content Protection team has an exciting opportunity available for a Content Protection Representative, unlike any other, that offers a chance to play a pivotal role in combating IP (Intellectual Property) theft at the world's largest music company.

The Content Protection department provides support to all UMG (Universal Music Group) labels and business units worldwide, across multiple time zones. The environment is often fast-paced and allows for opportunities to work on a diverse array of projects related to the management of audio and video content, as well as many other areas of our digital and physical workstreams. This role will suit a dynamic individual with a keen eye for detail and a passion for recorded music and technology.

As a Content Protection Representative, you will primarily be responsible for reviewing and assessing UMG content using a variety of internal and external technologies. You will also be trained in the physical, digital, and technical operations of the music business.


Bring your VIBE:

  • 0-1+ years' work experience in either Music industry or Digital Media, Entertainment, Technology, or related fields.
  • Familiarity with anti-piracy, copyright, or trademarks preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
     

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Highly organized with demonstrated attention to detail.
  • Self-starter with an ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Significant understanding of digital technologies, especially music platforms and mobile apps.
  • Strong organizational skills including follow-through and execution.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Passion for music and digital music platforms.

Preferred Skills/Abilities:

  • Fluency in Spanish or another language is a bonus.
  • Advanced knowledge of Office 365 including Excel.
  • Experienced in working with large datasets and / or databases including SQL language.
  • Excellent presentation skills (e.g., PowerPoint) along with a willingness to speak publicly amongst peers and senior managers.

How you'll CREATE:

  • Assess & review online uses of UMG digital and physical assets (including publishing), to detect infringement of our rights.
  • Handling inquiries from our internal business units and labels (including Spanish-speaking labels).
  • Work with our international trade groups to enforce our rights.
  • Staying abreast of digital trends related to the recording industry.

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

A little bit about our team:

The department consists of five specific areas of responsibility, all ultimately focused on the production and distribution of WMG products. Research and Development helps define new product specifications and processes for production; Product Data Management is responsible for defining product data standards and keying data into systems; Studio and Archive Operations delivers production masters for physical and digital manufacturing and archives the company master assets; Digital Production provides day-to-day production support for WMG labels’ digital releases and oversees production of digital assets and Digital and Mobile Operations manages the distribution of digital products to retail partners globally.

Your role:

In this role, you will work with one of the largest tape libraries in the world ensuring the protection, preservation, and production of tapes that source some of the most iconic albums and unheard rarities in all of music history. You’ll work with both librarians and engineers, directly handle and distribute master tapes and other audio sources to archive vendors, and ensure the accuracy of production and preservation through research, document creation, and spreadsheet & database maintenance. 

 

Here you’ll get to:

  • You will ensure that the proper tapes are being archived for a given release.
  • You will locate final product and verify that all metadata is correct in relation to tapes pulled.
  • You will create Archive Packing Lists detailing correct Artist, Title, Label, Sel #, Track Titles, Source File #, and any other pertinent information needed for each release, providing these to the archive vendors for reference and inclusion in the archives.
  • You will update the Transfer Tracker document for archives needed for current production requests, including the date sent for archive, where it was sent and when it is needed by.
  • You will schedule pick-ups of archive supplies and tapes and address sourcing issues with vendors as they arise (finding alt sources if tapes are problematic, etc.)
  • You will correct errors in our Master Library System (MLS) database based on research, tape box information or additional information provided by archive vendors working with the tapes.
  • You will assist non-archive librarians as needed.

 

About you:

  • You are detail-oriented
  • You enjoy problem solving and have initiative
  • You have composure and interpersonal savvy
  • You preferably have a college degree or equivalent work experience
  • You maintain a service orientation and costumer focus

 

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Familiarity with Excel and navigating databases
  • Knowledge of music industry processes past and present: Tracking/Mixing/Mastering/Duplication
  • Familiarity with audio recording media format

Overview:

 

The Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Account Manager, reporting to the SEM Product Manager, is an integral member of Audacy’s centralized Revenue Operations Search team. This individual is responsible for building, managing, monitoring and analyzing client Google Ads campaigns while serving as the primary SEM contact for sales teams and external vendors.

 

The Account Manager will proactively optimize campaigns in accordance with Audacy SEM best practices and provide strategic recommendations to support campaign performance and client success. This individual must be comfortable adapting to evolving platforms, processes and priorities while remaining receptive to direction and established team standards. Day-to-day guidance and support will be provided by the SEM Product Manager.

 

This position is eligible for remote work in any of Audacy’s 48 markets.

  • Use forecasting and research tools to provide sales teams with accurate estimates of campaign potential for prospective clients
  • Build and launch Google Ads campaigns, including campaign structures, keyword strategies, ad copy, targeting, budgets and supporting assets

  • Manage campaign budgets and pacing to support accurate monthly spending and full delivery over the life of each campaign
  • Review conversion tracking and reporting for accuracy, troubleshoot concerns and coordinate with internal teams or vendors when additional support is needed
  • Analyze campaign performance and clearly communicate results, recommendations, required actions and potential growth opportunities to sales teams
  • Manage multiple accounts, requests and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation and proactively communicating priorities, concerns or potential delays
  • Identify and escalate performance, tracking, policy, billing or fulfillment concerns before they negatively affect a campaign or client
  • Stay current with evolving advertising platforms, SEM products and internal processes, applying new team guidance and Audacy SEM best practices as directed
  • Collaborate with sales teams, internal partners and external vendors to support accurate campaign execution and a positive client experience

Required & Preferred:

  • BS/BA degree or relevant experience
  • Paid search or digital media advertising experience preferred
  • Experience with keyword research tools and ability to use these tools to setup/expand SEM campaigns
  • Working knowledge of Google Ads, Bing Ads, or other PPC platforms 
  • Proficient in Microsoft office suite and Google Workspace
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with sales and account teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities

Job Title: Multimedia Journalist

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: TWIN Traffic Operations Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Dallas, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

NewsRadio 1080 KRLD, Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas State Networks is looking for its next full-time Multimedia Journalist. The ideal candidate is an upbeat, positive, and motivated news junkie who thrives in a fast-paced environment where content is driven by audience demands, breaking news, severe weather, and coverage of major traffic incidents.

 

In this unique and exciting role as a multimedia journalist, you will serve as an editor, anchor, reporter, digital and social content creator for NewsRadio 1080 KRLD’s multiple distribution platforms, including Texas State Networks. The skills utilized may be different each day, based on staffing, content, and audience demands.

 

This full-time position would include a Monday through Friday schedule and may include on-call duties as needed.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Stay up to date on current affairs and content planning for the day/week.
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news, traffic & weather content, including live coverage from the studio or from the field on KRLD, Texas State Networks, or associated distribution platforms.
  • Identify great audio, write and edit urgent and compelling copy for stories.
  • Assemble/stack, and edit newscasts delivered by another anchor and/or by you, free of any political or social biases. 
  • Anchor multi-hour news shifts on KRLD and/or Texas State Networks.
  • Interview newsmakers and news reactors, including the general public.
  • Development and research of potential news stories, using all newsroom resources, including non-traditional and social media, to identify potential news stories relevant to KRLD’s strategy and target audience.
  • Organize, develop, and coordinate assignments with reporters during hours associated with Editing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with KRLD meteorologist and/or traffic teams during changing weather conditions, severe weather, and significant traffic incidents.
  • Creatively pursue new ways of presenting stories so that they have the most impact on the audience.
  • Contribute to team editorial meetings with story ideas.
  • Learn, understand, and be able to follow and implement KRLD strategy and Audacy policy and procedures.
  • Alert management to content that is questionable or that may be in violation of FCC, corporate or station policies and regulations.
  • Other duties as required by management.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Have a passion for the process of news and news story development.
  • Understanding of newsroom ethical and legal guidelines and restrictions that govern broadcast media.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and deep understanding of current events, politics and news.
  • Keen awareness of the current socio-political landscape, and the ability to separate personal political and social views from influencing story selection and presentation.
  • Contemporary sound and excellent on-air delivery and storytelling skills.
  • Write for both styles of distribution (on-air and digital) and include audio and/or video.
  • Thrive under pressure, especially during breaking news, severe weather, and unrelenting news deadlines.
  • Comfort with on-camera work for social and digital distribution.
  • Fully utilize all the tools of broadcast and social media in the field (Twitter, Facebook, live and recorded video and audio equipment, etc.) 
  • Technical proficiency of audio and video recording equipment and editing software.
  • Proficiency in editing and packaging news sound and interviews.
  • Possess strong multi-tasking skills, and the ability to quickly pivot and produce content spontaneously based on changing news, breaking news, severe weather, etc.
  • Positive and effective communication with team members, advertisers, newsmakers, stringers and network counterparts, listeners and the general public.
  • Understanding of target demographics, and target topics/beats for news coverage.
  • Proficient with basic computer software skills, including Gmail and Slack.

 

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the Dallas-Fort Worth news environment.
  • 4 year degree in journalism.
  • 1+ years of experience in an active newsroom environment.
  • 1+ years anchoring or reporting news for broadcast or digital media.
  • Burli or (similar news content management system) experience.
  • Experience updating stories on digital CMS platforms (i.e. - WordPress, etc)
  • Ability to edit video, overlay graphics and/or subtitles, etc.
  • Graphic editing skills, and use of products for visual storytelling, such as Canva.
