job.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

The People Team sits at the heart of Warner Music Group and is focused on attracting, retaining and developing exceptional people. As part of the People team, our dynamic and diverse Talent Acquisition team is responsible for finding and hiring the best talent for the business, and partnering with our business leaders on their talent attraction strategies.

Your role:

At WMG, you will immerse yourself in a vibrant, creative environment, turning your passion for connecting people and music into a rewarding career.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, you will drive our end-to-end talent acquisition strategy, identifying and engaging high-caliber, diverse talent across the business. Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, you will work with executive collaborators and hiring managers. You will craft proactive sourcing strategies and carry them out to meet business needs now and in the future. Beyond managing complex searches, you will lead strategic TA initiatives, champion our employer brand, and oversee key talent programs and projects. This is a high-impact role requiring strategic foresight, strong business insight, and a consultative approach.   

Here you’ll get to:

- Own the full lifecycle recruitment for assigned roles, delivering an outstanding candidate experience from initial briefing to negotiation and onboarding.   Although the role is west-coast based, you will recruit for positions in other locations and time zones, as well.

- Serve as a strategic talent advisor to business leaders, using labor market insights, industry trends, and data to build hiring strategies and influence talent decisions.

- Design and execute innovative sourcing strategies to build robust, diverse talent pipelines for immediate hires and long-term organizational growth.

- Lead key talent acquisition projects aimed at enhancing candidate experience, optimizing recruitment processes, and embedding best practices across the organization.

- Manage agency partner relationships, evaluating vendor performance and ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and SLAs.

- Represent the Warner Music organization as an employer brand ambassador at industry panels, networking events, and campus programs.

- Partner seamlessly with the broader People team (People Partners, Total Rewards, etc.) to deliver cohesive, business-aligned talent solutions.

- Drive recruitment initiatives, establishing strategic partnerships and talent channels to continually diversify our pipeline.

- Mentor and guide hiring managers on interview guidelines, candidate assessment, and competitive market dynamics.

  • Other duties as assigned by management

 

Qualifications

  • Positive and energetic attitude.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check 

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Senior Reporter - AI and Technology, English Services, (On-site)
job.description:
Position Title:

Senior Reporter - AI and Technology, English Services, (On-site)

Status of Employment:

Permanent

Position Language Requirement:

English

Language Skills:

English (Reading), English (Speaking), English (Writing)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-09-21 11:59 PM

CBC News is looking to hire a senior technology and AI reporter who will help us make sense of this ever important and evolving beat.

We are looking for a smart, energetic reporter who is fully immersed in the news and developments in the technology and AI landscape and has lots of contacts and connections in the industry. Whether it’s a story about how AI is being deployed or how it has changed our lives, you understand the latest trends, where the news is going, and what the impact will be. You’re able to explain this to our audiences on all platforms in an engaging and compelling way. 

As a senior reporter, you are prepared to move fast on breaking news, providing updates as they come and pivoting where required. You are confident going live (and at times, unscripted) on video, radio and on digital live story pages. You have excellent presentation skills and can explain things quickly, simply and accurately on the fly. You work well in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment. 

You are expected to pitch original stories. You have strong writing, research, and interviewing skills. You are a confident storyteller and can file on-demand pieces in text, audio and video. You craft these stories with a mobile audience in mind. You know how to engage a younger, diverse audience, and are ready to deliver. You are hungry to file stories.

Driven by curiosity and an open, inclusive mindset, you thrive in a breaking news environment and in working collaboratively and effectively with a team. 

This job is 5 days a week, full-time, with an expectation to work overtime and weekends as required. 

This is a permanent full-time position based anywhere in Canada with daily access to a CBC facility. As collaborating with teams across CBC News is a priority, you will be required to be on-site in this role. 

Here’s more details:

Key tasks:

  • Pitch stories about technology and AI that engage our target audience. Break news and follow developments.

  • Go live when the story demands it – and file into live story pages and live programming. Gather news in the field and go on location whenever possible.

  • Cover major or fast-moving events. Work well under pressure.

  • Research, interview and gather new information.

  • Craft work with a target 30-49 diverse Canadian audience in mind. Drive to develop content that will be relevant to this demographic. Make stories relatable to a general audience and explain the impact these stories have on people’s everyday lives.

  • Generate and execute journalism that elevates a range of voices and perspectives.

  • Shape scripts and file stories for all platforms. Prioritize a mobile and streaming audience. 

  • Work collaboratively with editors and vettors to sharpen writing, headlines and text.

  • Understand the elements needed to produce strong visual and audio stories. 

  • Be able to remain calm under pressure. 

  • Recognize issues of importance quickly and take effective action to ensure appropriate coverage. Prioritize demands.

  • Develop and maintain contacts with a variety of sources. Be a leader in the beat and share expertise and knowledge with colleagues.

  • Have a strong understanding of legal journalistic issues and the ethical principles of our Journalistics Standards and Practices. 

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues on the business team and other parts of the CBC.


Your profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. 

  • Minimum 10 years relevant full-time experience. 

  • Excellent understanding of the technology and AI and the impacts they have on our audience. 

  • Come with sources and contacts in the tech and AI community and beyond.

  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of the diversity within the tech beat and the diversity of our target audience

  • Experience writing, researching, fact-checking and packaging text, audio and video pieces.

  • Excellent presentation skills; comfortable reporting live and unscripted.

  • Have deep familiarity with social media and have an ability to surface trending stories.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with a team and across departments.

  • Proven ability to work in a high-stress, tight-deadline environment.

  • Experience working on multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Ability to work flexible hours and do overtime as needed.

  • Knowledge of the public broadcaster's role, responsibilities and journalistic standards.

  • University degree in journalism or equivalent preferred.

Please submit a cover letter with your resume, which will be used to help us assess your written communication. Include two examples of each of the following stories: video, audio, text, and live coverage (any format). 

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check. 

  • Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.


CBC/Radio-Canada is committed to being a leader in reflecting our country’s diversity. That’s because we can only create and tell the stories that connect Canadians, by having a workforce that mirrors the ever-changing makeup of our country. That’s why we, as an employer, value equal opportunity and nurture an inclusive workplace where our individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada’s public broadcaster. For more information, visit the Diversity and Inclusion section of our website. If you have accommodation needs at this stage of the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible by sending an e-mail to recruitment@cbc.ca.
 
You are invited to consult and familiarize yourself with our Code of Conduct, which can be found on our corporate website. All employees must adhere to the Code as a condition of employment. We also invite you to take a look at our policy on conflicts of interest. In the event that you become an employee, it will be important to inform us, as quickly as possible, of any situation that, because of your hiring, constitutes or could appear to constitute a conflict of interest.

Join the People & Culture team at CBC/Radio-Canada on an exciting journey dedicated to administering time, attendance, and compliance while maximizing and optimizing our Workday platform.   

We are currently seeking a dynamic Administrative Specialist to join our HR Services team. Our focus is ensuring all timesheets, reporting, and inquiries are handled efficiently, accurately and in a timely manner. In this role, you will bring your precision and expertise to provide crucial administrative support, resolve  complex timekeeping discrepancies, audit records for compliance, and collaborate closely with timekeepers and other People & Culture teams to continuously improve our time-tracking processes.  

Additionally, this role offers great professional growth, with opportunities to cross train with our Expertise team in managing service dates, leave banks, and complex pay analysis.

  • Collaborate closely with the Payroll and Operations teams to ensure accurate wage calculations, retroactive pay adjustments, and seamless, timely payroll processing.

  • Reconcile overtime, leave balances, holiday pay, and shift differential earnings to ensure accuracy. 

  • Provide training and support to employees and managers on timekeeping procedures and Workday system navigation.

  • Identify issues or improvement opportunities related to the Workday timekeeping module, collaborating with the Senior Specialist responsible for escalating and resolving issues with the People Systems and Analytics team. 

  • Collaborate with the HR Services Expertise Team to develop your skills and support various activities, including service date calculations, complex leave bank management, and deep-dive pay analysis.

  • Post-secondary education or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in HR, Payroll or administrative operations within CBC/Radio-Canada or similar complex organization.

  • Essential fluency in both English and French (written and spoken).

  • Exceptional attention to detail and high accuracy in data management.   

  • Hands-on experience with pay processing systems, such as Workday combined with strong knowledge of HR policies, collective agreements, and federal/provincial labour standards.

job.title: Executive Assistant to Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

The Executive Assistant will provide a wide range of administrative and project support to relieve the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of administrative tasks to increase the time they can spend attending to executive-level responsibilities. This position often participates and manages multiple projects, ensuring strong communication and collaboration with the CFO, other Ministry Leadership, and Team Members.

 

This is an onsite role in Franklin, TN

 

 

Here's some of what you will be doing...

 

  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for the CFO to include, but not limited to: development of correspondence of time sensitive and both confidential and non-confidential matters; e-mail, telephone, voicemail and other electronic messaging communication; opening and sorting mail; purchasing supplies; managing receipts and filing completion of expense reports; photocopying, scanning and faxing; maintenance of filing and records management systems, both hard copy and electronic; and other general administrative functions as needed.
  • With minimal supervision and as directed, consistently and accurately plan, conduct, lead, and complete complex assignments requiring independent action and a high degree of initiative to resolve issues. Assignments may include develop and monitor budget activities, formulating long and short-range requirements; monitor project performance and timelines; coordinate administrative activities; act in a liaison capacity with other departments, divisions, outside counsel, and other organizations; evaluate progress or results and recommend major changes in procedures and process; and interpret policies and procedures.
  • Manage and maintain calendars, coordinate schedules, and handle a variety of meeting logistics, providing individualized support for phone messages; receiving and directing visitors; organizing, scheduling, and preparing for meetings and appointments, including conference calls, with increased ability to anticipate CFO needs; and independently updating department documents as needed.
  • Understand and continued development of specific goals and plans to prioritizing, organize, and accomplish work in coordination with CFO.
  • Provide outstanding customer service. Act as the main point of contact for all internal and external inquiries, appointments, and concerns.
  • Prepare CFO for meetings, bring urgent matters to the attention of the CFO, and handle emergencies and routine matters on behalf of the CFO.
  • Prepare materials for Board presentations and plan Board meetings and events.
  • Function as Board Members’ point of contact in the absence of the CFO.
  • Work within a wide scope of responsibility, requiring awareness of departmental areas of responsibility, which may include handling all inquiries within outlined capacity in order to relieve the CFO of administrative details and to maximize the time efficiency and availability of leadership. Independently research, review, retrieve, and analyze information (station files, legal files, accounting information, contract files) and create CFO summaries, reports, and spreadsheets pertinent to projects. Learn and master statistical software programs, creating appropriate reports and analysis.
  • Complete special projects/ad hoc reports and create engaging and informative presentations utilizing multimedia and technical tools.
  • Assist in the tracking of ministry and department budgets; make recommendations based on data collected toward budgetary requirements.
  • Coordinate appropriate travel and develop itineraries, including for conferences and complex group and meeting arrangements.
  • Exercise administrative judgment on a regular and continuous basis and assume responsibility for decisions, outcomes, and results have an impact on people, costs, and/or quality of service within the functional area. Perform to earn leadership’s confidence, assuring confidential and discreet handling of all business with reliability.
  • Act as an information source on organization policies and procedures.
  • Know the formal and informal ministry and departmental goals, standards, policies and procedures, and maintain familiarity with other departments within the ministry, preserving sensitivity to the inter-relationship of both people and functions with the ministry.
  • Maintain K-LOVE polices and procedures such as time keeping, expense reporting, IT systems and software products, HR policies and procedures, etc., training staff, and regularly answering questions and/or concerns.
  • Support compliance with ministry standards by maintaining the privacy and confidentiality of information, protecting organizational assets, acting with ethics and integrity, reporting noncompliance, and adhering to applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
  • Support and contribute to ministry endeavors through following employment policies and practices and supporting a safe and healthy work environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Here's some experience and skills we are seeking...

 

  • Minimum 4-7 years’ executive level administrative experience.
  • Excellent/advanced knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures; principles and processes for providing a service-oriented environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including managing complex spreadsheets, pivot tables, and performing mail merges and specialized software as determined by the ministry.
  • Strong research skills, including the abilities to obtain research from multiple sources, conduct valid Internet research, investigate, and convey information to enable strategic decision-making, and to research and analyze a variety of complex issues and recommend solutions.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability in relation to others’ needs and priorities, using discernment to prioritize and integrate those needs with ongoing responsibilities.
  • Confidence with humility to bring creativity, initiative, and innovation to routine and non-routine situations; and ability to exercise judgment in the resolution of administrative problems.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects concurrently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Verbal comprehension, communication, and interpersonal skills in various situations. Must have strong skills in reading comprehension and written communication with the ability to produce a variety of documents based on intent and audience. Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language, including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information on a regular basis. A proven ability to maintain confidences is essential to success in this position.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills in all work-related relationships, including self-monitoring, self-assessing, and being sensitive to develop constructive and cooperative working relationships with others and maintaining them over time. Demonstrate experience in negotiating conflict and difficult situations with tact, candor, and humility.
  • Possess a professional attitude, along with a willingness to support ministry and management needs.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.

  • Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance and company paid Dental
  • Company paid life insurance and short term/long term disability insurance
  • Company 401k with a generous company match

job.title: ESPN Cleveland Account Executive
job.description:
ESPN Cleveland Marketing Consultant (Account Executive)

(Cleveland, OH)  

ESPN Cleveland is looking for our next high-performing Marketing Consultant to join one of Cleveland’s leading sports media brands. You’ll help local, regional and national brands connect with passionate Cleveland sports fans through customized marketing partnerships across ESPN Cleveland audio, digital content, social media and live events. 
 
As a Marketing Consultant, you’ll build relationships with advertising partners, understand their business goals and develop creative solutions that leverage the power of ESPN Cleveland. You’ll bring together the right ideas and assets to create meaningful partnerships that help our partners grow their businesses.

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with local, regional and national brands and decision-makers.
  • Build, grow and maintain strong partner relationships focused on achieving their business and marketing objectives.
  • Understand each partner’s goals and challenges and develop customized marketing solutions across ESPN Cleveland audio, digital content, social media and live events.
  • Collaborate with ESPN Cleveland’s Digital Marketing Consultants to develop integrated solutions that help partners achieve their business goals.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to uncover additional partnership opportunities across Good Karma Sports and connect partners with the right teammates and solutions.
  • Communicate and collaborate with sales support teammates to effectively manage partner relationships, campaign execution and follow-through.
  • Develop a strong understanding of ESPN Cleveland’s audiences, content and marketing assets and connect those opportunities to partner needs.
  • Proactively manage new business activity, leads, opportunities and partner follow-through through our internal CRM.
  • Stay current on sports marketing, media and emerging industry trends.
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve new business outreach, partner research, campaign development, communication and sales effectiveness while maintaining a high level of personalization and partner interaction.
  • Other assigned tasks.
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the company core values: Listen, Be Honest, Follow Through, Teamwork, Work Hard and Over Deliver.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications 

  • Previous sales, business development or marketing experience and a passion for sales and service.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage decision-makers at all levels.
  • Goal-oriented and creative self-starter with a strong sense of responsibility and accountability.
  • Strong network and relationships within the Cleveland business community, or the ability to develop them.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently.
  • Willingness to accept and provide feedback and continuously learn and grow.
  • With this career, you are required to hold a valid driver’s license

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is an exempt role with a competitive base salary plus commission. This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for salary growth based on increased skills and responsibilities and meeting targeted goals. The position will be required to work some evenings and weekends based on station events, promotions, and community activities.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than September 18, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Outside Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes

  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments

  • Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs

  • Ease working with senior level executives and using influencing skills to negotiations and drive sales

  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust

  • Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information

  • Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members

  • Business development experience with new and existing customers

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: General Sales Manager - WHIO TV
job.description:
Location: OH-Dayton

Job Title:  General Sales Manager - WHIO TV

 

Position Overview

WHIO-TV is looking for an inspiring sales leader to join our nationally renowned team. As the longtime top CBS affiliate in the country, WHIO-TV requires a strategist to maximize the monetization of our highly successful brands. Our TV, digital and radio station collaboration is well established and comes with unique cross-platform marketing opportunity.

 

At Cox Media Group (CMG), our team comprises top talent and high performers. We are united in our approach to competing with our products and winning with our people.

 

The successful candidate for the General Sales Manager position (GSM) will have exemplary skills to inspire, coach, and influence others. The GSM will lead the advertising sales department and support other sales leaders. Together, they will develop creative advertising campaigns that can be executed seamlessly across multiple media platforms, in turn creating success for our customers and business results.

 

The GSM will place significant focus on consumer insights, market research, trends, and specific client challenges. Ensure advertising campaigns are custom-designed and deliver a sufficient return on investment for clients.

 

The GSM will lead client and sales meetings and market events, including developing advertising seminars and B2B marketing strategies. While most of their attention will be to work with the advertising sales team and advertisers, the GSM will partner with the Local Programming team. Together, they are developing effective marketing campaigns for our top-rated radio stations.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading integrated campaign development, strong collaboration skills, a strong work ethic, a proven management background, and experience with multiple media platforms. A successful background in recruiting and managing talented account executives is preferred.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Coaches, leads, and inspires the sales team to exceed business goals
  • Integrated Marketing and Sales Advocate
  • Establishes and executes a revenue strategy to maximize our assets and revenue potential
  • Achieves revenue goals by developing and supervising the CMG sales team
  • Develops advertising campaigns tailored to advertiser needs and objectives and executes across multiple media platforms
  • Develops strategy, designs, and activation plan for advertiser events and promotions
  • Responsible for leading seamless collaboration between the sales and programming teams to ensure the market achieves optimal audience engagement and delivers strong advertiser results
  • Exercises independent judgment in allocating resources to programs is likely to yield the best results
  • Partners with Program Directors to develop and implement external and internal marketing strategies, communications, and public relations activities
  • Leads the creative process, including brainstorming and designing campaigns
  • Develops insights and strategies from consumer research
  • Drives critical thinking about brand and product strategy
  • Drives new-business development across all platforms

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years leading a team in at least one of the following areas: marketing, advertising agency, digital media, or media sales
  • Proven track record of developing unique advertising campaigns and promotions for advertisers across radio formats and across multiple media, including digital and social media platforms
  • Strong track record of developing strategic priorities and action plans, and of achieving results
  • Proven understanding of the competitive media landscape
  • Highly successful at leading collaboration and cross-departmental processes
  • Proven success in developing integrated marketing concepts and campaigns across multiple media platforms
  • Experienced problem solver; brainstorming and marketing strategy facilitation
  • Strong relationships and networking skills are essential
  • Must have a valid driver's license and a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, equivalent work experience, and abilities considered

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Internal Auditor
job.description:
Department Finance Location Montreal

At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and cutting-edge technology are the pillars of our DNA. Keen on joining a team of tech-savvy music lovers in a stimulating and fun work environment?    

Within the Finance team, the Internal Auditor plays a key role in strengthening our control environment, continuously improving our processes, and proactively managing risks.

In parallel, this position has a strong technological component: evaluating IT General Controls (ITGC) and collaborating with IT teams to ensure the integrity and security of our financial data.

Your day-to-day

  • Act as the primary point of contact for the 52-109 compliance program
  • Lead the design, implementation, and rigorous maintenance of Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
  • Assess the effectiveness of internal controls as well as IT General Controls (ITGC)
  • Analyze, document, and recommend improvements to business and technological processes
  • Identify risks, formulate pragmatic recommendations, and support teams (Finance, IT, Operations) in implementing action plans to address gaps
  • Participate in the assessment of control risks during the implementation of new systems, applications, or technology partnerships
  • Prepare clear and structured audit reports to present findings to stakeholders
  • Support the annual financial statement audit: coordination, information gathering, document preparation, and responding to external auditors’ requests
  • Collaborate with various teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement and implement best control practices

 

Your qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in auditing (internal and/or external), with significant experience in 52-109 or SOX compliance
  • Proven, hands-on experience in evaluating IT General Controls (ITGC)
  • High level of rigor, attention to detail, and ability to structure information in a manner that is audit-ready for external auditors
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and ability to simplify technical concepts for financial and operational audiences
  • Bilingual (French/English)

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Relevant professional designation (e.g., CISA, CIA, or CPA with strong IT experience)
  • Knowledge of IT governance and security frameworks
  • Experience in process improvement (Lean, control optimization, automation)

Key Skills

  • Analytical mindset, professional judgment, and strong prioritization skills
  • Autonomy, cross-team collaboration, and a business partner mindset
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously

 

Life at Stingray

  • A cool office in Montreal with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays
  • Stingray café with breakfasts, lunches and snacks offered every day
  • A subsidy for your OPUS card to make your commutes easier
  • Shares purchase plan (with a contribution from Stingray)
  • Full access to the Dialogue virtual healthcare platform (including an EAP)
  • Free fitness classes offered weekly
  • Access to private consultations on nutrition and wellness
  • Free language classes, training and access to the latest AI technologies and platforms to boost your productivity and creativity
  • Summer hours
  • Milestones celebrated with our loyalty program
  • 5@7 and vibrant social events
  • And much more!

We leverage AI‑supported tools to assist with the initial review of applications. These tools do not replace human judgment—final decisions are made by our recruitment teams.

Montreal-based Stingray Group is a leading music, media and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. Our offices are located in the Old Port of Montreal just minutes from the Lachine Canal bike path, a prime location for picnics or a jog at lunch time.

Stingray supports the principles of Employment Equity and is committed to ensuring our workforce is representative of the communities we serve and in which we operate. job.title: Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy
job.description:

In this role, you will partner closely with League and Club stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions and program operations that enable informed decision-making and drive business outcomes across global markets.

The ideal candidate brings 6 - 8+ years of experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering centralized, enterprise-scale initiatives. You will work hands-on across data strategy, technology, and program execution—owning delivery, driving cross-functional alignment, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring scalable, high-quality outputs.

This role is well-suited for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, excels at stakeholder management, and is passionate about leveraging data to unlock value and build scalable enterprise capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Drive cross-functional alignment and champion adoption of the International managed model through clear communication, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Program Management: Oversee day-to-day program operations for the international managed model, tracking progress across data onboarding, curation, fulfillment, reporting and insights.
  • Customer Partnership: Partner closely with clubs to drive adoption of the international managed model by capturing requirements and translating them into prioritized program initiatives.
  • Data Product Architecture: Translate business needs into scalable data and platform requirements to support segmentation, data access, and performance measurement.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure efficient and consistent execution by establishing standardized processes and continuously optimizing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 6 - 8+ years of progressive experience in data strategy, product management, data governance, or technology leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale initiatives.
  • Proven track record leading complex data and analytics programs, including cloud data platforms, data lakes, governance frameworks, and cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Strong understanding of privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, consent management, and responsible data practices.
  • Experience supporting fan, customer, or consumer-centric organizations, with knowledge of engagement strategies, audience development, and lifecycle marketing preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging enterprise data and marketing technology platforms, including AWS Redshift, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, drive alignment across business and technology teams, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes.

job.description:
Are you passionate about technology and helping people solve problems? Join Scripps as an End User Computing Technician II, where you'll play a vital role in ensuring our employees have seamless access to the technology they need to excel in their work. In this hands-on position, you'll provide critical technical support across a wide range of technologies from desktops and laptops to printers, scanners, and mobile devices. You'll work with diverse operating systems including Windows, MacOS, and Linux, while collaborating with talented teams to implement innovative solutions.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love making a difference through technology, this is your opportunity to shine!


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide technical support: Respond to service desk tickets, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and providing technical assistance to end-users.

  • Install and configure hardware and software: install, configure, and maintain hardware and software on end-user devices such as desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and other peripherals.

  • Maintain and update system, ensure that software and operating systems are up to date and free from bugs and malware.

  • Diagnose and repair hardware issues. Identify hardware problems and make necessary repairs, such as replacing hard drives, motherboards, and memory.

  • May provide training and support to employees on how to use hardware and software effectively.

  • Document support activities: Keep detailed records of support activities, including issues resolved, hardware and software installed, and troubleshoot steps taken via the Scripps incident management system.

  • Maintain an inventory of all hardware and software assets and ensuring that they are up to date.

  • Collaborate with other Scripps Technology teams to resolve complex issues and implement new technologies.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • High School Diploma preferred

  • Generally 1-3 years of desktop experience

  • Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician (MCDST), or similar certifications desired


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Working knowledge of hardware, software, and operating systems such as Windows, macOS, and Linux

  • Working knowledge of Azure, Entra, Intune, Jamf, and similar enterprise tools is desired.

  • Familiarity with Dell/HP and Mac laptops

  • Familiarity with network protocols, troubleshooting techniques, and diagnostic tools

  • Strong communication skills and working effectively with employees to understand and resolve technical issues

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and in a team environment

  • Ability to document technical support activities and maintain accurate records.

  • Requires the ability to sit for long periods of time, listen and converse over the telephone and frequently type on a computer (4 or more hours per day).

  • Requires the ability to work shifts outside of normal working hours including holidays, weekends, and evenings.

job.title: Solutions Marketing Associate
job.description:
The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations.

For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings.

This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting.

The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared.

What You’ll Do

Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support

  • Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories.

  • Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach.

  • Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage.

  • Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests.

  • Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters.

  • Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings.

  • Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support.

Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support

  • Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity.

  • Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points.

  • Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch.

  • Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant.

  • Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging.

  • Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager.

Sales Alignment & Enablement

  • Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points.

  • Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate.

  • Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team.

  • Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out.

  • Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations.

  • Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development.

  • Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers.

  • The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support.

What You Bring

  • 1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role.

  • Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges.

  • Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment.

  • Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs.

  • Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast-turn requests.

  • A proactive, service-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed.

  • Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus.

  • Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

We are in a high-growth phase, integrating innovative tech from recent acquisitions. You will have a seat at the table to influence our long-term technical strategy and help us "build and scale" for the future.

job.title: Solutions Marketing Manager
job.description:
The Solutions Marketing Manager leads the team responsible for turning customer challenges into insight-led, differentiated solutions. This role is both a people leader and a senior strategic partner to Sales, setting the standard for how the organization approaches complex opportunities, RFPs/RFIs, and high-priority client conversations.

Rather than starting with a product or a predetermined activation, the Manager starts with the customer: What are they trying to accomplish? What does the market tell us? Which combination of capabilities can best address the challenge? And what is the most compelling story for why Digital Remedy can solve it?

The Manager owns the strategic approach for the most complex opportunities while building a team and operating model that gives Sales the right level of support across the pipeline.

What You’ll Do

Lead Customer & Opportunity Strategy

  • Partner with Sales on complex, strategic, and high-value opportunities to identify the underlying customer business and marketing challenge.

  • Lead problem-led solution development that combines multiple products, audiences, platforms, media types, and services around specific customer needs.

  • Define the strategic angle, narrative architecture, and recommendation for major pitches, RFPs, and RFIs.

  • Challenge briefs and assumptions constructively when a stronger strategic approach can improve the opportunity.

  • Translate customer objectives, audiences, KPIs, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations.

Build Strategic Narratives & Solutions

  • Develop executive-level client narratives that connect challenge, insight, strategy, solution, proof, and expected outcome.

  • Ensure recommendations are integrated solutions rather than collections of disconnected capabilities.

  • Lead custom research and insight development where it can materially strengthen the strategy.

  • Simplify complex capabilities into persuasive stories for senior client and agency audiences.

  • Lead quarterly business reviews for top strategic accounts, setting the standard for how the team frames performance, insight, and forward-looking recommendations that shape the client relationship.

Lead the Solutions Marketing Team

  • Manage, coach, and develop the Solutions Marketing Analyst and Solutions Marketing Associate.

  • Establish intake, prioritization, routing, and quality standards so the team deploys strategic resources where they can have the greatest revenue impact.

  • Create clear escalation paths from scalable sales support to custom strategy and executive-level opportunity support.

  • Build the team’s skills in customer discovery, research, storytelling, strategic thinking, presentation development, and sales partnership.

  • Measure team impact through pipeline support, meetings created, opportunity outcomes, turnaround time, and seller adoption, not presentation volume alone.

Partner Across Marketing & Sales

  • Work closely with the Marketing Manager, Product & Enablement to apply established positioning, messaging, GTM frameworks, proof points, and foundational materials to customer-specific opportunities.

  • Provide feedback from live opportunities to Product & Enablement on recurring customer needs, competitive themes, content gaps, and emerging solution opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Research, Product, Creative, and other subject-matter experts to assemble the right expertise around priority opportunities.

  • Advocate for earlier Solutions Marketing involvement so the team helps shape recommendations rather than simply package decisions already made.

What Success Looks Like

  • Solutions Marketing is viewed by Sales as a strategic partner, not a production resource.

  • Priority pitches and RFP/RFI responses lead with customer problems and insights rather than product capabilities.

  • The team provides differentiated levels of support efficiently across the pipeline.

  • Sellers bring Solutions Marketing into important opportunities earlier in the process.

  • Team support contributes to stronger client conversations, pipeline progression, and revenue outcomes.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions marketing, integrated marketing, media strategy, sales strategy, brand strategy, agency planning, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling narratives.

  • Experience leading RFPs, RFIs, major pitches, or complex client proposals.

  • Strong research, analytical, storytelling, and executive presentation skills.

  • Ability to connect multiple products and capabilities into cohesive customer solutions.

  • Strong commercial instincts and a collaborative, consultative approach to partnering with Sales.

  • People management or demonstrated team leadership experience.

  • Experience in media, advertising, agencies, ad tech, or B2B marketing is a plus.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
The Senior Data Engineer is a highly hands-on individual contributor responsible for building, operating, and improving Sinclair's enterprise data platform. This is a Snowflake-first engineering role: most of the work is performed within Snowflake and its native ecosystem. The role spans ingestion, integration, transformation, data modeling, data quality, observability, performance, cost optimization, and production support, with particular emphasis on Snowflake-native development and Snowflake Openflow.


The ideal candidate has approximately five years of progressive data engineering experience with substantial Snowflake depth, strong SQL and Python skills, and a track record of delivering reliable, well-governed data solutions in a complex enterprise setting.

This position is on-site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.


Responsibilities


Snowflake Engineering & Data Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain production-grade data pipelines using Snowflake-native capabilities including Snowpipe, streams, tasks, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Build scalable ELT patterns and bronze/silver/gold data models that make enterprise data reliable, reusable, and easy to consume.
  • Develop SQL and Python solutions for transformation, automation, orchestration, validation, and operational workflows.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable, maintainable fixes.


Snowflake Openflow & Enterprise Integrations

  • Build, configure, operate, and troubleshoot Snowflake Openflow pipelines and connectors for enterprise data ingestion and replication.
  • Develop and support integrations from relational databases, Oracle environments, traffic and operational systems, CRM platforms, and other enterprise sources.
  • Implement API-based and vendor integrations using secure stages, external access integrations, authentication, and appropriate Snowflake ingestion patterns.
  • Modernize legacy ETL by moving appropriate workloads to Openflow and Snowflake-native ELT patterns that improve reliability, maintainability, and efficiency.


Data Quality, Reliability & Observability

  • Build data quality and validation controls covering completeness, accuracy, freshness, reconciliation, and integration health.
  • Develop monitoring and observability for ingestion, pipeline execution, data freshness, failures, and other operational conditions.
  • Design pipelines for resilience, restartability, traceability, and maintainability, with clear operational ownership and documentation.

Platform Engineering, Performance & Governance

  • Work deeply with Snowflake databases, schemas, warehouses, stages, integrations, roles, and other platform objects required to deliver production data solutions.
  • Optimize queries, pipelines, warehouses, and data structures for performance and cost using actual workload and usage patterns.
  • Apply appropriate access controls, environment separation, data protection, auditability, and governance practices in partnership with Security and data owners.
  • Identify technical debt, reliability risks, unnecessary spend, and opportunities to simplify or standardize solutions.


Data Products & Engineering Collaboration

  • Build governed data foundations for enterprise reporting, analytics, operational workflows, and emerging AI and data-product use cases.
  • Develop reusable data assets that support analytics applications, semantic layers, agents, and other consumption patterns without duplicating business logic.
  • Participate in technical design, code reviews, releases, production support, and continuous improvement; use Git, automated deployment, testing, and documentation practices.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, BI, Data Science, Security, Infrastructure, Finance, and business stakeholders to deliver practical, supportable solutions.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • Approximately five or more years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Deep, hands-on Snowflake experience building and supporting production data solutions in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience in data modeling, ELT/ETL development, query optimization, and production troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake-native capabilities such as Snowpipe, streams, tasks, stored procedures, and related engineering patterns.
  • Experience building production integrations across multiple source systems and business domains, plus strong Python skills for engineering, automation, APIs, or Snowflake development.
  • Experience with data quality, monitoring, observability, access controls, and governance in a production environment.
  • Experience with Git-based source control, code review, deployment practices, and modern software engineering approaches; strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and ownership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Snowflake Openflow and NiFi-based connectors for enterprise data replication and integration.
  • Snowflake certification such as SnowPro Core, Advanced Data Engineer, or Advanced Administrator.
  • Experience modernizing legacy ETL platforms into Snowflake-native and Openflow architectures.
  • Experience with Snowflake performance tuning, warehouse sizing, workload optimization, resource monitoring, cost management, data sharing, or secure data distribution.
  • Experience with external access integrations, OAuth, API integrations, notification patterns, or data quality/operational observability solutions.
  • Experience with enterprise financial, customer, CRM, advertising, traffic, media, audience, or operational data; familiarity with Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence is a plus.


Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to do meaningful, hands-on data engineering at the center of an enterprise Snowflake environment that directly supports how the business operates, measures performance, serves customers, and makes decisions. You will work on real production data problems across Snowflake, Openflow, enterprise integrations, data quality, automation, and emerging AI capabilities. If you enjoy building things that work, taking ownership of production systems, solving complex data challenges, and continuously improving a modern data platform, this role is built for you.

Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.
