job.title: Senior Director, Legal Operations
job.description:
The Legal Department at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Senior Director of Legal Operations to join our team!

The Senior Director of Legal Operations is the operational, technical and business management leader for the Legal department, partnering with Legal leadership to establish and execute the department’s operating strategy and drive efficiency, scalability, financial discipline and continuous improvement. 

In this position you will help develop, refine and promote the legal department’s short and long-term operations plan, including managing law firm and third-party vendor management programs, optimizing financial resources leveraging technology and supporting the development and implementation of a sound annual plan.

The role will report to the SVP, Chief Privacy Officer and Head of Legal Operations, and will serve as key business partner to Legal team leadership.  This position will interface with Finance, HR and other cross-functional partners across the team and company to drive meaningful operational improvements.

ABOUT YOU:

You are a strategic Legal Operations leader who combines strong business acumen with deep operational and technical expertise. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations, independently identifying opportunities for improvement, and translating strategy into practical execution.

You bring strong project and relationship management skills and have a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, manage complex initiatives, negotiate with external partners, and build scalable processes. You are data- and technology-savvy, curious about emerging AI capabilities, and able to identify where technology can meaningfully improve the effectiveness and efficiency of a Legal department.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Provide creative thinking to help identify and develop cutting-edge strategies for increasing value and reducing outside legal spend, while maintaining excellent legal representation and optimizing engagement practices with our law firms.
  • Manage other strategic plans or initiatives to make the legal department more efficient, as delegated by the SVP, Chief Privacy Officer and Head of Legal Operations, and other Legal team leadership.
  • Create metrics and monitor progress to measure success against strategic plans.
  • Benchmark both internally and externally to stay on top of current trends and emerging and best practices and opportunities to improve the team’s operating model and performance.

Finance and Budget Management

  • Partner with Legal leadership, finance and procurement to develop and manage the legal annual operating plan and all department budgets. Work as primary interface between the legal department and finance.
  • Identify, collect, and report on key performance indicators and metrics on a global basis that are meaningful and relevant in ascertaining the legal team’s budget management performance, including spend analysis, efficiency initiatives and technology.
  • Manage and develop Billing Supervisor and oversee Legal billing operations and related processes.

Legal Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence

  • Lead the Legal department’s technology and AI strategy, identifying opportunities to leverage existing and emerging technologies to improve productivity, automate processes, enhance knowledge management, reduce costs and mitigate risks.
  • Assess and implement technology (e.g., matter management, knowledge management, Evisort, ethics and compliance, document management, electronic billing and compliance systems), including tools with AI-enable functionality, to streamline operations, improve cost effectiveness and implement best in class systems and processes.
  • Lead continuous process improvement initiatives and work with IT on automation as needed.
  • Work closely with selected electronic billing provider to implement system enhancements, run detailed reports within the software tool and create spend dashboards.

Outside Counsel and Legal Vendor Management

  • Update and manage master retention agreements, billing guidelines, and pricing models for outside counsel.
  • Develop tracking and reporting systems to monitor pricing performance and savings across engagements.
  • Manage relationships with outside counsel and vendors, including conducting RFPs and negotiating fee arrangements.

Communications & Administration

  • Align legal workflows with department priorities to increase efficiency, leveraging technology.
  • Manage new hire onboarding in collaboration with HR, training, and policy implementation for the legal team.
  • Collaborate with HR, IT, and other departments on company-wide initiatives.

Talent Management and Education

  • Track and maintain records for Continuing Legal Education (CLE) requirements for all lawyers
  • Manage and provide regular CLE programming, both live and asynchronously, for Department lawyers.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Business, Finance or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 15 plus years of total work experience in operations or law firm management, ten years in legal operations.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic and operational plans and delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, quality, and service.
  • In-depth understanding of law firm billing, pricing and compensation practices
  • Demonstrated experience with alternative fee arrangement cost modeling
  • At least two years' experience evaluating, implementing and using legal technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions (including contract lifecycle management, electronic billing and ediscovery), with a demonstrated ability to translate technology capabilities into meaningful business improvements and cost efficiencies.
  • Technology- and AI-savvy; proficient in all Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel; expertise with electronic billing and contract management software.

This position supports the EVP of Theatrical Marketing and two SVPs of Marketing Strategy across a high-volume slate of theatrical film campaigns. The role sits at the center of the theatrical marketing organization, coordinating across senior executives, filmmakers, talent representatives, internal marketing disciplines and external partners.

Job Title

Executive Director, Account Strategy

Job Description

About Your Role

People Inc. is looking for an Executive Director of Account Strategy to lead our Health vertical. This is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing a team of Account Strategists supporting our pharmaceutical and healthcare advertising business and driving revenue retention and growth through best-in-class client strategy, campaign management, and operational excellence.

With a focus on solutions, critical thinking, and analytical rigor, you are a proven leader who can successfully navigate the complexities of the health and pharmaceutical advertising landscape. You will serve as a senior strategic partner across Sales, Marketing, Ad Operations, Campaign Analytics, Research & Measurement, Product, Data, and other key functions, ensuring our programs are positioned for success from pre-sale strategy through execution, optimization, measurement, and renewal.

You understand that strong Account Strategy goes beyond campaign execution. You will help your team identify opportunities to improve performance, deepen client partnerships, grow revenue, and evolve our Health advertising capabilities. You are a growth-oriented, positive self-starter who proactively identifies ways to improve processes, increase efficiency, solve complex business challenges, and continually raise the standard of client service across the Health organization.

Hybrid 3x a week- (NYC, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

The Health vertical partners with leading healthcare and pharmaceutical clients to develop and execute advertising solutions that reach both consumers (DTC) and healthcare professionals (HCPs). The business operates within a highly dynamic and regulated industry, requiring a strong understanding of evolving health and pharma trends, client priorities, audience behaviors, and regulatory and compliance requirements that impact healthcare advertising. The team must stay closely connected to changes across the marketplace to anticipate client needs, identify emerging opportunities, and ensure our solutions continue to meet the unique needs and standards of healthcare and pharma marketers.

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

70%

Business & Client Leadership — Lead the Account Strategy function to drive client success, revenue retention and growth, and operational excellence. Partner with Sales and cross-functional leaders to address business needs, identify growth opportunities, and build scalable processes that improve performance and efficiency.

30%

People & Organizational Leadership — Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing Account Strategy organization, creating clear expectations, accountability and opportunities for growth. Coach and develop managers and individual contributors, proactively assess talent and organizational needs, and build structures that support the evolving needs of the business

  • Lead and develop the Health Account Strategy team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, strategic thinking, client service, and deep expertise across the pharmaceutical and healthcare business.

  • Serve as a senior strategic partner to Health Sales leadership, helping drive revenue retention, renewals, incremental opportunities, and long-term account growth across key clients and agency partners.

  • Develop deep expertise across the Health portfolio, including DTC and HCP advertising solutions, branded and unbranded programs, custom content, audience targeting, programmatic activation, and measurement offerings.

  • Ensure the team understands the unique requirements and complexities of pharmaceutical advertising and can confidently navigate client, agency, regulatory, operational, and measurement considerations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, systems, and work products, creating greater efficiency and scalability as the Health business grows.

  • Provide strategic recommendations that help evolve our advertising product suite, measurement capabilities, client deliverables, and overall Health offering.

  • Build strong partnerships across the sales support teams.

  • Lead regular team meetings, training, and development opportunities to ensure the Account Strategy organization maintains strong expertise across Health products, systems, processes, measurement solutions, and industry trends.

  • Own the Performance Center of Excellence including campaign reporting and measurement, ensuring the team can confidently analyze first- and third-party data, identify meaningful trends, develop actionable insights, and translate performance into compelling client stories.

  • Ensure the team consistently connects campaign performance back to client objectives and broader business outcomes, moving beyond reporting metrics to delivering meaningful strategic recommendations.

  • Proactively communicate business, campaign, and client needs to senior management and cross-functional partners, identifying risks early and driving solutions before they impact the client or revenue.

  • Partner with Health leadership to identify broader trends across clients and campaigns and translate those learnings into new products, capabilities, processes, and commercial opportunities.

  • Represent Account Strategy as a senior leader within the Health organization, helping shape how People Inc. continues to evolve and grow its pharmaceutical and healthcare advertising business.

Education:

Bachelor's Degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience within digital media, advertising, publishing, or an advertising agency; pharmaceutical, healthcare, or health media experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex, high-value advertising partnerships. Relationships with clients, agencies, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 5:00 pm EST on Friday, September 18th, 2026

Intro to Position

The Office of Transformation is responsible for leading the design and execution of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across NPR to support our ambitious goals for audience growth and enhanced Network collaboration. The Project Manager functions as the central operational coordinator within the Office of Transformation. Tasked with steering high-priority initiatives, this role oversees complex transition timelines, coordinates deliverables between multiple independent teams, and ensures all project milestones are hit on schedule. This position requires a collaborative, detail-driven leader who can seamlessly bridge operational gaps between technical, financial, and station relations functions. 

Responsibilities

  • Timeline & Milestone Enforcement: Design, monitor, and manage the master project roadmaps for critical Transformation initiatives, driving accountability across cross-functional streams.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary operational connector between the Office of Transformation and other NPR and NPM teams, for operational support on NPR’s Transformation effort.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project dependencies, flag operational bottlenecks, and work with stakeholders to implement solutions to keep projects moving forward on time.
  • Status Reporting & Governance: Maintain real-time status dashboards and reports, facilitate meetings, and package project updates for institutional leadership.
  • Coordination Support: Assist the SVP of Transformation in coordinating projects and resources across NPR teams to further our Transformation goals.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 3-5  years of dedicated professional project management experience steering enterprise-level transitions or systems implementations.
  • Demonstrated experience using advanced project management tracking methodologies, software, and dashboarding tools.
  • Proven success directing cross-departmental teams where deliverables depend on multiple matrixed stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior project management experience within a media organization, membership association, or non-profit system.

The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C.  location at least 10 days a year. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Connect (SiriusXM CV) is a leading provider of connected services to vehicle manufacturers, delivering one of the most broadly adopted connected vehicle platforms in North America for the last 25 years. Named the 2020 Company of the Year in the Telematics Industry by Frost & Sullivan, we provide safety, security and convenience services to millions of vehicle owners across major automotive brands. Our teams are continuously working to develop leading-edge technology that can not only add convenience to the daily lives of so many drivers across the country but our advancements in safety and security could also help save their lives.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Contact Center Revenue Generation Supervisor is responsible for the daily management of a remote Retention Specialist team in the SiriusXM Connect contact center.  Responsibilities include ensuring an exceptional customer experience is provided during the sales process, achieving sales and contact center metrics, coaching and developing team members, motivating and recognizing team members, as well as hiring, onboarding new employees, and fostering an environment based on engagement, teamwork, collaboration, and cohesiveness.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead a team of contact center agents toward the achievement of the established goals for sales, retention, quality, and call handling results.
  • Consistently monitor team performance through reporting scorecards and call listening/audits, proactively identify issues, share trends/opportunities, and implement action plans when targets are not being achieved.
  • Provide constant recognition to their team to keep the environment fun and rewarding.
  • Engage with team members through video calls, Slack, videos, email, and other activities numerous times per day fostering a strong team and individual relationships.
  • Provide in-depth behavior-based coaching via video call and documents sessions with agreed upon actions.
  • Administer progressive discipline or terminate employment when attendance or desired performance targets are not being achieved or there is a violation of company policy.
  • Participate with the recruiting process by interviewing candidates and making hiring decisions.
  • Share process changes, new initiatives, system changes, or other pertinent information to their team members.

job.title: Editor, Weekend Audience
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is looking for an editor to help lead our teams across our flagship social accounts and search, with a focus on weekend programming. A successful candidate for this role will bring expertise in all things audience growth off-platform, including search and social platforms as well as emerging ones, a strong sense of news judgment and audience signals, as well as a keen eye for off-platform photos, graphics and videos.

The editor will help establish a vision for shaping and targeting our journalism for different platforms to ensure that the full breadth of Times journalism finds audiences on weekends. This role bridges tactical execution and high-level strategy. Leading the work of a small team of off-platform editors during the weekends, you will work story by story — including helping to program our social accounts — and think more broadly about the mix of our off-platform social report, and how it should or should not differ from the weekday to the weekends. You will also have a hands-on role in ensuring our journalism appears across high-demand topics for users who seek news, but haven't yet made The Times their destination for news.

This person will work Wednesday through Sunday.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Play a lead role in shaping our weekend social report off-platform. This will include leading the work of social editors to develop effective ways to share Times journalism off-platform, as well as helping to execute those strategies day to day and week to week

  • Conduct daily performance tracking and detailed analysis to identify immediate content opportunities and necessary optimizations.

  • Systematically translate complex changes and day-to-day observations into clear, timely, and actionable editorial SEO recommendations and best practices for various newsroom teams.

  • Help to lead our weekend report off-platform, ensuring that priorities are shared on key platforms where they are most likely to find audiences and helping to organize broader plans for signature enterprise stories and other priority projects.

  • Monitor on-site and off-platform conversations and signals for story ideas.

  • Developing, refining and upholding the voice of The Times on all of our off-platform channels, exhibiting excellent news judgment and audience-sensitive framing.

  • Interpreting data and signals to know what pieces are the right fit for what audiences both on and off our platforms.

  • Working with journalists in the newsroom on best social media and SEO practices, including framing pieces for specific audiences.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to the Audience Deputy, Off-Platform.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in social media, SEO or digital journalism for a news organization

  • Excellent news and editorial judgment and exceptional editing skills

  • Proven track record of identifying real time coverage opportunities using internal data and external audience signals

  • Consistent record running social accounts and/or search optimization for major news outlets, both in a hands-on way as an editor and in a supervisory role

job.title: Senior Creative Strategist
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

Senior Creative Strategists develop original media strategies, brand narratives, and strategic platforms and ideas, codified into thoughtful proposals to share with partners across industries and markets, focusing on New York, DC, Africa, and Gulf regions. In this role, you will be expected to understand your clients’ priorities and challenges, and authoritatively operationalize cross-functional processes to develop best-in-class presentations and proposal deliverables. This role will work closely with other Creative Strategists on the team as well as the Sales team, Revenue Operations team, and broader marketing teams. 

Your Responsibilities

  • Create and visually design thoughtful, strategic, and engaging proposals, typically in visual presentation format, that clearly and concisely communicate ideas/concepts that map back to key advertiser objectives and KPIs.
  • Be a subject matter expert on Semafor’s brand and products. Understand and build on Semafor’s brand story on behalf of clients.
  • Engage with genuine curiosity and interest in deeply understanding clients’ brand challenges, priorities, and objectives.
  • Utilize research and data to articulate and support strategies and creative ideas.
  • Take a lead role, driving processes and operationalizing the organization with sales leads and post-sale teams, ensuring consistency in pre-to post-sale transition.
  • Show a clear and convincing connection between a client’s brand challenge and proposed partnership solutions.
  • Leverage a solid understanding of the media landscape, including expertise in new and emerging media platforms as well as off-platform opportunities, to elevate the ideas we present to clients.
  • Lead brainstorms both internally with cross-functional teams, client partnership leads, agencies, and clients to clarify asks, gather critical intel, and craft winning proposals.
  • Work directly with Semafor leadership on high-profile C-Suite pitches and presentations.
  • Demonstrate strong presentation skills in both internal and external client meetings — articulating strategic ideas with clarity and confidence, and representing the Semafor brand with polish and authority.

What makes you qualified

  • Bachelor's degree plus a minimum of 4-6 years of experience in advertiser marketing or sales.
  • Excellent communication, design, presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, and the ability to manage many different work streams at once.
  • Experience developing brand, creative, or marketing strategies for clients — especially blue-chip B2B organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate revenue through marketing strategies.
  • Approaches revenue opportunities with curiosity, ingenuity, and originality.
  • Feels deep ownership of their work.
  • This is an in-person role, with 4 days a week expected in our New York or Washington D.C. office. There may be some travel on an as-needed basis. 
  • Must have advanced skills with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Google Slides/Powerpoint.

Additional Job Details

This position is based in New York, NY or DC. Candidates must be willing to work flexible hours and travel domestically and internationally on an as-needed basis.

Salary Range: $115K-$135K base annual salary.  Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc.

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.

job.title: Sr Data Engineer (Data Architecture and Modeling)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview and Responsibilities:

 

The Signal Intelligence (SigInt) team turns a high-volume, multi-source data ecosystem — operational systems, client-app event streams, ad-tech platforms, stitcher events, ad server logs, and telemetry — into the trusted data models, metrics, and dashboards that drive business, product, and ad-ops decisions.

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer who is, in equal measure, a data modeler, a SQL craftsperson, and an analyst — not only a pipeline builder. You will own data end-to-end: modeling raw events into conformed, analytics-ready marts; writing the analytical SQL that answers hard business questions; defining the metrics leadership relies on; and building the pipelines that feed it all. Because we sit close to the business, translating ambiguous questions into durable models and clear insight matters as much as engineering the pipeline.

In practice, you will be the team's data sherpa — the person who knows the data terrain cold, guides analysts and business partners through it, and turns an ambiguous “can we find out X?” into a trusted, well-modeled answer. You own the map — the definitions, lineage, and the “why” behind the numbers — as much as the pipelines.

This is an analytics-engineering role on a semi-business team. It is not a pure platform / infrastructure position — if your passion is exclusively distributed-systems plumbing with little interest in modeling, analysis, or guiding the business, this will not be the right fit.

 

Responsibilities Include:

 

Modeling & architecture — the core of the role

• Design and own the dimensional and semantic models — conformed dimensions, facts, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions (Type 2), and well-defined grain — that serve as the trusted source of truth.

• Architect data marts spanning operational, advertising, and telemetry domains for analytics, reporting, AI, and operational use.

• Establish shared definitions and a semantic / metrics layer so users, sessions, devices, content, campaigns, and impressions mean the same thing everywhere.

SQL & analysis

• Write and optimize sophisticated analytical SQL — window functions, cohort and funnel logic, sessionization, distributions — on large event-scale datasets.

• Analyze complex datasets to find patterns, quantify drivers, and produce actionable insight; define new metrics and KPIs (usage, revenue, etc.) and the logic behind them.

• Independently investigate variance across platforms and communicate findings clearly to peers and senior leadership.

Business partnership

• Be the go-to guide for the data — the person who knows where every number comes from, what it means, and its quirks and landmines.

• Own the institutional knowledge of the data — definitions, lineage, and the reasoning behind metrics — and make it legible so analysts, ad ops, product, and finance can self-serve with confidence.

• Partner with stakeholders and source-system owners to translate ambiguous business questions into durable data models and metrics, and support/conduct strategic investigations and analysis.

Pipelines, quality & delivery

• Build and harmonize the ingestion and transformation pipelines — event data from client apps, ad-tech platforms, stitchers, ad servers, and telemetry — that feed the models, handling deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Stitch identity and sessions across client, server, and ad-side events for accurate user, content, and revenue analytics.

• Establish data-quality standards (testing, monitoring, alerting, freshness and volume SLAs) and troubleshoot incidents end-to-end — from a dashboard anomaly back through marts, transformations, and raw logs.

• Support and improve BI dashboards; document datasets, lineage, and business logic so the data map stays trustworthy and current.

• Mentor engineers and analysts on SQL, modeling, event data, and engineering best practices.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

• Expert SQL, including analytical SQL craft (window functions, complex joins, cohort / funnel / sessionization logic) and performance tuning on large event-scale datasets.

• Deep data-modeling expertise — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions, grain, and data-mart design; able to design a trusted source of truth from messy multi-source data.

• Strong data analysis and business translation — able to independently investigate data, define metrics and KPIs, and act as a trusted guide who turns ambiguous business questions into clear answers and enables others to self-serve.

• A guide’s temperament — curiosity to learn the data terrain deeply, patience to help non-technical partners, and communication that earns trust across the business.

• dbt (or an equivalent transformation / modeling framework).

• Cloud warehouse — BigQuery strongly preferred (our environment); Snowflake or Databricks acceptable with a fast ramp.

• Python for data processing and pipeline development.

• Orchestration experience (Airflow).

• High-volume event data — clickstream, telemetry, ad impressions, or similar — including deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Proven track record harmonizing data across multiple source systems with conflicting schemas, identifiers, or grain.

• BI tools (DOMO, Looker, Mode) — comfort both consuming and supporting their development.

• Experience debugging data-quality issues across the full stack — from BI tool to warehouse to raw event logs.

• BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

• Semantic-layer experience (LookML, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube).

• Streaming-media / ad-tech domain (ad servers, SSAI / stitchers, VAST/VMAP, impression and fill-rate metrics).

• Streaming ingestion (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

• Statistical analysis with R and predictive-analytics tooling; experimentation / A-B analysis.

• Master data management or entity resolution.

• MS in a quantitative discipline; experience mentoring or leading engineers/analysts.

 

How you will succeed in this role:

 

• You think in models and metrics, not just pipelines.

• You are the person others come to when they are lost in the data — and you like being that guide.

• You are as comfortable in a SQL console or a dashboard as in a DAG, and you move fluidly between business context and technical root cause.

• You treat data as a product — with users, definitions, SLAs, and documentation.

• You turn ambiguous business questions into clean models and clear answers.

Overview

The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure. This is a hybrid role that blends deep software engineering with hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure. It is purpose-built for engineers who are equally writing production Java services and designing multi-cloud platform architecture.

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of cloud-native systems. You will build high-performance streaming applications and architect the infrastructure they run on. You will also ensure both are production-grade, observable, and secure. You will bridge application and platform engineering, reducing the gap between what software teams need and what the cloud platform delivers.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes, and software engineering best practices. You should have a track record of operating at both the application and infrastructure layers.

 

Key Responsibilities

Optimize Data Streaming Applications on Cloud

  • Own end-to-end performance of data streaming applications running on cloud infrastructure — from Kafka topic configuration through consumer processing and downstream delivery.
  • Profile and tune streaming pipelines to maximize throughput and minimize latency, leveraging cloud-native compute, storage, and networking resources.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks at the intersection of application code and cloud resource constraints, including CPU throttling, network saturation, I/O limits, and memory constraints.
  • Design and implement cloud resource utilization strategies. This includes spot/preemptible instances, managed streaming services, and dynamic node pool scaling to balance performance with cost efficiency.
  • Benchmark streaming pipelines end-to-end and translate findings into actionable infrastructure and code improvements.
  • Collaborate with Data and AI/ML engineering teams to ensure streaming pipelines are optimally provisioned for real-time feature engineering, inference, and analytics workloads.


Design & Build Cloud-Native Applications

  • Develop high-throughput, low-latency streaming applications using Java and Kafka.
  • Design event-driven microservices that process, enrich, and route real-time data at scale.
  • Implement reactive, non-blocking architectures to support high concurrency and resilience.
  • Develop reusable streaming frameworks, libraries, and platform capabilities to improve engineering velocity and standardization.


Architect & Operate Multi-Cloud Infrastructure

  • Architect, implement, and optimize multi-cloud infrastructure across GCP and OCI to support large-scale data and streaming workloads.
  • Design and implement advanced networking architectures, including VPC peering, VPNs, load balancers, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code frameworks to standardize deployments and enable developer self-service.
  • Define autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization strategies for high-volume production systems.
  • Contribute to platform-wide architecture decisions related to scalability, resiliency, high availability, and disaster recovery.


Kubernetes & Container Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments (GKE, OKE) across cloud platforms.
  • Implement container orchestration best practices, service-mesh configurations, and rolling-deployment strategies.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to improve developer tooling, deployment automation, and runtime reliability.

 

Production Reliability & Performance

  • Ensure production-grade reliability, observability, and operational maturity across streaming platforms and infrastructure.
  • Implement comprehensive observability using Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and health monitoring.
  • Optimize systems for throughput, latency, resiliency, resource efficiency, and cloud cost governance.
  • Build automated testing strategies for streaming and infrastructure workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortems to improve uptime and reduce operational risk.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate streaming architectures with batch processing, data lakes, and analytical platforms.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.
  • Work closely with AI/ML engineering teams to support real-time feature engineering, inference pipelines, and operational AI workload.
  • Clearly communicate technical tradeoffs to engineering stakeholders. Also, discuss scalability considerations and operational risks.

 

Technical Management

  • Lead architectural discussions, design reviews, and technical deep dives across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure.
  • Drive engineering standards across code quality, documentation, observability, security, and platform maintainability.
  • Influence long-term technical strategy and modernization initiatives for real-time data infrastructure and cloud platforms.

It will build fault-tolerant streaming applications supporting real-time analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and critical data services.This role will design and build high-performance, fault-tolerant streaming applications that power real-time analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization. You will architect and implement distributed, event-driven systems using Java, Kafka, Kubernetes, and modern reactive frameworks. As a senior engineer, you will set the technical direction. You will mentor other engineers. You will also ensure that our streaming platforms are reliable, scalable, and operate smoothly. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, concurrency, and cloud-native microservices.

 

Primary Responsibilities

Design & Build Real-Time Streaming Applications

  • Develop high-throughput, low-latency streaming applications using Java and Kafka.

Architect Scalable Distributed Systems

  • Design and optimize distributed streaming architectures. You will work with Kafka topics, partitioning strategies, consumer groups, schema management, and event lifecycle patterns.
  • Help make architecture decisions for the whole platform. This includes scalability, resiliency, high availability, disaster recovery, and deployments across multiple regions.
  • Drive best practices around event modeling, schema evolution, idempotency, replayability, and data consistency across streaming systems.
  • Build and optimize horizontally scalable services deployed within Kubernetes-based cloud environments.
  • Production Reliability & Performance Make sure that streaming platforms and services are reliable and easy to monitor. Keep these systems operationally mature.
  • Optimize systems for throughput, latency, resiliency, resource efficiency, and infrastructure cost management. Set up full observability using metrics and centralized logging. Use distributed tracing, alerting, and health monitoring tools.
  • Build automated testing strategies for streaming workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Participate in production support. Help with incident response and root-cause analysis. Work on initiatives to improve reliability continuously.

Cloud-Native & Kubernetes Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments across GCP, AWS, or similar cloud platforms.
  • Define strategies for autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization. These strategies will focus on high-volume production systems.
  • Create and manage CI/CD pipelines. This includes Infrastructure-as-Code and workflows for automated deployment.
  • Collaborate with platform engineering teams to improve developer tooling, deployment automation, and runtime reliability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate streaming architectures with batch processing systems, data lakes, and analytical platforms.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.

  • Strong experience with reactive frameworks such as Spring WebFlux, Project Reactor, or similar.

  • Extensive experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, streams, schema registry).
  • Strong knowledge of partitioning strategies, offset management, rebalancing, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing event schemas and managing schema evolution.
  • Familiarity with Kafka Streams, Flink, or similar stream-processing frameworks.

Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Systems

  • Strong hands-on experience deploying and operating applications in Kubernetes. You should have experience using Docker for containerization. It's also important to have knowledge of microservices architecture. You should understand how autoscaling functions. You also need to learn about rolling deployments. It's important to know patterns that ensure reliable production.

You should be comfortable working in cloud-based systems that use microservices. This includes engineering environments that focus on these technologies.

Job Title

Lead Digital Ad Ops Coordinator

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

As a Lead Digital Ad Operations Coordinator, you will be part of the Digital Ad Operations group responsible for launching all D/Cipher digital campaigns. This role ensures creative meets site specifications, manages production with vendor partners, generates and traffics ad tags, and resolves campaign execution issues.

You will communicate directly with internal sales representatives and clients and proactively make business decisions that impact successful campaign launches.

Hybrid 3x a week

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

D/Cipher is People Inc.’s in-house media platform and activation team, fueled by the rich user engagement data of People Inc., the nation’s largest publisher.  D/Cipher helps advertisers make informed media buying decisions on and off People Inc. content.  The Digital Ad Operations team is responsible for the execution, trafficking, and quality assurance of all digital advertising campaigns. The team works cross-functionally with sales teams, clients, creative agencies, and third-party vendors.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

  • 40%: Facilitate communication, workflow, trafficking, and quality assurance of all assigned digital media campaigns.

  • 20%: Serve as a team resource and subject matter expert for campaign execution, assist with onboarding and training of new team members, and support process improvement initiatives across Digital Ad Operations.

  • 20%: Test and traffic creative through third-party ad servers such as Innovid, Flashtalking and CM360 and DSPs such as Amazon, Cadent and TTD.

  • 5%: Act as the first point of escalation for campaign execution and troubleshooting issues.

The Post-Production Supervisor oversees the day-to-day execution of post-production for promotional content produced by Paramount Television Media (PTVM) Marketing. Working closely with writer/producers, editors, audio mixers, and production leadership, this role supervises the finishing of promos from editorial through delivery, ensuring creative intent is executed accurately, and all deliverables meet network technical standards and on-air deadlines. The Post Production Supervisor coordinates resources across online editing, audio sweetening, voice-over recording, and media preparation while maintaining clear communication with operations, engineering, and production teams. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise in post-production workflows, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a deadline-driven broadcast environment.

•    Collaborates with operations, engineering, media planning, and other internal teams to coordinate schedules, resolve technical issues, and maintain alignment across departments involved in the delivery process.

•    Working knowledge of file-based and cloud-based post-production workflows.

•    Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

•    Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across creative, technical, and operational teams. 
•    Proficiency with Mac and Windows operating systems, spreadsheets, database systems, and general productivity tools.

job.title: Director, Catalog Production
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We LEAD: 

The Director, Catalog Production helps bring iconic music to life through dynamic, culturally relevant catalog releases that celebrate artistry and innovation. This role contributes to the creation of exceptional physical and digital products — from collectible vinyl and anniversary box sets to special-edition releases that give timeless music a fresh voice and new energy.

Rooted in collaboration, precision, and creative execution, this position works closely with design, A&R, marketing, and supply chain teams to help ensure products are expertly crafted and seamlessly produced. Every detail — from artwork to delivery — reflects the care and legacy of the music itself.

At its core, this role is about helping craft experiences that fans can hold onto, turning legendary recordings into meaningful, lasting moments.

How You’ll CREATE: 

  • Support the production of catalog releases that inspire fans and collectors — including deluxe box sets, limited vinyl runs, and special anniversary campaigns.

  • Collaborate with A&R, Creative, Marketing, D2C, and International teams to translate creative ideas into tangible, high-quality products.

  • Partner with printers, manufacturers, mastering studios, and the UMG supply chain to ensure accuracy, timing, and quality in all deliverables.

  • Manage key aspects of the production process — including artwork prep, pre-press, mastering, and delivery — while keeping creative intent and execution aligned.

  • Track and coordinate production timelines and milestones across multiple releases, ensuring projects stay on schedule.

  • Explore and recommend new materials, packaging, and production techniques that elevate the fan experience.

  • Assist with digital companion releases, ensuring alignment between physical and digital versions.

  • Work with global teams to adapt releases for different markets while maintaining consistency and creative integrity.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • A creative production professional with 5–7 years of experience in music, entertainment, or design-driven product development.

  • Passionate about music, creativity, and craftsmanship, with an appreciation for legacy and innovation.

  • Knowledgeable in physical manufacturing, printing, design, pre-press, and mastering workflows, with high attention to detail.

  • Experienced in digital production and asset management, ensuring smooth coordination across platforms.

  • An excellent communicator and collaborative team member who thrives in a creative, fast-paced environment.

  • Highly organized, solution-oriented, and committed to delivering quality at every step.

  • Proven ability to deliver exceptional physical releases that engage audiences and elevate artists.

  • A balanced mix of creative thinking and technical understanding.

  • Curiosity for new production methods, sustainable materials, and innovative packaging.

  • Familiarity with UMG systems or similar production workflows is a plus.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

  • You’ll play a vital role in shaping how fans experience some of the most influential music ever made — bringing catalog to life through creativity, detail, and innovation.

  • Your work will help connect classic recordings with new generations, proving that great music never stops evolving.

  • This is a chance to contribute to projects that honor the past while pushing the boundaries of what catalog can be.

  • You’re inspired by creativity and precision in equal measure.

  • You love collaboration and value being part of a passionate, dynamic team.

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members.   • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

The US  Retail & Licensing team service the merchandise interests of WMX artists, as well as ‘Third Party’ artists and licenses. We live at the crossroads of music and fashion. The team is commercially focused, and you will be working with teams in creative, production and brand management on a daily basis, as well as with the Global Head of Retail & Licensing and the Senior Director of Retail to grow and manage the business, coach and mentor the broader team, and take the business to the next level.

Your role:

No day is the same on this team as we serve a diverse roster of artists and coordinate with a multitude and varied list of retail partners. Due to the small nature of the team, everyone has a voice and the ability to contribute ideas. In a changing landscape, this is an opportunity to be a leader and a key voice in the LA office; an opportunity to touch and feel an artist’s vision; an opportunity to see ideas come to life and the fans appreciation in real time.

Here you’ll get to:

  • You will work closely with internal stakeholders across creative, production, brand management and finance to resolve issues and queries
  • You will be requesting product set ups and communicating regularly with the production team to ensure orders are successfully fulfilled
  • You will be responsible for sending product set ups to retailers in a timely manner
  • You will be liaising with the creative and brand management teams regarding the creative decks needed to service our retailers
  • You will lead real time communication with 10+ accounts/vendors to maintain VIP customer service
  • You will be responsible for keeping track of all buyer requests and preferences
  • You will be responsible for driving a large portion of the departments sales and ensure we deliver on our margin expectations 
  • You will manage order approval requests; which includes receiving order requests from buyers and requesting approval from product managers for each order, by retailer, monitoring/communicating approval completion as well as escalating pending approval requests on a weekly basis
  • You will periodically submit art requests to the creative team, which will include receiving design requests from buyers, entering design/art requests and revisions, making sure art requests are completed per buyer direction/call outs and communicating/confirming design revisions with buyers
  • You will tackle additional sales/administrative support as needed

About you:

  • You have a demonstrable track record in a similar role
  • You have 5+ years of experience in sales / account management
  • You can work independently as well as within a large varied team
  • You have previous experience managing high volume buyer requests
  • You have previous experience in music merchandising or fashion/apparel industry
  • You can demonstrate in depth knowledge of retail math and sales
  • You have a positive attitude and can demonstrate strong attention to detail, excellent organization, and strong communication skills
  • You have an extremely proactive work ethic and the ability to multi task
  • You enjoy problem solving and do not shy away from getting to the bottom of situations in order to reach your goals
  • You are a self-starter with a ton of ideas who is excited to share your vision and creativity
  • You have a high proficiency in Google Workspace

We’d love it if you also had:

  • You have previous experience working in music or entertainment
  • You have previous experience working with project management tools
  • You have previous experience working with EDI


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $90,000 to $110,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. job.title: Traffic Anchor/Producer overnights
job.description:
Total Traffic + Weather Network

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

We’re seeking an experienced Traffic Anchor keep our listeners abreast of traffic and weather in the local area

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Provide timely, accurate, and useful information to help commuters plan their drives.

  • Deliver up to the minute reports on accidents, delays, and major traffic disruptions.

  • Read traffic updates, commercials, and public service announcements on air.

  • Gather information from multiple intake sources and monitor local, state, and national traffic feeds to determine what’s most relevant.

  • Research, write, and produce traffic and weather copy for on air use; edit audio using digital editing software. 

  • Manage incoming information, verify facts, and ensure all details are accurate and current; maintain updated content on station websites.

  • Create written, visual, audio, and video content for websites, blogs, and social media platforms.

  • Work a flexible schedule as needed, which may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, or holidays. 

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

  • Strong knowledge of local geography, major roadways, mass transit systems, and traffic patterns. 

  • Clear, pleasant, and well controlled on air voice with excellent pronunciation. 

  • Skilled at working in a fast paced, deadline driven, newsroom style environment. 

  • Excellent writing and editing abilities with a strong command of grammar. 

  • Exceptional attention to detail with consistent follow through until issues are resolved.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and multitask effectively in a high volume setting. 

  • Familiarity with police scanners is a plus. 

  • Previous broadcast experience preferred. 

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Full proficiency and understanding of job function
  • Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus
  • Strong problem solving skills
  • Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance
  • Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness
  • Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$20.05 - $25.06

job.title: Writer/Producer
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Writer/Producer

WWE develops and produces 52 weeks of original programming for two of the longest running weekly episodic television shows: Monday Night Raw and Friday Night SmackDown. Both Raw and SmackDown combine action, drama, reality, comedy and adventure! The goal of the Creative team is to provide compelling stories portrayed by the world's most charismatic, diverse, larger-than-life characters on or off television!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop clearly defined, yet emotionally sophisticated, characters for a diverse group of WWE Talent.

  • Script descriptive, thought-provoking, captivating, and creative storylines for RAW, SmackDown, and select WWE programming streaming on ESPN.

  • Collaborate with a team of writers to build compelling stories that capture a global audience fitting multiple demographics.

  • Provide punch-up for specific scripted segments as well as review the totality of entire episodes for continuity and flow.

  • Incorporate consumer insights and social media to deliver impactful storylines that are consistent with the WWE brand and each Talent's skills and history.

  • Weekly travel to our shows (RAW or SmackDown) & rotating travel to PLEs (Premium Live Events).

  • Attend and contribute in creative writing team meetings every week at our Stamford, CT HQ.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of writing for TV or Film

  • Producing and Directing experience a plus

  • Professional TV or Film staff experience preferred

  • Experience in Live TV production a plus

  • Previous experience working with On-Screen Talent, Creative Writers, and Producers

  • Understanding of WWE's audience (demographic and psychographic) preferred
