job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

WHO WE ARE

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

 

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

WCBS-TV is the #1 CBS owned-and-operated station in the nation’s largest media market, and together with Paramount+ and the full CBS Stations portfolio, we give advertisers something rare: reach that spans every screen, every daypart, and every device.


THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who is capable of doing it all — someone who has spent time in local TV, knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.

 

As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.

 

You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will be held to results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.
  • Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Go multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build, don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Think like a strategist. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business objectives, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals.
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, and to deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.
  • Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape.
  • Represent KOVR Sacramento at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

 


Key Responsibilities:

 

  • Prospect, develop, and manage new and existing business accounts to achieve and exceed revenue goals
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through remarkable service and strategic guidance
  • Identify client needs and create customized, creative multi-media advertising campaigns
  • Present and sell integrated advertising solutions across broadcast, digital, and emerging platforms
  • Demonstrate strong negotiation and closing skills throughout the sales cycle
    Utilize media research and ratings tools (e.g., Nielsen and similar platforms) to develop data-driven proposals

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

Required:

 

  • 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable track record of hitting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Real hunger—you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships.
  • Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision.
  • Valid CA driver's license. 

 

Preferred:

 

  • Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television.
  • Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales.
  • Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with WideOrbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel.


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Organizations that wish to receive job vacancy notices from this posting’s television station should contact sf_recruitingsupport@paramount.com.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $80,000.00 - 100,000.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.  This position is eligible to earn sales incentive compensation. 

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

The Senior Network Engineer role focuses on the implementation and support of reliable, scalable network solutions supporting media and corporate systems. The role participates in network projects across the full lifecycle and collaborates closely with peer engineers, operations teams, and cross‑functional partners.

Sr Live Event Technology Specialist (Streaming Operations Specialist)

Location:
Flexible / Global (based on operational needs)

Role Overview

As a Sr. Live Event Technology Specialist, you will serve as the primary technical escalation point for Paramount+’s global Live Event Operations team, providing technical support for Tier-1 live streaming events. This role focuses on diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues across the end-to-end live streaming ecosystem while minimizing customer impact during high-profile live broadcasts.

Working alongside Live Event Operators, Engineering, Product, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and distribution partners, you will lead technical investigations, coordinate cross-functional incident response, and drive root cause analysis for issues affecting acquisition, encoding, packaging, delivery, playback, advertising, and platform integrations.

Your expertise will ensure rapid issue mitigation, operational excellence, and continuous improvements across Paramount’s live streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for the Live Event Operations team during live events.
  • Support global Tier-1 live streaming events by troubleshooting complex issues across the complete video delivery chain.
  • Investigate service-impacting issues involving contribution feeds, cloud encoding, packaging, DRM, origin, CDN delivery, playback, and client applications.
  • Perform detailed technical analysis using streaming manifests, player logs, encoder metrics, QoS/QoE analytics, SCTE-35 signaling, transport stream analysis, and cloud monitoring tools.
  • Coordinate technical response across Engineering, Platform, Network Operations, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and third-party partners to restore service quickly.
  • Lead technical bridge calls during critical incidents, providing real-time updates, impact assessments, mitigation strategies, and recovery coordination.
  • Support Live Event Operators by providing technical guidance during event execution, validating mitigation actions, and assisting with operational decision-making.
  • Perform pre-event technical validation, redundancy verification, workflow testing, and production readiness reviews.
  • Conduct post-event root cause analysis (RCA), identify systemic issues, and drive corrective actions to improve platform reliability.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting documentation, operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support certification, onboarding, and production rollout of new streaming technologies, cloud workflows, monitoring tools, and vendor integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations supporting global live streaming operations and high-severity production incidents.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years supporting large-scale live streaming, OTT platforms, broadcast technology, or video delivery systems.
  • Experience serving as a technical escalation resource supporting live operations teams during Tier-1 live events.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across end-to-end streaming architectures including:
    • Contribution and video transport
    • Cloud encoding and transcoding
    • Packaging and origin services
    • DRM
    • SSAI/DAI
    • CDN distribution
    • Player playback
  • Deep understanding of HLS, DASH, CMAF/fMP4, MPEG-TS, SCTE-35, timed metadata, and adaptive bitrate streaming.
  • Experience analyzing manifests, transport streams, encoder logs, player telemetry, QoS/QoE metrics, and cloud infrastructure metrics.
  • Familiarity with AWS Media Services, CDN technologies, cloud networking, and streaming observability platforms.
  • Working knowledge of contribution protocols including SRT, Zixi, RIST, RTP, UDP, and multicast workflows.
  • Strong understanding of DRM, SSAI, client playback behavior, redundancy architectures, and failover strategies.
  • Excellent incident management, root cause analysis, and cross-functional communication skills in high-pressure live production environments.

job.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 

Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects. 

You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy. 

Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers.

  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps. 

  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery. 

  • Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers. 

  • Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data. 

  • Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications. 

  • Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process.

  • Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs. 

  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.

  • Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Organize architecture discussions. 

  • Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies. 

Qualifications:

Must-Haves 

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field. 

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. 

  • 5+ years experience leading engineering teams. 

  • Agile best practices. 

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go.

  • Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services . 

  • Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices. 

  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.

  • Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks. 

  • Strong troubleshooting skills 

  • Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch. 

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries. 

  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning.

  • Personalization and recommendation systems. 

  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)

  • Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc. 

  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.) 

  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)

  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus) 

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change). 

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

Base Pay Range: $160,000 - $175,000 + Bonus

We’re committed to offering competitive and flexible compensation to attract top talent. This pay range reflects our good faith estimate for the role and may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, and other relevant factors.

For bonus-eligible roles, targets are determined based on multiple considerations, including market benchmarks and individual contributions.

For benefits-eligible roles, we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package covering health, retirement, wellbeing, and more, along with optional benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees.

We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

Universal Production Music (UPM) is seeking an experienced Contract Admin Manager, based in Santa Monica, CA, to support the UPM Licensing and Partnerships team in reviewing, drafting, and administration of licensing and other contract related inquiries.

  • Work with Account Executives, Clients, Business Affairs, and internal staff on modifications and approvals for agreements

  • Work with the EVP of Global Operations on attaining legalese change approvals and any necessary agreement language modifications with UMPG Business Affairs

  • Directly manage one employee – ensuring contract drafting flows are running efficiently.

  • Join Client calls as may be needed to ensure efficient contract resolution

  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date filing system for license and contract archives

  • Assist with any report requests summarizing license output

  • Research claims asserted against company

  • Attend and actively participate in internal team meetings as requested

Bring your VIBE:

Skills/Abilities:

  • Knowledge of music industry/licensing or production industry a plus

  • Exceptional organizational, time management, written and verbal communication skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, Outlook

  • Proficiency in CRM Programs (e.g., Salesforce or MS Dynamics)

  • Comfortable utilizing e-signature programs (e.g., Adobe or Docusign)

  • Strong customer-focused aptitude, with a polite and courteous manner

  • Possess the ability to work in a fast-paced collaborative and creative environment

Experience:

  • 3+ years working in capacity involving the drafting and processing of legal contracts

  • Experience working in the Entertainment industry and/or in Publishing is a plus

Education:

Radio-Canada Ottawa-Gatineau is looking for a sporting life videojournalist. This is a permanent, full-time role working three (3) days on a weekday schedule and two (2) days on a weekend schedule.


Your Role  


Reporting to the Senior Digital Producer, Sports, you’ll gather and process news from the local and national sports scene. You’ll be expected to create content for all Radio-Canada platforms. You’ll be responsible for writing copy and producing video for digital platforms as well as contributing to Le Téléjournal Ottawa-Gatineau, live or pre-recorded radio newscasts and programs. You may also be required to work on national programs.


The greater Ottawa-Gatineau area is home to a large number of Canada’s national and multi-sport organizations and professional, college and university sports teams. It offers an extensive range of possibilities for stories about the region’s sporting life, leisure and outdoor activities. This is a unique opportunity to create content that is informative and interesting for our audiences and relevant to their lives. 


Do you have a passion for sports, local sporting life, physical activity and all the accompanying trends? Do you take an inclusive, people-first approach to sports reporting so that your content can be enjoyed by a wider audience including women and diverse communities? Do you have a network of contacts in the sporting world on both the Ottawa and Gatineau sides of the region or has your past experience demonstrated your ability to develop and maintain sources? Do you like to propose original stories while staying up to date on what’s happening every day? Then this position is for you!


You must be able to work independently, have excellent organizational skills, be highly creative and possess sound editorial judgment. You’ll prepare, align, set up and operate various cameras and ancillary equipment, ensuring optimal audio and video quality under prevailing conditions. Work is governed by CBC/Radio-Canada programming policies and Journalistic Standards and Practices. When needed, you may be asked to lend a hand in the newsroom as a general news videojournalist.


This role requires full-time on-site presence.


What you bring:

  • Graduation from university or community college in a relevant course of study.
  • Minimum of three (3) years’ relevant journalism experience.
  • Solid reporting skills.
  • Proven skills shooting and editing video to tell compelling stories.
  • Comfortable and dynamic on-air presence.
  • Excellent interviewing skills.
  • Ability to write clearly and concisely.
  • Flexibility to work regularly for television, radio and/or digital platforms.
  • Creative problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of the latest sporting events as well as sports-related community and socio-economic issues.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the key issues facing Ontario, Eastern Ontario and the Ottawa/Gatineau region.
  • Demonstrated range of visual storytelling techniques and digital best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of social media and digital platforms in general.
  • Critical acumen.
  • Proven ability to generate original story ideas and knowledgeable contacts.
  • Strong desire to live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture.
  • Proven conversational writing style.
  • Ability to respond to breaking news situations quickly and accurately.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in teams.
  • Ability to work flexible hours in a high-pressure, tight-deadline environment, often in unexpected overtime situations.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Solid command of French and good knowledge of English (asset).
  • Valid driver’s licence as well as a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio-Canada’s insurer.
  • Valid passport and ability to travel as needed.
  • Knowledge of camera models Sony PXW x200, Sony RX10 and Sony A7R iv is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Avid Media Composer, Photoshop and Lightroom is an asset.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KKCO
job.description:
KKCO, the NBC affiliate in Grand Junction, Colorado, is looking for a multimedia journalist who is ready to own stories from idea to air and publication. The MMJ will be able to connect with audiences across every platform. This is an opportunity for a strong, curious storyteller to cover the issues, people and moments that matter across western Colorado — from breaking news and enterprise reporting to compelling video, digital and social content that helps our communities stay informed.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.

  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.

  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.

  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.

  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.

  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration

  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.

  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.

  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.

  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems

  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred

  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment

  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

Where You’ll Live, Work and Play

Grand Junction offers the best of Colorado living without the big-city pace. Set in the heart of the Grand Valley, the community is surrounded by red rock canyons, mesas, rivers and endless access to hiking, biking, climbing, skiing and more. You’ll find a strong sense of community, a growing downtown, nearby wineries and year-round outdoor adventure — including the rare chance to ski and golf in the same day during parts of the year. It’s a place where journalists can build meaningful local connections while enjoying an active, scenic lifestyle outside of work.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

Forma parte de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. Con la videoteca más extensa de contenido propio y una capacidad de producción sin igual, impulsamos nuestras plataformas de televisión, streaming y radio, conectando diariamente con millones de personas a través de experiencias de entretenimiento e información.

• Inglés intermedio

job.title: Account Executive, Programmatic Sales
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

As an Account Executive, you bring deep expertise in programmatic and CTV advertising with a consultative, solutions-driven sales approach. This role is designed for a revenue-driven seller who thrives in collaborative, fast-moving environments while also demonstrating the ability to work independently to achieve results within your Hold Co. You will be responsible for maintaining, building, and exceeding advertising revenue goals across the digital portfolio, leveraging your programmatic knowledge to deliver innovative solutions, unlock new opportunities, and navigate an evolving marketplace.

 

You are:

 

  •  Results Driven 
    • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.
    • Proven capability to sell CTV, sponsorships, and tentpoles across the full streaming ecosystem, leveraging both DIO and Programmatic.
    • Manage a Hold Co programmatic sales pipeline—including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, reporting and long-term revenue growth.
    • Proactively uncover new streaming sales opportunities. 
    • Establish and cultivate relationships with clients by conducting a high volume of face-to-face calls.
  • Consultative Sales Executive
    • Collaborate across platforms within your Hold Co (including cable, broadcast, and sports) to generate revenue across the Paramount portfolio product suite to deliver holistic client solutions.
    • Act as a trusted advisor to your clients and key point of contact both internally and externally. 
    • Bring proactive, consultative solutions to your clients by leveraging Paramount’s sales products and delivering strategic insights through QBRs.
  • Programmatic Proficient
    • Programmatic is a fast-moving space and is a crucial component of Paramount’s Streaming offering. It’s imperative to stay ahead of industry trends by actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications.
    • Confidently lead conversations about the programmatic landscape (SSP/DSP Marketplaces) and direct 1:1 advertiser/agency strategies.
  • Lead by Example
    • AM Management & Development
      •  In partnership with AM Management, work closely with and mentor your AM sales partner to deliver best in class client servicing pre and post sale, including Deal Set up, Deal Management and Post Campaign QBRs.
      • Collaborate with AM Management to ensure assigned AMs have clear day-to-day direction, real-time feedback and development support to foster team growth, motivation, and performance.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of advertising and programmatic streaming sales experience, with direct experience in programmatic roles at publishers, ad tech firms, or platform companies.
      

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong relationship building skills.
  • Have a strong desire to win and grow as a streaming ad sales professional.
  • Exceptional communication and organizational skills.
  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate a command of our business, offerings and client needs.
  • Ability to manage stress well, and balance multiple priorities at once in a fast paced environment.
  • High initiative, problem solving, agility and a growth mindset.
  • BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience.

 

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $93,000.00 - 165,600.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York City, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Your role:

 

CBC’s Business & Rights team has two positions available: one in B&R Scripted, reporting to the B&R Senior Director, Scripted & Acquired, and the other in B&R Unscripted, reporting to the B&R Senior Director, Unscripted. 

As the Manager, Business & Rights, you work closely with the independent production community and are responsible for negotiating and drafting development and/or licensing agreements and business recommendations. You decide how to approach negotiations and structure deals that meet CBC’s rights and financing strategies and priorities. In addition, you have the ability to efficiently assess proposed project budgets and calculate the appropriate level of CBC and third-party funding to be included within the financing structure. You will make recommendations and seek approvals from your B&R Senior Director on deal terms that best represent CBC’s priorities and interests. As a Manager, Business & Rights, you will also manage the creation of streamlined (and nuanced) contracts that represent and protect CBC's position. 

For the Scripted Role: Your portfolio could include development, production and/or acquisition deals across scripted genres including kids, comedy and drama including scripted feature films. Experience working on productions governed by the CMPA’s Independent Production Agreements (WGC, ACTRA & DGC) would be considered an asset.

For the Unscripted Role: Your portfolio could include development and production deals for documentaries (shorts, one-offs, and series), factual entertainment, award shows and variety shows.  Knowledge of music rights, and experience working with documentaries, format based factual entertainment, competition and event/concert shows, would be considered an asset 

Your project portfolio is expected to be diverse and could include development agreements, feature film licensing agreements and complex acquisitions, in addition to licensing agreements for original Canadian productions. Your responsibilities would include:

  • Taking a tailored approach to deal and contract negotiations for a wide range of projects including big budget scripted series intended for CBC’s platforms including but not limited to primetime television, CBC Gem, CBC FAST Channels and YouTube.

  • Ensuring CBC's contractual requirements and business interests are secured on a consistent and nuanced basis across programs of similar scope.

  • Reviewing and recommending third-party financing sources for each project with a critical eye to ensure eligibility and compliance with oft-changing requirements.

  • Reviewing third party agreements, including agreements from public and private funding agencies, and deals with other Canadian and international media platforms to ensure harmonization with CBC’s rights.

  • Applying strategic thinking to funding agency applications, to maximize benefits while ensuring CBC is accurately and strategically represented.  

  • Assisting in research, management and presentation of rights data across genres, platforms, and windows of exploitation.

  • Refining our business approach through continuous innovation, agile processes, and market-leading thinking about rights and financing models.

  • Authorizing contract payments where required. 

We are looking for candidates with the following: 

  • A post-secondary education or related experience, with a strong preference for formal legal training (contract law, entertainment and copyright law).

  • In-depth knowledge of all forms of current media, negotiating techniques, corporate business practices, and the funding rules of various agencies including CMF, private funds for screen-based media, provincial agencies across Canada, and tax credit authorities. 

  • Facility with approved artificial intelligence technologies to improve workflow and data analysis. Eagerness to learn and adapt to emerging technologies.

  • Financial and contract management experience. Role includes estimating and validating calculations of tax credits and independent drafting of complex agreements.

  • Strong understanding of linear and streaming entertainment business models, social media, and other online platforms including FAST channels.

  • Strong computer skills including Google suite, Excel, Microsoft Office and Adobe.

  • Ability to comprehend and translate the concerns of creative producers/directors/creative heads into appropriate contracts within the constraints of the applicable regulatory bodies, CBC policies and funding guidelines.

  • Creativity and innovative problem-solving skills to address all policy and production issues in a manner satisfactory to all parties.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, including an ability to work with both emerging and experienced producers.

  • Ability to exercise judgment and work independently taking initiative.

  • Strong analytical skills. 

  • Able and willing to work beyond regular office hours during peak periods of activity as well as the flexibility to attend industry functions and events.

  • Bilingualism (French/English) would be considered an asset.

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team. As such, working closely with the product owners, architects and technical managers, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

  • Experience in developing an application published on the App Store.
  • Experience in developing within code review context (pull request).
  • Knowledge of programming patterns (such as MVC, MVP, or MVVM).
  • Knowledge of SOLID architecture principles is an asset.
  • Ability to read, produce, and adhere to software architecture diagrams (UML, sequence diagram, etc.).
  • Interest in working on an application available on multiple form factors (mobile/tablet/TV).
  • Knowledge of SwiftUI, Combine.
  • Knowledge of AVPlayer, CoreData, and AlamoFire is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Cocoapods (including the design/maintenance of internal pods).
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

job.title: John DiStaso Political Fellowship
job.description:
John DiStaso Political Fellowship

The John DiStaso Political Fellowship is a one-semester paid position at Hearst ABC affiliate WMUR-TV in Manchester, NH.  Our Fellow will work closely with members of our political team on several projects including daily political coverage, our 2022 and 2024 election-related coverage, and our weekly political show, “CloseUP”.  The Fellowship will be awarded to a motivated junior or senior in college who is interested in pursuing a career in political journalism.

More about John DiStaso

John DiStaso was the most experienced political journalist in New Hampshire. He was often referred to as the “dean” of New Hampshire’s political press corps. John died from complications of pancreatic cancer on April 21, 2022, at the age of 68.  Throughout his career, DiStaso interviewed four sitting presidents and countless presidential candidates while covering 11 New Hampshire primaries. John spent much of his career working for New Hampshire’s largest newspaper, “The Union Leader”.  He spent the last seven years of his career working for WMUR, where he wrote daily for WMUR.com regularly breaking stories.  He also often appeared on WMUR-TV to provide analysis for political stories.

The opportunity

In this political fellowship, you’ll play a meaningful role on the experienced political team of WMUR. You’ll follow in John’s footsteps working on daily political coverage. You’ll learn from John’s enduring legacy, as well as the experienced political team at WMUR to gain the knowledge and experience to launch a successful career in political journalism.

How to qualify

  • Working toward a bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Journalism, Communications or a related degree
  • Experience in journalism through internships or college media
  • Goal to work in the field of journalism
  • Excellent writing and research skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Deadline driven
  • Willingness to work various shifts including nights, weekends and holidays
  • You also need to have a strong academic record, and two recommendations from faculty or internship supervisors

How to apply

Please apply on our career site. Include the following documentation in your application:

  • Include the following documentation in your application:
    • A letter expressing interest in the fellowship and promoting your candidacy
    • A summary of your commitment to journalism (one page, single-spaced)
    • A current resume citing work experience and accomplishments
    • A complete academic transcript through your completed semester
    • Two academic or professional recommendations
    • Finalists will be interviewed by phone and either in-person or via video conference

Application deadlines

For the fall fellowship, applications are due by June 15th. For the spring fellowship, applications are due by September 15th. Decisions regarding fall selection will be made in July and decisions regarding spring selection will be made in October.

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Analytical thinking is important, as you'll be interpreting data and helping with making informed decisions. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.

We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Entertainment Tonight - Production Assistant
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

    Entertainment Tonight is looking for a sharp, pop-culture-obsessed Production Assistant to join our team. This is an entry-level role built for someone who's ready to work hard, learn fast, and grow inside the #1 entertainment news brand in the world.  

Overview:

This PA will be assigned to one of ET's Supervising Producers in the NYC bureau, supporting a mix of exclusives, features, red carpet coverage, set visits, and news. One day you might be building a folder off breaking news, the next you're on the ground at a red carpet or a set visit. The best PAs bring editorial instincts to all of it. If you're deep in a folder on a breaking story and you spot a vault clip that just became gold, we need you to recognize it and flag it. That awareness is what separates a good PA from a great one.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You'll work directly with a Supervising Producer across ET's NYC bureau coverage, serving as the link between raw footage and finished stories.
  • Media management — ingest shoot footage, log and label assets, and build organized folders that segment producers can write directly from
  • Transcription — turn celebrity interviews and field shoots into accurate, usable transcripts on deadline
  • Morning show & podcast monitoring — watch and transcribe morning news broadcasts and podcasts to flag newsworthy moments before the rest of the day catches up
  • Exclusives & features support — help prep and execute interviews, shoots, and packages tied to ET exclusives and features
  • Asset coordination — pull b-roll, photos, social clips, and archival material; track rights and credits
  • Producer support — research, fact checks, and content prep across broadcast, digital, and social
  • Field and studio assistance — crew support, errands, and on-the-ground help when shoots need an extra set of hands
  • Cross-department coverage — pitch in where the show needs you

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • You live and breathe pop culture — you can name every famous face in a crowded shot
  • You're fast, accurate, and organized under pressure
  • You communicate clearly and work well with a team
  • You have sharp editorial instincts — you know the difference between a great sound bite and a throwaway line
  • Must pass a short celebrity knowledge quiz

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Degree or internship in TV, film, or a related field is a plus, not a requirement

 

THE DETAILS:
  • Compensation: $20/hour | Overtime paid after 40 hours
  • Schedule: Approximately 45 hours/week | 8am EST - 5:30pm EST | with some weekend / big award show coverage expected

job.title: Director, Marketing Operations
job.description:
Job Summary

The Director, Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational strategy, execution, reliability, and advancement of the platforms and processes that power Hearst Newspapers' digital subscription marketing strategy. This role leads day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, subscription rates and offers, data integrations, and platform quality assurance, ensuring the marketing technology stack operates reliably while continually improving how Marketing uses technology, data, AI, and automation. This is a centralized role supporting nine markets, with responsibility for building consistent, scalable processes and capabilities across the portfolio.

 

The ideal candidate is a technically fluent marketing operations leader who combines deep hands-on marketing technology experience, strong data and systems thinking, and disciplined operational leadership. This person will manage a distributed team of four and serve as a key bridge between Marketing and Product, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, Customer Service, and technology vendors - translating marketing needs into clear requirements, identifying new capabilities and opportunities, and driving adoption across marketing and newsrooms.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team, managing workload, performance, priorities, and professional development while establishing clear ownership, service levels, operating rhythms, and accountability.

  • Own the Marketing Operations intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, allocating team capacity, managing tradeoffs, and keeping stakeholders aligned on timing, scope, and dependencies.

  • Own day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, and any other future platforms, including platform administration, workflows, audience segmentation, campaign activation, personalization, troubleshooting, documentation, governance, and scalable execution across markets, with particular responsibility for supporting Marketing and newsroom teams in their use of Sailthru.

  • Ensure operational reliability across recurring marketing processes, integrations, audience and data flows, rates and offers, tracking, and platform capabilities; proactively monitor for issues, diagnose root causes across systems, and partner with BI, Product, and vendors on resolution and safeguards.

  • Oversee email operations across newsletters, lead generation, acquisition, retention, and other lifecycle communications, including audience selection, campaign/template setup, scheduling, suppression logic, deployment, and operational readiness. Partner closely with marketing and newsroom teams to strengthen newsletter capabilities, workflows, and best practices.

  • Manage the operational setup and governance of checkout and cancellation flows, subscription rates, pricing configurations, and promotional offers, partnering with Finance, Marketing, Product, and Customer Service to ensure accurate implementation across customer experiences.

  • Serve as Marketing's close partner to the Product Director and as the primary Marketing-to-technology translator: turn loosely defined business problems and ideas into clear functional, data, and operational requirements; support prioritization, ideation, implementation, testing, and rollout; and translate technical capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs into practical marketing implications and opportunities.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to expand Marketing's capabilities through existing or new technology, data, AI, automation, and self-service. Assess business value and operational feasibility, reduce manual work and handoffs, enable appropriate self-service, and move the strongest opportunities from concept to implementation while maintaining governance and human oversight.

  • Manage marketing technology vendors, including relationships, contracts, renewals, platform performance, issue resolution, roadmap alignment, and service levels. In partnership with Product and technical stakeholders, represent Marketing in evaluating prospective technology and assessing capabilities, gaps, integration needs, and tradeoffs against business requirements.

  • Lead capability rollout and adoption across Marketing and newsrooms by translating new functionality into usable workflows, documentation, training, governance, and operating practices; establish rigorous QA and change-management standards to ensure capabilities are implemented accurately and sustainably.

 

Qualifications & Skills

  • Significant experience in marketing operations, marketing technology, lifecycle marketing, CRM, or digital subscription operations, including experience leading teams and managing complex cross-functional workflows.

  • Strong hands-on experience directly configuring and troubleshooting marketing technology platforms, including customer data platforms, email/CRM platforms, audience segmentation, automation, personalization, business rules, and campaign activation; BlueConic and Sailthru experience are strongly preferred.

  • Strong technical fluency across marketing technology ecosystems, including data integrations, APIs and data feeds, audience schemas, identity and profile data, tracking, campaign logic, platform dependencies, and data flows between marketing platforms and enterprise data environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose marketing technology and data issues, trace problems across systems and data flows, identify likely root causes, and partner effectively with BI, Product, Engineering, and vendors on resolution.

  • Strong data and systems literacy, including the ability to interpret data schemas, understand field-level logic and transformations, validate outputs, translate business needs into precise technical and data requirements, and assess upstream and downstream dependencies; familiarity with SQL or similar data-querying concepts is strongly preferred.

  • Strong experience with email and newsletter operations, including supporting both Marketing and newsroom use cases, segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, automation, deployment workflows, deliverability considerations, and identifying and implementing new platform capabilities and best practice.

  • Experience managing checkout or monetization platforms, subscription pricing, rates, promotional offers, or comparable configuration-driven customer subscription programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, partner effectively with Product and technical teams, evaluate technology capabilities and tradeoffs, and drive adoption of new tools and functionality across non-technical users.

  • Proven people-management experience, ideally leading remote or distributed teams, with strong coaching, prioritization, stakeholder management, communication, and accountability skills.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, and self-service approaches to improve operational workflows, QA, speed, and team capacity while maintaining appropriate governance and human oversight.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving and operational judgment, and the ability to balance business urgency with platform integrity, data quality, scalability, and sustainable processes in a fast-moving environment.

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

This position does not provide sponsorship. All applicants should have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship.

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York, NY. The reasonable estimate is $150,000 - $160,000. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

job.title: Senior Social Producer, Sports
job.description:
Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.
 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact: 

The Senior Social Producer, Sports will drive the day-to-day execution of SiriusXM Sports’ social strategy and bring programming, talent, and major sports moments to life across social platforms. This role will identify the stories and moments that matter and translate them into compelling, social-first content across priority sports properties. Working across major tentpole coverage, real-time publishing, and internal teams, this role will support the continued growth, reach, and relevance of SiriusXM Sports.

What you’ll do:

  • Own day-to-day social strategy execution for SiriusXM Sports and its programming across NFL, NBA, MLB, NASCAR, wrestling/Busted Open, and other priority sports properties.

  • Develop and execute social content plans around major sports moments, live events, interviews, programming launches, and tentpoles.

  • Identify the strongest content, conversations, and storylines from SiriusXM sports programming and determine how to best package and distribute them for social audiences.

  • Manage publishing and content distribution across SiriusXM Sports social platforms, adapting content, copy, creative, and formats based on the platform and audience.

  • Produce and publish compelling social-first content, including short-form video, clips, graphics, and real-time posts across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, and emerging platforms.

  • Make timely editorial decisions around breaking news, games, trades, viral moments, and broader sports conversations to ensure SiriusXM Sports is participating in the moments that matter.

  • Partner closely with Programming, Video, PR, Marketing, and other internal teams to align on priorities, develop content opportunities, and maximize key moments.

  • Lead social coverage for live events and onsite activations, including developing coverage plans, coordinating content capture, publishing in real time, and identifying opportunities with talent.

  • Work directly with hosts, producers, and programming teams to identify social-first opportunities that extend SiriusXM programming and talent beyond the audio experience.

  • Develop new social concepts, recurring franchises, and creative formats around SiriusXM talent, programming, and major sports moments.

  • Track social performance and audience behavior, using insights to inform content decisions, platform strategy, and future coverage.

  • Maintain a consistent SiriusXM Sports voice and social presence while balancing the needs and audiences of individual leagues, shows, hosts, and properties.

  • Stay deeply connected to sports culture, fan conversations, platform trends, creators, emerging formats, and changes in how audiences consume sports content.

  • Support the continued growth and evolution of SiriusXM’s sports social strategy by identifying new formats, franchises, partnerships, and audience opportunities.

  • Serve as a trusted social partner to internal stakeholders, bringing strong recommendations and social expertise to programming and content conversations.

What you’ll need:

  • 4+ years of experience in social media, digital content, sports media, entertainment, editorial, or a related field.

  • Deep knowledge of sports and sports culture, with strong familiarity across major leagues and properties including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NASCAR, and professional wrestling.

  • Excellent editorial judgment and the ability to quickly identify the quote, storyline, interview moment, or cultural conversation most likely to resonate with sports audiences.

  • Demonstrated experience independently managing social channels and executing content strategies for a brand, publisher, league, team, media company, or similar organization.

  • Strong knowledge of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, and emerging social platforms, including platform-specific formats and best practices.

  • Experience producing and editing short-form social video using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar tools.

  • Excellent social copywriting skills and the ability to adapt voice, tone, and storytelling by platform and audience.

  • Experience leading social coverage around live events, breaking news, or other fast-moving editorial environments.

  • Strong understanding of social analytics and the ability to translate performance data into actionable content recommendations.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple sports, shows, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with programming, talent, video, marketing, PR, and other teams.

  • Ability to operate independently, make sound editorial decisions, and take ownership of projects from planning through execution and reporting.

  • Flexibility to support major games, events, and breaking sports moments outside of traditional business hours when needed.

  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the annual salary for this this position to be between $67,000 and $85,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Success will be measured by the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s ability to focus on the highest-value enterprise priorities; the clarity and effectiveness of the organization’s operating cadence; the speed and quality of cross-functional decisions; and the consistent execution of strategic initiatives across the Product & Technology portfolio.

What you’ll do:

Executive Strategy and Decision Support

  • Serve as a recognized internal and external expert in executive operations, enterprise strategy, and organizational effectiveness, bringing authoritative perspective to the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior leaders.
  • Determine and introduce leading-edge business, operating, and decision-making approaches that improve how the Product & Technology portfolio sets direction and executes against strategic objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, providing objective analysis, recommendations, and a proactive view of risks, opportunities, and organizational dynamics.
  • Help define, prioritize, and communicate the Product & Technology portfolio’s most important enterprise priorities and strategic outcomes.
  • Prepare executive briefings, decision memos, talking points, presentations, and other materials for ELT meetings, leadership reviews, board-related moments, and critical internal communications.
  • Distill complex business, product, technology, operational, and financial information into clear choices, tradeoffs, and recommended actions.
  • Anticipate information and decisions the Chief Product & Technology Officer will need and coordinate the right people, data, and analysis to support timely resolution.
  • Operate with discretion and sound judgment, managing sensitive matters, stakeholder dynamics, and critical escalations professionally.

Portfolio Operating Cadence and Governance

  • Design and manage the operating cadence for the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s organization, including leadership staff meetings, operating reviews, strategic planning, portfolio reviews, and follow-up mechanisms.
  • Establish clear governance practices for cross-functional decisions, escalations, dependencies, and risk management across the Product & Technology portfolio
  • Maintain a single source of truth for enterprise priorities, milestones, decisions, dependencies, risks, and accountability.
  • Aggregate and synthesize performance updates, operating metrics, and strategic progress for the Chief Product & Technology Officer and the ELT.
  • Identify gaps in reporting, metrics, or operating mechanisms and implement improvements that increase transparency, speed, and accountability.
  • Track decisions and commitments through completion, escalating risks early with options and recommendations.

Cross-Functional Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead the most critical, strategic, complex, and high-risk enterprise initiatives on behalf of the Chief Product & Technology Officer from problem definition through implementation and measurable results.
  • Coordinate work across Product, Engineering, Technology Operations, Media Technology and Operations, Advertising Product, Finance, Legal, People & Culture, Security, and other stakeholders as needed.
  • Translate strategic priorities into integrated plans with clear owners, milestones, decision points, measures of success, and communication requirements.
  • Surface cross-portfolio tradeoffs and help leaders align on sequencing, resource allocation, scope, and risk.
  • Facilitate resolution of issues that span multiple functions, organizations, or executive stakeholders.
  • Drive organizational transformation, process improvement, and new ways of working that strengthen execution at scale.

Executive Communications and Alignment

  • Develop clear narratives and communications that connect the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s priorities to company strategy, business outcomes, team member impact, and customer value.
  • Support ELT, Product & Technology leadership, all-hands, offsite, and other executive forums with agendas, content, preparation, and follow-through.
  • Ensure decisions and priorities are communicated consistently across leadership teams and translated into actionable direction.
  • Serve as a connective point across the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s direct leadership team and key enterprise partners, while maintaining appropriate ownership with the accountable leaders.
  • Represent the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s priorities and direction in cross-functional forums when appropriate, using sound judgment and discretion
  • Consolidate, refine, or craft high-quality materials for executive, board, internal, investor, and other external interactions – e.g., presentations, memos, speeches. Also coordinate and assist with meeting prep or speaking rehearsals as needed.

Organizational Effectiveness and Confidential Support

  • Guide and mentor a wide range of leaders and stakeholders, using influence and expertise to strengthen decision quality, enterprise execution, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partner with the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership alignment, team dynamics, and decision quality.
  • Handle confidential business, personnel, financial, product, technology, and organizational information with a high degree of discretion and integrity.
  • Help clarify roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Build trusted relationships across the organization and create effective networks that enable progress without direct authority.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with C-suite, ELT, or senior executive leaders to drive strategic priorities and enterprise execution.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex topics into crisp narratives, executive briefings, and decision memos.

job.title: Audience Editor, Climate and Science
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

We are looking for an audience editor to join the newsroom Audience team and partner with our Climate and Science desks to help them continue to reach more readers and deepen our engagement with those readers.

This editor will work with the desk to inform coverage, both day-to-day and long-term, suggesting timely stories as well as evergreen topics, with an eye toward framing. They will help maximize distribution through search strategies and social programming, and by pitching internally to the homepage, newsletters and other alerts. And they will track data for the desk, using analytical skills to provide context and recommendations to the editors.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Audience strategy & growth:

    • Partner with senior editors to inform coverage decisions, suggesting timely stories, evergreen topics, and longer-term franchises that resonate with reader interest and important news moments, with a keen eye toward framing and formats.

    • Identify coverage and format opportunities that will attract new readers, particularly those who may not currently view The New York Times as a regular news source.

    • Maximize content distribution through sophisticated search strategies, strategic social programming, and by coordinating publication with the homepage, newsletters, and notifications.

    • Identify trending topics and competitive trends, along with coverage and format opportunities that will drive growth and competitive performance with a deep understanding of the off-platform landscape, trends and what's driving conversation.

  • Data analysis & reporting:

    • Interpret data and audience signals to strategically shape how we present stories both on and off our platforms.

    • Deliver actionable daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

    • Contribute to regular audience performance updates, including but not limited to morning audience notes, monthly masthead presentations, and quarterly and annual audience reports to company leadership.

    • Partner with the newsroom audience analytics team on deep and actionable analysis.

  • Social media & engagement:

    • Write compelling social copy, analyze our presence and strategy on existing platforms, and evaluate opportunities for potentially launching new accounts on social platforms.

    • Work with journalists on best social media practices, including framing pieces for specific audiences and effectively using the Reporter Reply commenting feature.

  • Cross-functional collaboration:

    • Liaise with the main search, social, community, home, notifications, and newsletter teams on breaking news and enterprise, coordinating overlapping coverage with Well and other relevant desks.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to a Senior Audience Editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in digital journalism, with a demonstrated track record in audience development.

  • Proven skill at bridging specialties, including reporting, editing, product, analytics, design, and user research.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive work independently and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience communicating and collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of news competitors.

  • In-depth knowledge of the search landscape, with the ability to spot trends and identify misinformation.

  • Solid understanding of all mainstream and emerging social channels, with a willingness to continuously learn about new platforms.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with knowledge of Times style or the ability to absorb and apply it quickly.

  • The ability to write in an engaging, smart tone that feels native to other platforms while remaining consistent with the values of The Times.

  • A highly strategic and analytical mind; comfortable with data, A/B testing, and iterating to find what resonates with various audiences.

  • A dedication to The Times and its journalistic mission.
