job.title: Backend Engineer - Media Streaming
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for a software engineer to join our Media Streaming Team, with a mission to operate a media streaming platform at global scale, delivering the best possible audio experience to creators, listeners, and partners alike. We are handling petabytes of data and gigabytes per second of traffic. You will join a tightly-knit team where you will help shape how millions of people experience music.  

Read about engineering at SoundCloud

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Contribute to building, scaling and maintaining backend APIs and services that serve millions of users
  • Collaborate closely with Android, iOS, web, and full-stack engineers to deliver seamless end-to-end media experiences
  • Ensure performance, scalability, and maintainability of SoundCloud’s services
  • Debug complex issues across systems, ensuring a consistent experience for users globally
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and roadmap planning
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Experience and Background:

  • 4+ years of experience in building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems
  • Proficiency in Go
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform
  • Experience with cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience with microservices, SQL/NoSQL databases, and container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages
  • Knowledge of API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Exposure to media streaming, playback, audio engineering or adjacent domains
  • Familiarity with audio/video codecs, streaming protocols (HLS, DASH), and transport container technologies
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard.
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Your Role


We are seeking stagehands to prepare, set up, install, assemble, tear down, load, unload and transport scenic elements, operate stage machinery and scenic equipment, and handle hands-on production tasks. Stagehands also prepare and configure filming locations to meet production requirements.

 

Key Tasks:

  • Prepare, position, install, assemble, strike, load, unload, transport, move and rearrange scenic elements according to instructions to meet production needs; procure scenic elements as required.
  • Read plans, drawings and instructions to build and strike sets and scenic elements accordingly.
  • Set up, install, adjust, operate and dismantle equipment (such as camera tracks and dollies) according to instructions; procure required equipment and materials as needed.
  • Install and operate stage machinery and scenic equipment according to instructions to fulfil production requirements.
  • Connect various equipment and props as directed, check their operation and report any issues.
  • Operate forklifts, aerial platforms and other motorized vehicles to transport materials or access equipment for installations and adjustments; perform routine maintenance and report servicing needs to the appropriate department.
  • Perform basic cooking, food preparation and beverage service as requested for production needs.
  • Handle and manage cue cards and prompt sheets as directed.
  • Dismantle scenic elements according to instructions, salvaging and preserving reusable materials.
  • Mark and spike rehearsal areas in accordance with plans and instructions.
  • Assist in rigging scenic elements onto battens or other supports, and help establish safety perimeters during installations and manoeuvres.
  • Maintain clean, orderly and well-kept work areas, filming locations and scenic elements.
  • Touch up paint and carry out minor repairs on set elements as needed to fix damage or imperfections.
  • Set up dressing rooms, makeup areas and related furniture and props as needed.
  • Prepare location sites (including setting up wheelchair ramps, guardrails and scaffolding, and levelling ground) to address spatial and production constraints.
  • Keep studio doors closed to maintain a controlled production environment within the studio and surrounding areas.
  • Adhere to rules in effect and guidelines when bringing or moving motorized vehicles and live animals on set.
  • Adjust, modify, repair and maintain scenic elements.
  • Receive, tag and store scenic equipment and materials and update inventory records; report missing or damaged items to the appropriate department and follow up as required; assist with regular inventory counts.
  • Ship, deliver and pick up scenic equipment and materials as directed, logging all incoming and outgoing inventory.
  • Inform staff of the availability and stock location of scenic equipment and materials.
  • Inspect returned equipment and materials for completeness and proper operation; take necessary corrective action and follow up as needed; report any damage or defects to the appropriate department.
  • Weigh scenic equipment and materials to determine loads for rigging or transport, reporting figures as required.
  • Complete the appropriate forms and documents; share information verbally or in writing to ensure proper followup and to keep others informed.
  • Familiarize other employees with their duties and the work environment.
  • Carry out, as needed, all or part of the duties of another job classification within an equivalent or lower salary group, as well as other related duties.

 

Job Requirements:

  • High-school diploma.
  • Twelve (12) months' relevant experience required to perform the duties satisfactorily, given that training is not directly or indirectly related to the job and given the variety of tasks involved (e.g., assembling sets during overnight shifts, working with furniture and props, working on live sets, working outdoors during galas).

  • Deliver cybersecurity strategy through software engineering and automation

job.title: Multi-Skilled Meteorologist (per diem)
job.description:
CBS Atlanta - Multiskilled Meteorologist

This is a per diem position

The brand-new CBS Atlanta is looking to build a dynamic team of meteorologists to drive weather storytelling in a full AR/VR environment. Never worked in that space before? It’s okay, we’ll train you. An ideal candidate must have superior forecasting and severe weather skills.  Ability to produce easy to understand and informational visuals, maps, and graphics to communicate the weather story to customers every day on air, streaming, online and on social media platforms.

Other duties include producing weather content, working with a team of meteorologists, and implementing station strategy. Writing / preparing forecasts; producing graphics to tell the weather story across multiple platforms, strong social media presence. The candidate will also be required to periodically write and report weather-related content for newscasts. We want good communicators who are team focused. Our meteorologists need to be leaders at this startup news operation.


SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE SHOULD HAVE:

  • On-air weather casting experience within a TV Station.
  • A degree in meteorology or related science.
  • Strong writing skills for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Ideal candidate needs to have strong social media skills.
  • Ability to use augmented reality in weather segments is a bonus.
  • Ability to provide continuous live severe weather coverage across all programs.
  • Write daily weather blog and post weather content on social media platforms.
  • Passionate about being a brand ambassador for CBS Atlanta.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • B.S. Degree or equivalent experience in Meteorology or Earth Sciences preferred.
  • Proficient in weather graphics production.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

Job Description:

Semafor is seeking a Senior Accountant to join our Accounting & Finance team and take ownership of core general ledger and month-end close activities as we build out our in-house accounting function. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented accounting professional with a solid foundation in month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations, who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment. This role will work closely with the Controller to strengthen processes, internal controls, and documentation, and will partner with FP&A on cost analysis and reporting. The successful candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, working independently and as part of a team, and adapting to shifting priorities within a rapidly growing media company. Prior experience in the media industry is a plus. This position offers meaningful growth potential as the accounting & finance team continues to scale.

What You’ll Do:

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end close process, ensuring all close deliverables are completed accurately and on a timely basis.
  • Prepare and post journal entries in accordance with GAAP, ensuring transactions are properly recorded and supported.
  • Prepare and analyze monthly account reconciliations for assigned balance sheet and income statement accounts, researching and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations across entities, ensuring balances tie out and are properly eliminated in consolidation 
  • Review the general ledger for accurate coding across all financial dimensions (department, project, entity, etc.), proactively identifying and correcting miscoded transactions.
  • Assist with accounts payable tasks as needed, including invoice coding, vendor inquiries, and payment support.
  • Partner with FP&A on analysis and reporting, including cost analysis, variance analysis, and ad hoc reporting requests.
  • Assist the Controller in further developing accounting processes, internal controls, and documentation.
  • Support the Controller with audits, special projects, and ad hoc analyses as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows and month-end close efficiency, and assist in implementing process improvements.
  • Comfortable wearing many hats and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment.

What You Offer

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field from an accredited university or college; CPA or CPA candidate a plus.
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and general ledger accounting principles.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills with a strong emphasis on Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling).
  • Experience with a general ledger/ERP system (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks) required; Bill.com or similar AP platform experience is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with proven organizational and time management skills and a strong sense of ownership and accuracy.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance role, with the ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines.
  • Experience in the media, publishing, or entertainment industry is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and works well in a team environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Compensation:
The base salary for this position at the time of posting will range from $110,000 - $145,000 in addition to an annual bonus incentive. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications. 

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  General Sales Manager - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) Athens Radio is seeking a General Manager, Sales to lead the market’s advertising sales organization and own revenue growth across broadcast and digital platforms. This strategic sales leadership role requires significant digital advertising expertise, disciplined revenue management, and the ability to build accountable sales teams that deliver integrated marketing solutions for clients. Candidates without a strong foundation in digital advertising strategy, products, analytics, and sales leadership will not be successful in this role.

 

The successful candidate will be an accomplished sales leader with extensive knowledge of digital marketing solutions, including search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display advertising, audience targeting, and campaign analytics. The GSM will be responsible for coaching and developing the sales team to confidently identify client challenges, recommend integrated solutions, and communicate measurable business outcomes across both traditional and digital platforms.

 

This leader owns total market sales performance, including local and digital revenue, new business development, forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and account growth. The General Manager, Sales, will serve as the market’s primary sales leader on integrated marketing strategy, helping sellers connect client objectives with effective multi-platform solutions while ensuring campaigns are measured, analyzed, and optimized to deliver results.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading successful sales teams, growing digital revenue, building integrated marketing strategies, holding teams accountable to performance standards, and developing high-performing sales professionals in a digitally focused media environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers consistent growth across total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business revenue, and account expansion.
  • Builds a sales culture defined by accountability, proactive prospecting, strong coaching, forecast discipline, and high client-service standards.
  • Increases seller confidence and adoption of integrated broadcast and digital solutions, supported by clear needs assessments, strong client strategy, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintains healthy pipeline visibility, accurate forecasting, and timely use of CRM and reporting tools to guide decisions and performance conversations.
  • Improves client retention and growth by using campaign performance data, market insights, and optimization recommendations to demonstrate value.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and inspire the sales organization to achieve and surpass total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business, and account-growth goals.
  • Establish and execute a market revenue strategy that maximizes radio, digital, event, promotional, and other available assets.
  • Drive new-business development and maintain accountability for prospecting, discovery, pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, and closing activity.
  • Develop the sales team’s ability to lead effective client needs assessments and create insight-driven, integrated advertising recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on leadership in digital sales strategy, helping sellers connect products and tactics to client objectives, audiences, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of priority digital advertising solutions and ensure sellers understand how to position them within integrated client strategies.
  • Guide customized campaigns across multiple platforms and use reporting, analytics, key performance indicators, and client feedback to evaluate results and recommend optimization.
  • Coach sellers to communicate campaign performance clearly, set realistic expectations, and strengthen client retention and growth.
  • Lead sales meetings, one-on-one coaching, account strategy sessions, client presentations, and market sales initiatives.
  • Collaborate with digital strategy, account management, operations, programming, and other internal partners to support accurate execution and a positive client experience.

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms.  Responsible for all aspects of daily treasury operations to meet the financial obligations of the organization. Overseas cash reporting and forecasting, credit administration and administration of business insurance programs.

Four year team management experience.

Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

CBS News is seeking a Producer with well-developed organizational skills and editorial instincts to work with the CBS Newsgathering team in Los Angeles. This role will create dynamic, visual content across multiple platforms, including network broadcasts, digital, streaming, and social. The ideal candidate will have a clear understanding of what it takes to produce live and taped segments, possess well-developed broadcast writing skills, plus understand the logistics of scheduling live shots with crews that are balancing newsgathering. You should have the editorial instincts to recognize developing news stories to ensure we are in the right places at the right times, ahead of the story.   A successful candidate is someone who’s worked in a highly functioning, quick-paced newsroom, is highly organized, and calm during breaking news. This person is a pro at multitasking, a passionate journalist, and a consummate team player. You must also be excellent at developing and nurturing relationships with other producers, reporters, photographers, managers, technicians, and other staff members inside and beyond the newsroom. Applicants must be willing to work a Wednesday through Sunday schedule,  along with some holidays.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Pitch original story ideas
  • Develop enterprise stories
  • Produce stories from concept to air
  • Work with correspondents and reporters
  • Participate in editorial meetings
  • Support breaking news coverage
  • Field produce when needed
  • Gather content/shoot basic video when necessary

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of local and/or network TV or cable news field producing experience
  • Strong editorial judgement with experience writing for broadcast 
  • Ability to shoot and knowledge of basic editing
  • Understanding of TV newsgathering and transmission technology
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally, without restriction
  • Must possess a valid U.S. driver’s license with the ability and willingness to drive

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Candidate should have a keen editorial eye for compelling stories of national interest and skill at developing pitches 
  • Successful candidate needs to operate under tight deadlines as well as being fast-moving and flexible
  • Ability to thrive in all environments and be comfortable with breaking news coverage, including natural disasters, tragedies, high-profile interviews, and investigative stories

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. job.title: Director, Programmatic Ad Sales
job.description:
Position Summary

Hearst News is Hearst’s unified programmatic team across Hearst Newspapers and Television, bringing premium local news, lifestyle, sports, entertainment, and video supply across Web, App, and CTV together in a single omnichannel marketplace. As Director, Programmatic Ad Sales, you will help define and execute the commercial strategy for this growing business, translating the scale and quality of our owned-and-operated inventory into meaningful outcomes for agencies, brands, and trading desks.

This is a senior sales leadership role for a modern programmatic seller who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. You will build trusted relationships with senior agency and brand stakeholders, create demand for Hearst News’ differentiated supply, develop direct and curated opportunities, and help clients understand how our premium content, first-party signals, addressability, contextual intelligence, and cross-screen reach can work together in a cohesive activation. You will also lead and develop a sales team, with a focus on coaching, operational excellence, accountability, and building lasting customer trust.

Reporting to the SVP, Programmatic Strategy, you will collaborate across Sales, Strategy & Operations, Technical Ad Management, Analytics, Product, Data, and Marketing. You will bring a strong point of view to the market, create clarity for internal partners, and translate customer insight into scalable commercial opportunities. This is an opportunity to help shape the next phase of Hearst News’ growth and define how advertisers access premium, omnichannel supply at scale.

What You'll Do

Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Own and execute a growth strategy across national agencies, brands, holding-company trading desks, and programmatic buying teams.

  • Develop new business and expand existing relationships through programmatic direct, private marketplace (PMP), preferred, programmatic guaranteed, and curated deal opportunities.

  • Position Hearst News as one premium, omnichannel marketplace spanning local and national audiences across Web, App, and CTV.

  • Build a disciplined pipeline with clear account priorities, business hypotheses, revenue potential, and next steps.

 

Agency, Advertiser & Partner Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with agency investment teams, programmatic leads, data and activation teams, and senior brand stakeholders.

  • Lead consultative conversations that connect client objectives to Hearst News' inventory, audience, data, and measurement capabilities.

  • Create compelling solutions that combine display, video, and CTV supply with addressable audiences, contextual signals, suitability controls, and first-party data where appropriate.

  • Represent customer needs internally and ensure that opportunities move from discovery to proposal, activation, optimization, and renewal with strong ownership throughout.

 

Omnichannel Product & Market Expertise

  • Stay current on the programmatic ecosystem, including DSP and SSP dynamics, identity, privacy, CTV, data collaboration, supply-path efficiency, measurement, and evolving buyer expectations.

  • Translate Hearst News' capabilities into clear, differentiated narratives for sellers and buyers, including our premium O&O supply, audience scale, addressability, contextual and suitability solutions, and cross-divisional packages.

  • Partner with Strategy & Operations, Technical Ad Management, Analytics, Product, and Data to align pricing, packaging, inventory allocation, deal execution, and performance insights.

  • Bring the voice of the customer into product development and help identify the next opportunities to improve our commercial proposition.

 

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate across Hearst News and broader Hearst teams to create larger, more integrated opportunities for advertisers.

  • Work closely with technical and operational partners to troubleshoot issues, improve the buyer experience, and protect campaign performance.

  • Coach and develop junior sellers, establish strong sales operating habits, and contribute to a culture of accountability, curiosity, and shared ownership.

 

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience in programmatic advertising, digital media, publisher sales, ad technology, or a related commercial role, ideally 5+ years in a selling role.

  • A strong understanding of programmatic buying and selling, including PMPs, curated supply, direct deals, audience activation, and the agency decision-making process.

  • A proven record of building senior agency and advertiser relationships and converting those relationships into durable revenue.

  • The ability to sell both the strategic story and the operational details, from market positioning and packaging through deal setup, delivery, and optimization.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills, with a bias toward action and follow-through.

  • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to create momentum across teams in a changing, cross-divisional environment.

  • A deeper understanding of CTV inventory is also a plus.

 

Why Hearst News?

You will join a team building a more connected, data-informed, and buyer-friendly way to access Hearst's premium owned-and-operated news supply. Hearst News combines the trust and local relevance of Hearst Newspapers with the reach and premium video capabilities of Hearst Television, giving advertisers a differentiated omnichannel platform with meaningful scale and quality. This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial strategy, influence product direction, and help define what modern programmatic advertising looks like at Hearst.

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.

  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.

  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.

  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.

  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.

  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.

  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

This position does not provide sponsorship. All applicants should have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship.

 

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York, NY. The reasonable estimate is $165,000 - $169,000. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

job.title: 2027 National Hearst Journalism Fellowship Program
job.description:
Hearst Newspapers Journalism Fellowship

Duration: 2 Years Location: Rotations in San Francisco, Houston, San Antonio, Albany, or Connecticut
Deadline to Apply: January 4, 2027

Are you ready to launch your journalism career with one of the most respected names in media?

The Hearst Journalism Fellowship is a prestigious, full-time, two-year opportunity designed to catapult the next generation of journalists into impactful careers in today’s fast-changing digital landscape.

This isn’t just a foot in the door, it’s a front-row seat to the future of journalism.

What You’ll Experience

  • Two immersive, 12-month rotations at leading Hearst newspapers—including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, Albany Times Union, or one of our respected publications in Connecticut.
  • Work alongside Pulitzer-winning journalists and newsroom leaders who are telling powerful stories with data, video, and AI-driven tools.
  • Receive hands-on mentoring from seasoned editors and specialists who are invested in your growth.
  • Access cutting-edge newsroom tech and training in digital reporting, investigative journalism, breaking news, and audience engagement.

What’s in It for You

  • Full-time employment with a competitive salary and benefits from day one
  • Health insurance, relocation allowance, and housing stipend (depending on location)
  • Personalized career development plans, mentorship, and peer networking across our national newsroom network
  • The opportunity to turn your Fellowship into a long-term journalism career with Hearst Newspapers (many of our Fellows do!)

Who We’re Looking For

We’re seeking bold, curious, and digitally savvy storytellers with a passion for public service journalism. You might be a reporter, digital producer, data journalist, visual storyteller, or multimedia creator.

Ideal candidates will:

  • Be recent college grads or early-career journalists
  • Have a background or demonstrated interest in journalism or related fields
  • Be eager to relocate and take on new beats in multiple cities
  • Bring a hunger to learn, create, and lead in a modern newsroom environment

How to Apply

Please submit the following in PDF format:

  1. Resume (1 page) – Include major/minor, graduation date, contact info, and social handles
  2. Work Samples (1 page with clickable links)
  3. Cover Letter (max 2 pages) – Tell us why you should be our next Fellow
  4. Three Professional References – Names, titles, emails, and phone numbers
  5. Two Letters of Recommendation – Sent directly to: fellowships@hearstnp.com

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the full two-year duration.
We are unable to sponsor work visas for this program.

Deadline to Apply: January 4, 2027

About Hearst Newspapers

With 24 daily and 52 weekly newspapers across the U.S.—including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, and Albany Times Union—Hearst Newspapers is one of the nation’s most influential media networks. We are investing boldly in the future of news—through digital innovation, community journalism, and the talent of storytellers like you.

This is more than a fellowship. It’s your launchpad.
Join us and shape the future of journalism.

Learn more at hearstfellowships.com

job.title: 2027 Hearst AI Newsroom Developer Fellowship Program
job.description:
Hearst Journalism Fellowship Program, Newsroom AI Development

The Hearst Fellowship for Newsroom AI Development is a one-year program focused on building tools for journalists and experiences for readers with the cutting-edge technology. The successful candidate will embed on the DevHub, Hearst’s San Francisco-based editorial innovation team, and they will work on AI-assisted projects, tools and news products with our core product and engineering teams and our top metro newsrooms: San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, Austin American-Statesman, San Antonio Express-News, (Albany) Times Union and our Hearst Connecticut newsrooms. 

Fellows will receive training, mentorship and real-world experience alongside top journalist-programmers who build interactive experiences and automation tools focused on building connections to the local communities we cover. 

Hearst Fellows are full-time employees with competitive salary and benefits, including health insurance, relocation allowance and a housing stipend.

 

What the DevHub does

The Hearst DevHub is a team of editorial engineers, AI developers, data journalists, interactive designers and content strategists who collaborate with local newsrooms to create best-in-class digital experiences. We make things like election results pages, AI tools, searchable databases, severe weather trackers, elegantly designed alternative story forms and whatever else you can dream up. You can learn more about the DevHub here.

 

What this fellowship could mean for your future 

Our goal for the program is for Fellows to earn full-time employment at the end of the yearlong term. We want to train our next builders, and then continue supporting them as they grow into our future leaders.

While participation in the program is not a guarantee of future employment, our goal is to recruit candidates who eventually will join our full-time professional staff. All of us here have an investment in your future and in the future of Hearst Newspapers. 

 

What the successful candidate will do on the DevHub

  • Create AI tools for newsrooms and experiences for readers that adhere to our strict editorial standards and company policies.
  • Work with newsrooms on best practices for AI usage.
  • Enrich existing tools and interactives with fresh approaches to workflows, data analysis and visualization.
  • Innovate with new technology to benefit journalists and the communities we cover.

 

Hearst Fellowships jump-start great journalism careers 

The experience you gain as a Hearst Fellow is the start of a strong foundation for your journalism career. Our objective is to recruit, train and retain journalists who have experience with AI, data journalism and programming. Candidates should be college graduates with interest, experience or background in journalism and AI. 

 

How Fellows are selected 

Hearst DevHub team members will conduct multiple interviews and test the top candidates.

If you are offered and accept a position, you will be assigned a mentor, and we’ll help you develop relationships with seasoned professionals throughout Hearst Newspapers and beyond. 

 

Requirements and Information 

Please see our Fellows website at https://hearstfellowships.com. In addition, candidates must be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area and work a hybrid in-office schedule.

 

To be considered you must submit in all required documents in PDF format: 

  • One-page resume that includes past journalistic experience, academic major and minor, date or expected date of graduation, permanent and current addresses, email, website, and social media addresses (if applicable).
  • Reference page that includes three work references including titles, email addresses and phone numbers.
  • Page with links to portfolio or digital work samples. 

Deadline to apply for the Fellowship program is Jan. 4, 2027.

job.title: Director of Finance
job.description:
Director of Finance

The Houston Chronicle is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Finance to help lead financial operations for one of Hearst Newspapers' most important local media businesses. This role is ideal for a finance leader who combines strong technical accounting judgment with business curiosity, operational discipline, and the ability to translate financial results into clear recommendations and strategy.

Reporting to the VP of Finance, the Director of Finance will oversee key close processes, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, advertising accounting and analysis, and cost control activities while partnering closely with department leaders, centralized accounting teams, and senior leadership. The position requires a leader who can manage the details, improve processes, develop people, and support decision making across a fast-moving and transforming digital and print media operation.

What You Will Do
  • Own the monthly close process, including accruals, variance analysis, review of financial results, and timely completion of close deliverables.
  • Lead weekly P&L reporting, monthly financial reporting, forecasting, and business review support for the VP of Finance, Houston Chronicle leadership, and Hearst Newspapers finance teams.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial reporting, with clear communication of revenue, expense, margin, headcount, and payroll trends.
  • Manage and develop the finance/accounting team, including advertising-focused accounting support and related operating analysis.
  • Oversee advertising accounting activities, including revenue recognition, digital advertising margins, commission processing, goaling, and coordination with advertising operations.
  • Lead advertising analytics and KPI reporting, including trends and insights to support the VP of Finance, VP of Advertising and Publisher.
  • Develop and monitor financial KPIs that help leaders understand performance, optimize product P&Ls and advertising margins, improve budget adherence, and identify cost savings opportunities.
  • Partner with department heads to project, budget, and monitor expenses, improve business processes, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes.
  • Serve as a liaison with centralized accounting teams for accounting functions such as balance sheet reconciliations
  • Assist internal and external audit support in partnership with centralized accounting, including maintenance of internal controls and SOX compliance requirements.
  • Provide technical accounting guidance and support system improvements, reporting enhancements, process automation, and AI-enabled efficiency opportunities.
  • Optimize AI opportunities to automate daily and monthly reporting and improve process workflows. 
  • Prepare ad hoc analysis, special projects, and executive-ready reporting for senior leadership, the VP of Finance, and the Publisher.
Key Relationships
  • Vice President of Finance
  • President and Publisher, Houston Chronicle
  • Senior Vice President of Advertising
  • Executive Editor and senior leadership across functions
  • Hearst Newspapers finance and centralized accounting teams
  • Department heads and operating leaders across the organization
What You Bring
  • 8-10+ years of progressive finance or accounting experience, preferably in a complex operating environment.
  • Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
  • Prior experience as a Director of Finance, Finance Manager, Assistant Controller, or comparable financial leadership role required.
  • Strong technical accounting foundation with experience in monthly close, financial reporting, accruals, variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and audit support.
  • Experience with advertising accounting and revenue recognition, digital margins, commission processing, or media revenue operations preferred.
  • Experience in media, publishing, digital media, marketing services, or a related industry preferred.
  • Proficiency with ERP, planning, and reporting systems; Oracle ERP, Oracle Cloud, Hyperion Planning, business intelligence tools, advanced Excel experience, and AI products preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop finance or accounting team members, including team members who support multiple business partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain financial results and business implications to non-finance leaders.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong process improvement mindset, including interest in automation, AI-enabled tools, and scalable ways to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach to working with internal and external partners.

 

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

job.title: Distribution Assistant
job.description:
Distribution Assistant - Houston Chronicle

Join a team that is dedicated, customer centric, able to adapt to change and enjoys working in the field making sure customers are receiving the best experience in a fast-paced environment.

Assist Distribution Managers Areas of responsibility include home delivery, single copy, third party distribution of the Houston Chronicle along with several third-party distribution partner contracts. The Distribution Assistant may also receive work assignments within many areas of the distribution function, which may include transportation, customer service, and redelivery operations.  This position may be full time or part time. 

What will you do?

  • Ensure compliance with independent contractor agreement; recommend corrective action for violations.
  • Monitor delivery of all products distributed by contractors within the delivery area.
  • Assume delivery responsibilities for open routes when necessary.
  • Contact customers with service-related problems; Work with Distributors and independent contractors to resolve service issues in a timely and permanent manner.
  • Verify the accuracy of information submitted by independent contractors.
  • Monitor and assist in delivery of customer issues such as missed, damaged, or late delivered papers.
  • Regularly attend departmental meetings to maintain a cohesive, well-informed unit.
  • Assist other departments as necessary.
  • Regularly communicate progress and concerns to supervisor.
  • Prepare requested reports in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Periodically audit routes to evaluate service performance and route structure efficiency. 
  • Actively recruit independent contractors.
  • Ensure that the distribution center is maintained in a safe, secure, and clean manner.
  • Other essential duties and tasks as assigned.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Ability to adapt and react to change.

  • Some Computer skills using Outlook, Word, and Excel. Ability to learn 3rd Party programs such as RouteSmart.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule.

  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and proof of auto liability insurance.

  • Ability to lift, push and pull up to 75 pounds.

  • Ability to frequently climb stairs.

  • Standing – 50% of the time.

  • Walking – 50% of the time.

  • Kneeling – 25% of the time.

  • Hearing – 100% of the time. 

  • Depth Perception – 100% of the time.

job.title: Apprentice Pressperson
job.description:
$1,000.00 Sign-on Bonus!

The Times Union is seeking a reliable, conscientious, and mechanically adept person interested in entering a four-year apprenticeship program to become a Journeyman Offset Pressperson in their Albany, NY production operation. If hired, you will work with an experienced, close-knit team responsible for maintaining and operating a state-of-the-art KBA Commander CL press that produces the Times Union, 14 other daily newspapers, fourteen weeklies, three monthlies, and numerous commercial print publications in a high quality and cost-effective manner.

•    Interest in learning a trade that consistently produces high-quality print products.
•    Detail-oriented with a focus on meeting deadlines and customer expectations.
•    Well-developed verbal communication skills.
•    Comfortable with computers and learning how to use them to operate printing presses.
•    Technical knowledge/mechanical aptitude in other production environments helpful.
•    Understands the importance of equipment maintenance and enjoys same.
•    Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
•    High school diploma or equivalent.

Hours: Hours and days can vary based on training and production needs. The normal shift length is 7-1/4 hours. Day shifts currently begin at 10:15 a.m. and evening shifts start at 5:45 p.m.

Pay: Starting pay is $22.43/hour for the first year. As an apprentice progresses and acquires required knowledge and skills, the pay rate increases in steps until full Journeyman status is acquired, usually within 4 years.

Sign-on Bonus: Receive $500.00 after 90 days and $500.00 after 6 months of satisfactory employment.

 

The Times Union is located in New York’s Capital Region. We offer great pay, substantial benefits and the ability to live in a beautiful area of the country. Our commitment to multiculturalism, inclusion and anti-racism is reflected in our content, hiring strategies and culture. We encourage members of underrepresented communities to apply, and all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

 

Interested applicants should contact Darrell Foster, Production Director, at 518-454-5744 or via email at dfoster@timesunion.com

job.title: District Manager
job.description:
Are you a night owl who wants a well-paid position with benefits? The Times Union is looking for a District Manager to service the many customers of our newspaper and our partners in New York's Capital Region. APPLY TODAY!

What You'll Do:

  • Provide excellent service to Times Union, New York Times and other home delivery customers.
  • Manage and administer formal Requests for Proposal (RFP) and Independent Contractor proforma’s as applicable within assigned region(s).
  • Identify and execute regional best practices and assist in identification and execution of cost containment strategies.
  • Provide input into budgets and capital submissions for assigned region(s).
  • Prepare, analyze, and execute substantive contracts and renegotiation requests.
  • Measure and audit contract service metrics for each Independent Business/Contractor as related to the Delivery Service Agreement. 
  • Work directly with the Distribution Director to determine whether to extend or terminate contractual relationships with independent contractors, distributors, and wholesalers.
  • Works closely with staff and Commercial Partners to ensure 3rd Party data accuracy, billing and returns. 
  • Interacts with Independent Contractors and single copy partners to ensure timely and accurate submission of single copy returns. 
  • Interfaces with Independent Contractors to reduce escalated complaints and poor service stops. 
  • Manages Independent Contractor service levels and DQI in accordance with Home Delivery Service Agreement. 
  • Manage distribution of product to independent contractors in an efficient manner at the warehouses.
  • Interact with customers to determine best means of customer satisfaction, complaint resolution and delivery efficiency.
  • Ensure that all routes and all products are delivered by their specified deadline.  When a route is not covered, deliver route(s) to ensure maximum customer satisfaction when necessary.
  • Practice safe working habits in all working environments.
  • Other duties assigned and as needed.

What You'll Need to Succeed: 

  • High School Diploma with 1-3 years relative experience.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Computer skills such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, NCS, touch-typing and internet services.
  • Proficiency in contract administration, negotiation, and compliance.
  • Ability to prepare and analyze contracts in an effective and error-free manner.
  • Analytical ability to manage contract performance metrics and complete departmental level reporting. 
  • Work effectively across departments, including Operations, Field Services, Customer Care, Newsroom and Sales. 
  • Work closely with Management to ensure all leased facilities are maintained in the appropriate condition and costs are minimized. 
  • Ability to manage budgets and identify opportunities for cost savings and optimization.
  • Ability to respond to frequent demands of multiple customers (internal and external).
  • Strong interpersonal skills. Must be very customer focused and must be a team player willing to help when and where needed.
  • Strong ability to troubleshoot, think forward to identify potential issues, and formulate responsive plans.     
  • Strong conflict management skills.
  • Ability to work in multiple different environments. Warehouse, driving/field work, office settings, etc.
  • Ability to lift, push and pull up to 75 lbs.

  • MUST HAVE a valid driver’s license, operable vehicle, and current proof of automobile insurance. 


     

District Managers begin their workday at or about 12:30 AM., weekends included. The work week is generally 37.5 hours per week; two consecutive days off each week, except OT for Holidays, and any needed circumstances. Hours and days are subject to change and may vary as the job warrants; mandatory overtime may be required. Extra pay comes with night and weekend work; two-and-a-half times pay for holidays, and time and a half for OT. Additional benefits include a monthly cell phone stipend, and a $100 quarterly auto-use bonus. Annual base pay is $51,928.50, with potential to grow. 

The Times Union manages home delivery for several newspapers in Eastern New York. This is a union position with benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid vacations, sick leave and personal time; pension; tuition assistance. 

You must list your job history in your application, or attach a resume, in order to be considered. Proof of valid NY Drivers' License and auto insurance required.

The Times Union offers great pay, substantial benefits and the ability to live in a beautiful area of the country. Our commitment to multiculturalism, inclusion and anti-racism is reflected in our content, hiring strategies and culture. We encourage members of underrepresented communities to apply, and all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job.title: Texas A&M Reporter
job.description:
The Houston Chronicle is looking for a digitally savvy reporter to cover Texas A&M and one of the most passionate fan bases in college sports. This is a role for a journalist who understands that Aggie athletics is more than scores and press conferences. It’s a year-round online conversation shaped by recruiting drama, fan reaction, coaching speculation, traditions, memes, social media and the rapidly changing business of college athletics.

 

We’re looking for someone who can move quickly, spot stories before they fully break and connect with audiences wherever they are — including social platforms, YouTube and video. The ideal candidate understands internet culture, thrives in a competitive news environment and knows how to turn complicated college sports developments into smart, accessible journalism that fans want to read, watch and share.

 

This reporter will cover Texas A&M athletics with urgency, creativity and authority, helping shape one of the Chronicle’s most visible and audience-driven coverage areas.

Key responsibilities

  • Deliver timely, audience-focused coverage of Texas A&M athletics that goes beyond game recaps and press conferences
  • Break news on recruiting, coaching changes, NIL developments, conference shifts and the evolving business of college sports
  • Identify and cover trending conversations, fan reactions and online moments shaping the Texas A&M community
  • Live-blog football and key volleyball, baseball and softball games
  • Produce smart analysis and explainers that help readers understand major stories and developments in college athletics
  • Collaborate with video and audience teams to create video content for social platforms, YouTube and Chronicle platforms, including quick reactions, explainers and analysis
  • Use analytics, search trends and audience insights to guide coverage decisions and identify opportunities for growth
  • Write and produce a Texas A&M newsletter
  • Collaborate with photographers, videographers, editors and audience strategists to create engaging, multiplatform storytelling
  • Build sourcing across the athletic department, the college sports landscape and the Texas A&M community
  • Travel as assigned for major games, SEC events and key coverage opportunities

We’re looking for someone who

  • Has three to five years of relevant sports reporting experience, ideally covering college athletics or another highly competitive, audience-driven beat
  • Understands the culture of college sports fandom and how online communities shape conversations around teams and athletes
  • Is comfortable reporting quickly and accurately in a fast-moving digital news environment
  • Has strong instincts for social storytelling, audience engagement and identifying stories that fans care deeply about
  • Is comfortable on camera and capable of creating compelling video explainers, reactions and analysis
  • Thinks creatively about storytelling formats and embraces experimentation across platforms
  • Is collaborative, audience-focused and committed to producing accurate, high-quality journalism under deadline pressure

Success is measured by

  • Breaking news and producing must-read coverage that stands out in the competitive college sports landscape
  • Growing audience engagement across platforms, including social, search, newsletters and video
  • Building a loyal readership among Texas A&M fans and broader college sports audiences
  • Creating content that consistently sparks conversation, drives sharing and strengthens the Chronicle’s presence in Texas college sports coverage
  • Helping readers better understand the culture, business and evolving future of college athletics

 

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Title: Account Executive

Join Midland Reporter Telegram to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview:  Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at Midland Reporter Telegram. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Midland area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within the Midland Reporter Telegram, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process.  

Why The Midland Reporter Telegram? 

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!
  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieves success as an Account Executive. 
  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.
  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.
  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.
  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.
  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.
  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.
  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.
  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.
  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.
  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

The Midland Reporter-Telegram, acquired by Hearst in 1979, is located in the heart of the vast 54-county Permian Basin of West Texas, a geological region producing 70 percent of the oil in Texas. The newspaper’s special coverage includes the Permian Basin Oil Report, a weekly section devoted to news of the gas and oil industry, and the mywesttexas.com website which serves the entire Permian Basin with local news and information.

This hands-on, end-to-end producer will take ideas from concept through production, post-production, publishing, and audience growth.

The role will support original Axios video programming, including The Axios Show, and other editorial video formats across YouTube, social, and digital platforms.

The Producer/Senior Producer will partner with editorial, video, social, audience, revenue, and external production partners to turn strong ideas into compelling, visually engaging video. This person will be equally comfortable developing a treatment, directing a shoot, editing a finished piece, managing production timelines, and working with on-camera talent.

  • Produce video from ideation through scripting, shooting, post-production, publishing, and promotion.

  • Create video optimized for YouTube and other digital platforms, including packaging, audience retention, and distribution.
  • Use platform trends and performance insights to inform creative decisions and help grow Axios’ video audience.

  • Strong editorial judgment, visual storytelling skills, and the ability to turn ideas into compelling finished video.
  • Experience producing for YouTube and an understanding of audience development, search/discovery, retention, and platform-native storytelling.
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience working with on-camera talent, alongside strong writing, communication, and project-management skills.
