We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Senior Producer to join Translation!

 

What You'll Do

  • Produce great work.
  • Manage and lead large scale, multi-faceted campaigns from concept vetting through job wrap with limited oversight.
  • Problem solve with internal and external teams to get to the best work possible. 
  • Develop and manage production calendars and direct the logistical flow of all phases of production to ensure all assets are delivered on time.
  • Accurately evaluate the feasibility of concepts, ideas, and scripts against client parameters.
  • Control the budget through all phases of production, working closely with business affairs during the production process through the closing of jobs, including presenting estimates and overages to clients for approval.
  • Manage junior producers working on your project and delegate assignments based on the job needs.
  • Research, evaluate and negotiate with industry partners to bring the best talent available to our projects, on time and on budget.
  • Manage shoots and post sessions to ensure the creative output is at its highest quality.
  • Follow financial and job wrap policies of the production department, client and agency.
  • Seek opportunities for underrepresented creators both in the agency and within the industry.
  • Support the creative team and their ideas/ representing, owning, championing and finding creative solutions to bring the idea to life in accordance with the brief, concept and budget
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Have an outstanding creative sensibility with a proven track record of producing industry leading work.
  • A track record of gaining the trust and respect of clients, internal teams and industry partners. 
  • The ability to work under pressure with flexibility, agility, and a good sense of humor.
  • Well versed in managing budgets and deadlines of all types with accuracy and diplomacy.
  • Superb problem solving, organizational, and communications skills.
  • You are a flexible multi-tasker that can handle a multitude of different responsibilities at one time.
  • Existing relationships with best in class industry talent.
  • Demonstrate, evangelize and live the core values of the agency.
  • Incorporate the passion, excitement and experience of one’s MINOR in relevant ways that inform the quality and output of the company.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of production experience at a creative driven company.
  • A portfolio of work showing large budget productions.
  • After hours work and overnight travel to shoots and post sessions required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with celebrities, athletes, musicians, influencers, etc. 
  • Experience with union and non-union crew productions, including both SAG and non-SAG talent. 
  • Passion and knowledge of latest industry trends (music, media, distribution, directors, film, tech, etc).

 

About UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters has over 1.5 million artists on its platform and is growing rapidly. Brands like Diageo, Ally, and ESPN come to UnitedMasters to partner with these artists and play a role in moving culture forward. In the past year, UnitedMasters subscribers have grown rapidly. With $170M raised to date and valued at $550M, UnitedMasters is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Apple, Alphabet (aka Google), and Disney amongst others. Over the last year, UnitedMasters artists have used our platform to land sync deals with major brands including the NBA, ESPN, Overtime Elite, Bose, Warner Brother Studios and in the NBA video game 2k. These deals give them additional money for their work and increase their exposure.

 

Salary Hiring Range: $115k-135k

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases that may include bonus, stock options, 401k match).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes

  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments

  • Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs

  • Ease working with senior level executives and using influencing skills to negotiations and drive sales

  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust

  • Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information

  • Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members

  • Business development experience with new and existing customers

                                                                             

Location:

Tigard, OR: 13333 SW 68th Parkway, Suite 300, 97223

                                                                             

Position Type:

Time Type:

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

job.title: Analista de Cumplimiento Publicitario, Posición Temporal por 2 meses
job.description:
Nombre de la Posición: Analista de Cumplimiento Publicitario

Ubicación: Ciudad de México (Protele)

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. Con la videoteca más extensa de contenido propio y una capacidad de producción sin igual en la industria, impulsamos nuestras plataformas de streaming, televisión tradicional y radio, creando experiencias que conectan con millones de personas.

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y Estados Unidos, unidos por la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y la innovación. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un entorno inclusivo, dinámico y lleno de oportunidades para crecer personal y profesionalmente, ¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo creativo!

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un(a) Analista de Cumplimiento Publicitario para integrarse al Departamento de Cumplimiento Publicitario.

El Departamento de Cumplimiento Publicitario es responsable de revisar y aprobar contenido publicitario para televisión, radio y plataformas digitales, garantizando el cumplimiento de las leyes, regulaciones, políticas corporativas y estándares de la industria. El equipo trabaja en estrecha colaboración con áreas comerciales, legales, producción y operaciones para identificar riesgos regulatorios, de propiedad intelectual, derechos de terceros y reclamaciones publicitarias, contribuyendo a la protección de la empresa y sus audiencias.

Sobre ti 

Eres una persona proactiva, organizada y con un alto sentido de responsabilidad y urgencia frente al cumplimiento de plazos regulatorios y legales, capaz de priorizar tareas críticas en entornos de trabajo dinámicos y de alta demanda.

Tu día a día

  • Revisar anuncios políticos para televisión, radio y plataformas digitales, verificando el cumplimiento de requisitos regulatorios, divulgaciones obligatorias y políticas internas antes de su transmisión.
  • Documentar las labores de revisión, una vez que se ha identificando posibles riesgos legales, regulatorios o de cumplimiento que puedan requerir correcciones o validaciones adicionales para solicitar correcciones a agencias y dar seguimiento a los contenidos.
  • Dar seguimiento oportuno a campañas políticas en revisión, asegurando que los materiales sean procesados dentro de plazos regulatorios y operativos estrictos.
  • Mantener comunicación constante con tu jefe, equipos internos, agencias, representantes políticos y áreas de soporte, proporcionando orientación sobre requisitos de cumplimiento y estatus de revisiones.
  • Monitorear prioridades y resolver solicitudes de alto volumen en un entorno dinámico, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta establecidos durante la temporada electoral.

Tu deberías de tener

  • Licenciatura concluida en Ciencias de la Comunicación o Mercadotecnia o Periodismo o áreas afines.
  • Inglés intermedio-avanzado con capacidad para revisar y comprender documentación profesional en ambos idiomas.
  • Conocimiento en paquetería de Microsoft (Word, Excel y Adobe Acrobat Reader)
  • Dominio de Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
  • Capacidad para analizar, revisar y evaluar contenido audiovisual y publicitario en televisión, radio y medios digitales, identificando detalles relevantes y asegurando el cumplimiento de lineamientos establecidos.
  • Excelente atención al detalle y habilidad para detectar inconsistencias, omisiones o elementos que requieran seguimiento.
  • Capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente en entornos de alto volumen y bajo plazos estrictos.
  • Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita para interactuar eficazmente con equipos multidisciplinarios y partes interesadas.
  • Pensamiento analítico y criterio profesional para investigar, documentar y escalar hallazgos de manera clara y oportuna.
  • Posición Temporal por 2 meses

Beneficios

En TelevisaUnivision, valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros colaboradores. Promovemos un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional, ofreciendo beneficios de ley y superiores que impulsan la productividad, la creatividad y el desarrollo personal y profesional.

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

TelevisaUnivision es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados serán considerados para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, nacionalidad, discapacidad, edad u otra característica protegida por la ley.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Account Manager (Leave Cover)
job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.  

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV, Network 10 (Australia) and Channel 5 (UK).   

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as 10 Streaming and on SVOD with Paramount+. 

 

 

 

 

We now have a rare opportunity for an experienced Ad Sales Account Manager to join our industry-recognised team in SYDNEY on a leave cover contract.   

 

What you’ll do as an Account Manager- Ad Sales:   

As an Account Manager you will work within Paramount’s high performing Ad Sales team representing and selling advertising across the Paramount ecosystem including Network Ten. You will be a champion of TV/Streaming and display a firm understanding of the role it plays in delivering effective outcomes for your portfolio of clients. You will act as the face of the Paramount brand in market, representing with passion, maximising revenue opportunities, creating best-in-class strategic solutions, and building meaningful relationships with your partners. 

 

Some of the key responsibilities include:  

  • Leading a dynamic portfolio of Agency/Direct clients with accountability for achieving revenue, increasing market share and yield targets across the wider Paramount playground (TV, BVOD, SVOD).  
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key clients, understanding their business objectives and providing tailored solutions. 
  • Proactively engage with media agencies via regular in person meetings and presentations to pitch creative opportunities and integrated cross-platform solutions. 
  • Mentoring and guiding Account Executives, fostering a positive team culture by providing training and support to enhance the skills and performance of the overall team. 
  • Educating yourself on the evolving media landscape by staying informed on industry trends, competitors and market conditions to identify any potential risks or opportunities for growth.  
  • Collaborating with all internal stakeholders within the business ie: Digital, Regional, Commercial Data & Innovation, Paramount Brand Studio, Sport, Revenue etc to provide seamless sales strategies for your clients and content led partnership opportunities.  
  • Driving new business growth by proactively prospecting and qualifying new clients 
  • Champion internal process improvements, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and enhance productivity in campaign delivery and client service. 

 

What are the benefits?  

  • Representing some of the world’s most powerful media & entertainment brands and content  
  • Ability to thrive in a highly successful Sales team who work hard and celebrate success regularly.  
  • Free subscription to Paramount + amongst other benefits 

  

What are we looking for in an Account Manager? What’s important?    

  • Account management experience in advertising and/or media sectors  
  • Demonstrated experience in a sales-focused role and pitching solutions to clients  
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills  
  • First-rate presentation skills   
  • A passion for content, streaming, advertising innovation and audience behaviour 
  • Understanding of the broader media landscape  
  • Strong agency/buyer relationships highly regarded 
  • Bachelor’s degree in media, Communications, Business, Marketing or related field highly regarded but not essential. 

 

 

Paramount ANZ is proud to be recognised by Diversity Council Australia as a 2024-2025 Inclusive Employer.  

 

Paramount embraces differences and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds regardless of factors such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property or birth. These grounds also include age, nationality, marital status, disability, place of residence and sexual orientation.   

 

Paramount acknowledges and respects Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the first peoples of the lands where we live, learn and work, and honours their continuing connection and care for Country and storytelling.   

 

#LI-LG1

Paramount recognises that everyone is unique, and you might require some adjustments to ensure you have the best opportunity to apply and be considered for this position.  If we can make some adjustments to our recruitment/interview process to help set you up for success please contact us at careers@networkten.com.au.  Adjustments include but are not limited to; alternative application methods, interview setups, physical requirements, guidance for trans or gender diverse applicants, specific interview availability times.

job.title: Account Coordinator - The Merch Collective
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Merch Collective is an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talent—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership.

 

As an Account Coordinator, you will support the execution of artist commerce initiatives across touring, e-commerce, retail, VIP, licensing, events, and pop-up activations. Working closely with Account Managers and cross-functional teams, you will help coordinate merchandising projects from concept through fulfillment by tracking deliverables, facilitating communication, and ensuring projects remain organized and on schedule. You will assist with product development, client requests, and day-to-day project execution while collaborating with creative, production, operations, finance, and fulfillment teams to deliver a seamless experience for artists and their teams. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to supporting multiple projects simultaneously.

What you'll do:

Support Client Relationships & Day-to-Day Account Management

  • Partner closely with Account Managers to deliver exceptional service to artists, management, and internal teams. Support Account Managers through proactive communication, meeting coordination, follow-up, and execution across touring, e-commerce, retail, VIP, and licensing initiatives.

Coordinate Merchandise & Commerce Execution

  • Support the planning and execution of merchandising and commerce initiatives by tracking deliverables, coordinating product launches, and ensuring projects move efficiently from concept through completion while contributing ideas that enhance the fan experience.

Support Project Coordination & Product Development

  • Coordinate the day-to-day workflow of merchandise projects, including product setup, approvals, artwork routing, placing orders, sample tracking, inventory coordination, and launch readiness. Maintain accurate documentation and ensure all project details are organized and executed on schedule.

Coordinate Cross-Functional Communication & Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a key point of coordination between creative, production, finance, touring, e-commerce, retail, and external partners. Ensure information is communicated clearly, action items are tracked, new clients onboarded, and processes are followed to keep projects moving efficiently and accurately.

Who you are:

  • 1+ years of experience in merchandising, e-commerce, retail, marketing, project coordination, entertainment, or a related field, with an interest in artist commerce.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and priorities while maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with teammates and cross-functional partners and is comfortable following up, asking questions, and keeping projects on track.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn, with a solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to work in ambiguity while being adaptable to ever changing shifts, changes and seasonal ebbs and flows of the business
  • Passionate about music, merchandising, and fan experiences, with a collaborative attitude and a desire to contribute to outstanding client service and the successful execution of artist commerce initiatives.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Program Movement Specialist
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

We are looking for an eager and motivated candidate to join the Acquisition & Distribution team in the role of Program Movement Specialist. You will be responsible for ensuring high quality and entertaining programming reaches millions of Canadians for well known brands such as Citytv, FX, Bravo, and Discovery by supporting teams with maintaining the media asset catalogue, and development of ingest and delivery pipeline workflows.

What you will do:

 

  • Foster relationships with customers and internal teams related to content availability,
  • Track and troubleshoot issues with content availability.
  • Support co-workers and teams through training and feedback on system improvements
  • Maintain training and support materials for distribution to teams and new hires.

Organization: Applied Machine Learning Group (AMLG) → ML Platform
Level: Lead / Senior Lead (IC4–IC5)

 

Overview 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Lead ML Platform Engineer to architect and own the technical direction for our Training and Inference infrastructure. This is a high-leverage role designed for an expert who understands the deep technical stack required to shift ML models from research to global production. You will be responsible for the "engine room" of the AMLG, ensuring that our MLEs can train massive models efficiently and serve them with sub-millisecond reliability. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems and hardware acceleration. You will lead the adoption and optimization of AnyScale (Ray) for distributed training and manage a high-performance Kubernetes-based inference environment. You aren't just managing clusters; you are building a seamless, scalable platform that abstracts the complexity of GPUs and distributed compute for the entire organization.

Why This Role Matters

The ML Platform Lead is the force-multiplier for every other ML pod. In this role, you will directly shape:

The Training Foundation: Establishing AnyScale/Ray as the standard for distributed compute, enabling MLEs to train models on petabytes of data without managing infrastructure.
Inference at Scale: Architecting the serving layer that handles billions of requests per day, optimizing for both p99 latency and GPU utilization.
Operational Excellence: Setting the organizational standards for how ML models are deployed, monitored, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Roadmap & Strategy: Own the long-term architectural direction for the Training and Inference domains, ensuring the platform scales 10x over a 1–3 year horizon.
Distributed Training Leadership: Lead the implementation and optimization of Ray/AnyScale, providing a unified compute layer for batch processing, model training, and reinforcement learning.
High-Performance Inference: Design and maintain K8s-based inference servers (e.g., Triton, TorchServe, or vLLM) optimized for GPU memory management and high throughput.
Hardware & Cost Optimization: Navigate the trade-offs between different GPU instances (A100s, H100s, T4s), optimizing for cost, availability, and performance.
Cross-Team Standardization: Solve high-leverage problems that affect multiple pods (e.g., Entry, Session, Presentation), establishing reusable patterns for CI/CD, model versioning, and canary deployments.
Reliability Engineering: Define and enforce SLIs/SLOs for the platform, ensuring that infrastructure failures never interrupt the user-facing personalization experience.
Mentorship & Coaching: Act as a technical mentor to senior engineers across the ML Platform and Applied ML pods, raising the bar for system design and operational rigor.

Basic Qualifications

6-8+ years of experience in ML Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or high-scale Backend Engineering.
Orchestration & Serving: Extensive experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and serving frameworks for large-scale ML models.
Hardware Proficiency: Strong knowledge of GPU architecture, CUDA, and optimizing ML workloads for hardware acceleration.
Leadership (IC4/5): Proven track record of owning the technical direction for a major domain anddriving impact across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Infra-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) and building automated MLOps pipelines.
Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep expertise with Ray (AnyScale) or similar distributed compute frameworks.
Familiarity with ML observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Weights & Biases, or MLFlow).
Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud ML environments.
Deep knowledge of Python and C++ for performance-critical systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you will:

Unify the Compute Layer: Successfully transition the majority of AMLG training workloads to a governed AnyScale/Ray environment.
Optimize Inference ROI: Measurably improve GPU utilization and reduce inference costs through better auto-scaling and server optimization.
Establish Durable Standards: Author the "Gold Standard" for ML deployments that is adopted by at least three other pods in the organization.
Reduce Systemic Risk: Implement a self-healing infrastructure layer that significantly reduces manual intervention for cluster-related failures.

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers. All are encouraged to apply.

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships.

As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution.

Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Compensation:

This position will be paid on a 100% commission basis. Commission rates generally range from 2.0% to 10%+ depending on product, station, and type of business.

The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

job.title: Media Consultant - Jacksonville Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Jacksonville Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:

Fox Corporation

FOX is seeking a Senior Transmission Engineer to join our Fox Network Engineering and Architecture team in Los Angeles, supporting high-profile live sports productions across FOX Sports.  As a member of the team, you will collaborate closely with FOX Sports’ Engineering and Field Operations teams, designing, implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting network transmission systems that deliver mission-critical video, audio, and data signals from venues to broadcast and digital platforms.

The ideal candidate brings expertise in networking and broadcast transmission technologies, a strong operational mindset, and the ability to perform under the demands of live event production. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role operating in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment aligned with live sports schedules, requiring flexibility for nights, weekends, and major events.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain transmission paths for live sports events, including fiber, satellite, IP-based transport (SMPTE ST 2110 / 2022), and bonded cellular solutions
  • Coordinate and manage contribution and distribution workflows between venues, broadcast centers, and cloud environments
  • Provide real-time operational support for live sports broadcasts, including rapid troubleshooting and escalation management
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless signal acquisition and delivery
  • Monitor network performance, signal integrity, latency, and redundancy across all transmission paths
  • Design and implement failover strategies and redundancy plans to ensure high availability during live events
  • Support integration of emerging technologies, including cloud-based workflows and remote production (REMI) models

  • Strong understanding of IP networking concepts, including BGP, OSPF, multicast (PIM, IGMP), QoS, VLANs, and STP

  • Familiarity with streaming and transport technologies, multicast distribution, and packetized video/audio workflows

  • Experience supporting or deploying systems using SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022, AES67, or Dante is a significant plus

  • Hands-on experience with network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls) in high-bandwidth environments
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex signal paths under time-sensitive conditions
  • Demonstrate ability to perform and analyze packet captures using tools like Wireshark or tcpdump.
  • Understanding of redundancy models, QoS, and network reliability principles

  • Knowledge and practical experience with Arista switches and EOS

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with production and engineering teams

job.title: Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
WLWT Engineering operates in a fast-paced, technically advanced environment that supports broadcast systems, IT infrastructure, and live production workflows. We are seeking a Broadcast Maintenance Technician to join our Engineering team. 

This position is responsible for maintaining and supporting the broadcast and IT systems that keep the station on the air and operating at a high level. It is ideal for a technically capable individual who enjoys troubleshooting, learning new systems, and working collaboratively across multiple departments. 

The Broadcast Maintenance Technician will work with a wide range of technologies, including broadcast equipment, RF systems, networking, servers, automation, video and audio routing, and live production systems. 

Responsibilities 

• Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair broadcast and IT systems to support reliable daily operations. 

• Execute and improve preventative maintenance programs.

• Install, configure, test, and maintain broadcast equipment, networking systems, servers, workstations, and related infrastructure. 

• Provide technical support to News, Production, Creative Services, Sales, and Administration. 

• Support live broadcasts and remote productions, including technical setup, operation, and troubleshooting. 

• Assist with the maintenance and operation of digital transmitters, satellite systems, automation platforms, and content-distribution workflows. 

• Travel as needed to transmitter sites, remote locations, and live event venues. 

• Respond to equipment failures and technical issues, including those requiring service outside normal business hours. 

• Document systems, workflows, technical procedures, maintenance activities, and configuration changes. 

• Collaborate with engineering and IT team members on station operations, system improvements, and new technology deployments. 

• Maintain compliance with FCC regulations, industry standards, and Hearst Television technical requirements. 

• Participate in equipment evaluations, system testing, capital projects, and technology planning as assigned. 

 

Requirements 

• A strong technical foundation in broadcast engineering, IT, audiovisual systems, electronics, or a related field. 

• Experience with managed network switches and IP-based systems. 

• Working knowledge of servers, workstations, and network infrastructure. 

• Understanding of TCP/IP networking, VPNs, and LAN environments. 

• Experience with Windows desktop and server operating systems. 

• Familiarity with broadcast equipment, production environments, RF systems, video and audio routing, automation, or digital transmission. 

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 

• The ability to work effectively under pressure during live broadcasts, technical failures, and time-sensitive situations. 

• The ability to lift 50 pounds and work on rooftops, at transmitter sites, and in confined spaces as required. 

• A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel to remote locations and live event venues. 

 

Education and Preferred Qualifications 

• An associate degree or higher in Electronic Engineering Technology, Broadcast Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; completion of a comparable accredited technical program will also be considered. 

• Cisco, VMware, Microsoft, SBE, or similar certifications are preferred. 

• Military technical training or experience is valued. 

• Candidates with strong IT, audiovisual, electronics, or technical aptitude who are interested in learning broadcast systems are encouraged to apply. 

• A commitment to ongoing professional development in broadcast, IT, networking, and emerging technologies. 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. Residents enjoy easy access to miles of beaches, the Chesapeake Bay, and outdoor recreation year-round. We're hiring a Master Control Operator in Des Moines, IA to be a key player in our 24/7 operations hub. In this role, you’ll help drive the success of live news, sports, and special event broadcasts across multiple channels. It’s high energy, high impact — and no two days are the same.

What You’ll Do:

  • Operate the multi-channel Master Control room, managing live events, playlists, graphics, and automation systems.
  • Maintain seamless broadcasts by preparing, monitoring, and adjusting playlists in real time.
  • Execute precision switching for live news and sporting events.
  • Monitor on-air feeds to ensure content matches programming schedules and meets technical standards.
  • Ingest, record, and prepare content for broadcast with a strong focus on accuracy and timing.
  • Ensure proper routing of video sources and troubleshoot equipment issues as needed.
  • Keep detailed logs and documentation on air discrepancies, timing, and run times.
  • Communicate clearly and consistently with team members and management to support smooth shift transitions.
  • Stay sharp and adaptable in a mission-critical, fast-moving environment.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in Master Control operations or broadcast environments (1+ year preferred).
  • Familiarity with live event production, news switching, and local station workflows is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to juggle multiple feeds and priorities.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology including automation systems, switchers, servers, and signal monitoring tools.
  • Knowledge of industry standards related to audio, video, closed captioning, and loudness compliance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm under pressure.
  • Willingness to work any shift in a 24/7 operation, including weekends and holidays.
  • Experience with Amagi CLOUDPORT or similar cloud-based playout systems is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and general computer applications.

We believe the future of media lies at the intersection of great content, cutting-edge technology, and passionate people. At Sinclair, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, invests in talent, and leads the way in local broadcasting. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills, contribute to live moments that matter, and help shape the way millions of viewers experience news and entertainment.

If you're ready to take the reins in a fast-moving broadcast environment where accuracy, timing, and teamwork are everything — apply today and bring your talent to Sinclair.

Product Strategy & Vision

Product Execution & Delivery

• Define measurement frameworks and success metrics to evaluate product effectiveness and campaign viewability.

Cross-Functional Leadership

job.description:
Deputy Director of Visuals, San Antonio Express-News

 The deputy director of visuals helped to lead daily operations of the department to ensure an audience-driven focus on informative and engaging photography and videos, with a mission to increase engagement and enhance the visual quality of our digital and print news reports. The position reports to the regional director of visuals, Michel Fortier.

Major daily responsibilities: 

  • Edit visual content for quality, accuracy and relevance across platforms.
  • Coordinate scheduling and logistics for daily assignments and breaking news.
  • Collaborate across departments to seek out visual opportunities.
  • Help manage and coach visual journalists.
  • Coordination with the audience team on initiatives to build audience. 
  • Daily presentation of visuals in the afternoon budget meeting
  • Editing of video projects as needed


Attributes needed for success: 

  • Audience-first mentality, willingness to experiment with new story forms to promote digital audience engagement with print as a secondary element.
  • Understanding of social media as a tool to increase our reach, emphasizing work which puts audience growth first
  • Editing ability for both daily, short and long-term projects for digital and print.  
  • Sense of urgency and the ambition to win the 24/7 news cycle on digital platforms
  • Ability to work effectively under deadline pressure.
  • Adherence to journalistic ethics.
  • Knowledge of communications law as it applies to photography.
  • Working knowledge of photo software programs such as Photoshop, Premiere Pro and Photo Mechanic.
  • A passion for journalism that elevates and motives others. 


Requirements: 

  • Hybrid, 40 hours a week, with four-day-per-week in-office requirement.
  • Some weekend, evening and holiday work will be required.
  • A minimum of 3 years of visuals experience within a news organization. 
  • Previous supervisory experience is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, photography, video or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted.
  • Ability to edit video on deadline when needed.

 

About the San Antonio Express-News

The Express-News is the third-largest daily newspaper in Texas and the only daily in San Antonio. It serves a metro area of 2.5 million people. By one name or another, it traces its roots back to 1865. Over the past three years, the paper has reorganized to focus on digital journalism and substantially increased the audience for its subscriber website, ExpressNews.com. Over the same period, the Express-News has won a George Polk Award, two IRE (Investigative Reporters and Editors) Awards, and numerous regional and state journalism prizes.

It is part of Hearst, a diversified global media, services and information business. Hearst Newspaper Group includes the Express-News, the Houston Chronicle, the Austin American-Statesman, the San Francisco Chronicle, the Albany Times Union and other daily and weekly papers.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.

job.title: Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement
job.description:
Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement

The Houston Chronicle is seeking a Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement to lead the next chapter of our digital strategy.

This senior leader will oversee efforts to grow and deepen audiences for the Houston Chronicle across video, engagement and conversation, social platforms, emerging platforms, local trends and trending content. The role will help transform viewers, listeners, readers and commenters into loyal fans of our journalism—and build meaningful relationships with audiences across Houston.

We’re looking for someone who is deeply curious about audiences: what they need, how they discover information, what makes them return and how journalism can better serve them. This leader should be able to articulate a clear, actionable philosophy for digital growth and translate that philosophy into newsroom strategy, daily operations and measurable results.

This is a hands-on role for a creative, data-informed and operationally minded digital leader who is comfortable with experimentation, change and scale. The successful candidate will understand that the audience strategies that worked in the past will not be enough for the future. As search traffic declines and platform and consumer habits continue to evolve, this leader will help us build new ways for audiences to discover, engage with and depend on our work.

This is an opportunity to bring your vision to a senior leadership team boldly reimagining what local news can be. You will help make the Houston Chronicle a powerhouse of digital journalism—one that serves all of Houston and remains essential for years to come.

As a member of the newsroom’s senior leadership team and masthead, the Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement will help shape strategy across the organization. This role reports to the editor-in-chief and oversees teams focused on video, audience growth and engagement, local trends and trending content, and social media.

You’ll join our news organization at a pivotal moment.

The Medill School at Northwestern recently named our newsroom a Bright Spot in Local Journalism. The American Press Institute recently included us in a creators cohort, and we wrote about our experiences innovating with creators. We were named the Best Newsroom in Texas for 2026 and were finalists for ONA Awards for innovative journalism and INMA’s Global Media Awards for newsroom innovation.

Some newsrooms are talking about change. We’re actually changing. Join us.

The Responsibilities

  • Lead audience growth and engagement strategy across platforms, formats and content teams.

  • Develop new strategies for audience discovery and loyalty as search declines and traditional content distribution models evolve.
  • Help the newsroom move beyond legacy content strategies by identifying new opportunities in video, audio, social, newsletters, communities, emerging platforms, creators and other forms of audience connection.
  • Articulate a clear point of view on digital growth and turn it into actionable plans, priorities and operating practices.
  • Coach teams and ideas with metrics at the forefront of decision-making; establish goals, evaluate performance and use audience data to guide experimentation and investment.
  • Build strategies that move audiences from casual discovery to sustained engagement and loyalty.
  • Understand how to grow fans on different platforms and operationalize effective tactics across the newsroom.
  • Lead and support experimentation, taking smart risks and learning quickly from what works and what doesn’t.
  • Embrace AI across the organization to help journalists with their work, improve audience understanding and drive innovation.
  • Work collaboratively with the managing editor of news and strategy to oversee the daily operations of the newsroom.
  • Champion inclusive reporting that reflects the diversity of Houston, with strategies and journalism designed to serve communities—not simply report about them.
  • Demonstrate collaborative, creative and transformational leadership centered on learning, strong journalism and innovation.
  • Push the organization to bring new approaches to old problems and explore new platforms, possibilities and audience relationships.

  • Partner across editorial, product, technology, marketing, analytics and business teams to align audience strategy with the organization’s broader goals.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • Significant experience leading audience growth, engagement, digital strategy or a related function in a news or media organization.

  • A strong understanding of how audiences discover, consume and engage with journalism across platforms.
  • Experience developing new growth strategies in a rapidly changing digital environment
  • Proven track record of developing viewership around franchise shows and YouTube strategy
  • A track record of using data, experimentation and audience insights to improve reach, engagement and loyalty.
  • Experience leading, coaching and developing multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong editorial judgment and a deep respect for journalism and public service.
  • Comfort working across strategy and execution, with the ability to move from a big-picture vision to daily operational decisions.
  • A creative, entrepreneurial mindset and enthusiasm for emerging platforms, technology and AI.
  • A commitment to inclusive journalism and serving the full breadth of Houston’s communities.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

To Apply

As part of your cover letter, please explain your philosophy of audience growth and engagement. Please also share specific examples of how you have driven digital growth and built meaningful relationships with new readers, listeners or viewers, particularly through strategies that went beyond traditional search or legacy distribution models.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate.

job.title: Customer Service Rep- CCLI (Vancouver)
job.description:
Christian Copyright Licensing International (CCLI) is seeking a Customer Service Representative to join our team in Vancouver, Washington. In this role you will be responsible for supporting customer needs by answering questions, providing information on CCLI licenses and services, as well as first level technical support. In addition, the Customer Service Representative contacts existing customers to ensure retention, processes orders for new and renewing licenses and services, and performs outbound calling to prospective customers gained from marketing campaigns.

 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Responds to large volumes of incoming calls and written communications to ensure timely and accurate responses to customer needs.
  • Asks qualifying questions to properly identify the needs of current and prospective customers, educates and recommends appropriate products and services as solutions, answers questions, resolves objections in order to successfully renew or issue new license.
  • Follows up on leads, responds to inquiries and performs outbound calling to prospective customers gained from marketing campaigns.
  • Demonstrates knowledge and expertise to license holders/customers by confidently and accurately providing information about CCLI’s suite of product offerings and services (including CVLI and ScreenVue), terms and conditions, church music offerings, rights owner information, and copyright law.
  • Assists customers with license renewals, identifies and fulfills product and service needs.

  • Answers questions regarding licensees’ activity reporting and clarifies procedures, and assists IP department on reporting accuracy for royalty payouts.
  • Ensures customer accounts and profile information is properly updated in computer databases/software systems.
  • Maintains current knowledge of products and services, and customer service best practices through ongoing training and education in areas of responsibility.
  • Provides first level technical support to customers for CCLI’s online services.
  • Informs supervisor about customer concerns and escalates difficult customer contacts as needed. 
  • Special project and duties as assigned.

 

What Makes You Qualified:

  • High School diploma or two years of equivalent work experience in customer service.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
