job.title: VP, Commerce, Latin/Iberia - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

The VP, Commerce, Latin-Iberia is an entrepreneurial commercial leader responsible for developing and executing the region’s commerce strategy across digital platforms, physical, direct-to-consumer, YouTube Ad Sales, and brand partnerships. The role will identify scalable growth opportunities, strengthen platform relationships, and translate market insight into measurable revenue for clients and the company.

Reporting to the SVP, Co-Managing Directors, Latin-Iberia, this executive will work in close partnership with Relationship Managers and territory leaders to align commerce priorities with each client’s objectives, release plans, and broader business strategy. Relationship Managers retain primary ownership of the client relationship and client communication; the VP, Commerce serves as their senior commercial partner, providing platform expertise, actionable insights, and tailored growth solutions.

What you'll do:

  • Regional Commerce Strategy: Build and own the Latin-Iberia commerce roadmap, operating model, and KPIs. Translate global company priorities into regionally relevant plans and ensure disciplined execution across territories.
  • Relationship Management Partnership: Partner closely with Relationship Managers to understand client objectives, release priorities, and business needs. Develop tailored commerce strategies and opportunities that strengthen client outcomes and drive revenue, while ensuring Relationship Managers retain primary ownership of the overall client relationship and communication.
  • Platform Strategy & Partnerships: Lead senior-level relationships and commercial strategy across DSPs and other key platforms. Shape regional platform priorities, secure high-impact opportunities, and build initiatives that improve visibility, engagement, monetization, and market share.
  • Multi-Channel Revenue Growth: Identify and execute opportunities across streaming, physical, D2C, YouTube Ad Sales, and brand partnerships. Connect these pillars into cohesive commercial plans tailored to each market and client.
  • Territory Leadership & Coordination: Work with local territory leaders and Commerce teams to establish priorities, share best practices, remove executional blockers, and ensure consistent regional standards while respecting local market dynamics.
  • Data, Insights & Scalable Execution: Partner with Analytics and business teams to embed data-driven decision-making into commercial planning. Use tools, automation, audience and platform insights, and performance reporting to identify opportunities and improve execution at scale.
  • Financial & Performance Accountability: Establish revenue targets, forecasts, and performance indicators for regional Commerce initiatives. Track results, communicate risks and opportunities, and recommend adjustments based on measurable business impact.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop the regional Commerce team, fostering commercial creativity, accountability, collaboration, and a strong service mindset toward Relationship Management teams and clients

Who you are:

  • Industry Experience: 12+ years of relevant experience in music distribution, digital commerce, platform partnerships, commercial strategy, or related fields, including meaningful leadership responsibility.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep understanding of the Latin American and Iberian music markets, including their commercial dynamics, cultural differences, platform ecosystems, and client needs.
  • Platform & Channel Knowledge: Strong knowledge of DSPs and other commerce channels, including physical, D2C, and brand partnerships.
  • Relationship-Driven Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver through partnership with Relationship Managers, territory leaders, clients, platforms, and cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience with revenue planning, forecasting, performance measurement, and the use of data and insights to prioritize opportunities and drive business growth.
  • Executive Communication: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex commercial ideas clearly and credibly to senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and Spanish required; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Travel & Availability: Availability to travel within the Latin-Iberia region as needed for meetings with clients and artists, business engagements, industry events, and awards ceremonies.

What We Give You

  • Opportunities to connect with our valuable resources, such as our Counsel of Equity & Progressive Action (CEPA). A group created by a group of our employees tasked with developing and implementing innovative solutions to advance a globally shared goal of ensuring fair and inclusive spaces for all

Job Title: Sr. Analyst, Financial

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music Group's Global Business Services (GBS) is home to the finance operations, legal, and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our global Finance labels and affiliates. Each regional center embodies the collaboration and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in cultivating entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities. Based out of Nashville, our US Participations team is fully remote and committed to supporting all U.S. record labels, and artist & label services divisions.


We’re excited to hear from impactful finance and audit professionals who are ready to apply their elite analytical skills to a specialized, high-stakes environment. We are looking for "detective-minded" analysts with a passion for music, who thrive on uncovering the "why" behind the numbers and who possess the commercial acumen to translate complex legal logic into precise financial outputs.

Why this could be your next big break:

You are a highly autonomous finance professional who takes immense pride in ownership and accountability. You don't just process data; you interrogate it. You thrive in environments where you are expected to be a subject matter expert, serving as a trusted point of contact for both partners across the company, and your peers.

This role is perfect for someone coming from a rigorous Audit, Royalty, or Financial Reporting background who is ready to move into a fast-paced, dynamic industry. You’ll be given the space to work independently, but you’ll do so through a lens of deep collaboration—mentoring analysts and acting as a link between financial accounting, royalty operations and our business. If you enjoy the challenge of high-volume data, complex financial calculations, and the satisfaction of delivering accurate insights under tight deadlines, this is your next step.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the preparation, analysis and review  of complex participation profit-share and distribution financial statements. You will ensure every output aligns with both unique contractual obligations and rigorous accounting standards. 

  • Prepare fiscal month-end close tasks, including true-ups, reconciliations, and expense accruals. You will act as the link between statement reporting and general ledger accuracy, ensuring financial integrity for the labels you support.

  • Act as the team’s primary “Variance Detective” and quality gatekeeper. You will interrogate the “how” and “why” behind data fluctuations to provide clear narratives for management while reviewing peer statements to ensure the highest standards of precision, audit-readiness, and internal control compliance.

  • Translate complex artist and label legal agreements into functional financial models. You will identify and comprehend intricate deal terms and apply them to large-scale data sets to ensure reporting accuracy and rigor.

  • Compile, transform and analyze vast sets of transactional data to support statement reporting, budgets, and cash forecasts. You will provide critical financial data for deal models and audit responses, ensuring the Participations group remains a valued partner to the wider organization.

  • Proactively investigate artist inquiries, data issues or audit claims with a focus on mitigating financial risk. You are expected to anticipate future roadblocks and suggest resolutions to management before they impact deadlines or relationships.

  • Take an active role in team development by guiding analysts, providing ongoing review feedback, and facilitating training sessions for new hires to demonstrate standard processes in Participations accounting.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships across the company—from label finance and legal teams to senior executives—acting as a trusted partner with a high degree of professional IQ and responsiveness.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the department by identifying inefficiencies and implementing solutions supported by modern tools. You will champion automation initiatives and process improvements that drive team-wide excellence and scalable growth. 

About you:

  • BA/BS degree required (Accounting or Finance preferred) with 3-5 years of professional experience in a sophisticated financial capacity.

  • Advanced proficiency with MS Excel is crucial. You should be very comfortable with complex calculations and working with large, disparate data sets.

  • You have a solid grasp of financial accounting principles and how they apply to P&L statements, reconciliations, fiscal close processes and internal controls.

  • You have strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proven track record of taking full ownership of your work. You are self-driven, highly organized, and able to implement with accuracy and deliver under pressure.

  • You can distill complex financial information into clear, actionable insights for interested parties and possess the leadership traits necessary to mentor peers.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience in Music, Media, or Entertainment (specifically in Participations, Royalties or Audit).

  • Proficiency with SAP S4 Hana, SAP Analysis for Office, BI and SharePoint.

  • A natural technical curiosity, and digital innovation having leveraged Generative AI tools to automate manual workflows and drive efficiency in finance operations.

  • Proven success working in a fully remote, Shared Services environment.

As the home to 10K Projects, 300 Elektra, Asylum, Atlantic, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. job.description:
Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day. SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America. As the combined advertising revenue organization of Sirius XM Holdings Inc.,

SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBCUniversal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Account Manager is a key contributor on SXM Media’s Client Services team that drives and defends revenue by being a trusted client partner and resource working with internal and external partners to independently design, execute, monitor, and optimize advertising campaigns across a portfolio of Advertisers/Agencies. The right individual will be highly effective in communication, organization, and critical thinking, while thriving in an ever-evolving, fast-paced environment. Your team will include thoughtful, problem-solving individuals who are passionate about growing the SiriusXM Media brands. This role applies developing professional expertise, company policies, and established procedures to resolve a variety of client, campaign, creative, technical, billing, and delivery issues.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and cultivate positive business relationships with clients and sales, creative design team, sales research, and technical teams.
  • Partner with sales team to develop ideas and materials for Proposals/Avail submissions including media recommendations, research, competitive data, and advise on what is technically feasible to execute. Evaluate client objectives, inventory, product mix, technical requirements, and revenue impact to recommend appropriate campaign solutions.
  • Be a product expert, know your client and the right SXM Media products that will meet their marketing needs and drive positive results.
  • Ensure revenue goals consistently inform all facets of account management; design and execute media plans and campaigns; work directly with client on all pre-launch elements related to creative specifications and submission. Independently manage defined campaign tasks and apply judgment within established procedures to determine next steps, resolve variances, and escalate risks when needed.
  • Create and manage creative and technical production timelines with Advertisers/Agencies and asset delivery to ensure campaigns launch in a timely manner.
  • Work with internal traffickers, creative design, and client as needed to troubleshoot any ad creative issues that impact tracking, implementation, or reporting. Review campaign data and partner inputs to diagnose issues of moderate scope and recommend practical solutions.
  • Be the frontline on all booked revenue to monitor campaign delivery and pacing; escalate issues when applicable. Proactively identify delivery risks, communicate options to internal and external partners, and support corrective action to protect revenue and client outcomes.
  • Collaborate with billing team to resolve monthly invoicing queries.
  • Provide necessary campaign deliverables including but not limited to: reporting, screenshots, and ad-hoc requests.
  • Coordinate work with internal resources as necessary to support campaign execution, timelines, and issue resolution.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience in digital/radio/mobile advertising operations or account management.
  • Extremely proactive and highly organized, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple and varied tasks and campaigns in a timely manner.
  • Excellent client service and verbal and written communication skills; results driven with strong analytical skills.
  • Knowledge of pre- and post-sale process and creation of media plans; experience with custom display, mobile, audio, and video advertising products.
  • Experience working within internal order management systems and third-party systems including ad servers.
  • Ability to analyze campaign, client, and operational inputs to resolve a variety of issues and determine appropriate action within defined procedures and practices.
  • Enjoy working in a collaborative team environment, sharing knowledge across the department.
  • Areas of experience that are preferred but not essential include: knowledge of programmatic transactions; performance campaign management handling conversion data and related ad technology.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the annual salary for this this position to be between $60,000 - $82,350 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. You will assign photography covering a wide array of subject matter and photographic genres including fashion, portraits, interiors, travel and still lifes. You have experience producing editorial photoshoots involving studios, set builds, hair and makeup, location scouting, casting, and wardrobe.   • In partnership with the Director of Photography, produce photo shoots for all sections of the magazine and website including fashion, interiors, travel and still lifes.
  • Source freelance photographers, producers, stylists, hair and makeup artists, set builders, prop designers, location scouts, casting agents, animal handlers, and fabricators for photo shoots.

  • You will report to the Photo Director.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years producing creative photography including fashion, interiors, travel, and still lifes for print and digital.
  • Experience liaising well with top editors, writers, designers, and photo editors while producing shoots.
  • Knowledge of journalistic ethics, standards, and practices.
  • Knowledge of the top creatives working in the fields of art, photography, and video.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience recognizing, developing, and recruiting new talent.
  • Experience working across multiple platforms including photography, video, multimedia, and social media.

  • Willingness to work nights and weekends as needed.

The New York Times' Motion Graphics team focuses on elevating how animated graphics and motion design are used in our video journalism. job.title: Program Manager
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Program Manager to join Translation!

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.


What You'll Do

  • Own the how. Develop scopes, timelines, budgets and delivery systems for programs ranging from complex to “simple.” Don’t assume one size fits all. 
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings throughout the lifecycle of the program, and maintain close coordination with key stakeholders, including Business Leadership and Production.
  • Deliver strategic and creative deliverables directly to day to day clients. Own contact reports, internally and back to the client.
  • Manage talent allocations week over week. Work with the Group Engagement Director and Business Leadership to ensure programs are planned to achieve successful completion, including coming in on time and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal teams, ensure high quality delivery, and manage back to overarching strategy of the engagement.
  • Develop a strong understanding of client’s business and industry, key competitors, and audience demographics.
  • Help maintain integrated ways of working by reinforcing team processes and managing documentation and communications.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality. You take immense pride in your work. You’re results-driven and detail-oriented, but also passionate about people, culture, and creativity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, accurately, and succinctly.
  • Stellar time management and organizational skills, able to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Thick-skinned, persistent, and diplomatic—you handle challenges with optimism and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable navigating across multiple internal disciplines (creative, production, strategy) and external partners to keep projects moving forward.
  • An understanding of when to escalate challenges and opportunities to the appropriate leads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a creative agency or similar communications environment, with a strong understanding of advertising, marketing, media, production, and agency finance.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns across broadcast, digital, experiential and/or social.
  • Experience supporting or leading calls with cross-functional agency teams and interfacing directly with clients.
  • Fluent in Google Suite (especially Sheets and Slides); experience with resource management or workforce planning, as well as project planning tools.
  • Strong curiosity with a strong desire to learn and engage AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience directly managing timelines and deliverables for creative and production workstreams.
  • Exposure to or direct experience with production processes.
  • Acted as a producer or account executive in an agency environment with client facing
  • A passion for culture, innovation, and helping brands show up meaningfully in the world.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms.   • Provide additional administrative support as needed, including travel arrangements and handling phone calls

  • Maintain internal studio database, tracking key dates and data for all projects in production from greenlight through final delivery.

  • 1+ years of experience as a Production Coordinator or Executive Assistant

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a professional and personable demeanor

  • Strong interest in television production and a growth-oriented mindset

This is an on-site role based on the Paramount Pictures Studio Lot requiring (5) days in office.

•    Contribute to entry-level research work, including:
•    Reading scripts and contributing to early pre-greenlight analysis

•    Analyzing and distributing box office projections 
•    Contributing to the development of deliverables and presentations for departments across the studio
•    Landscape research to understand trends within the broader moviegoing industry 
•    Be a vocal and active contributor to brainstorming sessions and meetings
•    Be excited by movies and in tune with current releases

job.title: GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization
job.description:
Job Title

GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization

Job Description

About The Position :

The GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization is a mid-to-senior execution leader responsible for the day-to-day coordination, commercial readiness, and field adoption of our enterprise ad product portfolio. Based in our New York City office, this role serves as the critical, high-touch bridge between our product capabilities and sales execution.

As the ultimate "keeper of the Ad Product Catalog," you will ensure that our New York-based revenue teams—including Sellers, Account Strategists, and Brand Marketers—fully understand our ad products, their operational nuances, and how to position them for maximum yield. Additionally, you will act as the on-the-ground project manager ushering new products through the formal GTM process, ensuring cross-functional alignment and gathering real-time field feedback to optimize our commercial engine.

Hybrid 3x a week- NYC

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team:

The Ad Product Commercialization team partners across Product, Sales, Brand Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, and Commercial organizations to successfully bring advertising products to market. The team enables revenue growth by ensuring product launches are well coordinated, sales teams are equipped for success, and customer feedback continuously informs product evolution.

About The Position’s Contributions:

35% Ad Product Catalog Governance & Advisory

  • Single Source of Truth: Own and maintain the comprehensive Ad Product Catalog. Ensure all product specifications, packaging rules, pricing guidelines, and operational constraints are meticulously updated, accurate, and accessible.

  • Technical & Operational Advisory: Act as the primary, local "help desk" and subject matter expert for NYC-based Sellers and Account Strategists. Provide rapid, clear answers to complex, nuanced questions regarding ad product capabilities and custom configuration rules.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the Brand Marketing team to ensure that their client-facing narratives match the exact technical and operational realities housed in the product catalog.

35% GTM Program Management & Training

  • Launch Traffic Control: Act as the dedicated project manager ushering individual products and packages through the formal GTM pipeline. Coordinate timelines, keep cross-functional stakeholders on schedule, and prevent rollout bottlenecks.

  • Operational Readiness & Briefings: Translate dense, technical ad product mechanics into clear, digestible operational instructions. Lead internal briefings and training sessions for revenue teams detailing what a product is, who it is for, and how to book it.

30% Field Adoption & Commercial Yield Analysis

  • Data-Driven Optimization: Regularly analyze internal sales data and product adoption metrics. Identify which packages are driving the highest yield and surface trends regarding what is selling well versus what isn't.

  • On-the-Ground Feedback Loops: Leverage your physical presence in the NYC office to build deep trust with sellers and CROs. Proactively capture field feedback, understand seller pain points, and investigate the "why" behind product adoption data to inform future iterations.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Experience:

  • 4–7 years of experience in ad product operations, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, digital media project management, product marketing, commercial operations, or a related field.

  • Experience managing cross-functional product launches and commercialization initiatives.

  • Experience supporting revenue organizations within digital advertising, media, ad tech, or SaaS environments.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams in a fast-paced organization.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Relationship Building & Empathy: High emotional intelligence with a proven track record of earning trust across diverse commercial teams. Exceptional ability to act as a supportive, empathetic partner to quota-carrying sellers.

  • Program & Project Management: Highly organized with the disciplined capability to manage multiple moving parts of a launch simultaneously, enforce deadlines, and keep diverse stakeholders communicating effectively.

  • Product Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, ad tech, and sales lifecycles. Ability to quickly master technical ad product configurations and explain them simply to non-technical teams.

  • Data Curiosity: A natural inclination to look at sales spreadsheets, ask probing questions about revenue performance, and translate numbers into actionable insights for catalog optimization.

% Travel Required (Approximate): < 5%

This role is ideal for a post-sale champion who excels at client communication, project management, and operational execution within the performance marketing space.

You will take the reins once a partnership is secured, ensuring successful partner onboarding and fast-turnaround campaign launches. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love turning complex client campaigns into seamless successes, this role is for you.

job.title: Art Director
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

WMX, Warner Music Group's culture-driving merchandise, creative content, and artist services division, is a global full-service team that offers creative direction, production services, and support for WMG licensed artists and labels. As the Retail Art Director, you will step into a brand-new, highly strategic role designed to grow and develop our retail business strategy as a whole. You will act as the vital creative bridge on our team, working directly with our Creative Directors to align on artistic vision, while collaborating hand-in-hand with our Retail Sales team to build bespoke presentations for global retail partners. Your work will directly impact how our entire artist roster breaks into major retail spaces, transforming creative concepts into massive commercial realities.

Your role:

As Art Director at WMX, you’ll bring our artists’ visual worlds to life across music, fashion, and culture. You’ll focus directly on developing visual concepts, leading art direction for merch collections, and collaborating closely with both in-house talent and freelance creators. This role is fast-paced, hands-on, and deeply plugged into culture. You’ll be turning artist identities into compelling, fan-obsessed merchandise and visual assets across our roster.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Develop Visual & Art Direction: Create the visual language and offer creative mentorship for merch collections and campaigns. Confirm every concept reflects the artist's identity and resonates with their fanbase.

  • Lead the visual invention and curation of merchandise lines for artists represented by our company. Progress collections from initial aesthetic moodboards to fully realized visual concepts.

  • Guide In-House & Freelance Designers: Source, brief, and direct internal designers, outside studios, and specialized freelancers (illustrators, typographers, graphic designers). Provide clear feedback to elevate output and ensure visual consistency across all assets.

  • Partner with Artists & Management: Work directly with artists, managers, and internal brand teams to understand aesthetic goals and translate them into cohesive visual designs.

  • Ensure Visual Quality & Brand Consistency: Review and refine all art deliverables to ensure high aesthetic standards, on-brief execution, and visual harmony across product lineups.

  • Collaborate with Production & Operations: Partner with production teams to manage asset handover, review tech packs, and refine designs to align with physical production capabilities without compromising creative vision.

  • Stay Ahead of Visual & Fashion Trends: Maintain a deep awareness of emerging fashion, music, design, and subculture trends, continually infusing fresh visual ideas into our artist collections.

About you:

  • You have 4-6+ years of experience in art direction, graphic design, or brand design, preferably within retail, fashion, or corporate pitch-deck creation.

  • You have a proven track record of trend forecasting and a deep understanding of commercial retail landscapes and consumer behavior.

  • You have expert-level layout and presentation skills, with a portfolio that proves you can turn complex strategies into clean, beautiful, and compelling visual stories.

  • You enjoy acting as a bridge between highly conceptual creative ideas and business-driven commercial targets.

  • You are passionate about emerging fashion, design, and music culture, and you instinctively know how to translate those movements into retail-ready product ideas.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • You have expert knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and key presentation platforms like Keynote or PowerPoint.

  • You have a deep passion for fashion and product design

  • You have experience designing mockups for apparel, retail packaging, or point-of-sale displays.

  • You have a passion for emerging creative tools, trends, and technologies (AI, AR, motion, etc.) and how they can elevate storytelling


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role:

#LI-Onsite 

The New York Times is an international brand that prints nine daily newspapers. These are printed at our Print Plant in College Point, Queens, and distributed to the New York Metropolitan area and the Eastern Seaboard. Our daily work is guided by our mission and values. 

We are looking for a part-time casual Paperhandler with in-depth knowledge of all Paperhandler equipment and multiple newsprint roll types for commercial printing. You will undergo a training period, after which you will read work orders or receive instructions to determine work assignments, material, and equipment requirements. You will be reporting to the Deputy Plant Manager and you will report to work onsite at our Printing facility in College Point, Queens, New York. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Ensure that all paper rolls for the nine daily newspapers are handled and transported safely. 
  • Work in a Union production environment with deadlines on a daily basis. 
  • Take inventory of paper rolls and prepare them for use in the printing facility. 
  • Ensure that all paper rolls are stacked according to safety regulations. 
  • Operate Paperhandler equipment safely while working with extreme care and caution. 
  • You must maintain a clean environment in the paper storage area. 
  • You must follow all safety guidelines and report any accidents or incidents to the supervisor. 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Must be willing to work flexible hours in a Union production environment on a daily basis. 
  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent. 
  • Can stand and walk for 8-10 hours per shift and lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be willing to undergo a background check. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 1+ year of experience in a production environment. 
  • The ability to work with different types of paperhandler equipment. 
  • The ability to work in a team environment.

job.title: SVP, Product
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.

Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.

Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.

The SVP, Product will connect these levels by making decision rights, prioritization, and handoffs clear: what should remain a local workflow, what AI Enablement should support, and what Product and Design should develop into a durable, supported product or shared capability. The role spans the products, platforms, and workflows that power Axios, from the CMS, axios.com, newsletters, and Local products to internal tools and shared platforms supporting editorial, revenue, and company operations, as well as the growing set of AI-enabled solutions being developed closer to the work.

As Axios becomes more capable of building with AI, more teams will identify and prototype solutions for their own needs. Reporting to the CTO, this leader will establish the product operating model that allows Axios to evaluate, prioritize, and scale those ideas without creating fragmented, duplicated, or unsupported systems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
  • Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
  • Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
  • Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.

Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to the CTO and senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.

Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.

What we’re looking for:

  • A trusted partner to senior leaders who can challenge assumptions, form a clear point of view, make hard tradeoffs, and keep decisions moving.
  • A clear vision for where product development is headed and how Axios can succeed as the technology landscape rapidly evolves.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you personally use AI to accelerate your work and prototype ideas, and you know how to turn AI capabilities into useful products and workflows.
  • Senior product leadership experience in software, information services, media, or another fast-moving environment, with a record of bringing Product and Design together.
  • Technical fluency across product strategy, workflows, tooling, data, and production tradeoffs.
  • Experience with prioritization and portfolio management across multiple stakeholders.
  • A track record of turning prototypes and experiments into durable, supported products.
  • The judgment to create useful governance without becoming a bottleneck.
  • The ability to distinguish a meaningful product opportunity from an interesting AI demo.

Worth your time: This is an opportunity to help define what modern product leadership looks like inside an AI-native media company. You’ll help shape not only what Axios builds, but how Axios operates.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $285,000 - $315,000, plus a 25% bonus, and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

At SoundCloud, we believe growth is not the responsibility of a single channel. Growth happens when products, experiences, customer journeys, marketing channels, creators, communities, and partnerships work together as a unified system.

We're looking for a Senior Director, Integrated Marketing & Growth to oversee SoundCloud's growth marketing ecosystem and connect every customer touchpoint into a unified engine that drives acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, monetization, and advocacy. In this role, you will build SoundCloud's growth operating system, own the end-to-end customer journey strategy, and lead performance, lifecycle, and organic growth channel strategy, while ensuring our platform remains discoverable in a world increasingly shaped by AI-powered search and recommendation engines. Working closely with Product Marketing, Brand, Community, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Executive Leadership, you will drive integrated campaign orchestration across the business, modernize marketing measurement and experimentation, and build and lead a high-performing growth organization.

Reporting to the Chief Growth & Marketing Officer, you will be ultimately responsible for how users discover, engage with, subscribe to, and advocate for SoundCloud,  maximizing long-term customer value across our entire ecosystem.

Above all, we're looking for a builder — someone who can connect people, teams, channels, and ideas into a growth engine that helps more creators and fans find success on SoundCloud.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days/week in our NYC office.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and lead the growth operating system, processes, and planning rhythms that unify efforts across Product, Marketing, Community, Partnerships, and Analytics into coordinated, scalable strategies, with clear prioritization and resource allocation
  • Refine end-to-end creator and fan journeys to eliminate friction, bridge conversion gaps, and partner cross-functionally to accelerate activation, engagement, retention, and lifetime value — tying marketing efforts to customer behaviors, not just channel activity
  • Own the overarching performance strategy for acquisition, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and conversion optimization, while expanding emerging discovery channels including SEO, AI search, AEO, App Store Optimization, and growth loops
  • Lead integrated campaign orchestration across major product launches and brand moments (in close partnership with Product Marketing) establishing repeatable frameworks to sync execution across paid, owned, earned, and product surfaces
  • Modernize measurement and attribution alongside Analytics and Data Science by advancing incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling, forecasting, LTV frameworks, and growth scorecards for the executive team
  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing growth organization grounded in a culture of experimentation, operational excellence, and data-driven accountability

Experience and Background:

  • 10+ years in Growth Marketing, Growth Strategy, Integrated Marketing, consumer technology, marketplaces, or platform businesses
  • Experience leading large-scale acquisition, retention, and lifecycle programs for subscription or consumer businesses
  • Demonstrated success building growth systems, operating models, and cross-functional organizations
  • Deep expertise in experimentation, measurement, attribution, and growth analytics
  • Experience managing complex customer journeys and multi-channel ecosystems
  • Fluent with AI tools and comfortable building them into growth, discovery, and measurement workflows
  • Strong strategic thinking paired with operational excellence
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and influence skills
  • A real passion for creators, music, technology, and culture

The salary range for this role is $210,000 - $260,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) AI Lab at CBC/Radio-Canada operates as an agile, high-performance innovation hub. Our mission is to prototype, experiment with and deploy artificial intelligence solutions for media production systems across the organization. We design customized functionalities and seamlessly integrate advanced AI technologies into our existing product ecosystem.

We are looking for an AI Analyst who is pragmatic, curious, ambitious and ready to kick-start their career in applied AI. Backed by senior experts, you will work in a highly experimental environment where your initiatives will have real, immediate impact.

Our team is supported on a day-to-day basis by next-generation coding assistants like Cursor and Claude to optimize ideation, development, debugging and documentation. By joining our team, you will learn to leverage those tools while ensuring the highest standards of reliability, security and code integrity for your deliverables.

Your Responsibilities

  • Play an active role in the full life cycle (prototyping, development, deployment) of AI-driven applications and features, with a specific focus on cloud architectures.
  • Help fine-tune, evaluate and integrate large language models (LLMs) into our core business processes.
  • Set up and maintain testing, monitoring, feedback and performance assessment protocols for our AI systems.
  • Assist the team in connecting intelligent agents to internal or external services and APIs (using the MCP protocol or equivalent tool frameworks).
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (product, architecture, data science) to embed AI capabilities into our digital platforms.
  • Conduct exploratory proofs of concept to bridge AI with our legacy systems and build viable new products.
  • Leverage AI co-pilots to accelerate your development workflow while maintaining strict standards for test coverage, code quality and IT security.

Minimum Requirements

  • University degree in software engineering, computer science, data science or a related field.
  • One to two years’ hands-on technical experience in software design (gained through internships, academic projects, personal initiatives or early professional work).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript or Java, together with an outstanding capacity for continuous learning.
  • A solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including quality control, debugging, testing methodologies and information security.
  • Functional bilingualism (English and French) essential for Canada-wide communications.

Preferred Qualifications (Assets)

  • Professional or personal projects involving machine learning, LLMs, RAG architectures or autonomous agent development.

Are you a creative, dynamic and people-focused senior journalist looking for a new leadership challenge in a bustling, multi-city newsroom?

CBC Saskatchewan is looking for an executive producer to lead our news operation. This is a fourteen-month full-time onsite role covering a maternity leave. The position can be based in either Regina or Saskatoon.

Reporting to the managing editor, the executive producer will lead our teams who gather and produce daily and enterprise news content across platforms, including video, digital, social, radio and television. In this role you will work alongside the executive producer of programming to steer our journalism and our storytelling to audiences on video, digital and audio platforms.

You’ll approach your work with an open mind and a genuine curiosity, and you’ll be comfortable challenging assumptions and seeking out a variety of perspectives to better reflect our audiences and their stories. 

You will be a strategic thinker: you are able to set direction and delegate effectively, but you aren’t afraid to roll up your sleeves and do the hard work. You know how to balance out the daily demands with longer-term projects and strategy. You champion growing our audiences, using data to help us grow them.

As a leader, you are naturally collaborative, skilled at navigating conflict and change, breaking down silos and championing team success. You are a mentor at heart, and are deeply invested in developing a representative and inclusive culture. 

You will be a developer of people, skills and careers.

  • Superior communication, interpersonal and organizational skills.

  • A strategic thinker with a proven track record of executing on a vision.

  • Demonstrated ability to exercise both quick editorial judgment and long-term planning.

  • A high-energy leader with a positive, team-first attitude and the ability to motivate and coach teams, encourage creativity and embrace experimentation.

job.title: Morning Show Co-Host - WNGC Athens Radio
job.description:
Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  Morning Show Co-Host - WNGC Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. This role is one of the primary on-air voices of the morning show and helps build audience loyalty, grow ratings and digital engagement, create compelling multiplatform content, and represent WNGC in the community.

 

We are looking for a great storyteller with a strong point of view, quick wit, and passion for Country music, local culture, and audience engagement. The ideal candidate understands how to maintain forward momentum through effective teasing, pacing, and content execution while connecting naturally with listeners on-air, online, and in person.

 

Please include your Air Check Package with application!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Co-host a live, personality-driven morning show that delivers compelling storytelling, listener interaction, local content, interviews, and engaging entertainment.
  • Develop and execute daily content plans, recurring features, story arcs, and digital content across social, video, web, and podcast platforms.
  • Voice-track assigned shifts and create commercial, promotional, and endorsement content as needed.
  • Represent WNGC at community events, promotions, concerts, remote broadcasts, and client activities while collaborating across departments to support audience growth and revenue opportunities.
  • Operate the control board, radio automation system, phone system, and other studio equipment, including editing interviews, phone content, and other audio.
  • Execute station strategy while supporting ratings growth, digital engagement, FCC compliance, and ongoing professional development.
  • Participate in regular show planning, coaching, airchecks, and content reviews.
  • Maintain reliable attendance, punctuality, and professional judgment in a live, deadline-driven environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated on-air radio experience with strong storytelling, audience engagement, and personality-driven content skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with a relatable, topical, and occasionally humorous point of view.
  • Understanding of audience retention, content pacing, teasing, show momentum, and the Country radio audience.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and vocal delivery skills.
  • Experience with audio editing software, such as Adobe Audition, and radio automation systems, such as WideOrbit.
  • Proficiency creating social media and video content across multiple digital platforms.
  • Creative, prepared, coachable, and able to collaborate effectively within a morning show and across Programming, Promotions, Digital, and Sales with a strong work ethic and team-first mindset.
  • Availability for early mornings, local or regional travel, and occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, events, and remote broadcasts.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet applicable company driving requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Country music, Country lifestyle culture, and relevant pop-culture trends.
  • Familiarity with the Athens/North Georgia market and local audience interests.
  • Passion for North Georgia, its communities, and the local audience WNGC serves.
  • Experience creating podcast, video, interview, or social-first content.
  • Prior experience with remote broadcasts, promotions, concerts, community events, or client-facing appearances.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

In fact, U.S. News ranks Fayetteville seventh best place to live in the country!  http://realestate.usnews.com/places/arkansas/fayetteville 

   

Our newsroom is forward-thinking and built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth and development of talent, and a desire to win. We are consistently winning awards from our local audiences for our commitment to our community and our service-centered sense of duty. 

Whether you’re looking for a place to settle in or a place to equip yourself and launch into that “big step” – we have a proven track record of providing both outcomes.

job.title: Director, Event Location Strategy
job.description:
The Director, Event Location Strategy shapes and executes the NFL's long-term host market strategy for the League's premier tentpole events, including the Super Bowl, NFL Draft, NFL Scouting Combine, NFL Flag Championships, and other strategic initiatives. 

This leader owns the end-to-end evaluation, selection, negotiation, and governance process for future host locations and serves as the League's primary strategic liaison with host clubs, destination partners, and local organizing committees. Working across the NFL, the Director aligns business, operational, financial, sponsorship, media, public affairs, and fan engagement objectives to position each host market for long-term League impact and successful event delivery. 

The successful candidate will bring strategic judgment, commercial and financial acumen, relationship leadership, and operational rigor to complex decisions that begin years in advance and extend through final event completion. 

Responsibilities

Host Market Strategy & Selection 

  • Lead the NFL's long-range host market strategy and event location selection framework, aligning market recommendations with League growth objectives, event requirements, fan engagement goals, and commercial priorities. 
  • Develop recommended selection timelines, decision criteria, governance frameworks, and repeatable workflows for domestic tentpole events. 
  • Identify and assess established and emerging host market opportunities using financial, strategic, operational, infrastructure, partnership, and reputational considerations. 
  • Direct competitive host selection processes, including bid design, stakeholder engagement, proposal evaluation, diligence, recommendation development, and executive decision support. 
  • Prepare clear, executive-level recommendations and presentations that translate complex market analysis into actionable decisions. 

Commercial, Financial & Risk Leadership 

  • Lead comparative financial and business-case analysis of host market proposals, including public- and private-sector commitments, operational obligations, revenue opportunities, and value to the League. 
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Audit, and other stakeholders to structure and negotiate host agreements, clarify accountabilities, and identify and mitigate material risks. 
  • Balance long-term strategic value with near-term financial, operational, sponsorship, media, and partnership considerations throughout each selection and planning cycle. 

Host Market Partnerships & Governance 

  • Serve as the senior day-to-day relationship lead for prospective and awarded host markets, managing a portfolio of approximately 10 active relationships at a time. 
  • Cultivate trusted partnerships with NFL clubs, local organizing committees, convention and visitors bureaus, venue operators, municipal leaders, government agencies, and economic development organizations. 
  • Establish clear governance, decision rights, milestones, and issue-escalation paths with host partners from award through event completion. 
  • Advise host clubs and market partners on League standards, commitments, planning dependencies, and cross-functional requirements. 
  • Collaborate with the NFL International team to support location strategy and strategic projects, as needed  

Enterprise Collaboration & Event Integration 

  • Partner across Events and with Sponsorship, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Media and Broadcast, Communications, Government Affairs, Security, Football Operations, Club Business, and other functions to develop integrated market recommendations and execution plans. 
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of each tentpole event's business model, operating requirements, stakeholder commitments, and critical dependencies. 
  • Provide host market guidance across the planning lifecycle and proactively surface trade-offs, risks, and opportunities for senior leaders and project teams. 
  • Create durable tools, templates, market intelligence, and institutional knowledge that improve future selection and planning cycles. 

People Leadership 

  • Lead, coach, and develop a small team currently comprising one full-time employee and two to three temporary team members, such as interns and rotational program participants. 
  • Set clear priorities, roles, and performance expectations while fostering accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
  • Allocate team resources across concurrent bids, host relationships, planning cycles, and event deliverables. 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. 
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sports, live events, venue or destination strategy, consulting, hospitality, or a related field. 
  • 5 years of management experience  
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Proven success managing competitive proposal, procurement, bid, partnership, or location-selection processes. 
  • Experience developing business cases, evaluating financial proposals, managing budgets, and supporting complex negotiations. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Proven people leadership experience, including direct management, coaching, prioritization, and talent development. 
  • Exceptional executive communication, writing, presentation, and facilitation skills. 
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining sound judgment and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to travel approximately 25% of work time, including attendance at NFL tentpole events and planning meetings.

job.title: Regional General Manager, WCPO, WEWS & WKBW
job.description:
Regional General Manager

WCPO Cincinnati | WEWS Cleveland | WKBW Buffalo

Scripps is seeking a Regional General Manager to lead three of the company's most important local media operations: WCPO in Cincinnati, WEWS in Cleveland, and WKBW in Buffalo. This executive leader will serve as the senior accountable leader across the market group, providing strategic, operational, financial, and people leadership to drive audience growth, revenue performance, community impact, and organizational effectiveness.

The Regional General Manager is a collaborative leader who models the company's core values, develops strong local leadership teams, and partners closely with corporate stakeholders to advance Scripps' mission of creating a better-informed world. This role requires a proven operator who can lead through influence, inspire innovation, develop talent, and deliver results across multiple markets while maintaining strong local brands and community connections.

Work Arrangement: The successful candidate may be based in any of the three station markets and will travel regularly among WCPO, WEWS, and WKBW to support employees, clients, and community partners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead and oversee fully functioning multi-platform media operations across Cincinnati, Cleveland, and Buffalo with a focus on growing revenue, audience, brand strength, and community impact.

  • Serve as the senior accountable leader for ratings, revenue, operational performance, and execution across the assigned market group.

  • Develop and guide strategic and operational plans that support multi-platform content delivery, revenue generation, audience growth, and local brand alignment.

  • Partner with local leadership teams to establish market-specific priorities while ensuring consistent execution of company strategy and operating standards.

  • Lead with positive motivation, direction, insight, and accountability while supporting market leaders in achieving operational and financial objectives.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and appropriate risk-taking throughout the organization.

  • Provide visible leadership across all assigned markets through engagement with employees, community leaders, advertisers, clients, and business partners.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, agencies, community organizations, and civic stakeholders.

  • Create highly collaborative, performance-focused environments that encourage teamwork, transparency, and accountability.

  • Coach, develop, and support succession planning for market leaders and key talent across the region.

  • Guide financial performance across assigned markets, including budgeting, expense management, operational planning, and capital investments.

  • Partner closely with sales, news, content, finance, engineering, HR, legal, and other corporate teams to strengthen business performance and drive strategic initiatives.

  • Ensure compliance with FCC, EEO, SOX, and all applicable regulatory and company requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to scale best practices, improve operational effectiveness, and enhance market performance across the region.

  • Maintain the highest ethical standards and reinforce a culture aligned with Scripps values.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 10+ years of senior leadership experience, including responsibility for complex organizations, markets, business units, or multi-location operations.

  • Demonstrated success leading revenue growth, operational execution, strategic planning, talent development, and brand advancement.

  • Proven track record of executive leadership in media, broadcasting, digital media, or related industries.

  • Experience leading multiple markets, geographic locations, business units, or matrixed organizations preferred.

  • Strong background in financial management, budgeting, business planning, and organizational leadership.

  • Experience overseeing regulatory compliance and operational governance within a complex organization preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Proven ability to cultivate innovation, lead change, and inspire high-performing teams across multiple markets.

  • Passion for local media, community service, journalism, and the Scripps mission.

  • Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to analyze performance metrics, identify trends, and drive results.

  • Ability to effectively manage budgets, resources, and investments while maintaining compliance with company and regulatory requirements.

  • Demonstrated success leading geographically dispersed teams through influence, collaboration, and accountability.

  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage employees, senior executives, clients, and community stakeholders.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to create alignment across multiple functions and markets.

  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and decisive leadership in complex operating environments.

  • Ability to identify, develop, and replicate best practices that enhance performance across multiple organizations.

  • Commitment to building inclusive, people-focused cultures where employees can grow and succeed.

WHY JOIN SCRIPPS?

At Scripps, you'll have the opportunity to lead three iconic local media brands serving millions of viewers and communities across Ohio and Western New York. You'll help shape the future of local journalism, content, and media while developing exceptional teams and driving meaningful business results.

This role offers the unique opportunity to influence strategy across multiple markets while helping accelerate Scripps' continued transformation across broadcast, digital, streaming, audience growth, and revenue diversification. You'll partner with talented local and corporate leaders to strengthen trusted local brands, develop high-performing teams, and ensure the long-term success of WCPO, WEWS, and WKBW.

#LI-Onsite

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff.
