job.title: Director of Meteorology
job.description:
Position Summary 


The Director of Meteorology serves as the authoritative scientific compass for The Weather Channel. In this pivotal leadership role, you will leverage expert-level meteorological knowledge to guide company-wide forecasting strategy, drive scientifically sound storytelling, and uphold the highest standards of accuracy across all platforms.

As a master communicator, you will translate complex atmospheric science into engaging, clear, and relatable narratives for a nation-wide audience. You will serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership—informing critical operational decisions such as field crew deployments and breaking news preemptions—and act as our chief ambassador to the broader weather enterprise, government entities, and academic partners.

Note: This is not a 9-to-5 role. It is a dynamic leadership position driving the meteorological direction of a 24/7 news and intelligence organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Scientific Leadership & Quality Assurance

Network Authority: Serve as a principle decision-maker for high-stakes, network-imperative meteorological calls.

Accuracy & Standards: Review scripts, broadcast graphics, and published media across all digital and broadcast platforms to ensure flawless scientific accuracy and adherence to TWC standards.

Performance Coaching: Monitor airtime, review broadcasts, and provide constructive feedback to On-Camera Meteorologists (OCMs) on science communication, narrative clarity, and forecast accuracy.

Innovative Experiences: Serve as the guiding scientific voice for Immersive Mixed Reality (IMR) experiences

Editorial & Newsroom Integration

Daily Intelligence Briefings: Lead meteorological briefings during editorial meetings to guide daily story selection and production focus.

Breaking News Liaison: Act as the critical bridge between the meteorological team and editorial production teams—especially during fast-moving breaking news and extreme severe weather events.

Message Alignment: Collaborate closely with the Principal Weather Producer to align internal analysis with clear, consistent external messaging.


External Partnerships & Enterprise Relations

Chief Scientific Ambassador: Represent The Weather Group to local, state, and federal agencies, scientific institutions, and government officials.

Industry Engagement: Stay engaged with the broader weather enterprise to keep the network ahead of scientific advancements, technological shifts, and policy/political movements affecting the industry.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements 

  • Advanced Degree: Master’s or Ph.D. in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or a closely related physical science discipline.

  • 10+ Years Experience: Demonstrated track record of professional meteorological experience, including a minimum of 5 years actively communicating complex forecasts to the public.

  • Proven Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams, driving decision-making under high pressure, and mentoring technical talent

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 

  • Expert level understanding meteorological phenomena for all seasons

  • Thorough comprehension of numerical models

  • Monitors and comprehends the latest peer-reviewed weather and climate studies 

  • Strong ability to communicate orally and verbally.  Ability to disseminate complex meteorological information in a useable and understandable manner

  • Ability to write scripts

  • Possesses exceptional interpersonal and teamwork skills

  • Proficient in leveraging AI toolsets to develop and create

  • Knowledge of social media and its role in the information and content gathering process

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, involving cross-functional teams, in an efficient manner

  • Exhibits creative problem solving skills and unique resourcefulness in order to complete tasks

  • Quickly learns and applies new technologies

  • Customer focused, innovative, and self-motivated

  • Receives feedback constructively and incorporates that feedback into work products and performance

  • Good multitasking and trouble-shooting skills

  • Displays strong collaborative skills and works effectively through conflict

  • Maintains high standards for product, performance, and ethics

  • Effectively contributes to team goals within a highly interactive, and at times, stressful environment

  • Dependable and flexible in a 24x7 operational environment

job.title: Facilities Coordinator
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Role Summary

The Facilities Coordinator performs hands-on maintenance and supports day-to-day facilities operations at WWE's corporate headquarters in Stamford, CT. Reporting to the Facilities Senior Director, this role keeps building systems, office spaces, and on-site amenities running safely and to a high standard, and delivers responsive, white-glove support to staff and executives. This is an on-site, hourly position that requires 24x7 on-call availability and occasional after-hours and weekend work.

Reports to: Facilities Senior Director

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on corporate headquarters building systems—including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, and life-safety equipment—troubleshooting and repairing MEP systems to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.

  • Handle general repairs and finishes—including drywall, painting, and carpentry—using hand and power tools.

  • Conduct routine inspections of offices, conference rooms, common areas, and building equipment to identify maintenance needs and safety concerns.

  • Maintain and upkeep the on-site state-of-the-art gym.

job.description:
San Francisco Chronicle Summer Digital Design/Development Internship

The San Francisco Chronicle is seeking motivated students and recent graduates interested in pursuing careers in visual, product and UI/UX design, visual storytelling and coding/development for journalism. 

The Chronicle’s design team is a multidisciplinary group responsible for elevating the newsroom’s most ambitious journalism. We are a diverse group of designers, illustrators, graphics/data reporters and developers of varied backgrounds. Our projects range from crafting design systems for lines of coverage to piecing together immersive storytelling approaches for longform narratives and investigative reports. Recent successes include an Online Journalism Award-winning project on the impact of the World War II incarceration of Japanese Americans on San Francisco’s Japantown and the extremely successful relaunch of our list of Top 100 Restaurants in the San Francisco Bay Area that we rebranded and redesigned with new product features and audience strategies. We also contributed to two investigations — “The Right to Remain Secret” and “Fast and Fatal” — that were finalists for the Pulitzer Prize in 2025.

Our interns have worked on a variety of projects depending on their interests and emerging skillsets. A more coding-focused intern helped create tools to make it easier for other members of the team to produce bespoke, custom-coded projects. Another designed unique visualizations for a story on how winter storms impacted areas around Northern California’s Feather River. You may find yourself creating motion graphics, static and/or interactive information graphics, page designs or new components, such as a better video player over the course of your internship.

Prior interns have gone on to internships or full-time jobs at the Chronicle (and its sister publications or groups in Hearst Newspapers), The Pudding, the Seattle Times, the Texas Tribune, the New York Times and the Washington Post.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. 

 

Responsibilities

  • Participate in brainstorming and design sprints for newsroom projects
  • Execute assignments via reporting, writing, designing and/or coding as needed
  • Communicate effectively with collaborators within the newsroom
  • Manage the production process for your projects

 

Requirements

  • Must be a college junior, senior or recent graduate at time of application
  • Must have an interest in journalism and/or design demonstrated by coursework or practical experience at student publications or professional internships
  • Must be able to work in the Chronicle’s San Francisco office at least three days a week.
  • You should have a basic understanding of HTML and CSS.

 

Skills that we like

This is a list of skills that we would put to use on the design team. It’s impossible to be skilled at everything. We only expect you to do a couple of these. 

  • Basic reporting and writing for accuracy, brevity and clarity
  • News design techniques
  • Visual, UI/UX and/or product design, including typography, color and grid
  • Ability to use the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Development experience with HTML, CSS, Javascript and React, with version management via Git and GitHub
  • News tools such as ArchieML and AI2HTML
  • Data reporting and analysis via Python (preferred) or R
  • Data visualization via DataWrapper or D3
  • Three.js
  • Illustration
  • Animation/motion
  • Video
  • Social media design

 

Internship details

  • Interns are paid $20.50 per hour.
  • Interns work 40 hours a week from Monday through Friday. We generally work from 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Depending on news coverage needs, you may be occasionally asked to work nights or weekends.

  • Based on your interests, we will match you with a mentor in the newsroom who will augment the feedback you receive from your supervisor.

job.title: VP International Marketing GSA (m/f/d)
job.description:
(Full-time, permanent, starting as soon as possible, based in Berlin)

Releases of global artists shape culture far beyond borders — but their success in each market depends on how deeply they connect locally. In this role, you will help define how global artists and international repertoire become relevant, visible and successful across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, working closely with European Marketing teams across the region. Leading the GSA International Marketing team and cooperating closely with Marketing leads across the Continental Europe & Africa region, you will bring together strategic direction, local market insight, creativity and data-informed decision-making to turn global priorities into powerful local campaigns. If you combine strong leadership with global thinking, cultural understanding and a clear sense of what makes music resonate in the GSA market, we are looking for you!

  • You develop the overall marketing strategy for international artists and global releases in GSA, translating international campaign guidelines into tailored, culturally relevant GSA strategies
  • You lead and develop the GSA International Marketing team, setting clear priorities, roles and responsibilities while fostering close collaboration within the team and across local, regional and international interfaces

job.title: Director, Planning and Portfolio
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM 

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Director, Planning & Portfolio Management leads the department-level Planning & Portfolio team within Enterprise Planning & Portfolio Management. This role is responsible for the operating backbone that enables P&T to govern its enterprise portfolio with consistency, transparency, and decision quality.

The role manages the team supporting business-critical portfolio operations. This team owns the frameworks, processes, tools, reporting structures, automation, portfolio data products, and AI-enabled knowledge base that support planning and portfolio governance across P&T.

What you'll do:

This leader ensures that portfolio information from Tempo, EOS, Jira, and internal data tools is translated into trusted weekly, monthly, and quarterly rollups for Catalyst operations, Finance, Accounting, P&T Operations, PTLT, and C-suite reporting. The role sits at the intersection of planning, execution, investment governance, operating rhythm, and executive decision support.

The successful candidate will be expected to maintain continuity for existing enterprise portfolio operations while continuing to mature the function from manual reporting and local process variation toward scalable systems, standardized governance, and AI-enabled portfolio intelligence.

  • Lead the department-level Planning & Portfolio team responsible for the core infrastructure of P&T portfolio governance, including frameworks, processes, tools, data, automation, reporting, and AI-enabled knowledge management.

  • Drive the use of AI and modern work tools, including Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, and other approved enterprise platforms, to reduce manual effort, improve insight quality, accelerate reporting, and strengthen portfolio decision support.

  • Own the operating mechanisms that support quarterly and annual planning, portfolio intake, prioritization, roadmap governance, initiative tracking, and enterprise portfolio visibility.

  • Ensure portfolio data across Tempo, EOS, Jira, Databricks, and internal data tools is accurate, consistent, timely, and usable for executive reporting, planning decisions, investment reviews, and operational governance.

job.title: Senior Staff Editor (Temporary)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Washington bureau is seeking a temporary senior staff editor to work on editing Washington news, including stories on the White House, Congress, the military, intelligence agencies, the Justice Department, the State Department, the Supreme Court, health care, economics and more.

You will work on a mix of daily and enterprise stories as well as breaking news and live coverage during weekday evenings, picking up from the dayside team and working alongside other editors in the Washington bureau and on the Live team in New York, as needed. You will also monitor news developments, consult with the Washington Night Editor and bureau leadership about priorities, do first and second reads and make judgments on the length, placement and framing of stories and, at times, assign stories to reporters.

You will need to have familiarity with a wide variety of topics, versatility, speed, proven judgment and the ability to collaborate across desks and platforms.

This is a temporary position based in Washington, D.C., with regular presence in the office, 4 days per week. It includes night and weekend work as newsroom needs require.

Responsibilities:

  • You will work with other editors and reporters to ensure stories are cleanly edited.
  • You will edit a wide range of material for accuracy, grammar, style and readability, including breaking news, live updates, daily news and major enterprise stories.
  • You will provide first and second edits for a variety of stories and topics across the desk.
  • You will manage coverage of breaking news stories, coordinate with other editors on deployment decisions and launch reporters as needed.
  • You may work with reporters on stories from assigning to publication, including framing, shaping and close-in editing.
  • You will monitor wires, social media and other sources for news developments and stay in touch with reporters and editors about advancing running news stories to keep the report fresh and competitive through the evening, with an eye to coverage into the next news cycle.
  • You may manage the Washington live blog, as needed. Be familiar with its workflows and adjust presentation and coverage plans as news developments require.
  • You will work with other editors in the Washington bureau, on the Live team and across the newsroom to collaborate as necessary.
  • You will coordinate with editors and the audience team on story publication and promotion plans as needed.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Washington Night Editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of editing and writing experience at a journalism or media company or other relevant organization
  • Commitment to The New York Times strategy, ethics, standards and mission for themselves, their team, stringers and colleagues
  • A willingness to collaborate and the ability to partner with colleagues across the Washington bureau and The New York Times newsroom
  • Experience working in high-pressure, deadline-driven newsrooms, including breaking-news or live-coverage workflows
  • Writing and editing skills that demonstrate mastery of journalistic style and standards, including ethical and superb news judgment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A strong understanding of Times style and standards
  • Experience managing or contributing to a live blog, running news report or other continuous coverage format
  • Knowledge of Washington politics, policy and institutions
  • A willingness to be flexible as the bureau and newsroom's needs evolve

job.title: Head of Editorial, Axios Live
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We’re hiring a Head of Live Editorial to join our award-winning events team, Axios Live!

Why it matters: Axios Live is one of Axios’ three core business pillars, bringing Axios journalism to in-person and virtual audiences through interviews, panels, roundtables, and executive forums. This senior editorial leader will oversee macro people management, connect the Booking and Coverage silos, and serve as the primary liaison between Axios Live and the broader newsroom. Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Global Head of Axios Live, this role ensures our live events portfolio meets Axios’ editorial standards, reflects diverse perspectives, and strengthens Axios’ position at the forefront of news and business storytelling.

Go deeper: This is a high-impact leadership role with broad editorial and operational responsibilities, including but not limited to:

Axios Live Editorial Leadership

  • Set the editorial vision and strategy for Axios Live programming across all event formats.
  • Ensure all Axios Live editorial outputs, including onstage interviews, marketing materials, recap articles, and post-event coverage, meet Axios’ editorial standards and Smart Brevity style.
  • Exercise sound editorial judgment in fast-moving news environments, adapting programming as news develops and ensuring live-event scripts, materials, and coverage assets are ready for breaking-news needs.
  • Lead and develop the Axios Live editorial team, including editors, bookers, coverage leads, and Managing Editor; oversee team structure, role design, performance management, and career development.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing culture aligned with Axios’ mission and values.
  • Serve as the primary liaison to the broader newsroom, aligning editorial priorities, event coverage, and resource sharing.
  • Partner with Communications to align on timely promotion, amplification, and coverage of Axios Live events, while identifying opportunities to grow the Axios brand, audience, and event reach.
  • Lead rigorous copy editing and final editorial review of Axios Live’s external-facing materials, including event scripts, moderator notes, speaker introductions, marketing copy, run-of-show materials, recap stories, social copy, and other audience-facing assets, to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to Axios’ editorial standards and Smart Brevity style.

Programming and Standards

  • Develop event concepts, programming arcs, and editorial frameworks for all Axios events, summits, and larger Axios-hosted programs.
  • Shape a diverse, compelling Axios Live programming portfolio that keeps Axios at the forefront of news, policy, and industry storytelling.
  • Partner with Sales and Partnerships to design sponsored and branded programming that maintains editorial integrity.

Strategy and Innovation

  • Contribute to the strategic growth of Axios Live, including new formats, verticals, and revenue opportunities.
  • Demonstrate comfort with and understanding of AI, automation, and emerging tools, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and quality across research, booking, production, and editorial workflows.
  • Represent Axios Live internally and externally, and potentially onstage at live events, as a senior editorial voice.

Connect Booking and Coverage

  • Own the connective tissue between Booking, including securing newsmakers and influencers, and Coverage, including event language, recaps, live-tweeting, and post-event content.
  • Ensure seamless coordination among editorial, events, sales, and partnerships so programming is editorially sound and commercially compelling.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a deep passion for Axios’ mission and journalism, and the following skills:

  • 12 - 15+ years of journalism or editorial experience, including significant experience leading teams and complex editorial operations.
  • Significant experience in live news, events, TV or video production, or related fields.
  • Proven success working in, or closely with, a newsroom and building strong cross-functional relationships.
  • Excellent writing, copy editing, and research skills, with exceptional attention to detail, keen news judgment, and storytelling ability.
  • Deep familiarity with digital and social media landscapes and how news travels across platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Axios’ Smart Brevity style and the ability to teach and uphold it across a team.

job.description:
KATZ Radio Group

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution.

Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In addition to our deeply rooted media expertise, our unique regional sales structure is key to driving our clients’ success. Katz Media Group is based in New York City, with 15 regional offices across the country, providing advertisers and agencies with local expertise and insights across the nation.

Be a part of the largest media representation company in America. At Katz Media Group, we have the best, brightest and boldest talent in the media industry — individuals who deliver unparalleled value for our business partners and clients. We are looking for people who can grow, think, dream and achieve. Every employee brings inspiration and imagination to our constantly evolving and expanding business. If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At Katz Media we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                              

What We Need:

Katz Media Group is looking for a skilled Account Executive

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Broker deals, develop and negotiate new business revenue and client generation

  • Build strong relationships to maintain and grow existing customer base by addressing their evolving needs

  • Create sales strategies to help clients reach their target audience while being mindful of budget

  • Consistently meet or exceed budgeted revenue goals by delivering results and providing services that earn repeat business

  • Establish relationships with a number of different media agencies

  • Manage client accounts by proactively identifying/rectifying problems, obtaining rate quotes and negotiating deals amenable to all parties

  • Communicate all components of sales to key stakeholders

  • Pursue vertical and horizontal penetration of assigned advertisers and ad agencies to maximize exposure for Sales division’s clients and their online assets and events

  • Highlight the benefit of marketplace via positioning and pre-selling opportunities

  • Research business, financials, products/services and markets of clients and their competition. Stay abreast of emerging technologies and market trends

  • Work cross functionally across sales, operations, product, marketing, and finance teams

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 3+ years’ experience in media sales, marketing or advertising with proven success

  • Demonstrated ability to generate new business and to understand the sales cycle: prospecting, buying, behaviors, negotiations for a win-win outcome, overcoming objections and closing

  • Ability to plan and organize, set priorities and multi-task in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong oral and written communication skills; excellent grammar

  • Independence, self-motivation, competitiveness, assertiveness, goal-orientation

  • Understanding of market dynamics, including demographics

  • Stress tolerance, especially with tight deadlines and financial pressures

  • Flexibility and creativity

  • Strong understanding of operational business practices through a four-year college degree in marketing, advertising, business or communications or the equivalent work experience

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and social networking platforms

  • Local or regional travel may be required

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers
  • Knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes
  • Desire to broaden sales capabilities and knowledge base
  • Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members
  • Ability to build a territory plan or account approach
  • Objective judgement and prior experience to solve business problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable applying active listening and influencing skills to drive sales
  • Understanding of impact of your own efforts to meet sales quotas

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

job.title: Senior Vice President, Unscripted Studio - Production
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

With a strong pipeline of returning franchises and bold new formats coming down the line, Fox Entertainment Studios is in search of a Senior Vice President, Unscripted Studio - Production to shepherd its unscripted slate to air, ensuring the delivery of shows with the highest levels of entertainment and production value — on budget and on schedule.

We are looking for a leader who can take a complicated concept and simplify the process, working closely with creators and colleagues to champion shows and bring them to life. This executive will have deep knowledge of the unscripted production process from bottom to top — casting and field production through story, post and delivery — and the instincts to balance the creative ambition of each show against the financial resources available to produce it.

The Senior Vice President will join an innovative leadership team that isn't afraid to take calculated risks and experiment with content and production models. This is an untapped opportunity to be nimble, thoughtful, and innovative about how the content the studio creates comes to life and reaches audiences across platforms domestically and abroad.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee all aspects of physical production across a high-volume portfolio of concurrent unscripted series, returning multi-season franchises and paid development
  • Oversee integration and product placement deals on shows, vetting network and platform approval on all terms
  • Oversee productions made with external production companies and partners — assessing and approving each partner's production plan, budget, schedule and staffing, and holding them to Fox's creative, technical, legal, cost and delivery standards from greenlight through final delivery
  • Oversee risk management and insurance for both corporate and production
  • Provide insight and guidance to efficiently resolve creative, production and post-production hurdles, successfully balancing the creative needs of the shows with the financial resources available to produce them
  • Work closely with showrunners, executive producers, line producers and key department heads to ensure shows are produced at the highest quality within the constraints of budget and schedule
  • Innovate new unscripted production models and partnerships that speak to today's business realities — including domestic and international productions and co-productions — to protect margin without compromising on screen
  • Build the production plan, budgets, calendars, and assumptions for every project
  • Manage and oversee all line producers to ensure they are hitting milestones, on budget and on schedule
  • Negotiate budgets with network and platform production executives. Partner with development and current teams to build budgets for new shows and paid development
  • Supervise series physical production and delivery schedules and cost reports in accordance with each network's and platform's deliverable requirements. Track costs and create cost reporting for the development and finance teams
  • Hire, supervise, and mentor a team of production executives, line producers, EICs, production managers, and freelancers; build credibility and strong working relationships across the organization
  • Collaborate across departments to strategize, develop systems, problem-solve, and ensure company resources are maximized across the full slate
    • Partner with Finance to ensure proper cash flow, funding, and cost reporting on all projects
    • Partner with Business & Legal Affairs to negotiate network and platform deals, talent and producer contracts, staffing agreements and access agreements as needed
    • Partner with Production Legal to anticipate and manage legal and clearance issues
    • Partner with Current Programming to ensure a smooth handoff at greenlight and maintain brand and format integrity throughout the production lifecycle
  • Run and continually optimize the studio's production and post-production operation — studio and stage space, edit bays, equipment and gear — that serves the full slate, maximizing utilization, revenue and margin across shows
  • Supervise, secure, track, and manage all state and international tax incentive programs on eligible shows, including financial reporting and auditing
  • Lead international co-productions and the physical production of FAE-owned global formats across territories — partnering with local producers and broadcasters (e.g., TF1, ProSieben) to deliver Fox-owned IP to spec, on budget in every market
  • Identify production challenges and risks and work with the appropriate teams to resolve issues, streamline processes, and foster innovation
  • Stay on top of key industry trends and identify opportunities. In concert with senior leadership, evaluate opportunities for increasing revenue and margin across the studio
  • Drive operational excellence — ensuring systems are in place to direct and control costs, measure key financial and performance metrics, and identify opportunities for optimization
  • Participate in the analysis and development of new ideas, formats, and pitches, bringing a producer's lens to what each concept will take to execute

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 15+ years of progressive production experience culminating in a senior executive role (SVP/EVP/Head of Production level) at a major unscripted studio, production group or group of networks, with responsibility for a high-volume slate
  • Demonstrated knowledge of production from bottom to top: field production, postproduction, story structure, and staff management
  • A track record of delivering marquee, tentpole formats and returning multi- season franchises — competition and game shows, culinary and lifestyle, celebrity-reality, docuseries, talk and live/event — at the highest quality yet cost-effectively, including re-engineering and refreshing recurring seasons to keep long-running brands strong
  • Direct experience on large-scale competition and culinary franchises of the kind that anchor Fox's slate is a distinct advantage.
  • Progressive, executive-level experience producing a wide variety of high-quality, boundary-pushing content that breaks through. Able to skillfully produce high quality yet cost-effective productions that are creatively synonymous with Fox Entertainment content.
  • Able to innovate new production models and partnerships that speak to the reality of today’s business models
  • Proven history of applying seasoned business judgment in creative decision- making strategies
  • Combination of right brain/left brain thinking. Someone who can speak the language of creatives and can also manage the business and bring discipline and process to the operation.
  • Process-driven; functions tactically and with great detail within the production/postproduction process
  • Significant experience in contract negotiation, staffing agreements, licensing, rights and clearances, and state/international tax incentives.
  • Proven builder of teams — has recruited, developed, and led a bench of production executives, line producers, EICs and production managers, not merely staffed individual shows.
  • Effective communicator who can ensure seamless communication with other departments to ensure quality control, timely delivery of shows, higher reliability, etc.
  • Strong, established relationships with key players in the entertainment industry including talent, agents, production companies, producers, etc.
  • Ability to manage outside producers, build credibility and strong working relationships with other internal executives, and generate commitment to goals
  • Track record and reputation for conducting business with the highest standards of integrity and ethics.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; able to manage multiple priorities, personalities, agendas, deadlines, and rapidly changing circumstances
  • Leverage ideas, people, and resources for maximum results
  • Able to balance strategy formulation with execution; great attention to detail and follow-through
  • Track record of tenacity in the face of obstacles, with the ability to adapt and be resourceful in unanticipated situations
  • Able to identify crucial priorities and develop the plans and resource allocations to achieve them
  • Organized and Dependable: Highly organized with a sharp eye and a passion for nailing the details from casting to field to post
  • Can be depended on to deliver projects on schedule and without errors, and to take ownership
  • Strong work ethic and multitasking skills
  • Live equally in the creative and the tactical spheres
  • Has the focus, drive and execution skills to guide a show to its highest potential while managing disparate stakeholders, teams and personalities — and, above
  • all, can execute
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, changing environment on multiple projects in various stages of production simultaneously; performs under pressure and balances strategy formulation with execution
  • Reaches out to peers and cooperates with talent, colleagues, and partners to build a collegial and collaborative working environment
  • Understands that great ideas can come from anywhere; has a constrained ego, follows through on commitments, and often solicits feedback
  • Can-do attitude with demonstrated tenacity and willingness to go the distance. Highly driven and energetic; exhibits genuine passion and excitement for the work
  • Loves the business of entertainment; an avid TV watcher with a strong point of view on where television and content are
     

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Craft credibility that commands the respect of top talent, showrunners and crews - Emmy-caliber recognition or comparable standing in the unscripted community

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
The Master Control Operator is responsible for the overall on-air look of television stations through airing programming and scheduled station breaks in a centralized broadcast hub environment. 

  • Updates and maintains signal control systems
  • Maintains programming logs as required by station management
  • Segments content and clips to the server and then trims and modifies it

As a Client Services Content Creator, you will help bring client, market, regional, and national creative ideas to life. This role is ideal for someone who is confident in the full production process, comfortable managing multiple creative assignments, and able to work independently while collaborating with Sales, Client Services, project management, and creative leadership.

As an ACCET Client Services Content Creator in our Baltimore, MD market, you will create commercial, branded, digital, promotional, and multi-platform content for assigned markets while helping maintain strong creative quality, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

Create High-Quality Multi-Platform Content

  • Write, produce, shoot, edit, and deliver commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, promotional creative, and other client deliverables.

job.description:

Overview:

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! This person will be tasked with implementing a comprehensive program of Information Technology (IT) internal auditing throughout the Company. They are primarily in charge of defining the scope of audits to identify control deficiencies, security weaknesses, opportunities to streamline and improve operations, and promote best-in-class business practices.
The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements
  • Lead audits of highly technical areas within applications and infrastructure, security and vulnerability assessments, third party management, identity and access management, change control, asset management, disaster recovery, data privacy, cybersecurity, cloud services, and other emerging technologies
  • Evaluate the design and performance of internal controls and communicate audit and special project findings to management by clearly articulating risk exposure and providing realistic, cost-effective recommendations to mitigate risk and improve operational efficiency
  • Assess risks and controls associated with system implementations, major technology transformations, and pre- and post-implementation reviews
  • Coordinate audit activities with IT and business management while supervising and critically evaluating the performance of audit staff
  • Serve as a primary audit contact for assigned business and technology functions, developing trusted relationships and providing risk-based insights to management and executive teams
  • Perform special assignments, including business process reviews, due diligence activities, investigations, and strategic risk assessments, as directed by the Vice President of Internal Audit
  • Review work completed by staff members to ensure sufficient documentation, quality, and support for audit conclusions
  • Support the Internal Audit Vice President in periodic risk assessments and development of the annual audit plan
  • Draft, edit, and review audit reports, executive summaries, special project reports, and administrative communications
  • Develop the technical, management, and audit capabilities of IT Audit Managers and Staff through coaching, mentoring, and formal development activities
  • Stay informed on emerging risks and trends in cybersecurity, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, media technology, privacy regulations, and technology governance
  • Partner with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen risk management and control environments across the organization
  • Some domestic travel may be required

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive audit experience, including 2+ years of leadership experience in IT audit/accounting 
  • Experience within a top public accounting company, consulting organization, or internal audit function of a large public company preferred
  • Prior IT consulting, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technical operational experience is a plus
  • BS or MS in Information Systems, Accounting, Information Systems Auditing, Computer Science, or a related field required

  • Ability to understand the Company’s operational and technology environment, business objectives, key processes, and associated risks
  • Advanced knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity, cloud security controls, infrastructure operations, application development and support, data privacy, and technology risk management practices
  • Experience applying IT and information security frameworks (e.g., NIST, SOX, COBIT) to audit testing and risk assessments
  • Strong comprehension of system development and implementation lifecycle methodologies and related controls
  • Experience auditing automated environments, enterprise applications, cloud technologies, and complex global security and compliance functions
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, and drive successful outcomes in a matrixed organization through collaboration rather than direct authority
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, audit management tools, Microsoft Office applications, and collaboration platforms
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences
  • Sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to think strategically and creatively

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CIA, or CPA preferred
  • Experience with Oracle and/or SAP environments preferred

job.title: Senior Director, Engineering
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment. We are hiring a Sr. Director of Engineering to lead the people, systems, and practices behind reliable products. 

Why it matters: This leader will develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders while closely guiding teams using AI to build and experiment. Working closely with the CTO, you will turn company technology direction into clear engineering decisions and execution.

Go deeper: The role spans engineering across Axios products, platforms, and workflows, from our CMS and axios.com to newsletters, Local products, internal tools, and systems supporting the Newsroom and business teams. Product, Newsroom, and business leaders set the goals. Engineering builds the systems and capabilities that help achieve them. The right leader will speed decisions, shorten the path from idea to product, spot risks early, and escalate issues before they grow. Responsibilities include:

  • Partner closely with the CTO and engineering leaders to shape engineering strategy and technical direction.
  • Lead and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, supporting clear accountability and a healthy culture. Develop and retain strong talent, and hire thoughtfully as needs evolve.
  • Strengthen planning, delivery, quality, and reliability. Help teams make faster decisions, move ideas into products, spot risks, and escalate issues early.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Newsroom, and business leaders to turn priorities into technical plans and match engineering capacity to the most important work.
  • Bring strong judgment to architecture, platforms, and reliability, especially when tradeoffs span teams.
  • Own the operating standards, guidelines, and practices that help engineering teams plan, build, test, release, operate, and learn effectively.
  • Establish shared benchmarks and baselines for engineering health.
  • Lead vendor evaluation and selection for engineering tools, platforms, and services, balancing capability, cost, security, reliability, support, and long-term fit.
  • Help define modern engineering leadership inside an AI-native media company and shape how Axios builds, learns, and delivers at speed.

Worthy of your time: This leader must be a close partner to the CTO and senior leaders who can explain technical details clearly and dive deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions. Success means faster decisions, a shorter path from idea to product, strong engineering leadership, reliable systems, and an organization that sees around corners. What we’re looking for:

  • You have led and developed engineering managers and senior technical leaders, setting clear expectations and addressing performance directly.
  • You have helped teams use AI to improve how they build, test, and operate software and to experiment with new product capabilities.
  • You translate technical details for executives and nontechnical partners while going deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions.
  • You quickly understand unfamiliar areas, ask the right questions, and know when to bring in expertise, invest in platforms, simplify systems, or accept a short-term tradeoff.
  • Ideally, you have led teams responsible for high-traffic digital products and the platforms behind them.
  • You have a strong vision for how AI and technology will change engineering practices, product development, platforms, and internal workflows.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $250,000 - $270,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.


Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.


A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.


This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.


Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Information Security Analyst, Third-Party Security and Data Breach Expert, to spearhead its Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program for external partners and vendors.

 

In this role, you will oversee and execute ongoing assessments of third-party technology risk to ensure vendor risks remain within acceptable tolerance thresholds while maintaining compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. You will report the overall risk posture to information security governance and management committees. As a recognized subject matter expert, you will serve as a trusted adviser for governance, risk and compliance (GRC) across the organization.

 

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

 

What’s in It for You

 

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

 

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Drive the TPRM program: Lead and oversee the organization-wide Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program, from process development through to operational implementation.
  • Define assessment methodologies and standards: Design, maintain and update third-party risk classification frameworks (criticality, data sensitivity) and security assessment questionnaires aligned with industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST).
  • Assess compliance and security posture: Evaluate the security posture and maturity of third parties by reviewing SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 certifications, penetration test results and regulatory compliance attestations (e.g., GDPR, Quebec’s Law 25).
  • Address risks and recommend mitigation: Assess identified security gaps, formulate risk mitigation strategies or compensating controls, and establish binding remediation plans with vendors.
  • Define and validate complex contractual security requirements, including audit rights, incident notification SLAs (24- to 48-hour response windows), encryption standards and business continuity plans.
  • Negotiate directly with partners and vendors: Engage directly with vendor security leaders during contracting phases to advocate for and enforce organizational security requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership during third-party security incidents or data breaches.
  • Manage third-party risk registers: Maintain an up-to-date mapping and complete inventory of all external partners and their corresponding risk levels.
  • Oversee periodic reassessments: Schedule and perform ongoing security evaluations based on vendor criticality (e.g., annual reviews for high-risk third parties).
  • Champion security best practices across internal teams to foster a security-first mindset from contract initiation.
  • Advance the TPRM strategy: Continuously adapt assessment processes in response to emerging cyber threats and regulatory updates.
  • Produce governance dashboards and metrics (KPIs/KRIs): Report third-party risk metrics to leadership (e.g., assessment completion rates, turnaround times, open risk findings).
  • Maintain broad knowledge of best practices and trends in information security.

 

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years’ experience in IT risk governance and TPRM, including a minimum of three years focused on information security.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with legal teams to define and negotiate contractual security and privacy requirements (e.g., security schedules, audit rights, data breach notification timelines).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • Ability to make others feel comfortable and open up on air

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. job.title: News Producer, Telemundo - WFOX TV
job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  News Producer, Telemundo - WFOX TV

 

Position Overview

WFOX TV Jacksonville is in search of a News Producer for its new Telemundo Jacksonville Spanish language newscast. The ideal candidate consistently crafts in-depth, fast-paced, memorable newscasts. You must be able to own breaking news inside newscasts. In addition, successful candidates must understand coverage on all platforms and are expected to help generate enterprise story ideas.  Collaboration with others is a must for this position, and candidates should be open to feedback and have a desire to grow in their role. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Bilingual with excellent Spanish writing skills.
  • Research, write and edit news stories to ensure they meet quality and ethical standards.
  • Create relevant, important and memorable newscasts 
  • Develop graphics for production by Design Department 
  • Write Opens, Stories, and Teases 
  • Assign stories to anchors, writers, and editors for scripting, production and timing 
  • Work closely with news team to create compelling news segments and maintain high production standards.
  • Work in the Control Room during broadcast to oversee presentation and changes in format 
  • Understand and effectively use all platforms 
  • Ensure all news segments are produced and aired on time and often under tight deadlines.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions

job.title: Weekend Host/Producer, LiveNOW (Orlando, FL)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for a Weekend Host/Producer to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As the Weekend Host/Producer, you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

The schedule for this position will be Monday-Tuesday, Friday-Sunday.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.

  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.

  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.

  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.

  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.

  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.

  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.

  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.

  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.

  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.

  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.

  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.

  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.

  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).

  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.

  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.

  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.

  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $75,000.00-85,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.
