WYFF TV, the NBC / CBS affiliate in Greenville, SC has an opening for a Local News Producer who knows how to create meaningful and memorable newscasts. You have creative vision and have experience making decisions and communicating the plan. You know how to win the big story, own breaking news and display important weather information. You must be fast and able to play well in a room of same-minded pros. Accuracy is job one! 

Responsibilities

  • Select, research, and write content for live newscasts to make the newscast an "experience" for viewers
  • Work with and guide reporters in story production
  • Coordinate creative vision with team of anchors, reporters, meteorologists, photographers, editors, and production staff
  • Boothing assigned newscasts, breaking news and weather events
  • Live timing newscasts

 

Requirements

  • Professional or college producing experience
  • Experience working in a newsroom
  • Have writing and copy-editing skills
  • Coordinate several crews and responsibilities simultaneously
  • Experience summarizing information into easy-to-understand components
  • Creative presentation style, and ability to showcase all resources and elements
  • Have and exhibit the highest journalistic integrity and ethical standards
  • Must be available to work holidays, shifts including nights, weekends and overnights, and flexible with schedule to be available during breaking news
  • Related military experience will be considered

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

Benefits

Hearst's benefit programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on you. As a Hearst employee, you and your spouse or partner or dependents would have access to the following benefits.

  • Medical | Dental | Vision
  • 401(k) matching
  • Emotional Wellness Support
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • LGBTQ+ Health Services
  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

job.title: Account Executive III, Sales
job.description:
The Sales Account Executive generates advertising revenue by calling on established agencies, cold-calling new prospects and convincing potential clients of the merits of television advertising.

  • Implements strategies to consistently grow revenue and exceed revenue goals.
  • Establishes credible relationships with local business community.
  • Makes sales calls on existing and prospective clients.
  • Maintains assigned accounts and develops new accounts.
  • Prepares and delivers sales presentations to clients.
  • Explains to customers how specific types of advertising will help promote their products or services in the most effective way possible.
  • Provides clients with information regarding rates for advertising placement in all media.
  • Develops advertising schedules with clients and station personnel responsible for placing advertising into station media.
  • Works with clients and station personnel to develop advertisements.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising or Mass Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Minimum one year’s experience in sales, preferably in the media field.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Experience achieving long-range objectives and implementing the strategies and actions to achieve them.
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment.

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
KRQE Media Group in Albuquerque is looking for an evening News Anchor; Monday through Friday. You will serve as the primary presenter of news stories and other content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.

  • Presents news stories and other content for all platforms.
  • Ensures that all news content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality.
  • Writes and delivers news stories in a clear and concise manner.
  • Produces newscasts and communicates clear direction with team members.
  • Assists in writing, copy editing, researching and coordinating news programming and other content.
  • Acts as a field reporter as assigned.
  • Conducts interviews with news personnel and others.
  • Responds to breaking news and other urgent newsrooms situations as required.
  • Participates in promotional activities including public appearances.
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Edits video clips as assigned.
  • Writes content for the website and other eMedia platforms.
  • Interacts with viewers/users on social media sites.​


 Requirements & Skills:

  • Broadcast Journalism degree, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required.
  • Minimum five years’ experience in news reporting or anchoring.  
  • Superior on-air presence.
  • Excellent news judgment with an expansive knowledge of local and national current events, history, newsmakers and issues.
  • Experience guiding, directing and motivating others.
  • Ability to identify the developmental needs of others and to coach, mentor or otherwise help others to improve their knowledge or skills.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to effectively listen to fully understand problems and communicate with a team to shape a solution.
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record.

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
KOIN 6 TV/Portland’s CW, a Nexstar Inc. owned CBS and CW duopoly in Portland, Oregon is looking for a newscast producer in a top-25 market that’s become one of the most popular cities in the country to live.  We offer a competitive salary, attractive benefits, and collaborative work environment.

JOB SUMMARY:  The producer delivers and contributes accurate, visual, news content across all media platforms, including broadcast and streaming. The ideal candidate has worked as a successful producer and knows how to present news that gets our viewers’ attention.  We want a smart, passionate, and creative thinker who writes conversationally.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for evaluating stories and organizing them into a cohesive sequence within a newscast.
  • Write strong, active copy that matches video.
  • Oversee production and timing of broadcast newscasts.
  • Contribute story ideas to the editorial process, work collaboratively with reporters, and make solid decisions in breaking news situations.
  • Monitor postproduction processes to ensure accurate completion of details.
  • Write, produce, and edit material that appeals to target audiences.
  • Research production topics using the internet, video archives, and other information sources.
  • Assist with production of streaming shows on KOIN+ streaming platform.
  • Execute strategies that engage and grow audiences across all digital devices.
  • Contribute to digital and social platforms as needed.

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Must be able to interact well with anchors, reporters, videographers, news managers, production and engineering staff.
  • Detail oriented.
  • Excellent verbal, written, grammar and analytical skills.
  • Strong news judgment, journalistic integrity and understanding of viewer needs and expectations.
  • Knowledge of media production, communication and dissemination techniques and methods, including alternative ways to inform and entertain via written, oral, and visual media.
  • Ability to meet quality standards for service & evaluate customer satisfaction.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: Bachelor’s Degree (TV/film or equivalent experience may substitute) + 2 (two) years’ experience in television broadcast/production.

TRAINING/EQUIPMENT:  Utilize state-of-the-art television technology; MS Outlook, E-mail.

Work Environment/Physical Requirements: High stress environment with deadline pressures and the demands of breaking news, which can happen at any time. Position will require day-to-day multi-tasking, as well as managing multiple projects simultaneously with frequent change in direction and priority. Must be willing to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays), as well as be able to work any and all shifts as necessary, including overnights/early mornings, nights, and holidays.

The employee in this position must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work near others, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions. Repetitive movements are required. Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions.

NOTE: This job description contains the basic requirements for the position and is NOT intended to be a complete list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned.

TO APPLY: Please visit the Work for us page at KOIN.com: http://bit.ly/2IsKviW or at the Nexstar Website at: https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar  to complete the application process.

ABOUT US: Broadcasting since 1953, KOIN-TV is Portland’s CBS affiliate, providing exceptional local news content on air and online (koin.com), CBS Network programming and syndicated entertainment to viewers across Oregon and SW Washington. KOIN News is Watching Out for You with 51 hours of local news broadcasts each week, featuring award-winning, in-depth investigations, news, weather, traffic, KOIN News AM-Extra and Game-On!  KOIN-TV is a Nexstar Media Group, Inc. television station serving Oregon and SW Washington from its studios in downtown Portland, OR. Nexstar is the largest local television broadcast and digital media company in the nation with 200 broadcast stations (including partner stations) in 116 markets reaching approximately 68% of US television households. Today, as one of the most powerful and trusted voices in America, Nexstar remains true to its mission to uphold the public interest principles of localism, diversity, and trustworthy, unbiased broadcast journalism. At the same time, the company continues to simultaneously raise its commitment to support the evolving needs and interests of the local viewers, hometown businesses and community organizations that it proudly serves each day.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us.

 **** EOE/MINORITIES/FEMALES/VETERANS/DISABLED****

KOIN is an equal opportunity employer that seeks diversity in our workforce. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

KOIN values the contribution of its employees. We recognize their efforts by offering a competitive compensation plan and an array of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(K), and more. We are committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. Any job offer is conditional upon satisfactorily completing a background and DMV check.

job.title: Associate, Research (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Research Associate is responsible for developing, analyzing, and distributing football research that supports the NFL Media Group. This role will assist in ensuring editorial consistency, factual accuracy, and statistical context across all platforms. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of football history, statistics and current events, along with excellent research, writing, communication, and organizational skills. The NFL Media Group is seeking a collaborative and detail-orientated professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can support multiple projects while meeting tight deadlines.

Responsibilities

  • Leads the development of editorial content, ensuring ideas are properly executed into graphics, segments, features, and other content for live studio shows.
  • Contributes to daily content distribution plan that pushes targeted research materials to content creators throughout the Media Group.
  • Develops original storylines, notes, nuggets and boards that provide statistical context around events, news stories and topical issues.
  • Identify and anticipate league and team trends, applying relevant statistics to create compelling content.
  • Ensures factual accuracy of all research content.
  • Works within our standards for high-quality research content while maintaining tireless work ethic on a consistent basis.
  • Works closely with coordinating producers, producers, editors, writers, talent, and digital teams.
  • Make significant contributions to Weekly Research Notes, breaking news coverage, and numerous research-related projects supporting the Media Group.
  • Collaborate with the Research team on best practices regarding both dedicated show research and general research support.
  • Assists in training for new seasonal research staff.
  • Recommend improvements to research methods, tools, and standards.
  • React quickly to breaking news and adhere to strict deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent degree.
  • 3-5 years of professional experience working with statistics or covering and analyzing sports events and news.
  • Strong foundation of knowledge of current and historical football statistics, news, events and milestones.
  • Must be technologically savvy, with strong command of Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel.
  • Strong familiarity with digital and social media platforms.
  • Ability to meet strict deadlines and adapt quickly to breaking news and changing priorities.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in sports media.
  • Previous work experience working for or covering the NFL.
  • Proven track record of success working with high profile broadcasters.
  • Knowledge of football research databases/resources a plus (i.e. Pro Football Reference, Pro Football Focus, Next Gen Stats, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of the football media landscape, including emerging platforms and competing properties.
  • Detailed knowledge of television production processes, including awareness of key editorial roles.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at the same time.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and departments.
  • Ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Travel

  • Possible travel to events, less than 10%.

Terms /Expected Hours of Work

  • Required to work 40 hours per week with potential for overtime.
  • Required to work nights and weekends around NFL games and tentpole events.
  • This is an in-office position.
  • This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Senior Manager, IT Ops
job.description:
Are you a tech-savvy leader ready to drive innovation and keep our systems running seamlessly? KNXV in Phoenix, Arizona is seeking an experienced Information Technology Manager who will lead our local IT team and ensure our technology infrastructure supports our mission of serving the community. This is your opportunity to make a strategic impact while managing cutting-edge broadcast and business technology in a dynamic media environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Manage desktop support functions

  • Plan and direct the development, installation, and maintenance of computer application programs and computer software programs and systems

  • Ensure staff provides effective levels of support and guidance to employees regarding the use of systems and technologies available on network

  • Manage desktop support for local users to include workstations, laptops, printers, and copiers

  • Manage cell phone support for local users

  • Install, configure, and maintain the organization's LAN server and workstations

  • Maintain security of LANs

  • Notify appropriate management when users or organization are negatively impacted by network issues

  • Install and configure related telecommunications network hardware, software and peripherals including routers, switches, call managers, ACD systems, and other Ethernet and fiber optic networking & telecommunications equipment

  • Actively monitor network, voice, and video equipment ensuring prompt response to alarms

  • Perform mid level troubleshooting, diagnosis and repair/fixes for LAN related hardware and software

  • Maintain security of voice, data, and video systems

  • Notify appropriate management when users or organization is negatively impacted by voice, data, or video systems issues

  • Work with multiple hardware and software platforms

  • Participate in testing disaster recovery plan

  • Ensure inventories of Scripps systems assets, hardware, and software are current and accurate

  • Ensure IT Security compliance to include personal computer and server passwords, anti-virus, software patches, and other security upgrades are maintained

  • Research and evaluate new technologies, make recommendations as required

  • Document Division IT operations policies and procedures. Participate in and comply with audits such as SOX and PCI

  • Ensure change management procedures are followed

  • Provide project management for the implementation, installation, and operation of local networks and systems

  • Coordinate activities with local business units, Division IT staff, vendor support staff as needed

  • Ensure timely response time to technology requests and issues

job.title: Sr Reporter, KMVT
job.description:
KMVT, The E.W. Scripps Company CBS affiliate in Twin Falls, Idaho, is seeking a Senior Reporter who is passionate about investigative journalism and meaningful storytelling. This role is perfect for a seasoned journalist ready to lead by example, mentor others, and deliver impactful stories that resonate across multiple platforms.

As our Senior Reporter, you'll serve as a subject matter expert in investigative and long-form journalism while building authentic connections with our community. You'll be at the forefront of breaking news, diving deep into stories that matter, and inspiring others with your commitment to the highest journalistic standards.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop a network of sources throughout the community to leverage local experts.

  • Research stories by investigating public records, personal sources, and other contacts to determine the most effective approach for a story.

  • Use visual journalism such as graphics, photography, and videography as well as digitally distinct content.

  • Operate camera with still and video capabilities.

  • Serve as a lead reporter for in-depth breaking news and stay abreast of local developments.

  • Report live on location from various news events.

  • Fill in as morning anchor, as needed.

  • Inspire community belonging with diversity of coverage and perspectives.

  • Maintain current journalism capabilities to deliver high-quality reporting.

  • Collaborate and share content, design elements, systems, workflows, and best practices.

  • Ensure objectivity and fairness in coverage, sensitivity to community expectations and balanced content.

  • Engage with newsroom editorial and content planning to ensure effective planning for multimedia platforms that aligns to strategy and deadlines.

  • Participate in community events and actively engage with the community.

  • May serve as back-up for editorial coverage.

  • Periodically required to drive personal or company vehicle to cover various assignments.

  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in news reporting including in-depth long form reporting required

  • Experience in community, digital and solutions-based reporting, and journalism preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • High expertise in in-depth, long form reporting and application of journalistic standards

  • Talented storyteller with a distinct and engaging on-air personality

  • Media consumer mindset

  • Working knowledge of multimedia journalism, e.g. news reporting, writing, web posting, still photography, online video, infographics, databases, and social media

  • Versed in the fundamentals of news reporting, including privacy, access, ethics as well as state and federal laws regarding open meetings, open records, and access to information

  • High standards of accuracy and fairness

  • Outstanding editing and writing for publication

  • Working knowledge of Associated Press style

  • Able to use digital, video, mapping, social networking, and other technology to bolster on-air news reporting

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook), and web publishing tools

  • High adaptability

  • High emotional intelligence

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Twin Falls, Idaho, offers a unique blend of small-town charm and outdoor adventure. Known as the gateway to the Magic Valley, Twin Falls is home to the breathtaking Shoshone Falls—often called the "Niagara of the West"—and the stunning Perrine Bridge, a popular spot for BASE jumping enthusiasts. The area boasts world-class fly fishing, hiking, and mountain biking, with easy access to Craters of the Moon National Monument and the Sawtooth Mountains.

The community is welcoming and tight-knit, with a thriving downtown featuring local shops, restaurants, and cultural events. Twin Falls is also an agricultural hub, offering farm-to-table dining experiences and a strong connection to the land. With affordable living, excellent schools, and a growing economy, Twin Falls provides an exceptional quality of life for those seeking both professional fulfillment and outdoor recreation.

job.title: Regional News Director, KMGH, KOAA, KKTV, KKCO & KJCT
job.description:
Regional News Director, KMGH, KOAA, KKTV, KKCO & KJCT

Are you a transformational news leader ready to shape the future of local journalism across Colorado?

The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Regional News Director to lead one of the most important news regions in our company. Based in Denver at KMGH, our ABC affiliate serving Colorado's largest market, this leader will serve as News Director for KMGH while providing strategic leadership and oversight across KOAA (Colorado Springs/Pueblo), KKTV (Colorado Springs), KKCO (Grand Junction), and KJCT (Grand Junction).

This is a unique opportunity for an accomplished newsroom executive to influence journalism, content strategy, audience growth, and newsroom performance across multiple markets while leading a high-performing newsroom in Denver. We are looking for a collaborative, innovative leader who understands how to build strong newsroom cultures, elevate storytelling, develop talent, and leverage the collective strength of multiple stations to better serve audiences across Colorado.

The ideal candidate combines a passion for exceptional local journalism with the strategic vision, leadership skills, and business acumen necessary to guide news operations in a rapidly evolving media landscape.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Create and implement strategic plans for audience growth, journalism excellence, and newsroom operations at KMGH.

  • Communicate a compelling and inspiring vision for the newsroom that aligns with company strategy and content priorities.

  • Develop and execute measurable strategies to grow audiences across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

  • Analyze and respond to trends affecting the industry, audience behaviors, competitive landscape, and local news environment.

  • Oversee newsroom staffing and personnel decisions.

  • Develop and manage the annual newsroom budget in accordance with station and company guidelines.

  • Build and maintain key community relationships that strengthen KMGH's reputation and impact.

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, journalistic standards, and company policies.

  • Collaborate with station leadership to achieve overall station and organizational goals.

  • Lead and develop newsroom leaders and staff through coaching, feedback, accountability, and performance management.

  • Partner with station, regional, and corporate leadership to strengthen newsroom performance and align journalistic priorities across KMGH, KOAA, KKTV, KKCO, and KJCT.

  • Identify and lead regional coverage opportunities that leverage the collective strengths, talent, expertise, and resources of Colorado stations.

  • Establish clear performance expectations for market News Directors and provide coaching, mentorship, feedback, and accountability through a dotted-line leadership structure.

  • Evaluate content and journalism across assigned stations to ensure alignment with enterprise content strategy, audience priorities, journalistic standards, and company objectives.

  • Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across markets to promote best practices and innovation.

  • Partner with station and regional leaders to support workforce planning, resource allocation, and organizational effectiveness across the region.

  • Identify opportunities for shared coverage, breaking news collaboration, investigative initiatives, enterprise reporting, and special projects.

  • Use audience, performance, and operational data to identify opportunities, address challenges, and improve results across markets.

  • Support organizational change and the adoption of emerging technologies, workflows, and content strategies that strengthen local journalism.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive news management experience, preferably including leadership of large newsroom operations preferred.

  • Experience leading multiple teams, markets, stations, or geographically dispersed organizations preferred.

  • Demonstrated success driving audience growth and newsroom performance across multiple platforms.

  • Proven experience leading change, developing talent, and building strong newsroom cultures.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • A deep commitment to quality local journalism, ethical decision-making, and serving local communities.

  • Demonstrated success developing and executing content strategies that drive audience growth and engagement.

  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to translate enterprise goals into actionable newsroom plans.

  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of empowering teams, establishing accountability, and producing results.

  • Ability to influence and collaborate across organizational boundaries and multiple markets.

  • Strong understanding of audience analytics, content performance metrics, and data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Knowledge of newsroom technology, digital publishing platforms, streaming products, and emerging media trends.

  • Ability to adapt resources, workflows, and talent strategies to meet changing audience expectations and business needs.

  • Strong understanding of journalistic ethics, editorial judgment, and applicable laws affecting news operations.

LOCATION

This position is based in Denver, Colorado, at KMGH-TV. The successful candidate will serve as News Director for KMGH while providing regional leadership for KOAA, KKTV, KKCO, and KJCT. Regular travel throughout Colorado will be expected to support station partnerships, coaching, collaboration, and regional initiatives.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY

Denver offers an unbeatable combination of professional opportunity, cultural vibrancy, and outdoor adventure. With more than 300 days of sunshine each year, residents enjoy easy access to the Rocky Mountains, world-class skiing, hiking, biking, and countless outdoor activities.

As Colorado's largest city, Denver features a thriving downtown, outstanding restaurants, professional sports teams, a vibrant arts and entertainment scene, and a strong economy. From Red Rocks Amphitheatre and the Denver Art Museum to weekend adventures in Vail, Aspen, or Breckenridge, Denver provides an exceptional quality of life and is consistently recognized as one of the nation's best places to live and work.

On the reporter side, we are looking for someone with a clear understanding of how to dig for a story, research it, write it with an edge, and use strong storytelling and TV production to make it impactful and memorable. Knowledge of current events, educational and political systems is essential, with a focus on government accountability. 

On the forecasting side, the ideal candidate has a high interest in weather. You will turn weather-related stories. Fill-in forecasting on different shifts when needed.  Do you love sharing the big weather story, whether that is on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, a mobile app, or on TV? Do you love explaining the why and the how of weather, far beyond current radar and the 7-day forecast?  Utah is a dynamic state to cover weather, providing significantly different forecasts for different parts of the state.  We want someone who is hungry to learn about the impact the weather has on our communities.

Must have great organization and time management skills for both roles to be able to create a pipeline of stories, and connections within the community, track and hit deadlines on time. Your responsibilities in addition to television include reporting and forecasting for our digital and social platforms. Examples include- but not limited to- producing stories for KUTV.COM that include unique digital-only content. You will also be expected to post unique content to YouTube, Facebook, Twitter and other social media platforms.  Our newsroom is one that places a high value on being a voice for the voiceless through holding those in power accountable.  As a reporter in our newsroom, you’ll be expected to find and pitch these stories- then enjoy the satisfaction knowing your reporting is truly making a difference.  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 3 Years of reporting/MMJ experience
  • Develop and maintain contacts and sources in the community to enterprise story ideas
  • Identify and pitch enterprise stories that are unique and land in key topic areas
  • Work closely with newsroom managers to refine pitches and story scripts
  • Produce digital versions of your reports.  This may include digital-only elements, producing unique content for YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook.  Working with the digital team to create a unique digital plan for each story.
  • Shoot and edit stories
  • Maintain an active social media presence to build your brand. 
  • Produces and presents weather reports for all platforms when needed, including filling-in on newscasts.
  • Produce weather graphics and maps for all platforms
  • Report live during weather events
  • Be part of the news team ensemble where you will do non-weather things like trending topics, community events, interviews and traffic, as assigned.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Previous on-air experience presenting weather is preferred.

  • Excel in storytelling across multiple platforms
  • Retain strong writing and copy-editing skills
  • Ability to work well under pressure to meet deadlines

job.title: Senior Manager, Benefits & Wellbeing
job.description:
The People function at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Senior Manager, Benefits & Wellbeing to join our team.

The Senior Manager, Benefits & Wellbeing serves as a strategic lead responsible for helping shape and drive the Company's Health, Wellbeing and Retirement strategy, ensuring programs remain competitive, financially sustainable, operationally effective, and aligned with the Company's Total Rewards philosophy.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Total Rewards & People Operations, this role partners closely with Finance, HR Operations, Payroll, HRIS, Legal, Communications, brokers, consultants, and external vendors to continuously evolve our benefits portfolio while ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and an exceptional employee experience.

While this position maintains a strong understanding of benefits administration and provides strategic oversight of day-to-day operations, its primary focus is to lead and advance plan design, financial strategy, governance, market competitiveness, vendor management, and continuous improvement across the Company's benefits programs.

ABOUT YOU:

You are an experienced and strategic Benefits professional with strong expertise in health, wellbeing and retirement strategy, benefits financing, plan design, regulatory compliance, and governance. You are ready to operate as a senior lead, take ownership of key workstreams, and help shape the future direction of the Company’s benefits programs.

You understand the operational mechanics behind benefits administration and can effectively guide and influence operational teams to ensure seamless execution. While the Benefits Administration team within HR Operations manages the day-to-day execution of the Company's programs, you provide strategic guidance, governance, and continuous improvement leadership necessary to deliver a best-in-class employee experience.

You are equally comfortable partnering with Finance on long-term cost strategies, influencing brokers and consultants, evaluating emerging market trends, preparing executive recommendations, and driving innovative benefit solutions that balance employee value, financial sustainability, and business objectives.

You combine strong business acumen with analytical capabilities and are comfortable translating complex financial and regulatory concepts into actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategy & Plan Design

  • Develop and execute the Company's multi-year Health, Wellbeing and Retirement strategy, balancing employee experience, market competitiveness, financial sustainability, and operational excellence.
  • Help shape and drive the strategic direction of the Company's benefits programs, ensuring alignment with business priorities and the Total Rewards philosophy.
  • Develop and recommend innovative benefit programs and plan design enhancements that improve employee experience while maintaining long-term financial sustainability.
  • Monitor healthcare, wellbeing, retirement, and regulatory trends to proactively recommend enhancements that strengthen the Company's employee value proposition.
  • Evaluate the Company's benefits portfolio against market practices, benchmark studies, and industry trends to ensure competitive positioning.

Financial Stewardship

  • Partner closely with Finance, brokers, and external consultants to develop long-term healthcare cost strategies, financial forecasts, and funding recommendations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the financial and operational drivers of the Company's benefits programs, using data and market insights to recommend sustainable plan design and funding strategies.
  • Analyze claims experience, utilization trends, vendor performance, and plan costs to identify opportunities for optimization and cost containment.
  • Develop business cases, executive dashboards, and financial analyses supporting strategic recommendations, plan design decisions, and cost-management initiatives.

Vendor & Consultant Management

  • Serve as a senior strategic relationship lead for brokers, consultants, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, and wellbeing partners.
  • Influence and challenge external partners through market intelligence, financial analysis, and industry best practices to optimize plan performance and vendor outcomes.
  • Lead vendor performance reviews, contract negotiations, service-level agreements, and competitive RFP processes.

Benefits Operations & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide strategic oversight of benefits administration while partnering closely with the HR Operations Benefits Administration team responsible for day-to-day execution.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve benefits processes by leveraging technology, automation, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
  • Partner with HRIS to optimize Workday Benefits functionality, system integrations, automation, and self-service capabilities.
  • Establish governance, documentation, controls, and standardized operating procedures that support operational excellence.
  • Lead enterprise initiatives related to benefits programs, including Open Enrollment, vendor implementations, technology enhancements, wellbeing initiatives, and process improvements.

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure compliance with ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, IRS, DOL, ADA, USERRA, and all other applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Lead regulatory filings, Form 5500 reporting, Summary Annual Reports, government reporting requirements, and internal/external audits.
  • Oversee governance activities supporting the Company's Retirement Plan Investment Committee, including fiduciary documentation, committee materials, and coordination with external advisors.
  • Ensure timely payments to benefits vendors, government agencies, and third-party administrators while maintaining strong financial controls.

Employee Experience

  • Lead the overall strategy, planning, and execution of the Company's annual Open Enrollment process.
  • Partner with Communications and HR teams to develop comprehensive employee education and engagement strategies.
  • Continuously evaluate employee feedback and utilization data to improve the overall benefits experience.

Leadership

  • Serve as a senior leader within the Benefits Center of Excellence, helping drive strategy while providing direction and guidance to the Benefits Administration function within HR Operations.
  • Lead, coach, and mentor Benefits team members and project teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Payroll, HRIS, Legal, Communications, HR Operations, and business leaders.

YOU HAVE:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of seven (7) years of progressive Benefits experience, including significant responsibility for leading programs, projects, or strategic workstreams, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong expertise in U.S. health, wellbeing, and retirement programs, including plan design, financing, governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong understanding of benefits administration and operational processes, with the ability to strategically guide operational execution.
  • Experience developing long-term benefits strategies and evaluating plan design alternatives.
  • Experience partnering with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and healthcare cost management.
  • Experience managing brokers, consultants, insurance carriers, and third-party administrators.
  • Strong knowledge of ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, IRS, DOL, ADA, USERRA, and related regulations.
  • Experience with Workday Benefits, HRIS, payroll, and benefits administration systems.
  • Spanish and English fluency (written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders, exercise sound judgment, and lead cross-functional initiatives.

DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience supporting self-funded healthcare plans, stop-loss arrangements, and alternative funding strategies.
  • Experience leading large-scale Open Enrollment cycles and major vendor implementations.
  • Strong financial modeling, analytical, and data interpretation skills.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and present data-driven recommendations that influence senior leadership.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards and KPIs.
  • CEBS, CBP, or other professional Benefits certifications preferred.
  • Experience within a large, complex, multi-state organization preferred.

job.description:
The Ingest/Transmission Operator and Editor oversees all inbound and outbound media, content distribution, and news-gathering operations. Responsibilities include monitoring on-air product quality, ensuring compliance with government regulations, troubleshooting technical equipment, editing news content, and preparing programming for broadcast. This position is governed by the National IBEW Broadcast Agreement for CBS television stations.

 

Duties & Responsibilities


• Monitor and manage inbound and outbound media using various transmission methods, including fiber, Skype, and LiveU.
• Ensure timely response to breaking news events and oversee broadcast delivery.
• Collaborate with team members and network staff, providing operational support as needed.
• Identify, edit, and insert broadcast-quality video and audio into news bulletins on short notice.
• Handle broadcast media and feeds, manage video and audio switching, and operate recording equipment.
• Utilize servers and monitoring systems to manage media acquisition and delivery.
• Ingest media into servers and prepare files for editing and broadcast.
• Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues when necessary.
• Support live studio production requirements and provide excellent service to internal and external media operations clients.
• Monitor and control video encoding and decoding systems and troubleshoot incoming and outgoing transmission paths.
• Develop and implement backup plans for equipment or transmission failures.
• Edit news content using non-linear editing systems.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills & Qualifications


• Strong knowledge of server-based news environments, broadcast hardware, and software systems.
• Understanding of news operations, current events, and the importance of attention to detail.
• Proficiency in quality control (QC) tools and processes.
• Familiarity with digital video formats, ingest workflows, media servers, and broadcast production environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
• Understanding of broadcast production workflows and technical standards.
• Working knowledge of broadcast formats, server systems, and diagnostic tools.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced news environment.
• Strong organizational skills, reliability, and punctuality.
• Experience with Grass Valley Edius editing systems preferred.

 

Education & Experience


• Bachelor's degree in a technical field preferred.
• Minimum of 1–2 years of experience working in a fast-paced television news environment.
• Experience using non-linear editing systems required.
• Must be detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to work with minimal supervision.
• Must be a creative and adaptable team player capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
• Flexibility to work nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

NYC and Los Angeles are also possible locations in addition to Nashville


Overview:

Own the product direction for one of the largest sports apps in the country. The CBS Sports App is home to some of the biggest sporting events in the world: The Masters, NFL, March Madness, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full app experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you’re in the details.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for the CBS Sports App and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on.
  • Own the app's plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to continue, change, or stop.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1–2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.
  How We Build (The Builder Culture):
  • We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions.
  • AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll model it and push what's possible further.
  • The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission.
  What success looks like:
  • The app's product strategy is coherent. People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not to do.
  • Ideas are tested before they're committed. Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity. Fewer false starts, less rework.
  • PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer environment, ideally mobile-first and at scale. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold app-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view on how AI changes what a product team can do.
 


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage.

Engineering & People Leadership

AI Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • A sharp eye for picking out that one detail that makes a Post story a Post story that other outlets may miss

  • Strong news judgement and editing chops

About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As a Coordinator, Digital Marketing & Artist Development, you will play a key role in supporting the team to help our artists deliver music to their fans. Your role provides administrative and project support to the Artist Development Lead and helps with the day-to-day management of assigned artist projects. Position requires interaction with members of senior management and other high-level internal and external contacts.

What you'll do:

  • Support the Artist Development Lead with executing innovative digital marketing campaigns and completing detailed administrative objectives for an assigned artist roster
  • Provide overall marketing support to an assigned artist roster by attending & taking notes in artist meetings and maintaining artist marketing plans (one sheets, presentation decks, video reels, advertisements, etc.)
  • Grow and engage social network communities (e.g. Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube Community, etc.), track and analyze social media data and consumer marketing results
  • Execute assets needed for digital advertising campaigns to reach target audiences across the web and social media
  • Create, schedule, and send e-mail newsletters on behalf of assigned artist roster
  • Coordinate creative assets with internal and external teams and support the growth and engagement of fan communities through strategies for artist social media accounts, websites, promo landing pages, etc.
  • Collaborate with Lead on maintaining and balancing project budgets and working with the Marketing Admin on purchase order needs and invoice processing
  • Actively contribute to artist development strategy by cultivating ideas and supporting projects across marketing, media, and digital platforms, pitching and creating efficient solutions
  • Work closely with key internal label teams, artists, and management throughout the project life cycle to communicate about new products, technologies, strategies, social communities, and available digital opportunities
  • Collaborate with Production and Release Planning staff to set-up and schedule digital products
  • Coordinate, produce, and execute marketing events, artist shows, award shows, and conceptualize contests and sweeps (drafting of rules with the Legal department and working with Marketing Admin for set up & execution)

job.title: KSL Business Development Account Executive
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most. Our sports properties — spanning broadcast, digital, audio, and social — offer partners a powerful, integrated way to reach passionate fans at every level of competition.

Position Overview

KSL is looking to hire a passionate, ambitious Account Executive who is up for a challenge and have a strong commitment to excellence. As an Account Executive, your core goal will be to identify high potential business opportunities for Bonneville’s well-known brands: KSLPodcasts (including #1 rated “COLD”), KSLNewsRadio, 103.5 The Arrow, FM 100.3, and 97.5 The Zone, and numerous digital audio options. You will customize and build creative strategic plans that drive real results for our clients. We are interested in talking to candidates from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels.  The ideal candidate for this position is independent, self-motivated, and will confidently represent our brand.

Our fast-paced sales team has an infectious drive to exceed individual and team revenue goals. You will have access to superior analytics tools and will be able to utilize our digital offerings to enhance our clients’ marketing campaigns.

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is a hybrid role that requires the employee to sometimes work at our Salt Lake City site. Specific hybrid schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management.

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to: 

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly budgets in legacy and digital media brands
  • Maintain a system for tracking process in meeting established goals
  • Maintain positive and cooperative rapport with staff, management, and clients
  • Work collaboratively with internal partners to drive revenue.
  • Develop and maintain effective relationship with key decision-makers
  • Identify and solicit new business through prospecting and cold calling; build and maintains a full pipeline of sales prospects.
  • Service and grow relationships in existing client base.
  • Identify client/agency needs and develop persuasive proposals to meet needs and opportunities.
  • Deliver creative and effective sales presentations.
  • Follow all station procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts, and competitive analysis.
  • Remain current on industry trends in broadcast media and digital media, including display, mobile, OTT, and video

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For

  • Outside sales, media sales, business marketing or related field experience preferred but not necessary
  • Must have knowledge of working through the sales cycle (prospect, research, appointment-setting, CNA’s, presenting, overcoming objections, and closing business)
  • Ability to organize, analyze and interpret statistical data to draw conclusions from findings
  • Excellent oral, written, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • High level of proficiency with computers, software and new technologies
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with digital and social media platforms
  • A commitment to personal growth through continual training
  • Maintain a valid driver’s license and proven ability to safely drive personal vehicle without exposing company to serious liability risks

Physical Demands 

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively
  • Substantial physical movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers
  • Ability to extend hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction with good eye and hand coordination

Compensation

This is a 100% commissioned role, with an opportunity for an initial temporary commission guarantee.

What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

Employees at KSL can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including:  

  • Robust, affordable medical, dental and vision coverage with no wait period for enrollment
  • 401(k) with Company match, fully vested from day one
  • Paid leave for new parents under our Medical Maternity and Parental Leave policies
  • Opportunities to apply for tuition reimbursement
  • Paid time off for vacation and sick leave in addition to paid company holidays
  • Paid time off for volunteering
  • Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Minority/female/disability PWDNET/veteran are encouraged to apply.

iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Automotive Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Automotive Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations.

Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

job.title: Director, Stadium Network Architecture
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is seeking a highly skilled Director, Stadium Network Architecture to serve as the senior technical authority for the design, implementation, operation, and evolution of the Football Technology network infrastructure supporting NFL stadiums, clubs, corporate locations, and international events.

This role is ideal for a hands-on Senior Network Architect with deep expertise in networking, routing and switching, network design, troubleshooting, and large-scale infrastructure operations. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across complex network environments while remaining actively involved in architecture, implementation, escalation support, and operational excellence.

The Senior Network Architect will be responsible for developing network architecture diagrams, defining technical requirements, and serving as the technical lead for football technology network infrastructure. We are looking for a candidate who can drive the implementation and maintenance of complex and specialized network services, ensuring the highest levels of reliability, performance, and uptime.  

This hands-on senior stadium network architect will act as a leader of technical engineering for the Infrastructure Engineering Team across a wide range of areas including the production Football Technology Network, NFL temporary Fan Event Setups, sideline wireless technology and more.  

This onsite role can be based out of our Manhattan or Mount Laurel, NJ offices, and requires 30% to 50% travel domestically and internationally.  

Responsibilities

Scientific Rigor & Measurement

  • Design robust A/B, multivariate, and sequential testing frameworks.
  • Define primary metrics, guardrails, and success criteria aligned to long-term value, not just short-term conversion.
  • Improve offline-to-online validation practices in partnership with ML teams.
  • Standardize experimentation best practices across the Applied Intelligence group.
  • Champion causal reasoning and statistical discipline in decision-making.

Cross-Functional Management

  • Partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Design, Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering.

  • Communicate insights clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Create scalable documentation and experiment tracking processes.


Basic Qualifications

  • Proven track record designing and executing high-impact A/B tests in high-scale consumer digital products.
  • Deep fluency in experimentation methodology: statistical inference, power analysis, guardrails, sequential testing, causal reasoning.
  • Experience working closely with ML-driven systems (recommendation, ranking, personalization) in production environments.

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News is looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Senior Staff Broadcast Network Engineer to join the team in NY. As the Sr. Staff Broadcast Network Engineer, you will focus on Broadcast Media Technologies. Your responsibilities will be to design, implement, and administer highly resilient and scalable network(s) supporting media workflows for live broadcast systems for Fox News. 

As a Broadcast Network Infrastructure team member, you will work closely with other Broadcast teams to integrate solutions and services supporting real-time media/broadcast business requirements.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture/Engineering responsibilities
    • Gathering and assessing current network configuration, identifying risks, and proposing alternative solutions.
    • Design and implement new technologies that simplify the network environment while improving security and performance.
    • Work with the SDN team to design networking solutions capable of transporting live content(uncompressed) over dedicated high-bandwidth IP networks.
    • Manage projects and report progress to management and team members.
    • Collaborate with outside vendors to successfully test and integrate new technology.
  • Operational responsibilities:
    • Network capacity planning, performance assessment, and troubleshooting.
    • Collaborate with teams across the organization to troubleshoot service-impacting issues.
    • Track, report, and proactively deploy firmware/software updates on switching equipment when needed.
  • Create and maintain up-to-date documentation of the network environment detailing the configuration of deployed solutions.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A proven track record of designing and implementing large-scale mission-critical networks.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex problems while delivering innovative solutions.
  • Knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 – Professional Media Over Managed IP Networks standards.
  • 10+ years working with large-scale networks.
  • Expert knowledge and hands-on experience with network platforms such as Arista, Cisco, and PaloAlto. 
  • Expert network analysis fundamentals and robust troubleshooting skills.
  • Willingness and ability to teach and train others.

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

  • Media Technology and broadcast experience.
  • Experience with automation and scripting.
  • Cisco CCNP, or equivalent Arista certification.

As the Associate Manager, Digital Business  you will be managing accounts of digital service providers (music streaming platforms) and digital retail relationships in Hong Kong, and you will develop projects and initiatives that optimize revenue / opportunities for Sony Music’s artists under these accounts.

Essential to this role is a solid understanding of the digital retail landscape as well as a core understanding of the digital services. Equally important is a strong grasp of various different types of repertoires.

You will boast strong business relationships with current digital partners in Hong Kong and will play an integral role in developing partners, gathering, and synthesizing deal requirements to drive win-win outcomes in negotiations and partner development to grow digital revenue, streaming and market share for Hong Kong.

This role also supports physical product management and oversees sales channel coordination to maximize revenue and market presence.

 

What you will do:

DSP Account Management

•    Manage relationships with key DSPs in Hong Kong (e.g. Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, local/regional platforms).
•    Execute release strategies in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
•    Negotiate and secure promotional opportunities, playlist placement, and marketing support.
•    Monitor platform updates, trends, and algorithmic changes to optimize performance.

Strategy & Partnership Development

•    Define partnership strategies, build a robust new digital business pipeline, and execute go-to-market plans to achieve market share, revenue, and chart KPI’s in line with company priorities.

•    Source requirements, design deal parameters, plan the negotiation strategy and execute negotiations with key digital partners in Hong Kong, encompassing both new local partner deals and renewals.
•    Manager projects across various activities related to the partner and their platforms. This could include collaboration on content strategies, reporting integration, ongoing analysis of partner performance, problem solving, or driving marketing & promotional initiatives with large streaming accounts to maximize revenue. 

Streaming Performance & Analytics

•    Track, analyze, and report streaming performance across all platforms.
•    Identify growth opportunities and recommend data-driven strategies to improve engagement and revenue.
•    Work closely with marketing and A&R teams to optimize campaign execution.

Physical Product & Production Coordination

•    Support planning and execution of physical product releases (e.g., CDs, vinyl).
•    Coordinate with production vendors and internal teams to ensure timely delivery.
•    Updating the inventory levels and support forecasting.
•    Collaborate with retail partners, e-commerce platforms, and distributors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•    Work closely with Marketing, A&R, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.

•    Support regional/global initiatives as required.

Others

•    Weekly, Bi-weekly & Monthly reports/Updates/calls.
•    DSP performance, industry/competitor release update and marketing campaign idea sharing.
•    Regional office affairs and coordination, including HK digital market update and revenue/market share/subscribers update, as well as digital strategy plan/result summary.

 

Who you are:

•    University graduate in any disciplines but degrees of relevant subjects are preferred
•    Passionate with track records of success in business development and driving sales
•    A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant working experience, with passion in music & entertainment will also be considered
•    Experience working with digital industry or digital agencies will be advantageous
•    Strong familiarity with the business applications of digital music and social media platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, KKBox, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, etc.)
•    Strong analytical skills and data driven thinking
•    Strong understanding of technology trends, market best practice and digital marketing tools
•    Creative, bright, pragmatic and dedicated, with strong relationship management and consulting skills
•    A team player, happy working independently but also collaborating with colleagues in a matrixed organization.
•    Well-versed in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
