job.title: Associate Director, Global Priorities
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Your role:

The Global Priorities Associate Director at Warner Music Group plays a central role in developing and driving marketing strategy for the company’s highest-priority global artists. This position works cross-functionally to coordinate campaign planning and execution, ensuring alignment across label affiliates, commercial partners, and creative teams worldwide. The ideal candidate brings strategic marketing expertise, a global mindset, and a passion for helping artists break on the world stage.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the creation of comprehensive, multi-market marketing plans for WMG’s top global priority artists in collaboration with label teams and regional collaborators.

  • Partner with WMG affiliates around the world to localize campaign strategies, share resources, and ensure consistent execution of global priorities

  • Be responsible for global rollout timelines, deliverables, and go-to-market activities, ensuring campaigns launch on time and meet performance benchmarks.

  • Track key campaign and artist benchmarks globally, and work with analytics and marketing intelligence teams to identify insights and optimize efforts

  • Identify and apply emerging global marketing trends, platform innovations, and fan engagement strategies to enhance the visibility and growth of global artists

About you:

  • 5-7 years demonstrated ability in music marketing, global brand management, or international campaign strategy—preferably within a record label, artist management, or entertainment company

  • Proven ability to work across international markets and cultures, with a strong understanding of how to adapt strategy for local audiences while maintaining global cohesion

  • Exceptional organizational abilities with experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder campaigns on tight timelines

  • Strong interpersonal and written communication skills; comfortable working cross-functionally with senior executives, creatives, and regional teams

  • Deep passion for music and a strong grasp of global pop culture, digital trends, and fan behaviors across platforms and territories


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-09-28 11:59 PM

This role is a hybrid work arrangement. Work schedule to be discussed with the Hiring Manager according to the guidelines defined by the department.

The Director, Modernization and Change Enablement will drive the establishment and embedding of the People & Culture Change Leadership workstream.   This individual will design enterprise-wide change management strategies to foster collaborationminimize resistance, optimize workforce agility, and ensure a smooth transition toward achieving the organization’s modern talent and strategic goals.

Reporting into the Executive Director, Talent, Organizational Effectiveness and Change, this role acts as a critical bridge between human resources strategy and business operations.  The Director will partner closely with project teams, business leaders, and employees to embed sustainable capabilities and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Working across functions, the Director will design and implement key structures, such as the Enterprise Change Council, to align portfolio demands with employee capacity.  Operating as an enterprise subject-matter expert, this role provides the thought leadership, analytical frameworks, and strategic guidance that equip the organization to successfully deliver on its modernization and change enablement agenda.

Your work will directly support CBC/Radio-Canada’s strategic pillars of Proximity, Digital agility, and Bringing people together.

This position can be based in Ottawa, Toronto or Montreal.

Main Responsibilities and Impact:

1. Enterprise Change Governance & Council Leadership 

  • Establish Governance: Design, stand up, and govern the newly formed Enterprise Change Council to serve as the central governing body for cross-functional change alignment.

  • Define Operations: Formulate the Council’s charter, objectives, membership, and operational cadence, ensuring active, collaborative representation across all components and key stakeholders.

  • Manage the Portfolio: Lead Council sessions to aggregate, review, and evaluate the enterprise change portfolio, proactively identifying change collision risks, sequencing conflicts, and organizational saturation points.

  • Facilitate Decisions: Drive strategic decision-making and prioritization within the Council to balance modernization velocities with employee absorbency and operational stability.

2. Strategic Change Leadership & Transformation 

  • Develop Strategy: Formulate and execute a comprehensive change management and organizational transformation strategy aligned with the broader talent and engagement roadmap.

  • Assess Impact: Identify the deep cultural and operational impacts of major modernization initiatives across diverse functions, processes, and teams, creating highly tailored intervention plans.

  • Embed Best Practices: Standardize and embed enterprise-wide change management methodologies, uniting human resources, operations, and leadership across various functions and regions.

  • Measure Readiness: Co-design organizational change readiness and cultural pulse frameworks aligned with the enterprise Employee Listening strategy to gauge and build the capacity for continuous strategic evolution.

3. Talent and Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Build Partnerships: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key business leaders and partners to drive deep buy-in and commitment to workforce modernization efforts.

  • Coach Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor and executive coach to leadership teams, guiding them on their roles as active, visible sponsors of change.

  • Drive Communications: Develop and execute strategic communication plans that elevate employee voices, promote transparency, and maximize engagement throughout transformation lifecycles.

4. Organizational Capability & Learning Integration 

  • Design Capability Programs: Oversee the coordination and design of integrated training programs to equip employees with the new skills, competencies, and mindsets required to embrace modern working models.

  • Align Systems: Ensure complete alignment between modern talent programs, organizational development initiatives, and learning systems to facilitate high adoption rates.

  • Support Transitions: Provide ongoing, empathetic support and framework resources to teams and individuals navigating complex structural transitions.

5. Implementation, Analytics & Cultural Sustainability 

  • Integrate with HR: Collaborate across broader People & Culture teams to seamlessly integrate change management actions into existing workforce initiatives and program lifecycles.

  • Mitigate Fatigue: Monitor progress and address change fatigue or institutional resistance proactively through data-driven, analytical approaches.

  • Sustain Success: Promote deep alignment between organizational culture, workforce behavior, and long-term strategic objectives to ensure sustainable, long-term success.

  • Support Pillars: Lead ad hoc strategic initiatives as assigned to support and advance CBC/Radio-Canada’s core strategic pillars.

Qualifications, Experience & Skills: 

Education & Certifications

  • Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Organizational Development, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (required)

  • Advanced certification in Change Management (e.g. Prosci, ACMP, or equivalent)

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in change management, organizational development, talent management, or related fields

  • Proven success leading enterprise-wide modernization or human resources transformation initiatives within complex, cross-functional, and matrixed environments.

  • Direct, proven experience establishing, standing up, or operating an executive-level governance body or steering committee (such as a Change Council) 

  • Experience operating in public service, media, or similarly regulated/bilingual landscapes is preferred

Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep mastery of change management frameworks, portfolio governance, and workforce transformation methodologies.

  • Exceptional facilitation, communication, and emotional intelligence, with a natural ability to resolve conflicts and align matrixed stakeholders at the executive level.

  • Strong project management discipline, specifically regarding how to map portfolio-level change saturation and embed agile frameworks into massive organizational shifts.

  • An analytical and strategic mindset capable of turning workforce data and engagement metrics into actionable insights.

  • Experience with collaboration and project management tools, e.g. Google Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Slides, Sheets, Meet)

  • Bilingualism (English/French) is required.

  • Occasional travel may be required 

Leadership Competencies:

  • Strategic mindset: Attains strategic goals by systematically reflecting on priorities and objectives to be pursued along with consequences

  • Persuasive communication: Helps people shift toward a different perspective in a collaborative and positive manner

  • Accountability:  Recognizes, takes ownership, and engages in course correction of decisions and subsequent actions

  • Critical thinking: Engages in reflective thinking and challenges one’s personal assumptions in light of new arguments and verifiable information

  • Empathy: Acknowledges and appreciates others’ feelings, perspectives, and aspirations on the basis of their experiences

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

  • Work with management to enterprise and develop stories daily
  • Demonstrate compelling storytelling using dynamic live shots and stand-ups, creative graphics, and use of digital and social media platforms
  • Organize material, determine angle or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards
  • Gather and verify information regarding stories through interview, observation and research.
  • Build network of sources who supply information that allows the Company to stay ahead of its competitors
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communication/Journalism or related degree required (equivalent years of experience may substitute for education

  • Strong reporting skills
  • Understand importance of social media

  • Promotes teamwork and maintains attitude of cooperation with all station personnel

job.title: MultiMedia Journalist - Reporter
job.description:
The Multimedia Journalist Reporter produces, reports, shoots, writes, voices, edits and feeds news production content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.

  • Reports news stories for broadcast, describing the background and details of events
  • Arranges interviews with people who can provide information about stories
  • Reviews copy and corrects errors in content, grammar and punctuation, following prescribed editorial style and formatting guidelines
  • Reviews and evaluates notes taken about event aspects to isolate pertinent facts and details
  • Determines a story’s emphasis, length and format, and organizes material accordingly
  • Researches and analyzes background information related to news stories to be able to provide complete and accurate information
  • Gathers information about events through research, interviews, experience or attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social or other functions
  • Pitches stories to news managers and news producers which are relevant to the local community
  • Receives assignments and evaluates leads and tips to develop story ideas
  • Discusses issues with producers and/or news managers to establish priorities or positions
  • Checks reference materials such as books, news files or public records to obtain relevant facts
  • Revises work to meet editorial approval or to fit time requirements
  • Shoots and edits news events and news reports
  • Produces and presents reports for all platforms
  • Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality
  • Writes stories for the web and other eMedia platforms
  • Interacts with viewers/users on social media sites
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Minimum two years’ experience in news reporting (Depending on market size)
  • Superior on-air presence
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record
  • Flexibility to work any shift

job.title: Anchor, News
job.description:
News & Digital Livestream Anchor (Mobile, Alabama)

WKRG-TV News 5, the Nexstar CBS television affiliate in Mobile/Pensacola, seeks a social media savvy Journalist/Presenter to Co-Anchor AM Newscasts and to Produce & Present Digital Livestreams and Programs on our award-winning team in the Mobile, Alabama / Pensacola, Florida DMA.

The successful candidate will co-anchor weekday morning news broadcasts and produce & host livestreams on all platforms; broadcast, digital, OTT, and social.

When not anchoring or hosting, you will also serve as a Multimedia Journalist covering content for our media platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging, and meaningful to news consumers.

  • Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

    Anchoring ---

  • Present newscast stories on camera with accuracy in a professional, dynamic, warm, and engaging manner.
  • Book and conduct live interviews in studio and via remotes to bring informative and entertaining content and conversations to morning news viewers
  • Produce & Host livestreams (scheduled programs & breaking news) ensuring high-quality production, accuracy, and audience engagement
  • Work with content managers newsroom colleagues to identify and execute frequent livestream opportunities
  • Leverage online and social media presence to connect and converse with audience, generate story leads, and promote audience growth on all platforms
  • Serve as an ambassador to our coverage area by representing the station at community events and activities
  • Copy edit broadcast, digital, and social media stories to ensure accuracy, clarity, and strong storytelling
  • Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned
  • Report live online, on social media channels, and on-air

  • MMJ ---

  • Create original content for wkrg.com, social media and streaming platforms
  • Research/gather/analyze information, interviews, and video to produce accurate, complete, in-depth, relevant, and fair news reports for publication (digital & social media) and broadcast
  • Ensure that all content produced meets company standards for journalistic integrity, timeliness, and production quality
  • Author strong copy with correct grammar, punctuation, editorial style, and formatting to meet the requirements of each digital, social, and on-air distribution platform
  • Quickly solidify presence on all key beats and develop strong professional relationships with reliable sources
  • Daily, pitch & break exclusive, enterprise news stories online, on social media channels, and on-air
  • Report/shoot/edit video and audio content of varying lengths/formats to meet the requirements of each digital, social, and on-air distribution platform
  • Cooperate and communicate clearly, directly, and regularly with news teammates and other station departments
  • Share content across Nexstar’s digital network

  • Required & Preferred Capabilities:

  • Strong news judgment and high journalistic integrity
  • Candidates with Investigative Reporting experience preferred
  • Confident, authentic, charismatic on-camera presence
  • Be able to ad-lib in dynamic situations
  • Work well under pressure --- ability to handle breaking news and last-minute changes with aplomb
  • Low-to-zero call/approach reluctance --- ability to confidently engage with viewers, officials, those affected by stories, and others to cultivate story leads and information
  • Develop new livestream concepts and interactive programming.
  • Professional savvy and collegial demeanor when interacting with colleagues and members of the public
  • Strong, candid knowledge of self & capabilities and display the willingness and ability to take action to learn, improve, and grow
  • Fluency in English
  • 3+ years’ experience in a local newsroom preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, or a related or complimentary field of study; or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience preferred
  • Flexibility to work any shift

  • Technical Skills Sought:

  • Mastery of AP writing style to author digital, social, and on-air content
  • Confident and capable visual storyteller who is able to gather compelling video, strong natural sound, and solid interviews with field video gear to produce people-centered stories
  • Strong non-linear video editing skills required --- familiarity with Adobe Premiere video editing software preferred
  • Produce and edit vertical video for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels and other platforms.
  • Optimize YouTube content through strong packaging, including headlines, thumbnails, descriptions and metadata.
  • Analyze audience trends and performance data to improve reach and engagement.
  • Experience with OBS & vMix streaming tools and AKTA platform preferred.
  • Familiarity and confidence with ENPS rundown and story management system preferred
  • Familiarity and confidence with Wordpress digital content publishing system preferred
  • Valid driver’s license required for hire.  A clean driving record is required and must be maintained to be able to safely & confidently operate company motor vehicles

  • Physical Demands & Work Environment:

    The Anchor / MMJ must be able to stand, sit, reach, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, and work outdoors with various weather conditions and indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.

job.title: Content Stylist
job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and amazing careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

The Content Stylist supports QVC and HSN, and you will be reporting to the Stylist Supervisor. You will be is responsible for the preparation and styling of all soft- and hard-good products during multi-channel platform productions. You will collaborate with a team of creative photographers, videographers and Art Directors, and you ensure that they execute QVC brand stylistically and appropriately during still photography and video shoots.

Where You'll Work

This role is onsite and will require you to work from our West Chester, PA headquarters daily. Relocation assistance is not available for this role. This is a full-time role. We release the schedule one to two weeks in advance. You will primarily work from Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm.

What You'll Do

Responsible for styling soft- and hard-goods for multi-channel platforms. This includes:

  • Acquisition and prepping of all products.
  • Create proper look, feel and environment to make sure products are represented based on style direction and style guides.
  • Using Branding information from several sources including category and creative to ensure styling is brand-right.
  • Gather and coordinate props to enhance and romance product.
  • Design and realize tabletop and set builds.
  • Research and coordinate model outfits and accessories, ensuring proper fit and product accuracy.
  • Partner with Product Central to ensure product is available for production; restore Model Area, return products, care for model prop closet clothes, etc.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor of Arts/Science in a related field or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience with apparel and prop styling for print, web, and retail and/or TV production/photo shoots.
  • In-depth knowledge of current style and fashion trends; understanding of fashion styling elements based on brand, silhouette, etc.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of on-figure styling and layflats.
  • Ability to coordinate outfits and accessories, and interpret style guides and creative decks to style to the QVC brand

job.title: Weekend Meteorologist, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN 9, we help Southern Arizona stay informed, prepared, and connected every day. As our Weekend Meteorologist, you'll deliver accurate, compelling forecasts that matter to viewers across Tucson and the surrounding communities. From monsoon storms and extreme heat to clear desert skies, you'll help audiences understand how weather impacts their daily lives. You'll be a trusted on-air presence while contributing weather and news content across multiple platforms. This is an opportunity to combine forecasting expertise, storytelling, and community engagement in one of the country's most unique weather markets.WHAT YOU'LL DO:
  • Prepare and deliver engaging weekend weathercasts using the latest meteorological data, radar systems, and graphics technology.
  • Analyze weather information from satellites, radar, models, and other forecasting tools to create accurate forecasts.
  • Provide urgent weather updates and breaking severe weather coverage when conditions warrant.
  • Produce and distribute weather content across television, digital, social, streaming, and other media platforms.
  • Develop weather-related story ideas and enterprise content that informs and serves the community.
  • Report live from community events, weather-related locations, or field assignments as needed.
  • Drive station vehicles to remote broadcast locations and live reporting assignments throughout the viewing area.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership and technical teams to evaluate emerging weather technologies and presentation tools.
  • Research, gather, and verify information through observation, interviews, and reliable sources.
  • Support newsroom operations and perform additional duties that contribute to overall station success.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:
  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology or a related field preferred.
  • Three or more years of forecasting and on-air meteorology experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company requirements required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
  • Strong understanding of meteorological forecasting tools, weather systems, and broadcast presentation techniques.
  • Proficiency with weather graphics systems, newsroom technology, and digital publishing platforms.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and field production workflows.
  • Experience with video editing systems and multimedia storytelling.
  • Excellent broadcast writing and AP style writing skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex weather information clearly and confidently across multiple platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across departments to serve viewers and communities.
  • Ability to travel locally for live shots, community events, and field reporting assignments.

OUR TEAM:KGUN 9 is a passionate and community-focused newsroom dedicated to serving Southern Arizona. Our team includes experienced journalists, storytellers, meteorologists, and digital innovators who value collaboration, creativity, and public service. We support one another, celebrate diverse perspectives, and work together to deliver trusted local content that makes a difference in the communities we serve.WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:Tucson offers an exceptional quality of life with over 300 days of sunshine each year, stunning mountain views, and a vibrant cultural scene. Outdoor enthusiasts can explore Saguaro National Park, world-class hiking and cycling trails, and nearby destinations throughout the Sonoran Desert.The city blends rich Southwestern heritage with modern amenities, outstanding food, arts, and entertainment. Whether you're enjoying a local festival, exploring historic neighborhoods, or taking in spectacular desert sunsets, Tucson provides an inspiring backdrop for both your career and your lifestyle.#LI-SM2

USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. Account Executive – Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Erie, PA area | Hybrid (home office with client/prospect visits as needed)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Are you looking to launch or grow your career in sales and marketing? Our Account Executive role is an excellent opportunity for motivated early-career professionals who are eager to learn consultative selling, develop business relationships, and make a direct impact on local businesses.

In this role, you'll identify new business opportunities, engage with prospective clients, and recommend marketing solutions that help businesses grow. You'll partner with local businesses to understand their goals, present tailored marketing recommendations, and support their growth through a combination of digital and traditional advertising solutions. You'll also collaborate closely with our post-sale support teams, who manage campaign performance, reporting, and optimization.

During your first 90 days, you'll participate in structured onboarding, learn LocaliQ's products and sales process, and begin building your prospecting and client engagement skills. Our goal is to provide the coaching and resources needed to help you ramp successfully and build a long-term career in sales.

Why This Role Stands Out

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission potential

• Comprehensive training and structured onboarding program

• Hands-on experience in consultative sales and digital marketing

• Mentorship and ongoing coaching from experienced sales leaders

• Clear career path into senior sales and leadership opportunities

• President's Club, contests, and recognition programs

• Hybrid flexibility and autonomy in managing your territory

• Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and technology

• Strong support from marketing specialists, strategists, and post-sales teams

What You Will Do

• Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

• Build relationships with prospective clients and identify business growth opportunities.

• Conduct discovery conversations to understand client needs and business goals.

• Partner with experienced team members to develop and present marketing recommendations.

• Maintain accurate CRM records and develop strong pipeline management habits.

• Collaborate with internal teams to support positive client experiences.

• Participate in ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development.

• Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

• Motivated self-starter with a desire to learn and grow in a sales career.

• Comfortable speaking with new people and building professional relationships.

• Organized with strong time-management skills and attention to detail.

• Experience using Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM systems

• Interest in digital marketing, advertising, or business growth solutions.

• Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

Who Thrives Here

Successful Account Executives are curious, coachable, resilient, and motivated to learn. They enjoy connecting with people, are comfortable stepping outside their comfort zone, and view challenges as opportunities for growth. Whether you're coming from sales, customer service, hospitality, athletics, recruiting, or are an upcoming graduate, this role offers the training and support needed to build a rewarding career in consultative sales.

This version should resonate strongly with new graduates, recent graduates, athletes, retail/customer-service talent, recruiting backgrounds, and early-career professionals while still supporting LocaliQ's consultative sales model.

job.title: Deputy Editor, Breaking News and Live
job.description:
Deputy Editor, Breaking News and Live


The San Francisco Chronicle seeks an editor to help expand the way we cover news in real time and oversee our live news operation.


This editor will have two central responsibilities: monitoring, assigning and editing daily breaking news; and helping the Chronicle uplevel and expand our “live” coverage. The role is ideal for an editor with strong news judgment and an appetite for audience strategy and emerging forms of digital storytelling.


They will help determine what matters right now, how quickly we need to respond and the best way to serve readers as a story develops. They will also help build a stronger, more consistent live-journalism operation under the direction of senior leadership. This could include launching and editing live blogs, coming up with new ways to publish rolling updates on developing news stories, real-time explainers, event coverage, alerts and other emerging formats that help readers understand what is happening.


In particular, this editor must be interested in using artificial intelligence tools and automated systems to help drive breaking news discovery and content delivery to readers. This position reports to the Breaking News Editor and will work especially closely with the audience team on live coverage.


Responsibilities

 

  • Monitor for, assign and edit stories on breaking news and emerging developments.

  • Launch and edit live blogs and other rolling coverage.

  • Help develop an evolving editorial approach to live journalism.

  • Increase the volume and range of the Chronicle’s live journalism by identifying opportunities across major coverage arenas: breaking news, elections, severe weather, major public events, sports and other high-interest moments.

  • Use audience data to evaluate live coverage and improve its format, cadence, reach and usefulness.

  • Help test live storytelling formats, tools and workflows across web, app, alerts, newsletters and social platforms.

  • Participate in an editing rotation that may include nights, weekends and holidays.

     

Qualifications

 

  • At least two years’ experience at a daily newspaper, magazine or web publication or the equivalent as a reporter and/or editor

  • Strong news judgment and instinct for what matters to Bay Area readers.

  • Experience with live blogs, rolling coverage, real-time updates or another form of continuous digital journalism.

  • Excellent editing, headline-writing and digital-production skills.

  • An understanding of how to use real-time data and audience signals to inform editorial decisions.

     

This is a full-time position based in San Francisco. The role requires flexibility to work nights, weekends and holidays as part of a rotating breaking-news and live-coverage schedule.

 

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in California. The reasonable estimate is between $80,000 and $100,000. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

 

About SF Chronicle:

The San Francisco Chronicle (www.sfchronicle.com) is the largest newspaper in Northern California and the second largest on the West Coast. job.title: Director, Individual Giving
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking a strategic and mission-driven Director of Individual Giving to join our dynamic development team. Reporting to the Senior Director of Major Gifts, you will play a pivotal role in cultivating high-level philanthropic partnerships by managing a portfolio of major donor prospects capable of 6- and 7-figure gifts. In this role, you will execute a comprehensive moves management strategy—from initial qualification to long-term stewardship—while collaborating across the organization to drive revenue goals and champion a culture of philanthropy that supports NPR’s commitment to public media.

Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Management & Donor Strategy: Manage and grow a portfolio of 100–150 major gift prospects, including members of the NPR Foundation Board of Trustees. Secure high 6- to 7-figure gifts by developing and executing comprehensive, annual solicitation plans for each prospect, ensuring cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship. Aim to generate $5M+ in new revenue each fiscal year.
  • Moves Management: Qualify, cultivate, solicit, and steward donors through the appropriate prospect cycle. Use moves management tools and fundraising best practices to track activity, pipeline health, and progress toward annual revenue goals.
  • Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with local Member stations on collaborative donor prospects and work with the Planned Giving team to facilitate blended gift opportunities. Communicate frequently with the Senior Director of Major Gifts, sharing activity, progress, and strategy updates.
  • Donor Materials & Reporting: Independently create engaging donor proposals, impact reports, and briefing materials. Partner with the Donor Operations, Donor Communications, and Donor Relations teams to utilize established templates and resources to ensure high-quality stewardship and engagement materials.
  • Database Management: Maintain and update donor information promptly in the donor database (Salesforce) to ensure real-time accuracy and data integrity.
  • Professional Standards: Exemplify fundraising best practices and the highest level of ethics in all activities, ensuring that all donor interactions align with NPR’s mission and values.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration: Partner across NPR’s development organization to contribute to a strong culture of philanthropy, participating in projects and initiatives as needed to support overall department goals.
  • Discovery and Prospect Identification: Conduct 20-40 discovery qualifications annually to identify new potential donors and expand the portfolio.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

Professional Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of frontline fundraising experience at a large, complex organization
  • Proven track record of successfully cultivating and closing six-figure (and higher) gifts and pledges.

Communication & Interpersonal

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling proposals and conduct meaningful donor meetings.
  • Advanced interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work professionally with diverse constituents, including senior leadership, board members, Member stations, and external partners.
  • Strong relationship-building skills focused on cultivating long-term partnerships with high-net-worth donors.

Strategic & Operational

  • Ability to develop and implement innovative fundraising strategies and moves management that align donor interests with organizational goals.
  • Commitment to ethical, data-driven decision-making to track progress and assess the success of fundraising initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, set priorities, and meet concurrent deadlines in a fast-paced environment while maintaining composure.
  • A self-starter capable of remaining motivated in a remote setting with comfort in travel and conducting face-to-face or virtual meetings.

DEI & Workplace Culture

  • Demonstrated commitment to cultivating and promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion within the workplace.
  • Ability to support and contribute to an inclusive and equitable workplace culture through collaboration with diverse stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An understanding of complex fundraising organizations or federated nonprofit models 
  • An understanding of media/public broadcasting organizations and the relationship between NPR and its Member Stations

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $132,000-$137,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Creative Operations Lead
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Creative Operations Lead to join Translation!

What You'll Do

The Creative Operations Lead is a critical operational leader at Translation, responsible for ensuring the right people are on the right work at the right time across every active account and initiative. This role sits at the center of the agency's capacity ecosystem, partnering closely with the Program Management team to keep delivery on track, talent balanced, and the business protected.

As Translation scales its resource planning capabilities — including the rollout of a new, intuitive staffing and capacity platform, this lead will serve as both the operational owner of that tool and the strategic steward of how people are planned, protected, and prioritized across billable and non-billable work.

Resource Planning & Allocation

  • Own and manage staffing allocations across all active client accounts, ensuring people are planned accurately and updated in real time.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing adoption of Translation's new resource management platform, serving as the primary administrator and internal champion.
  • Surface capacity conflicts, volume pressure points, and over-allocation risks proactively — before they become delivery problems.
  • Partner daily with the PM team to align headcount plans with project timelines, scope changes, and shifting client demands.
  • Develop and maintain clear visibility into who is available, who is over-committed, and where gaps exist across all functions.
  • Track talent skills and passions.

Workload Balancing & Prioritization

  • Balance competing demands across billable client work, proactive creative opportunities, new business pitches, and internal initiatives.
  • Make and communicate clear recommendations on when and how to pull staff from non-billable work in service of billable priorities.
  • Establish and enforce workload thresholds that protect talent from burnout while maintaining agency output and quality.
  • Build frameworks for how to triage competing requests, ensuring leadership has the right information to make fast, informed staffing calls.

Freelancer Management

  • Proactively source and pipeline freelance talent in advance of high-volume periods, ensuring the agency is never caught flat-footed when capacity spikes.
  • Manage first holds on preferred freelancers across disciplines, maintaining relationships so Translation has priority access when demand peaks.
  • Negotiate freelance rates with an eye toward engagement length securing better terms for longer commitments while staying within agency margin thresholds.
  • Vet new freelancers in partnership with relevant discipline leads and key creative, strategy, and production leaders before adding them to the approved roster.
  • Own and maintain a current, organized freelancer database including rates, availability windows, past project history, and performance notes  so the agency can move quickly when a need arises.

Awards & Case Study Management

  • Own the end-to-end process for awards submissions tracking eligible work, managing timelines, coordinating materials, and submitting entries across relevant shows.
  • Build and maintain a living library of agency case studies, ensuring work is documented accurately and kept current across accounts.
  • Partner with Business Development, Business Leadership, Strategy, and Creative to capture the story behind Translation's best work in a format ready for new business, press, and agency promotion.
  • Develop a calendar and workflow for proactive awards planning to avoid last-minute scrambles.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the PM team, creating tight alignment between resource plans and delivery commitments.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Business Leadership and Client Engagement teams on capacity and staffing strategy, translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with People Operations on headcount planning, open role identification, and freelance needs driven by capacity gaps.
  • Represent resource management in agency planning conversations, including scoping, new business, and organizational design discussions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-account staffing in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly.
  • Strong command of resource management tools and platforms; experience leading a tool rollout or system migration is a plus.
  • Experience managing or willing to learn managing awards submissions and/or case study development, with a clear understanding of how agency recognition supports business development.
  • A systems thinker who is equally comfortable in the weeds of a staffing grid and in a strategic conversation about organizational design.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can translate operational complexity into simple, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  • A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly and maintains it under pressure.
  • High integrity around people data: this role has visibility into utilization and performance-adjacent information and must handle it with discretion.                                                                             

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in resource management, project management, creative operations, or a related function within a creative agency or marketing organization.
  • Deep understanding of how creative agencies work, the rhythms of production, the difference between billable and non-billable time, and how to protect both.
  • Freelance recruiting experience and negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing and enhancing a product or platform.
  • A strong network of freelance talent relationships.

About UnitedMasters, Inc. 

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $140,000 - $165,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases that may include bonus, stock options, 401k match).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  

We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Security Officer - Overnight
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

Has God called and equipped you to serve in Ministry where the Good News of Jesus is shared with millions? If you’re someone who stays calm under pressure and takes action when it matters most, this role is for you. As a Security Officer, you’ll lead from the front—protecting team members, securing high-profile visitors, and handling everything from patrols to active threat response. This isn’t just security—it’s critical, hands-on protection work every day.

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

**This is an overnight shift position, providing coverage on Monday- Thursday from 10:00pm - 8am.**

 

**This role requires candidates to have an armed security license within the state of Tennessee.**

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Conduct routine interior and exterior patrols of facilities, parking areas, and event spaces to ensure safety and security.
  • Provide visible armed deterrence through professional open-carry presence.
  • Support special events, including traffic/parking control and venue security operations.
  • Control and monitor all ingress and egress points; verify employees, visitors, contractors, and deliveries using manual and electronic systems.
  • Issue and manage visitor, contractor, and Team Member badges; maintain accurate badge, access, and visitor logs; partner with HR on badge lifecycle management.
  • Monitor and operate access control, video surveillance, and alarm systems; maintain system awareness and functionality.
  • Conduct escorts for employees, executives, VIPs, and sensitive assets as required.
  • Provide reception and visitor support, including check-in processes and contractor oversight.
  • Prepare detailed incident reports and recurring system summaries, including camera activity, badge accountability, and visitor records.
  • Immediately report and fully document any use of force, firearm discharge, or weapon deployment in accordance with ministry policy and Tennessee law.
  • Monitor publicly available information and approved reporting channels for potential threats to personnel, facilities, or events, and escalate concerns in accordance with policy.
  • Investigate suspicious activity, incidents, and safety violations; document findings thoroughly.
  • Inspect mail and packages for high-profile individuals.
  • Enforce compliance with Ministry policies and safety standards, including physical-security controls over restricted and compliance-sensitive areas such as PCI cardholder-data environments.
  • Respond to facility issues and safety needs (e.g., equipment checks, elevator malfunctions, lockdowns).
  • Conduct routine workplace inspections to identify unsafe conditions and behaviors.
  • Observe work activities and report potential hazards to the Sr. Manager of Safety & Security.
  • Maintain inventories of safety equipment and supplies.
  • Communicate safety expectations and reinforce safe work practices.
  • Manage incoming security communications and escalate concerns as needed.
  • Maintain proficiency in firearms, less-lethal tools, and defensive tactics, exercising sound judgment and restraint.
  • Complete and pass firearms qualification at least annually, and any additional re-qualification required by ministry policy or Tennessee law.
  • Conduct routine and advanced threat assessments; identify vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Respond decisively to active threats, workplace violence, medical emergencies, and safety incidents.
  • Execute Threat Response Protocols, including lockdowns, evacuations, and coordinated law enforcement response.
  • Coordinate and maintain professional relationships with law enforcement and external agencies.
  • Participate in and support the emergency response team; lead and assist with emergency drills (fire, evacuation, active shooter, bomb threat).
  • Provide executive protection services for leadership, artists, and VIPs on-site and during travel/events, including advance security assessments of venues, routes, and accommodations.
  • Ensure secure movement and discreet protection of executives and guests while minimizing disruption.
  • Mentor and support new officers through training and guidance.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of security procedures, operations, and team effectiveness.
  • Support special projects and operational initiatives as assigned.
  • Work flexible hours, including overtime or off-hours, as operational needs require.
  • Travel occasionally, including overnight travel, in support of executive protection assignments and ministry events.
  •  

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • High school diploma or equivalent. An associate degree in Criminal Justice, Security, or related field preferred.
  • License/Certification
    • Tennessee Armed Guard license required.
    • Must meet the standards for armed security officers employed by a Proprietary Security Organization (PSO) in Tennessee.
    • First Aid and CPR certifications required.
    • Less-than-lethal certification required.
    • Certifications to Obtain Within Six Months of Employment
    • Active Shooter Response Training.
    • De-escalation training certification.

  • Required Qualifications

    • Strong working knowledge of emergency response, workplace violence prevention, and protective operations.
    • Must have excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively deal with difficult situations that could involve either guests or K-LOVE employees.
    • Ability to work independently.
    • Ability to be versatile and flexible. Regularly adapts to change while maintaining a positive attitude.
    • Demonstrated ability to represent ministry professionally and maintain confidentiality.
    • Must have the demonstrated ability to take initiative to solve problems and implement solutions.
    • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
    • May be subject to random and/or for-cause drug and alcohol screening, and must remain fit for duty at all times while carrying a firearm.

  • Preferred Qualifications

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in armed security, law enforcement, military, safety, or executive protection.
    • Investigative skills.
    • Knowledge of access control and surveillance systems, visitor management systems, Microsoft Office applications, as well as project management experience.
  • Employment Requirements
    • Must pass a pre-employment reference and background scree
    • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States required upon hire.
    • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. Job Summary:

Hope Media Group is seeking an AI-enabled Data Program & Impact Manager to help our Data Science & Analytics team translate its work into meaningful organizational and ministry outcomes. 

This role will manage a diverse portfolio of internal data initiatives, stakeholder projects, analytical deliverables, recurring responsibilities, and proactively discovered insights. The successful candidate will create clarity across the team’s priorities, reduce coordination burden on technical staff, strengthen stakeholder accountability, and ensure valuable insights lead to documented decisions and action. 

The role extends beyond traditional project delivery. It will help manage the full lifecycle of data work: 

  • Request 
  • Prioritization 
  • Execution 
  • Delivery 
  • Adoption 
  • Action 
  • Measurable contribution 

AI-enabled working is a core expectation. The successful candidate will use approved generative AI, automation, and project-management tools to rapidly understand the team’s work, structure ambiguous information, improve communication, automate routine coordination, identify risks, and increase personal and team productivity.

 

Essential Functions:

Portfolio and Project Management

  • Maintain a unified portfolio of active, planned, recurring, and exploratory data-team work. 
  • Establish clear objectives, owners, priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. 
  • Partner with data-team leadership to prioritize work based on ministry value, organizational need, urgency, effort, risk, and available capacity. 
  • Develop consistent processes for project intake, scoping, prioritization, status reporting, and follow-through. 
  • Identify stalled decisions, conflicting priorities, unclear ownership, and scope changes before they materially affect delivery. 
  • Facilitate useful planning sessions, project reviews, stakeholder updates, and retrospectives without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy. 


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Translate stakeholder needs into clear problem statements, requirements, decisions, and measurable objectives. 
  • Translate technical findings, limitations, and recommendations into understandable operational and executive language. 
  • Identify the appropriate sponsor, decision-maker, operational owner, and beneficiary for significant initiatives. 
  • Manage stakeholder expectations, commitments, dependencies, and follow-up. 
  • Ensure stakeholders understand what was delivered, what the evidence supports, what remains uncertain, and what action is recommended. 


Insight Activation and Impact Tracking

  • Maintain a system for tracking significant insights from discovery through stakeholder decision, action, and outcome. 
  • Ensure material recommendations are assigned to a named stakeholder or decision owner. 
  • Obtain and document an explicit disposition for important recommendations, such as accepted, deferred, modified, or declined. 
  • Follow up on accepted recommendations to determine whether action was taken and what resulted. 
  • Help define expected benefits, baseline measures, targets, outcome indicators, and measurement plans for qualifying projects. 
  • Track evidence of the data team’s financial, operational, audience, donor, and ministry contributions. 
  • Partner with data scientists and analysts to distinguish direct attribution from broader evidence-supported contribution. 
  • Develop concise portfolio reporting and case studies demonstrating how data-team work supports Hope Media Group’s mission. 


AI-Enabled Operations

  • Use approved AI and automation tools as a normal part of daily work. 
  • Turn meetings, transcripts, emails, and documentation into reviewed summaries, decisions, tasks, risks, and follow-up actions. 
  • Use AI to draft project briefs, requirements, agendas, status updates, stakeholder communications, and executive summaries. 
  • Develop reusable prompts, templates, agents, and automated workflows that reduce repetitive administrative work. 
  • Use AI to identify missing requirements, unresolved questions, contradictory assumptions, project risks, and potential scope drift. 
  • Review and verify AI-generated work and protect confidential information in accordance with organizational standards. 
  • Identify and measure additional opportunities for AI to improve the team’s speed, quality, and effectiveness.

  • Preserve institutional knowledge that might otherwise remain in meetings, individual employees, or disconnected documents.

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. 


Hope Media Group the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Vida Unida and NGEN radio.


We invite you to apply for our Network Music Director position in New Caney, TX (Greater Houston, TX area) and be a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! 


Job Summary:

We’re building something new at Hope Media Group. As we grow across platforms and brands - including the legacy of KSBJ and the national reach of WayFM, we’re not just maintaining music programming… we’re reimagining it.

We’re looking for a future-focused Network Music Director who doesn’t just love music, but understands its power to shape lives, build tribes, and drive listener loyalty across broadcast and digital. You’ll need to think beyond linear clocks and typical radio rules. The future of music curation blends art, science, and technology - and you’ll help lead us there!

This isn’t a one-size-fits-all playlist. You’ll protect and evolve the unique sound and spiritual heartbeat of each brand - from the Houston-rooted KSBJ to the nationwide WayFM audience. We believe in the distinct identities of our brands, and music strategy plays a central role in maintaining and celebrating those differences. Every song matters, every rotation has a reason, and every listener deserves a soundtrack that feels made just for them.

If you’re energized by the idea of innovating in a space where playlisting meets purpose… where we use data, instinct, and faith to build formats that move people… and where streams and stations live side-by-side in harmony - this might be your moment.

Music Direction:

  • Board Operators for remotes

  • Participate in ministry wide Christian Bible studies
  • Attend weekly Hope Huddles & Prayer Huddles for prayer and devotions
  • Any other work as assigned

  • Others duties assigned


Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent required; bachelor's degree preferred

Experience:

  • 5–7 years of professional radio experience, with at least 3 years in Programming (PD, MD, and/or APD) and on-air.
  • Hands-on knowledge of music scheduling and automation systems (G-Selector, Zetta), plus experience with Adobe Audition, Windows OS, and Microsoft Office.
  • Familiarity with music research and audience testing (music surveys, AMTs) and on-air fundraising/support drives is a strong plus.

  • Deep insight into the distinct audiences of KSBJ and WayFM - and how music selection should reflect and serve each one differently.

job.title: Multiplatform News Producer
job.description:
Key duties include, but are not limited to:

 

Digital Content Creation & Publishing

  • Write, edit, publish, and update content across WNYT's website, app, streaming, and social platforms.
  • Produce and optimize digital content using video, photos, graphics, and other multimedia assets.

Social Media & Audience Engagement

Newsroom Collaboration & Editorial Support

  • Work closely with reporters, anchors, photographers, assignment editors, managers, and production staff to develop and execute coverage plans.
  • Participate in editorial meetings, contribute story ideas, and support enterprise and digital-first coverage.
  • Monitor news sources, conduct research, gather background information, and assist with story development and follow-up coverage.

Television News Producing

  • Produce assigned newscasts, including building rundowns, selecting stories, managing timing, and making editorial decisions under deadline.
  • Write and edit broadcast content, including anchor copy, teases, breaking news updates, and other newscast elements.
  • Coordinate video, graphics, live shots, and newsroom teams to ensure accurate and compelling coverage.
  • Review content for accuracy, clarity, fairness, and adherence to station standards.
  • Support special projects, extended coverage, and other newscasts as assigned.

Technical & Platform Management

  • Use newsroom, production, and content management systems to create and publish content across platforms.
  • Utilize analytics and digital tools to support editorial decision-making and audience growth.
  • Maintain organized newsroom materials and perform other duties as assigned.

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in television news production, digital news production, or a newsroom setting preferred.
  • Strong writing, editing, grammar, and AP style skills.
  • Sound editorial judgment and the ability to make quick, accurate decisions during breaking news.
  • Ability to produce a television newscast, build rundowns, write scripts, manage timing, coordinate visual elements, and adjust to breaking news.
  • Experience with digital publishing tools, social media platforms, basic video editing, and graphics tools such as Adobe Creative Suite or Canva.
  • Familiarity with SEO, social media analytics, audience engagement practices, and digital performance metrics.
  • Understanding of television producing, including rundowns, script writing, timing, video, graphics, live shots, control room communication, and live news coverage.
  • Ability to write for different platforms, including broadcast, web, mobile, streaming, and social media.
  • Ability to work collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Initiative and creativity in developing fresh, community-focused content.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well with anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, directors, producers, assignment editors, and managers.
  • Ability to work weekdays, weekends and holidays, early morning, midday and evening shifts.
  • Must have reliable form of transportation and valid driver's license.  Driving record will be checked.
Physical Requirements

Average sitting, standing and office-type movements. Light lifting, moving and pulling abilities. Ability to communicate in English both verbally and in writing. Ability to hear and see clearly.
