job.title: Associate Corporate Counsel
job.description:
Title: Associate Corporate Counsel - Construction and Commercial Contracts

Reports to: General Counsel, Meruelo Enterprises

About the Role:

The Associate Corporate Counsel - Construction and Commercial Contracts is a parent-company legal role responsible for supporting contract review, negotiation, risk management, and contract governance across Meruelo Enterprises and its subsidiaries. The position partners with subsidiary contract coordinators, business leaders, project teams, and corporate functions to promote consistent contracting practices, identify and mitigate risk, and support timely business decisions. The role provides legal guidance and functional oversight while each subsidiary contract coordinator remains responsible for local contract intake, administration, tracking, and execution support.

Key Responsibilities:

² Serve as the centralized legal resource for contracts submitted by Meruelo Enterprises subsidiaries and corporate departments.

² Review, draft, analyze, and negotiate construction contracts, subcontracts, master service agreements, professional services agreements, vendor and supplier agreements, purchase orders, nondisclosure agreements, leases, and other commercial agreements.

² Identify and communicate legal, operational, financial, insurance, and compliance risks in clear, practical business terms.

² Review and provide guidance on various union labor agreements.

² Reference utilizing Document Crunch.

² Prepare contract redlines and alternative language addressing indemnification, defense obligations, limitations of liability, consequential damages, insurance, bonding, payment, change orders, warranties, delays, liquidated damages, termination, dispute resolution, and other risk-allocation provisions.

² Advise executive leadership and subsidiary stakeholders regarding contractual obligations, exceptions, and recommended risk-mitigation strategies.

² Provide legal guidance and functional oversight to contract coordinators located within each subsidiary, including review of escalated issues and nonstandard terms.

² Establish consistent enterprise contract intake, legal review, approval, execution, retention, and escalation practices in partnership with subsidiary contract coordinators and business leaders.

² Develop and maintain approved templates, clause libraries, contract playbooks, review checklists, approval matrices, and negotiation guidelines.

² Support project teams during contract performance, including interpretation of notice requirements, change-order provisions, payment rights, claims procedures, and closeout obligations.

² Assist with construction and commercial disputes involving change orders, delays, payment, defaults, mechanics liens, stop notices, bond claims, collections, and other contract matters.

² Coordinate with outside counsel on specialized legal issues, disputes, litigation, arbitration, mediation, and other matters as directed by the General Counsel.

² Partner with Risk Management and insurance professionals to evaluate contractual insurance and indemnity requirements.

² Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Operations, Estimating, Procurement, Project Management, Human Resources, and executive leadership on contract-related matters.

² Provide training to contract coordinators and business stakeholders regarding contract risk, company standards, and escalation requirements.

² Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting construction and commercial contracting and recommend updates to templates, processes, and guidance.

² Maintain organized legal records and support reporting on contract volume, risk themes, cycle times, escalations, and other relevant metrics.

² Perform other legal duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

² Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.

² Active membership in good standing with the State Bar of California.

² Two to three years of legal experience in commercial contracts, construction law, corporate transactions, procurement, real estate, or a related practice area.

² Demonstrated experience reviewing, drafting, or negotiating contracts through employment, a clerkship, internship, or law firm practice.

² Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and contract-drafting skills.

² Ability to explain legal issues and recommendations to nonlegal stakeholders in practical, business-focused terms.

² Ability to manage multiple matters, prioritize deadlines, and work across several subsidiaries in a fast-paced environment.

² Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn contract management and document-management systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

² Experience with construction, engineering, utilities, infrastructure, telecommunications, public works, or related industries.

² Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. KTTV Fox 11 is seeking a per-diem Transmitter Engineer to support our primary broadcast transmitter facility atop Mt. Wilson during high profile events or emergencies.

Key Responsibilities

Transmitter Operations (Mt. Wilson)

  • Primary Site Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive

Denver, Colorado

Position Summary

KDVR FOX31, KWGN Colorado’s Very Own Channel 2, and Nexstar Digital are seeking an experienced, high-performing Senior Account Executive & Project Lead to join our Denver sales organization.

This is a senior-level revenue position designed for a proven sales professional who can manage and grow key accounts while consistently developing new business across the full marketing funnel. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable selling linear television, streaming/CTV, digital marketing, sports, sponsorships, and integrated multiplatform solutions.

This role goes beyond traditional account management. We are looking for a proactive business developer who understands how the media landscape is evolving and can translate advertiser challenges into sophisticated, results-oriented solutions.

In addition to individual revenue responsibilities, the Account Executive will partner with sales leadership on select strategic initiatives, including the development and execution of community programs, tentpole opportunities, sponsorship platforms, and revenue initiatives that can extend across the Denver market, Front Range, and statewide Colorado footprint.

This is an opportunity for an experienced seller who wants to own business, create business, and help build what comes next.

  • Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Consistently achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals across linear television, digital, streaming, sports, and sponsorship platforms.
  • Manage, retain, and strategically grow an assigned portfolio of key accounts through strong client relationships, thoughtful account planning, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Maintain a strong emphasis on new business development, consistently identifying, prospecting, developing, presenting, and closing new advertisers.
  • Develop full-funnel marketing strategies that combine the appropriate mix of broadcast, streaming/CTV/OTT, online video, display, search, social, audience targeting, sponsorships, and other digital solutions.
  • Serve as a consultative marketing partner by identifying client business challenges, developing customized solutions, presenting strategic recommendations, and communicating campaign results.
  • Build strong, credible relationships with local direct advertisers, advertising agencies, decision-makers, and community business leaders.
  • Develop and maintain an active sales pipeline with both short- and long-term opportunities and demonstrate consistent prospecting and business-development activity.
  • Maximize revenue opportunities surrounding sports, tentpole programming, premium content, streaming sports, and integrated sponsorship platforms.
  • Proactively develop year-round sports and sponsorship strategies rather than relying solely on transactional or event-specific opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to grow local campaigns into larger Front Range, statewide, regional, or national programs utilizing Nexstar's extensive portfolio of media assets and markets.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling, customized, insight-driven sales presentations and proposals.
  • Educate clients on the changing media landscape and demonstrate how linear television and digital platforms work together to reach audiences throughout the customer journey.
  • Collaborate with sales leadership, digital teams, research, marketing, creative services, sales support, and other departments to develop and execute integrated client solutions.
  • Utilize research, audience insights, attribution, campaign performance data, and other available resources to improve recommendations and demonstrate advertiser ROI.
  • Maintain accurate account information, opportunity pipelines, activity, and forecasts within company CRM and sales systems.
  • Work effectively with sales support personnel to ensure accurate order entry, campaign implementation, billing, reporting, and overall client service.

  • In addition to individual sales responsibilities, this position assist with select strategic initiatives as assigned by sales leadership.

    Responsibilities may include:

  • Partner with sales leadership to develop, package, launch, and execute key station and market revenue initiatives.
  • Help lead the sales rollout of community initiatives, special programming, major events, and integrated sponsorship opportunities.
  • Identify and develop new sponsorship concepts capable of generating incremental revenue across the Denver market and broader Colorado footprint.
  • Develop opportunities that can be expanded across the Front Range, statewide, regionally, or throughout the Nexstar organization.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to establish pricing, inventory, digital components, sponsorship assets, sales materials, timelines, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Help translate major station initiatives into clear, sellable solutions for the broader sales organization.
  • Serve as a resource to Account Executives by sharing category expertise, sales strategies, successful approaches, and best practices related to assigned projects.
  • Track progress against project revenue objectives and provide regular updates to sales leadership.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve, expand, and scale successful programs.

  • What Success Looks Like

    The successful Account Executive will:

  • Consistently deliver revenue growth.
  • Protect and expand key account relationships.
  • Build a meaningful pipeline of new business.
  • Prospect consistently rather than relying primarily on an established account list.
  • Sell confidently across linear and digital platforms.
  • Make streaming a core component of their book of business.
  • Consistently monetize sports, tentpole events, and sponsorship opportunities.
  • Think beyond individual products and sell integrated business solutions.
  • Identify opportunities others may overlook.
  • Take ownership of projects and move them from concept to revenue-generating execution.
  • Collaborate effectively across departments and with sales leadership.
  • Demonstrate resilience, accountability, curiosity, urgency, and a strong work ethic.

  • Qualifications

  • Proven track record of success in media, advertising, marketing, business development, or consultative sales.
  • Prior experience managing significant client relationships and revenue responsibility strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently develop and close new business.
  • Strong understanding of today's media ecosystem, including broadcast television, streaming/CTV/OTT, digital video, display, search, social media, audience targeting, and sponsorship marketing.
  • Experience developing integrated multiplatform marketing solutions strongly preferred.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand client objectives, identify opportunities, and translate those needs into effective advertising strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish long-range objectives and execute strategies to achieve them.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with the ability to simultaneously manage key accounts, new-business activity, deadlines, and strategic projects.
  • Self-directed and comfortable taking ownership of projects with limited supervision.
  • Collaborative mindset and demonstrated ability to work successfully across multiple departments.
  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms, and digital sales tools.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Valid driver's license, acceptable driving record, and access to reliable transportation.

  • The Person We're Looking For

    We are looking for more than an experienced salesperson.

    We want a business developer, strategic thinker, relationship builder, and difference maker who understands where the media business is headed and wants to help lead that evolution. Someone who is comfortable moving between a major client meeting, a new-business pitch, a streaming strategy, a sports sponsorship, and a market-wide revenue initiative. Someone who understands that success in today's media environment requires the ability to prospect, adapt, integrate, execute, and grow.

    Most importantly, we are looking for someone who wants to build—not simply maintain—a successful book of business.

    Why Denver & Nexstar

  • Powerful Local Brands: FOX31 and Colorado's Very Own Channel 2 provide advertisers access to trusted local news, programming, sports, and community content.
  • Sports & Tentpole Opportunities: A powerful portfolio of professional and college sports, NFL programming, major live events, and premium sponsorship opportunities provides sellers with year-round opportunities to create high-impact campaigns.
  • Streaming & Digital Growth: Build sophisticated campaigns utilizing streaming/CTV, online video, audience targeting, search, social, display, attribution, and Nexstar's expanding digital capabilities.
  • National Scale, Local Expertise: Nexstar's national footprint provides opportunities to extend successful local ideas into regional and national campaigns.
  • Opportunity to Lead: This role offers the ability to influence major market initiatives while continuing to build and own a significant individual book of business.

  • Compensation

    Base Salary + Commission + Bonus $125,000-$150,000

    Expected total compensation will vary based on experience, portfolio development, and performance, with significant upside for a high-performing Account Executive.

    Ready to build what's next?

    Join a team focused on developing the sales professionals—and advertising solutions—of tomorrow.

Because journalism in 2026 is more dynamic than ever—and this is your chance to be part of it.

job.title: Product Growth Manager
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.
●    Experience owning a growth funnel end to end, including shipping changes to a live product.
●    Hands-on experience running paid user acquisition (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, or similar).
●    Fluency with app metrics: installs, CAC and LTV, activation, adoption, retention, and cohort analysis.
●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
●    Experience embedded on a product and engineering team in an Agile environment.
●    Background in sports, streaming, media, or consumer subscription apps.
●    Familiarity with ASO and app store editorial and featuring processes.
●    Experience with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), attribution (AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust), and lifecycle tools (Braze, Iterable, Airship).
●    A real interest in sports and how the sports calendar shapes fan behavior.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Overview

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the PlutoTV pod. You will focus on Channel, Guide, and Schedule personalization. Your goal is to make the FAST (Free Ad-supported Streaming TV) experience feel as dynamic as a premium on-demand service. You will help build the models that select which channels appear in the guide and how content is scheduled to maximize viewer session length.   This role requires deep knowledge of FAST systems and the unique constraints of linear programming. You will implement features within our GCP stack, leveraging Qdrant for content similarity and Post-training RL to optimize the "Lean-back" viewing experience.   Why This Role Matters
  • Modernizing Linear TV: You are part of the team transforming the static EPG (Electronic Programming Guide) into a personalized, data-driven discovery engine.
  • Optimizing the "Lean-Back": Your models help users find something to watch immediately, reducing the friction inherent in "channel surfing."
  • Global Scale: PlutoTV is a leader in the FAST space; your code will impact the viewing habits of millions of users worldwide.
  Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development: Design and deploy ML components for channel ranking and guide personalization.
  • FAST Metadata Integration: Work with linear scheduling data to create features that account for "Current" vs "Next" program relevance.
  • Vector-Based Similarity: Use Qdrantto group similar channels and content to improve the "More Like This" experience within the guide.
  • Model Refinement: Train and iterate on models using TensorFlow/PyTorch, focusing on session-start and watch-time metrics.
  • Independent Execution: Own the delivery of defined tasks within the PlutoTV roadmap, from data exploration to production deployment.
  Basic Qualifications
  • Minimum: 3+ years in MLE; proficiency in Python/SQL; experience with TensorFlow/PyTorch and GCP.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Preferred: Knowledge with FAST or Broadcast TV data structures; experience with Qdrant or similar vector databases.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Audience Conversion, this role is responsible for driving audience conversion across the customer journey—from converting anonymous site visitors to known users, to increasing paid subscriber acquisition through strategic upsell initiatives. This role owns the onsite conversion strategy, user journey optimization, and performance across subscription products, leveraging marketing technology platforms and data-driven experimentation to maximize revenue and audience growth.

Working cross-functionally with Email, Product, App, Data, and Editorial teams, the Director develops and oversees experiences that guide users from onsite engagement, to newsletter acquisition and/or in-app activation and ultimately to paid subscription.

This role will oversee the Campaign Manager of Conversion.

Remote or Hybrid 3x a week - (New York City)

job.title: Design Developer, Opinion
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role:

The New York Times Opinion desk is looking for a Digital Design Developer to join our award-winning design team. In this role, you will create digital storytelling experiences for our global audience of readers with web development. As an expert front-end engineer with great visual and editorial instincts, you are equally comfortable building out storyboards as you are collaborating with designers and editors to refine ideas. You will also build tools and templates and architect complex multi-part systems and features on deadline. 
 
Bridging creative vision and functional code, this role requires exceptional collaboration and communication. You will partner closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clearly articulating processes, constraints, and performance trade-offs. We’re looking for a proven track record of collaborating with art directors and designers, alongside a portfolio that demonstrates meticulous attention to visual craft.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with art directors, editors, and engineers to build responsive, pixel-perfect user experiences and product features
  • Assess designs for technical feasibility, accessibility, and performance, offering constructive feedback and alternatives when needed
  • Create interactive prototypes to validate ideas and propose responsive layouts, animations, and transitions for static wireframes
  • Integrate, debug, and optimize multimedia assets (video, audio, animations) for fast load times across devices and browsers
  • Conduct thorough QA to ensure typography, spacing, colors, and micro-interactions match visual specs across screen sizes
  • Build and maintain reusable templates, tools, and documentation for recurring editorial workflows
  • Onboard and guide designers on front-end systems to streamline asset handoffs and workflow integration
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • You will report to the Deputy Editor, Design

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of creative front-end development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Figma
  • Strong grasp of visual design fundamentals, including typography, layout, motion, and interaction.
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative coding workflows and demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and front-end languages such as emerging A.I. API toolsets
  • Experience and interest in rapidly evolving digital technology, such as emerging A.I. API toolsets

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Passion for journalism and visual storytelling
  • Experience or familiarity with Svelte, WebGL, three.js, canvas, React, After Effects, Cinema4D, Blender or Maya
  • Experience with motion design, data visualization, video and audio work
  • Strong understanding of design details regarding layout hierarchy, visual consistency, motion timing, and typography
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced newsroom with flexibility for occasional breaking-news hours (nights/weekends).
  • Interest in audience analytics

At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible possible. The Walt Disney Company is an entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways of storytelling to move audiences around the world, a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts, and a cruise line to sports, news, movies, and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences, and we’re constantly striving to enhance them.

Disney Experiences brings the magic of Disney stories to life through theme parks, resorts, cruise ships, unique vacation experiences, consumer products, and more around the world. Our talented team of Cast Members, Crew Members, Imagineers, and employees delivers unparalleled service, entertainment, and imagination, bringing a range of authentic, immersive stories to life across the globe. You would have the opportunity to be a part of this amazing team!


 

This position is located in Celebration, FL

Working closely with business leaders, Digital/Tech partners, and operational teams, this leader translates business needs into scalable system and process solutions. The role establishes standards for intake, requirements management, prioritization, governance, testing, operational readiness, and post-launch support.

As a people leader reporting to the Group Business Integration Director, this position balances team leadership, business systems strategy, and day to day systems execution.   • Ability to evaluate system capabilities, dependencies, integrations, and business impacts
  • Strong knowledge of implementation planning, UAT, operational readiness, and change management
  • Demonstrated experience using project planning and work management tools including JIRA, Smartsheet, and SharePoint
  • Ability to use reporting and data analysis to identify trends and improvement opportunities
  • Understanding of system roadmaps, enhancement planning, and platform sustainment activities

Business Acumen

  • Strong understanding of Gatherings operations, sales/services processes, and commercial impact
  • Ability to connect technology investments to business outcomes
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Experience establishing governance, prioritization, and decision-making processes
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across technical and non-technical teams
  • Ability to balance operational needs, project priorities, and long-term business strategies

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, develop, and manage a small team of system administrators
  • Establish performance expectations, and develop project plans
  • Ensure effective support for business systems, user inquiries, and operational issues
  • Lead business systems intake, requirements definition, prioritization, and governance processes
  • Translate business needs into practical, scalable, and sustainable system solutions
  • Manage system enhancements, upgrades, implementations, UAT, and post-launch stabilization efforts
  • Drive project execution, including scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications
  • Support negotiating price adjustments/cancellations, yield management, product modifications, and guest-facing product introductions
  • Maintain visibility into system roadmaps, enhancement requests, and sustainment priorities
  • Partner with Digital/Tech, Sales, Services, Marketing, Operations, and Communications teams to deliver business outcomes
  • Use data, reporting, and operational metrics to identify opportunities for process and system improvements
  • Support organizational readiness for new products, capabilities, and business initiatives
  • Work with GBS leaders to ensure consistent governance, documentation, training, and adoption of business systems
  • Influence and align partners to achieve revenue, guest experience, and operational objective
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and client-focused service

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in business systems, system administration, technology operations, project management, or business transformation
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, or similar reporting tools
  • Prior experience leading teams, projects, or cross-functional initiatives
  • Experience managing business system implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and platform changes
  • Strong project management, planning, and organizational skills
  • Ability to translate business requirements into actionable solutions
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  •  Experience working across technical and business organizations
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Smartsheet, SharePoint, and JIRA
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and organizational change
  • Flexibility to support business needs during weekends, evenings, and holidays when required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the Group travel industry and non-leisure business operations
  • Familiarity with Lightyear, Bolt, Polly, Disney Venue Matrix, and ER2
  • Advanced experience with JIRA and Agile delivery practices
  • Experience building governance models, intake processes, and operating procedures
  • Track record of improving adoption, reducing manual work, and increasing operational efficiency

job.description:

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on what the data says

• Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• 6+ years writing software

• 3+ years building Roku applications

• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

• You know OOP, data structures, and algorithms well enough to design systems, not just pass interviews

• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3

• You can explain Roku's memory model, the render-thread/task-thread split, device tiers, and what certification requires

• RESTful API design and data serialization

• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay

• Unit and integration testing on Roku

• HTTP protocol and caching behavior

• Git and GitHub

• You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them

• You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)

• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS

• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry

• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns

• You've worked with personalization or recommendation APIs on resource-constrained devices

• E2E testing for connected-device applications

• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)

• GraphQL

• You share AI tools and workflows that save the team time

• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right

• You say "I don't know" when you don't know

• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock you

 

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 

• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day

• Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough

• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what happened

• You track Roku OS releases and adopt new APIs when they solve a real problem, not because they're new

• You write architecture docs, component guides, and Slack explanations that save ten people from asking the same question

• You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better one

• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features

• You make the people around you better at their jobs

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV 

 

Location: New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware thatvaries by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall

About the Role

We are seeking contract professionals to support live broadcast and media operations across both cloud-based and on-premise environments. This role will be based in the Stamford, CT office and work alongside engineering and operations teams to support real-time broadcast workflows, monitor system health, and assist in troubleshooting and system setup. Structured training will be provided, but this role requires initiative and the ability to quickly build confidence in fast-paced, live environments. The ideal candidate brings a base of broadcast knowledge, fluency in cloud workflows, and the ability to learn and adapt as our platforms Evolve.

 

The ideal candidate for this role appreciates the discipline and precision of traditional broadcast, while embracing the agility and innovation of modern streaming; someone who sees both worlds not as separate, but as converging.

 

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support live broadcast operations across control rooms, cloud systems, and distribution platforms
  • Monitor signal flow, stream health, and system performance during live events
  • Assist with setup, configuration, testing, and validation of broadcast and media systems
  • Troubleshoot issues in real time and escalate clearly and efficiently
  • Follow established operational procedures while adapting to new tools and workflows
  • Collaborate with engineering, production, and operations teams to support live event execution
  • Contribute to documentation, process improvement, and knowledge sharing

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in broadcast, media operations, or live streaming environments, with a genuine passion for the space
  • Familiarity with signal flow concepts (video, audio, or IP-based workflows)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow technical processes
  • Ability to learn new systems and tools quickly
  • Comfortable working in time-sensitive, live-event environments
  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset

 

 

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Live Linear Playout System (AMPP, Amagi, Imagine…etc.)
  • Experience with SRT-based signal routing and distribution platforms (Netinsight, Techex, Haivision Gateway or similar)
  • Familiarity with closed captioning workflows in broadcast environments, including CEA-608/708 standards and AI-driven captioning services (EEG, AWS Transcribe, Verbit, or similar)
  • Basic experience with Linux or command-line tools
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, IAM, networking basics); familiarity with AWS Media Services a strong plus
  • Experience with OTT/streaming quality monitoring platforms (TagVS, Conviva, NPAW, or similar)

 

Training & Development

  • Structured onboarding with hands-on system training
  • Direct mentorship from engineering and operations staff
  • Exposure to modern cloud-based and IP-based broadcast workflows
  • Opportunity to take on increased responsibility as proficiency grows

 

Success in this Role Looks Like

  • Building confidence and reliability in live broadcast environments
  • Demonstrating strong situational awareness during live event support
  • Identifying, troubleshooting, and escalating issues effectively
  • Growing from task-based support into more independent operational ownership

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV 

 

Location: New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall

 

#LI-TG1

 

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. This position is bonus eligible.

And our first-party data is at the heart of informing everything we do--and not just on our finance and travel  sites, but across powerful brands in home, food & beverage, tech, beauty, style, family, and health (including powerhouses like Better Homes and Gardens, Food & Wine, People, and AllRecipes).

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York)

Our team helps the Finance & Travel brands and revenue organization understand and connect with these consumers, using data to surface insights that inform content, media and advertising strategies.

job.title: Director, Financial Reporting - SESAC (Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC is looking for a a Director, Financial Reporting to join our team in Nashville. As the Director, Financial Reporting you will own the Group’s consolidated financial reporting under US GAAP and will assist foreign subsidiary teams in relevant technical accounting areas, as necessary. In this role you will lead technical accounting research and conclusions, reviews contracts for the appropriate accounting treatment, supports M&A transactions from an accounting and general-ledger perspective, and work hands-on with the subsidiary finance teams on consolidation, intercompany eliminations and equity movements. As it relates to accurate and timely financial reporting, a key part of the role is leading the finance team’s adoption of AI to create efficiencies across the financial reporting process.

As the successful candidate, you will be comfortable working independently and shows initiative in identifying problems, leading solutions and ensuring appropriate resolution and recording in the general ledger. You will also be comfortable and confident in leading and presenting your work to both the finance team and company leadership, and bring exceptional analytical and critical-thinking skills, strong attention to detail, and clear, collaborative communication, together with a thorough, technical-level understanding of US GAAP.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Technical accounting research and interpretation of accounting guidance in areas such as business combinations, stock-based compensation, debt, software capitalization etc. and document conclusions in accounting memos on an as-needed basis.
  • Assessing accounting implications for complex transactions and guide the accounting team in accurately reflecting the accounting and financial reporting impact in the Company’s financial statements (both through journal entries and financial statements presentation).
  • Leading and guiding the team on AI implementation to create efficiencies in the financial reporting process. This would entail running process deep dives to identify where AI can improve operational and reporting efficiency and delivering those improvements.
  • Supporting M&A transactions from an accounting and general-ledger perspective, including purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, GL recording and integration of acquired entities to help implement standardized processes related to financial reporting.
  • Reviewing nonstandard contracts, including revenue, debt, investment etc. to determine the appropriate accounting treatment and document the conclusions.
  • Implementing and evaluating new accounting standards.
  • Reviewing monthly and quarterly consolidation and primary statements at the group level.
  • Taking a hands-on approach with the subsidiary finance teams on consolidation, US GAAP and local GAAP differences, intercompany eliminations, settlements, and equity movements etc., ensuring group figures are complete, accurate and well-supported.
  • Preparing annual US GAAP consolidated financial statements including drafting of disclosures.
  • Serving as the primary liaison for the external auditors for overall audit management, including presenting and defending accounting positions taken by the Company.
  • Working cross-functionally with other departments to increase financial reporting accuracy.
  • Assisting and overseeing special projects as assigned.
  • Other duties as needed and assigned by supervisor.

What Makes You Qualified:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related field, or equivalent combination of education & experience.
  • 5+ years high-quality experience in a technical accounting and/or financial reporting role.
  • 2+ years public account experience preferred.
  • Active CPA license required.
  • Big 4 public accounting firm experience strongly preferred.
  • A confident self-starter — comfortable working independently, taking initiative to solve problems, work collaboratively with the finance team to lead solutions through to completion, and presenting work to both the finance team and leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations and settlements, and equity movements.
  • Experience supporting M&A transactions — purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, and GL recording and integration of acquired entities.
  • Experience reporting under both US GAAP and foreign GAAP (IFRS or local) preferred.
  • Comfortable adopting and working with new technology, with a curiosity for emerging tools — including AI — and how they can improve financial reporting.
  • Have exceptional attention to detail and an ability to effectively prioritize work to meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS Office products (especially Excel).

This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

Overview

Job Title: Full-Time Reporter/Anchor (KCBS-AM All News Radio)

 

Department: News

 

Reporting To: News Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Union: SAG-AFTRA (182)

 

Location: San Francisco, CA

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Pay Transparency:

The anticipated starting salary range for California-based individuals expressing interest in this position and per SAG-AFTRA (182) is $37.6312/hr - $41.3462/hr. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Overview:

Audacy’s KCBS All News Radio, The Bay Area’s number one news station, is looking for an intrepid and tech-savvy broadcast journalist with a positive attitude and impressive work ethic to join an elite news team.  You must be a great writer, have compelling on-air delivery, be a proficient news gatherer – using a variety of sources – and be comfortable with audio and video editing equipment and programs.  You will be expected to work under tight deadlines in a fast-paced Newsroom or field environment.  We are seeking a broadcast journalist who collaborates with colleagues and actively participates in breaking news, long-form, feature and public affairs programming.  You will be expected to actively participate on various social media channels and contribute content to the station’s digital assets, including the Audacy app and station website, KCBSradio.com.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Report, from the field or Newsroom, over the course of multiple hours, on various KCBS channels (radio, Audacy app, station website and social media channels)
  • Conceptualize, pitch, producer and record news segments and series, feature reports and public affairs programming
  • Interview newsmakers
  • Write scripts and ad-lib material for stories
  • Use social media – including but not limited to Facebook, Twitter and Instagram – during the course of your shift to connect with the community, promote upcoming stories and interviews, and to highlight station content
  • Contribute content – including but not limited to audio, video and written format – to the Audacy app and the station website, KCBSradio.com
  • Develop and research potential news stories
  • Protect the station’s FCC license
  • Other duties as required by management

Qualifications

Required and Preferred:

  • Must be dependable, self-motivated and agreeable to a flexible work schedule (may include evenings, overnights, and/or weekends).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required
  • Candidates must be able to take a detail-oriented approach to work while meeting tight deadlines. 
  • Experience in the San Francisco market is a plus. 
  • Anchoring experience is a plus, but not required.

#LI-CM3

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

About Us

Audacy is a leading audio content and entertainment company. As champions of audio, we connect with people in the moments that matter — delivering trusted local news, passionate sports and your favorite music across 220+ radio stations, premium podcasts, live events and digital experiences that reach more than 200 million listeners every month.We create compelling content, foster deeply engaged audiences and deliver outcomes that matter for advertisers. Learn more at www.audacyinc.com and join the conversation on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

EEO

Audacy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Audacy affords equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals regardless of their race, color, religion or religious creed, sex/gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (over 40), physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or other classification protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, and to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Consistent with our commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities who need assistance in applying electronically for a position with Audacy, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship. To request a reasonable accommodation for this purpose, please call 1-610-660-5614. Please note that this phone number is to be used solely to request an accommodation with respect to the online application process. Calls for any other reason will not be returned. Reasonable accommodation requests are considered on a case-by-case basis.

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting assignment but a long-term opportunity with competitive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits. The position can be based in Montreal, Quebec City, Ottawa, Toronto or Vancouver.


Are you passionate about the intersection of technology and marketing? Are you a product manager with a proven track record in marketing data collection and activation platforms, who feels right at home in highly technical environments? If so, this opportunity with our Marketing and Communications team is for you. 


Context: Driving Digital Media Innovation

At Radio-Canada, we craft digital experiences enjoyed by millions of Canadians every day on platforms like ICI TOU.TV, Radio-Canada OHdio and Radio-Canada Info. In a fast-changing ecosystem, data and marketing technology (MarTech) serve as our compass, guiding how we customize the audience experience and optimize our results. You will play a key role in our transition to a modern architecture, harnessing technological innovation to drive marketing performance.


Why This Role Matters

As Product Manager, MarTech (Marketing and Technology), you will play a pivotal strategic role at the critical intersection of marketing business needs and our data and technology teams’ capabilities. As the steward of our marketing technology road map, you will drive the evolution and maximize the value of our entire MarTech ecosystem. Your goal will be to maximize user engagement and lifetime value (LTV) by delivering high-performance, secure and interoperable solutions.


Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Vision and Road Map: Own and steer the MarTech road map in alignment with strategic pillars defined by leadership. Anticipate market trends to fuel and sustain our growth objectives.
  • Procurement and RFP Management: Act as the technical subject matter expert and co-ordinator during procurement and vendor selection processes for new solutions, partnering closely with Procurement and specialized teams. 
  • Backlog Management and Delivery: Prioritize development pipelines by translating complex business needs into clearly defined technical user stories for integration into development team road maps. 
  • Optimization and ROI: Maximize the return on our technology investments. Track operational budgets (licensing and usage), optimize feature adoption across tools and lead post-implementation performance reviews.
  • Ecosystem Orchestration and Interconnectivity: Drive platform integration to ensure a seamless data flow across the MarTech stack. Orchestrate functional interconnectivity so that data is collected, centralized and actionable for third-party systems.
  • Governance, Quality and Ethics: Ensure platform compliance with privacy and data protection regulations while overseeing the reliability of our marketing data pipelines. 
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the internal subject matter expert to drive maximum adoption of our marketing technologies. Lead through influence with internal partners to align business processes with the ecosystem’s technological capabilities.

This is a hybrid role blending in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.


What You Bring:

You understand that tools and data hold value only when they directly serve audience engagement and business performance.


Key Technical Skills:

  • MarTech Ecosystem: Demonstrated expertise in deploying and managing complex products such as customer journey orchestration platforms, analytics and performance tools, ad servers and CDPs.
  • Data and Architecture: Strong understanding of data flows, tracking principles (tags, pixels) and decentralized architectures. 
  • Governance and Data Privacy: Strong command of compliance and privacy regulations in the digital space. 
  • Change Management: Proven ability to guide teams through the adoption of new workflows, mitigate resistance and facilitate training.
  • Agile Tools: Advanced proficiency with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence).

Professional Skills:

  • Translating Business Needs: Ability to translate marketing challenges into technology requirements and articulate technical value in terms of business outcomes.
  • Resilience and Adaptability: Comfortable navigating a rapidly changing environment and managing projects with shifting scopes. 
  • Thorough, Analytical Mindset: A passion for data precision and structured systems. 
  • Drive for Growth: Keen interest in modern marketing trends and continuous performance improvement.
  • Operational Discipline: Ability to maintain accurate documentation and asset inventories.
  • Communication: Bilingualism (English/French) and an outstanding ability to explain complex concepts clearly and simply would be a major asset when collaborating with external technology vendors.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in digital marketing, digital intelligence, information technology or a related field.
  • At least ten (10) years’ experience in marketing and technology or performance marketing. 
  • Excellent command of French and a good understanding of English.
  • Experience deploying or utilizing enterprise marketing technology tools is an asset.
  • Experience collaborating with external vendors or working within structured environments is an asset.

Why Join Us?

  • Be on the front lines of putting data at the core of the marketing teams’ strategic and creative decisions.
  • Play a pivotal role where your human impact will be just as important as your technical influence.
  • Enjoy the opportunity to lead and scale a cutting-edge MarTech stack within a major public media organization. 
  • Benefit from a corporate culture that values work/life balance, inclusion, diversity and ongoing innovation.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check. 

  • Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

Your Role

 

Reporting to senior leadership, this position is integral to the Legal Services senior management team. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and supporting health and safety, crisis management, environmental (loss control / risk management) and sustainability strategies. You will also develop and maintain working relationships with industry peers handling similar issues. You will facilitate the integration of health, safety, crisis management and environmental issues into management and union practices as well as daily business operations. You will participate in and influence legislative and regulatory changes regarding health, safety and environment that apply to and may affect CBC/Radio-Canada. In addition, you will ensure the implementation and co-ordination of national emergency preparedness, business continuity and corporate security policies, standards and procedures across all areas of CBC/Radio-Canada.

 

In this role, you will manage a team of nine direct reports.

 

This position can be based in Montreal, Toronto or Ottawa.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Define corporate strategies and establish objectives and priorities pertaining to health, safety, environment and sustainability. Develop, implement and evaluate policies, programs, procedures and guidelines in consultation with line management. 
  • Oversee the development and management of the crisis management portfolio for CBC/Radio-Canada which includes emergency preparedness, business continuity and corporate security. Ensure effective co-ordination across all components so that coherent plans and contingencies are established and updated as required.
  • Develop, establish and maintain procedures to monitor or evaluate compliance with applicable legislation and regulations, as well as CBC/Radio-Canada policies and procedures governing health, safety, environment and crisis management systems.
  • Develop, establish and maintain a hazard identification, assessment and control program in accordance with legislated and regulatory requirements, taking operational needs into consideration.
  • Facilitate the effective operation of the joint union/management Health and Safety Policy Committee and local workplace committees for CBC/Radio-Canada. 
  • Define health, safety and environment training requirements; determine course content; and, in consultation with line management and L&D, identify appropriate resources, target audiences and delivery methods. Plan and monitor the corporate training budget for health, safety and environment. Establish training budget allocations across all components.
  • Determine and oversee the management of health, safety, environment and crisis management resources to provide professional and technical advice, guidance, consultation, research, planning and monitoring services.
  • Promote health, safety, crisis management, sustainability and environment objectives and programs among CBC/Radio-Canada personnel. Represent CBC/Radio-Canada in liaising with ESDC, public security authorities, Environment and Climate Change Canada, and other external organizations on health, safety, environment and crisis management matters.
  • Prepare quarterly and annual reports to review the CBC/Radio-Canada health, safety and environment systems and activities. Track and summarize legislative/regulatory changes and identify their impact on CBC/Radio-Canada.
  • Actively participate in internal and external health and safety committees, as needed, to ensure CBC/Radio-Canada’s health and safety priorities are effectively represented.
  • Establish and maintain procedures to ensure effective internal and external communications regarding CBC/Radio-Canada policies, procedures, activities and performance related to health, safety, environment and crisis management. Oversee the maintenance of all CBC/Radio-Canada documentation dedicated to health, safety, environment and crisis management. Develop, organize, prepare and present information sessions on health and safety policies, procedures and guidelines.

 

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Sciences, Business Administration, engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 15+ years of professional experience in a senior health and safety role.
  • 5 years of experience managing professional and technical staff, preferably within large, complex organizations.
  • Active Canadian Registered Safety Professional (CRSP), Environmental Professional (EP) or Associate Business Continuity Professional (ABCP) designation an asset.
  • Experience managing professional and technical staff, preferably within large, complex organizations.
  • Fluent bilingualism (English/French).
  • Ability to manage multiple, competing priorities under pressure to meet tight deadlines and urgent requests.
  • Ability to provide clear, concise recommendations, analytical insights and interpretations of complex matters to senior management.
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgment and schedule flexibility to serve diverse internal stakeholders and adapt to changing environments.
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Ability to stay current on legislation and regulations governing health, safety and environment, as well as industry best practices and modern management principles.
  • Practical knowledge of federal or provincial health, safety and environment legislation an asset.
  • Experience managing health and safety requirements for large-scale international events an asset.
  • Valid driver’s license required.  
  • Occasional travel is required.

Your role


ICI Radio-Canada Manitoba is looking for a cross-platform videojournalist to be based in Winnipeg. The working language is French. In this role, you will be assigned to develop a digital content offering.


You will report on a wide range of stories, spanning the environment, the economy, politics, social and Indigenous issues.


You understand the diverse and changing population of Indigenous communities and the importance of reflecting that in our content.


You have a strong connection to Indigenous communities across the country and deep knowledge of issues that affect Indigenous people. 


Please note:

  • The work schedule may include weekend shifts.
  • Excellent English and French is required.

Key tasks:

  • Develop and maintain contacts with a variety of sources to ensure current knowledge of issues and events in the coverage area relevant to the objectives of the role.
  • Gather information from various sources.
  • Be interested in and knowledgeable about topics that engage young francophones and francophiles across the province.

  • Deliver all recorded materials, including shot lists and sequences.
  • Edit recorded items on appropriate/available editing systems.
  • Prepare and write scripts, continuity and headlines.
  • Report the story, either on camera or in voiceover form.
  • Be flexible to work regularly for television, radio and/or digital platforms.
  • Drive a motor vehicle in the performance of the job.

Engage in a unique experience that will have a lasting impact on your career!


This role requires full-time on-site presence.
