About CBC/Radio-Canada

CBC/Radio-Canada has a diverse, talented workforce thriving in an environment that encourages sharing and learning. Many different people in a variety of roles come together to make CBC/Radio-Canada a stronger, more relevant, and more dynamic public broadcaster. Our programming is distinctive, intelligent, innovative, and entertaining, much like the people we're looking to hire.

Job Summary

CBC Sports is looking for an Executive Producer for the 2028 Summer Olympic Games. Reporting to the Executive Director, the successful candidate will be a key member of the leadership team of CBC Olympics.  This position will work closely with two other Executive producers who oversee different aspects of the production.  

We are looking for an experienced producer who will push the boundaries of traditional broadcasting. As an editorial leader for the LA28 Games, you will champion unconventional narratives, bold visual formats, and fresh ways to capture the human drama of the Olympics—actively seeking to expand our range and impact across all screens.

The Executive Producer is instrumental in assigning stories to be chased, monitoring development, creating a coverage plan for the Games, and contributing to the overall planning function of the Games. The successful candidate will also be expected to mentor, direct, and develop programming talent, producers, on-air talent, and hosts, as well as take an active role in department-wide and CBC initiatives.

Function

Plans, conceives, organizes, and/or develops the production and realization of a program segment, program, or series. Work must adhere to CBC journalistic and/or program policies, standards, and practices, and the Executive Producer is ultimately responsible for ensuring that this occurs. Nevertheless, there is wide latitude for initiative, independent judgment, and creativity. There is a regular and ongoing requirement to co-ordinate the work of others.


 

Key Tasks

  • Conceives, develops, and champions ground-breaking program concepts that challenge conventional sports production. You will use your creative latitude to design distinctive, non-traditional formats that seamlessly bridge live television and digital platforms, turning complex technical setups into canvas elements for immersive, high-impact storytelling.

  • Review the style, pace, tempo, and format of the broadcast. Rather than relying on standard sports templates, you will bring a fresh aesthetic and creative choreography to live multi-sport events, tailoring content dynamically for different audiences and platforms.

  • Develops the program content including assigning, researching, gathering, writing, and/or editing; as required, commissions writing/research and prepares scripts.

  • Plans, organizes, and co-ordinates the program or its various components and segments.

  • Plans, selects, and requests, in collaboration with the Unit or Business Manager, the financial and production/resource requirements including creative contributors, participants, materials, and facilities. Responsible and accountable for exercising budget authority during program preparation, production, and post-production.

  • Exercises editorial responsibility as delegated by Management.

  • Evaluates all facets of a production, including the performance of program and production personnel and freelance contributors.

  • As required, performs the following tasks:

    • Directs talent, sound, and/or image.

    • Selects, re-writes, and/or edits copy or text written by others.

    • Ensures, in collaboration with Copyright Clearance Officers or others, the proper and accurate clearance of all material used in the program.

    • Determines the order and importance of various elements of a program.

    • Assigns, co-ordinates, and supervises the work of personnel who contribute to the program or segment for which the Producer is responsible.

    • Identifies, develops, and maintains contacts appropriate to the area of assignment.

    • Oversees internet site design and structure and organizes/co-ordinates on-line content.

    • Oversees the shooting, editing, encoding, digitizing, and packaging of digital audio and video for the internet.

    • Prepares programs for the internet, including coding, and manipulating images and graphics.

    • Edits and mixes, or directs the editing and mixing of audio and/or visual elements.

    • Assures the maintenance of a level of communication or rapport with members of the audience which is both feasible and appropriate to the style and nature of the program

.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • University degree or equivalent and ten years' experience, of which five must involve work in broadcasting or a closely related industry.

  • Significant experience producing live international multi-sports event programming.

  • Experience writing, editing, and conceptualizing the content and flow of distinctive programming.

  • Desirable experience in sports journalism; must demonstrate solid editorial knowledge of national and international sports news and issues.

  • Extensive knowledge of international professional and amateur sports (with special emphasis on Olympic sports).

  • Proven ability and experience working with a sales/revenue department developing programming to meet client needs, programming objectives, and financial goals.

  • Experience meeting and presenting programming concepts to clients, sponsors, and agencies.

  • Strong leadership skills to motivate a programming team, on-air talent, and hosts.

  • Ability to forward-plan while remaining topical and current.

  • Highly developed interpersonal skills, able to communicate effectively and cooperatively (established relationships with Canadian Sports Federations are an asset).

  • A proven understanding of the CBC and the relationship between Sports, the network, and regional programming.

  • An understanding and appreciation of complex production and technical needs.

  • An innovator in digital storytelling. You possess a deep curiosity for emerging digital media trends and know how to leverage social, interactive, and on-line content to build creative, narrative-driven experiences that extend far beyond the linear television screen.

  • Ability to work effectively in a high-pressure and stressful environment.

  • Ability to travel as required and to work long and flexible hours.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Vulnerability and External Attack Surface Management, to optimize the Corporation’s vulnerability management program and design, build and deploy its external attack surface management (EASM) service. 

In this role, you will take strategic and operational ownership of this domain. Monitor residual risk levels, update mitigation plans and present clear status reports to governance and executive committees to inform adjudication and investment decisions.

job.title: Vice President Human Resources
job.description:
HR Strategy and business partnership: Establish and lead enterprise HR strategy in partnership with the executive leadership, divisional presidents, and business leaders, translating company objectives into practical people priorities across workforce planning, compensation, recruiting, employee development, organizational design, and change management.

 

Executive advisory role: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing business acumen, sound judgment, clear communication, and practical guidance to influence decisions in a decentralized, entrepreneurial environment.

 

Organizational capability and culture: Strengthen organizational capability and culture by advising leaders, equipping managers, reinforcing accountability, supporting employee engagement, and building leadership readiness, succession depth, and high-performing teams across locations.

 

Core HR Operations: Oversee core HR operations, including talent acquisition and onboarding, benefits and retirement programs, HR communications, performance management, training, employee relations, investigations, adverse actions, policy governance, vendor partnerships, and outside counsel relationships.

 

Compensation Administration: Guide competitive, equitable, and compliant compensation decisions aligned with business objectives.

 

Compliance Oversight: In collaboration with HBI legal counsel, ensure HR policies, practices, reporting, documentation, and employment decisions comply with applicable federal, state, and local labor and employment laws. Oversee compliance with FCC EEO licensing and public file requirements for broadcast operations.

 

Data and analytics: Use HR data, workforce analytics, external benchmarks, and business insight to identify trends, anticipate risk, measure outcomes, solve complex issues, and provide actionable recommendations to senior leadership.

 

HR Technology and AI: Advance practical HR technology and AI-enabled process improvements that increase productivity and decision quality while protecting confidentiality, employee trust, compliance, and responsible implementation.

  • Senior HR leadership experience in a multi-location, geographically dispersed organization, with prior service as a top, divisional, or senior HR leader with significant enterprise HR responsibility; family-owned business and/or broadcasting industry experience a plus.
  • Broad HR generalist expertise across compensation, benefits, employee relations, talent management, learning and development, performance management, recruiting, workforce planning, HRIS, policy governance, and employment compliance; union environment experience a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources or a related field, ongoing professional development in relevant HR disciplines, and 5+ years of senior-level HR leadership experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Proactive player/coach who leads initiatives end-to-end, manages multiple priorities, builds strong relationships, develops direct reports, and drives accountability through teamwork, delegation, coaching, and empowerment.
  • Demonstrate professional maturity, sound judgment, high integrity, strict confidentiality, analytical problem-solving, and a practical service mindset that balances business needs, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Comfortable applying HR technology, AI-enabled process improvement, responsible automation, and people capability planning to improve productivity, informed decision-making, compliance, and employee trust.

 

This position is subject to a pre-employment criminal background check. A criminal conviction or arrest pending adjudication or adverse history information alone shall not disqualify an applicant in the absence of a relationship to the requirements of the position. job.title: Fleet Manager
job.description:
Title: Fleet Manager

Reports to: VP of Operations

 

Herman Weissker Power, Inc. (HW Power), a proud subsidiary of Meruelo Enterprises, is California’s go-to electrical utility contractor powering the state’s most critical infrastructure with precision and passion. Since 2011, from our headquarters in Norwalk, we’ve been leading the charge in overhead and underground electrical systems, including expert vault installations, conduit placement, and high-voltage power line construction.

But we don’t stop there. Our team also brings cutting-edge planning, design, and traffic control services to the table making even the most complex utility projects run smoothly. Driven by an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and high performance, HW Power is the trusted partner for public and private sector clients who demand reliable, future-ready energy solutions.

 

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Fleet Manager to oversee the vehicles and specialized equipment supporting our underground civil and electric utility construction operations.

This position is responsible for fleet safety, availability, maintenance, compliance, utilization, and cost control. The Fleet Manager will work closely with operations, safety, accounting, purchasing, and field leadership to ensure equipment is properly assigned, maintained, inspected, documented, and ready to support daily production.

Our fleet includes service and foreman trucks, pickups, dump trucks, trailers, backhoes, excavators, skid steers, vacuum excavators, bucket trucks, digger derricks, and other utility-construction equipment.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Manage the daily operation, maintenance, assignment, and utilization of company vehicles, trailers, and construction equipment.

²  Maintain accurate fleet records, including unit numbers, registrations, insurance, inspections, warranties, service histories, mileage, and operating hours.

²  Develop and manage preventive-maintenance and inspection schedules.

²  Ensure compliance with DOT, DMV, BIT, CHP, OSHA, and applicable state and federal requirements.

²  Coordinate equipment repairs, breakdown response, towing, rentals, and replacement units to minimize field downtime.

²  Review repair estimates and approve work within established authorization limits.

²  Track fleet expenses, including maintenance, repairs, fuel, tires, rentals, registrations, and insurance.

²  Monitor fuel-card activity, identify unusual usage, and ensure transactions are assigned to the correct vehicle, employee, and project.

²  Manage rental equipment and vehicles, including approvals, extensions, off-rent dates, damage documentation, and invoice reconciliation.

²  Coordinate the assignment, transfer, and return of vehicles and equipment between projects, yards, and employees.

²  Ensure all company units are properly numbered, branded, equipped, and documented before deployment.

²  Manage GPS, telematics, dash-camera, and driver-performance systems.

²  Monitor equipment utilization and recommend when to purchase, lease, transfer, replace, or dispose of assets.

²  Conduct regular fleet audits and yard inspections.

²  Maintain vendor relationships and negotiate pricing for repairs, parts, tires, fuel, rentals, and fleet services.

²  Support incident investigations involving company vehicles or equipment.

²  Verify that operators and drivers are properly licensed, qualified, and authorized for assigned equipment.

²  Develop and enforce fleet policies, inspection procedures, and accountability standards.

²  Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering fleet availability, downtime, utilization, repair costs, fuel consumption, rentals, and compliance.

²  Support project planning by confirming that the correct equipment is available, compliant, and job-ready.

 

Qualifications:

²  Five or more years of fleet-management experience, preferably within underground utilities, electrical construction, heavy civil construction, or a related field.

²  Strong working knowledge of construction vehicles and specialized utility equipment.

²  Experience managing preventive maintenance, repairs, inspections, registrations, rentals, and fleet records.

²  Knowledge of DOT, DMV, BIT, CHP, OSHA, and commercial-vehicle compliance requirements.

²  Experience with GPS, telematics, fleet-management, fuel-card, and asset-tracking systems.

²  Ability to review repair estimates, identify unnecessary costs, and make sound repair-versus-replacement decisions.

²  Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

²  Ability to work effectively with field employees, foremen, superintendents, project managers, mechanics, vendors, and executive leadership.

²  Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and fleet-reporting systems.

²  Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

²  Ability to visit project locations and respond to urgent fleet issues when necessary.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

²  Experience supporting underground civil and electric transmission and distribution operations.

²  Familiarity with bucket trucks, digger derricks, vacuum excavators, backhoes, excavators, skid steers, dump trucks, and commercial trailers.

²  Experience managing a multi-location fleet.

²  Commercial Driver’s License is a plus.

²  Experience with Samsara, ToolWatch, Fleetio, or similar platforms.

²  Technical or mechanical background is highly desirable.

²  Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

 

Performance Expectations:

²  The successful candidate will be measured on:

²  Fleet availability and equipment uptime

²  Preventive-maintenance completion

²  Regulatory and inspection compliance

²  Repair and maintenance costs

²  Fuel and rental cost control

²  Accurate fleet records and asset accountability

²  Reduction in preventable breakdowns and vehicle incidents

²  Timely support of field operations

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Director, AI Execution & Operations
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Develop and coordinate enterprise AI adoption strategies in partnership with business leaders, AI champions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by sharing AI best practices, lessons learned, and recommendations that help scale successful outcomes.
  • Partner with AI champions, business stakeholders, and cross-functional AI leaders to build, support, and expand CMG's AI Champion Network.
  • Coordinate communications, awareness campaigns, webinars, and employee engagement activities.
  • Partner with business leaders to support adoption and embed AI into day-to-day workflows.
  • Coordinate AI training, workshops, office hours, and enablement programs to accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Create adoption playbooks, implementation guidance, best practices, FAQs, and success stories.
  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches, and apply AI capabilities to solve practical business challenges and improve business outcomes.
  • Foster collaboration across teams pursuing AI initiatives to encourage knowledge sharing, consistency, and reuse of successful practices and solutions.
  • Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry practices, applying lessons learned and recommending improvements to adoption approaches, governance processes, and operating models.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify AI deployment and support processes.
  • Help business leaders successfully integrate AI into existing workflows and operating models.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (cont.)

AI Operations & Governance Coordination

  • Manage AI intake, evaluation, prioritization support, and execution tracking processes.
  • Support and coordinate governance reviews, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making activities in partnership with established governance bodies, business leaders, and AI stakeholders.
  • Support implementation of AI policies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Partner with Technology, Security, Legal, and HR stakeholders to ensure compliance with established governance frameworks.
  • Maintain AI operational documentation, reporting, and decision records.
  • Develop scalable operational processes that support long-term AI growth and enterprise adoption.
  • Ensure governance decisions are implemented consistently across AI initiatives

 

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with business AI leaders, champions, and stakeholders to support department-specific AI initiatives, share best practices, and accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Facilitate collaboration and build strong partnerships across business and technology teams to accelerate AI adoption and value realization.
  • Maintain consistent executive communication and reporting cadences.
  • Manage operational relationships with AI vendors, consultants, implementation partners, and service providers.
  • Support evaluation and implementation planning for new AI solutions and capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
  • An equivalent combination of education, professional experience, certifications, and demonstrated success leading technology transformation, AI adoption, operational excellence, automation, and organizational change will be considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant work in technology, AI adoption, operational leadership, change management, enterprise program execution, business operations, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives with executive visibility and measurable business outcomes.
  • Natural curiosity and a track record of applying technology, automation, or AI to solve business problems and improve operational outcomes.
  • Track record of translating business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions and operational improvements.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and applying Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, automation, or related AI technologies in a business environment.
  • Deploying, governing, supporting, or driving adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot and related AI capabilities, or comparable AI platforms.
  • Leading or supporting enterprise AI, Generative AI, automation, digital transformation, or technology modernization initiatives.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partnering across business, technology, vendor, and executive stakeholder groups to successfully execute AI initiatives and drive business value.
  • Driving technology adoption, communications, stakeholder engagement, and AI enablement programs.
  • Building executive reporting, KPI frameworks, operational dashboards, and business performance metrics.
  • Measuring AI utilization, productivity gains, business impact, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience building and scaling solutions using Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
  • Experience establishing AI governance, adoption, enablement, or value realization frameworks.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, security, risk management, and responsible AI principles.
  • Experience scaling AI initiatives from pilot programs into ongoing business operations.
  • Understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, connectors, and business process automation.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform technologies, including Power Automate and Power BI.
  • Ability to translate strategic objectives into scalable operational execution.
  • Background in media, broadcasting, advertising technology, revenue technology, or digital operations.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Digital Content Producer - KIRO TV

 

Position Overview

KIRO 7 News is seeking a Digital Content Center Producer to help drive audience growth, maximize engagement, and lead our digital-first news strategy.

 

This role is central to how we cover breaking news, elevate enterprise journalism, and connect with audiences across web, mobile, OTT, search, and social platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is an expert in digital audience development, SEO, and content optimization, with strong editorial judgment and exceptional writing and editing skills. They understand how audiences discover news, what drives engagement and loyalty, and how to use analytics to make real-time content decisions. They thrive in fast-moving news environments, know how to identify high-impact stories, and can quickly adapt coverage strategies based on audience trends and performance data.

 

This is a hands-on, on-site role within the Content Center. Digital Content Center Producers collaborate closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom leadership to ensure KIRO 7 is first, fastest, and most accurate online while continuously expanding our digital audience and strengthening our position as Western Washington's leading local news source.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor local and national news, field calls and tips, listen to police and emergency scanners, and track developing stories through public records and court systems.
  • Communicate and coordinate with newsroom staff and sources as stories develop.
  • Write, edit, and publish content across digital platforms including KIRO7.com, the mobile app, OTT, social media channels, and push alerts.
  • Develop and execute SEO strategies that improve search visibility, audience growth, and long-term content performance.
  • Optimize headlines, story structure, metadata, and distribution plans using SEO and audience insights.
  • Use analytics platforms including Chartbeat, Tableau, Google Trends, and social analytics tools to inform content decisions and identify growth opportunities.
  • Ensure daily content production and audience engagement goals are met.
  • Stream breaking news, major coverage events, and live newscasts.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment during breaking news and high-volume coverage situations.
  • Identify opportunities to grow reach, engagement, and referral traffic through search, social, and emerging platforms.
  • Collaborate with newsroom teams to integrate digital storytelling into broadcast workflows and strengthen cross-platform coordination.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proven ability to manage breaking news and make sound editorial decisions in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, headline writing, and copy-editing skills.
  • Strong understanding of audience development, content optimization, digital content strategy, and engagement best practices.
  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO, analytics platforms, CMS workflows, live streaming, and social publishing tools.
  • Experience using audience data and performance metrics to shape editorial decisions and drive measurable growth.
  • Deep understanding of AP Style, media law, and ethical journalism standards.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as news demands; this is an essential on-site role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a digital newsroom, audience development, or digital content strategy role.
  • Demonstrated success increasing website traffic, search rankings, audience engagement, or social growth through data-driven content decisions.
  • Experience managing SEO initiatives and developing strategies that improve organic search performance.
  • Experience coaching or leading newsroom staff on digital best practices, audience growth, and content optimization.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Trends, Chartbeat, Tableau, and other audience intelligence platforms.
  • Leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

 

The wage scale for this position is $24.75 per hour to $35.21 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT OUR TEAM

We’re a fast-growing, fast-moving media company at the forefront of podcast and video content. Our advertising partners range from major brands to exciting up-and-comers — and we help them connect with engaged, passionate audiences. If you’re curious about ad sales, love media, and thrive in fast-paced environments, we want to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a detail-oriented and client-facing Account Manager to support campaigns across their full lifecycle—from pre-sale pitch development through post-sale reporting and client recaps.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Account Executives and Sales Assistants during the pre-sale process, then quarterback campaign kickoff and execution, and ultimately deliver clear, insightful wrap reporting to clients. You’ll have a front-row seat to both sales and account management, making this an ideal role for someone looking to grow into a strategic, revenue-facing position.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Pre-Sale Collaboration 

  • In partnership with Account Executives and Sales Assistants to develop pitch materials and proposals

  • Build and refine client-facing decks, ensuring strong storytelling and clear campaign positioning

  • Support customization of campaigns based on client goals and objectives

  • Gain exposure to deal strategy, packaging, and pricing considerations

 

Campaign Kickoff & Execution 

  • Lead campaign kickoffs, aligning internal teams and clients on timelines, deliverables, and expectations

  • Gather all necessary campaign elements (creative assets, specs, approvals, tracking)

  • Act as the central point of coordination across sales, ad ops, creative, and analytics

  • Ensure a smooth transition from sale to execution and keep campaigns on track

 

Client Management & In-Flight Communication

  • Serve as a primary client contact post-sale

  • Lead check-ins, provide updates, and communicate performance throughout the campaign

  • Monitor pacing and performance, flagging and resolving issues proactively

 

Post-Sale Reporting & Recaps

  • Own development and delivery of wrap reports and campaign recaps

  • Translate campaign performance into clear, actionable insights for clients

  • Highlight successes, learnings, and opportunities for future campaigns

  • Support renewals and upsell conversations with performance-driven narratives

 

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Spans pre-sale through post-sale, not just execution

  • Direct partnership with AEs and Sales Assistants on live deals

  • True client-facing ownership, including leading calls and recaps

  • Opportunity to learn how campaigns are pitched, sold, executed, and renewed

  • Clear path toward Account Management or Sales roles

 

Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of experience in media, advertising, account management, or campaign operations

  • Experience supporting both pre-sale (pitch development, decks) and post-sale (campaign execution, reporting) workflows

  • Strong client-facing communication skills, with the ability to present performance and insights clearly and confidently

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously

  • Analytical mindset with experience interpreting campaign performance data and translating it into actionable insights

  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets

  • Familiarity with media metrics (e.g., impressions, CTR, CPA, CPM, etc.)

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Account Executives, Sales Assistants, or revenue teams

  • Background in media, podcast, influencer, or digital advertising environments

  • Experience with reporting tools

  • Understanding of campaign trafficking, tracking, and basic ad ops processes

job.title: News Reporter
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Role

FOX 29 Philadelphia is seeking a passionate, versatile, and high-energy News Reporter who brings hustle, originality, and innovation to our newsroom every day. If you are ready to "GO THERE" in Philadelphia, we want to see your reel!   We are looking for someone with a passion for creating content across livestreaming news programs, digital news sites, social media, and linear TV, someone with a streaming and digital-first mindset that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs.  We are looking for someone who can execute non-traditional storytelling, creating content for live streaming, website, and social platforms in a way that can also be repurposed for linear.  This is a full-time staff position focused primarily on General Assignment Reporting, backed by a dominant live presence and strong field reporting capabilities, with the flexibility to serve as a fill-in host of our streaming hours.  The ideal candidate excels in fast-paced breaking news situations, possesses a deep commitment to fair and clear storytelling, and knows how to engage audiences across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms, with a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reporting & Storytelling: Pitch and develop original story ideas, cultivate local contacts, and deliver clear, fair, and impactful reports covering a wide spectrum of topics—from hard news to popular culture.
  • Breaking News & Live Coverage: Maintain composure and authority during breaking news events with a strong, dynamic live presence in the field.
  • Fill-In Anchoring: Serve as a fill-in anchor on various newscasts when requested, delivering polished, authoritative coverage from the studio desk.
  • Multi-Platform & Social Media: Tailor content for linear broadcast, streaming, and digital channels. Utilize social media trends and best practices to interact with viewers and expand the station's reach.
  • Continuing Coverage: Track ongoing local issues, identify new developments, and provide meaningful context to complex stories.
  • Community Engagement: Represent FOX 29 professionally to foster trust and build strong, lasting relationships across the Philadelphia community.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional writing, researching, and on-air news reporting experience, preferably covering major news events in a Top 50 or medium-to-large market.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Broadcast Journalism, or a related field preferred.
  • Live & On-Air Excellence: Exceptional live field-reporting skills, polished on-air and anchoring presence, and outstanding written and verbal communication.
  • Editorial Judgment: Strong knowledge of current events, local issues, and a passion for owning your stories from concept to broadcast.
  • Flexibility: A collaborative team player willing to work non-traditional hours, including early mornings, weekends, holidays, fill-in anchor shifts, and dynamic field schedules as breaking news demands.

Ready to join our team? Submit your resume and a link to your reel highlighting your best live reporting and any anchoring work.

job.title: Digital Traffic Specialist
job.description:
Hearst Television is seeking a Digital Traffic Specialist to own the execution and quality control of digital advertising orders across the station portfolio. This role is dedicated entirely to digital trafficking to include queue ownership, order validation, and escalation. This role reports to the Sr Manager, Digital Campaign Operations.

This role requires in-office presence at Hearst Television's Charlotte hub.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Order Trafficking & Queue Ownership

  • Own the digital trafficking queue end to end: receive, validate, and enter digital orders and copy instructions using DMI, DQC, and DAT.
  • Implement and QA digital creative, tags, and targeting across ad-serving platforms; including Google Ad Manager to ensure orders launch accurately and on schedule.
  • Manage day-to-day pacing and delivery of digital orders while flagging discrepancies and reporting issues.    

Quality Control & Escalation

  • Apply standardized intake and validation checks to catch order-input errors and copy mistakes before they're keyed into station systems.
  • Serve as the escalation point for digital order issues, coordinating directly with Station DCS and Digital Sales Managers (DSMs) to resolve discrepancies.
  • Document recurring issues and feed them back into process, training, and automation improvements.

DCS & Station Partnership

  • Partner with Station and Central DCS teams on order handoffs, coverage, and continuity for digital work.
  • Provide clear, responsive communication to stations and sales teams on order status, changes, and turnaround.

Process & Automation

  • Work within Hearst's digital order intake and copy-instruction automation tools, helping validate output and improve automated workflows (including DAT) against manual fallback processes.
  • Support the shift toward exception-based work as automation absorbs routine trafficking tasks.

Reporting

  • Track and report on turnaround time, first-pass quality, and Pushback rate for the digital queue.
  • Surface trends and recommend process changes to the Manager, Digital Traffic Operations.

 

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in broadcast traffic, digital traffic, order entry, or digital campaign operations.
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort managing a high-volume, deadline-driven queue.
  • Experience with digital order-entry/trafficking systems strongly preferred; willingness to learn required for candidates without direct exposure.
  • Familiarity with digital ad-serving platforms (e.g., Google Ad Manager) a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with stations, sales, and Digital Operations.
  • Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and ticket- or queue-management tools.
  • Collaborative team player comfortable sharing workloads and backing up teammates.

job.title: Director, Special Events & Strategic Sourcing
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Director of Special Events & Strategic Sourcing leads long-range strategic sourcing, procurement, and contract negotiations for hotel accommodations, meeting venues, and food and beverage programs across all premier Championships and Association initiatives. This role oversees third-party vendor relationships, manages event budgets, and ensures financial stewardship and legal protection for major events, including the PGA Championship, Ryder Cup, Board of Directors meetings, Annual Meetings, governance meetings, executive leadership events, PGA REACH functions, and other Association initiatives. Additionally, the position drives operational excellence, establishes procurement best practices, and directs the planning and execution of executive and Association special events.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):

Strategic Sourcing & Long-Range Planning

Lead the multi-year planning cycle, securing hotel room blocks, meeting spaces, event venues, and key supplier relationships up to three to five in advance of Championships and Association events. 

Continually monitor hospitality industry trends, market compression cycles, and market fluctuations to identify risks and leverage negotiation opportunities early.

Lead destination research, hotel evaluations, venue assessments, and site inspections to identify facilities that best support the operational and strategic needs of the PGA of America.

Contractual Engagements & Financial Stewardship

Direct sourcing, RFP development, evaluation, negotiation, and execution of hotel agreements, all master service agreements, venue contracts, catering agreements, and other event related vendor contracts.

Negotiate contracts that protect the PGA of America from attrition, cancellation, force majeure while maximizing concessions,  rebates and value added services.

Develop and manage multi million dollar event budgets, forecasting future costs while ensuring procurement decisions maximize return on investment and operational efficiency.

Special Events Planning & Association Event Management

Serve as the strategic lead for planning and executing Association events, including Board of Directors meetings, the Annual Meeting, PGA REACH events, executive leadership and governance meetings, officer functions, awards events, VIP receptions, and internal conferences and retreats.

Develop comprehensive event plans including timelines, logistics, staffing, transportation, décor, entertainment, audiovisual production, registration, signage, and overall guest experience.

Establish operational standards and best practices to ensure consistency across all Association events regardless of location.

Food & Beverage Strategy

Develop comprehensive food & beverage strategies supporting Association meetings, executive functions, and special events.

Collaborate with hotels, venues, caterers, and culinary partners to develop menus, banquet service plans, beverage programs, and hospitality experiences that reflect the PGA of America's standards.

Oversee banquet guarantees, menu pricing, catering negotiations, service standards, and budget performance.

Identify innovative culinary experiences that enhance executive and member engagement while maintaining financial discipline.

Vendor & Strategic Partner Management

Develop and maintain long-term relationships with preferred hotel brands, convention centers, destination marketing organizations, destination management companies, transportation providers, audiovisual firms, entertainment partners, production companies, rental suppliers, registration vendors, and other strategic event partners.

Evaluate vendor performance through measurable service standards while identifying opportunities for increased efficiencies, innovation, and cost savings.

Maintain preferred supplier programs that create long-term value for the Association.

Executive & VIP Experience

Develop a thorough understanding of the expectations of PGA Officers, Board Members, Executive Leadership, PGA REACH donors, Championship leadership, players, sponsors, international guests, and member volunteers.

Serve as the Association's hospitality advisor for executive meetings and special events, ensuring every experience reflects the professionalism and brand standards of the PGA of America.

Oversee executive accommodations, VIP logistics, transportation coordination, and personalized service strategies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Championship Directors, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Communications, Player Services, Volunteer Operations, Corporate Partnerships, Ticketing, and Executive Leadership to ensure all procurement and event strategies support organizational priorities.

Provide strategic guidance during championship planning related to Association functions and executive events conducted alongside PGA Championships and Ryder Cups.

Operational Excellence & Risk Management

Develop contingency plans for lodging, transportation, food & beverage, venue operations, and other critical event services.

Lead operational response during unexpected disruptions including weather, vendor issues, hotel challenges, transportation delays, and other event-related risks.

Continuously evaluate processes and implement improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the Association event experience.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Recruit, mentor, and develop a high performing team responsible for strategic sourcing, special event planning, and Association meeting execution while  fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.

Develop a deep understanding of the diverse clientele, ranging from PGA Executives, Board Members, and PGA REACH donors to players, and various sponsors, tailoring housing strategies to meet their distinct expectations.

Manage housing bureaus, registration providers, destination management companies and other event partners to ensure seamless execution and exceptional service delivery.

INCLUSION:

Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. 

SHARED VALUES:

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values challenges and opportunities impacting you and your team.  Keep Leadership aware of the pulse of the workforce; recognizing, discussing, and addressing any cultural concerns.

SUPERVISION:

This is a supervisory position responsible for the performance management and hiring of employees within the department.  

FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

Responsible for preparation and oversight of the Department budget and for monitoring results.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred. 

Eight years of progressive leadership experience in strategic sourcing, hospitality management, corporate events, luxury hotel sales, meeting planning, or corporate procurement, with a focus on large-scale, citywide events and major sporting championships. Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams.

Four years team management experience.

Extensive knowledge of hotel contract law, attrition clauses, food and beverage agreements, venue contracts, and complex corporate or association negotiations.

Demonstrated experience managing multimillion-dollar event budgets, analyzing financial data, forecasting long-term costs, identifying savings opportunities, and ensuring all contractual obligations are met.

Experience in developing standard operating procedures, planning templates, and negotiation guidelines to support consistent and efficient event execution.

Travel and hospitality experience required.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:

Must have thorough knowledge of administrative principles and procedures with the ability to work on various projects and programs as assigned.  A knowledge of the organization's functions of a business operation.  Skills in planning and organizing.  Ability to understand legal and contractual terminology as it pertains to event contracting. Ability to gather information, analyze data, and provide recommendations.  Ability to maintain the confidentiality of sensitive information with the highest level of integrity. Must have working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders.

Ability to travel up to 25%.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Salt Lake City
job.description:
Are you ready to bring the excitement of sports to life through innovative advertising solutions? Scripps Sports is seeking a dynamic Scripps Sports Partnership Lead in Salt Lake City who will drive revenue growth by selling linear, digital, and sponsorship solutions across our acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory. You'll work with regional and national accounts to create customized advertising packages that connect brands with passionate sports fans.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Independently prospect regional and national accounts, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, conduct presentations and close sales.
  • Create and sell sponsorship/advertising solutions utilizing acquired league and team controlled sports inventory.
  • Attend internal meetings to establish strategy and revenue goals and attend weekly sports division meetings.
  • Serve as trusted advisor with new clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, collections of revenue due and retention reports.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients, attending sporting events or other associated functions.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of media sales including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with VP of Revenue regarding status of accounts.
  • Assist Scripps national or local AE's on key client sales calls for sports sponsorships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related field required, or equivalent experience
  • Generally 5+ years of sports-related experience required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated record of success in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office and other programs such as customer relations software
  • Working knowledge of various media sales platforms
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills required
  • Must have good organizational skills and time management
  • Ability to present and negotiate with confidence and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask and meet deadlines in fast pace environment
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City offers an unbeatable combination of urban sophistication and outdoor adventure. Nestled against the stunning Wasatch Mountains, you'll have world-class skiing and snowboarding at resorts like Park City, Alta, and Snowbird just 30-45 minutes from downtown. In warmer months, enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in Big and Little Cottonwood Canyons, or explore the unique landscape of the Great Salt Lake.

The city itself boasts a thriving downtown with excellent restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant arts scene including the Utah Symphony, Ballet West, and numerous galleries. Temple Square and the historic neighborhoods showcase the city's rich heritage, while the growing tech sector has earned Salt Lake City recognition as the "Silicon Slopes." With 300 days of sunshine annually, a lower cost of living than many major metros, and a family-friendly atmosphere, Salt Lake City provides an exceptional quality of life.

Sports fans will love being home to the NBA's Utah Jazz, Real Salt Lake (MLS), and Utah Hockey Club (NHL), plus easy access to outdoor recreation that rivals anywhere in the country. The city's central location also makes it a convenient hub for exploring Utah's "Mighty Five" national parks and other Western destinations.

If you're passionate about solving complex technical challenges, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to make a real impact, we want to hear from you!

  • Provide world class customer service to all business partners internal and external to the Scripps organization with a positive "can do" attitude.

  • Support, maintain, and install the full range of broadcast, Radio Frequency (RF), and production systems based on both Serial Digital Interface (SDI), and Internet Protocol (IP) based architecture.

  • Setup and enhance software, hardware, server, automation and workflow systems, projects and equipment to enable our teams to be both productive and efficient. Ensure all meet current industry standards and comply with Company policies and expectations.

This will include support and integration of audio and video, cameras, editing systems, streaming, content management and workflow.

  • Design improvements to our operation.

  • Maintain logs and reports as per FCC Rules and Regulations.

  • Provide, enhance, and utilize proactive monitoring system to anticipate technical issues and be able to act accordingly.

  • Update technical plan documentation when installations are completed to include changes that are made.

  • Document and maintain records of equipment repairs.

  • Research part numbers and pricing to determine where to purchase and the cost of repairs.

  • Operate studio, news and control room equipment.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Generally, 5+ years experience in related field preferred

  • Network certification required (Cisco, CompTIA Network+)

  • SBE certification preferred

  • At least 3 year broadcast operations experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Must have working knowledge of all the following areas, and specialize in at least one of these areas:

  • Broadcast and production systems support and engineering including SDI and IP based technology and workflow

  • Extensive knowledge of computer networking, broadcast automation and workflow systems

  • Transmitter support and engineering

  • Strong understanding and ability to work with IT/cellular systems, servers, and devices, and actively pursue emerging technology in these areas

  • Solid working knowledge of software for server and client operating systems including active directory

  • Strong interpersonal skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver a high level of customer service

  • Self-motivated to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals

  • Ability to comprehend schematics, mechanical drawings and technical manuals

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work within deadlines

  • Familiarity with various test instruments, alignment apparatuses and knowledge of personal computers

  • Deep operational knowledge of studio, news and control room technology

  • Ability to guide and coach colleagues

Green Bay, Wisconsin offers the perfect blend of small-town charm and big-city amenities. job.description:
The Director of Development & Production is a senior creative leader responsible for the development, production, and execution of premium digital-first content across Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment. This role oversees content from concept through delivery while driving creative innovation, production excellence, and audience growth across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and emerging digital platforms.

The ideal candidate is an experienced creative producer with a passion for storytelling, a proven ability to develop original franchises and recurring series, and an enthusiasm for Food, Travel, and Entertainment programming. They understand how to create compelling, platform-native content that grows audiences, attracts brand partners, and elevates an established media brand.

Working closely with executive leadership, editorial, audience development, and sales teams, the Director of Development & Production will lead creative development, oversee production operations, mentor production teams, and ensure every project meets the highest editorial and production standards.

Responsibilities

Creative Development & Strategy

  • Lead the creative development of original digital series, recurring franchises, specials, and branded content initiatives for growing digital editorial brands including @AmazingAmericaTV and @PauseRewind.
  • Identify emerging audience trends, platform opportunities, and storytelling formats that support audience growth and business objectives.
  • Generate, pitch, and develop new programming concepts while evolving existing series with fresh creative approaches.
  • Create series treatments, story outlines, mood boards, production decks, and presentation materials for internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Partner with leadership to build and maintain a robust content development pipeline aligned with editorial priorities and commercial opportunities.

Production Leadership

  • Oversee all productions from greenlight through final delivery across multiple platforms and formats.
  • Direct studio and field productions, providing clear creative vision to crews, producers, editors, and on-camera talent.
  • Manage creative execution throughout pre-production, production, post-production, and final approval.
  • Review and approve creative materials including treatments, scripts, casting recommendations, production schedules, budgets, graphics, music, rough cuts, fine cuts, and final deliverables.
  • Establish production workflows and best practices that improve efficiency while maintaining exceptional creative quality.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor producers, coordinators, freelance talent, editors, and production partners.
  • Foster a collaborative, creative culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage multiple concurrent productions while balancing priorities, deadlines, budgets, and available resources.
  • Facilitate creative brainstorms with Editorial, Audience Development, and Sales teams to maximize content performance.

Audience Growth & Optimization

  • Collaborate with Audience Development and Analytics teams to leverage performance insights and optimize future content.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of platform algorithms, viewer behavior, and evolving digital consumption habits.
  • Champion experimentation with new storytelling techniques, production technologies, creators, and distribution strategies.

Brand Partnerships & Business Development

  • Work closely with branded content and sales teams to develop premium sponsorship opportunities that seamlessly integrate advertiser objectives while maintaining editorial integrity.
  • Cultivate relationships within the tourism, hospitality, culinary, lifestyle, and entertainment industries to identify new content and partnership opportunities.
  • Represent the company during partner meetings, industry events, production shoots, and creative presentations.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Film, Television, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • 7+ years of experience developing and producing original digital content for major media brands, publishers, production companies, or digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing creative production teams and overseeing multiple concurrent productions.
  • Professional experience and genuine enthusiasm for creating Lifestyle, Food & Travel, and Entertainment content.
  • Proven success developing and launching original digital video series that drive audience engagement and growth.
  • Extensive experience overseeing productions from concept through post-production across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, FAST, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Strong creative judgment with experience providing feedback across every stage of development, production, and editorial review.
  • Experience directing both studio and field productions, working with talent, creators, celebrities, and non-professional hosts.
  • Strong understanding of branded content, sponsorship integrations, and advertiser collaboration.
  • Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience developing creator-led programming and influencer collaborations.
  • Familiarity with production management software, digital asset management systems, and content performance analytics.
  • Experience managing production budgets, vendor negotiations, and resource planning.

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Overview:
CBS Sports is seeking a skilled, creative and highly organized Senior Editor to lead key aspects of its NFL coverage across CBSSports.com and CBS Sports platforms.The Senior Editor will play a central leadership role within the NFL editorial team, helping set the coverage strategy and oversee its execution across breaking news, live games, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and enterprise storytelling. This role requires more than strong editing skills: We are looking for an ambitious editorial leader who can establish a clear vision, generate distinctive coverage ideas, manage and develop writers, and bring structure and accountability to a fast-moving newsroom operation. The NFL Draft will receive special attention in this role.
The ideal candidate has exceptional news judgment, deep NFL knowledge and a proven ability to make confident editorial decisions under pressure. This person should be equally comfortable directing coverage during a major breaking-news event, developing an ambitious long-term editorial franchise and coaching an individual writer toward stronger work. The Senior Editor will directly manage a team of writers, with responsibility for setting expectations, assigning coverage, providing regular feedback and supporting each employee’s professional development. They will also help establish team priorities, evaluate performance and foster a collaborative, creative and accountable culture. This position is based in New York and requires schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as NFL games, news cycles and editorial needs warrant.


Responsibilities:
• Help define and execute the overall editorial strategy for CBS Sports’ NFL coverage across daily, seasonal and long-term priorities
• Directly manage, mentor and develop a team of writers, setting clear expectations and providing consistent editorial and performance feedback
• Lead regular one-on-one meetings, contribute to formal performance evaluations and create development plans that help employees grow
• Hold writers accountable for productivity, quality, collaboration, audience performance and established editorial standard
• Establish clear daily and long-term coverage priorities, delegate assignments appropriately and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met
• Generate and develop original coverage ideas, franchises and enterprise projects that distinguish CBS Sports in a competitive NFL media landscape
• Assign and edit breaking news, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and other stories that meet CBS Sports’ editorial, legal and ethical standards
• Lead coverage surrounding NFL games, trades, injuries, coaching changes, free agency, the NFL Draft and other major league events
• Make decisive editorial calls during breaking news, live games and other high-volume coverage periods
• Work closely with writers to strengthen reporting, sharpen analysis, improve story structure and develop more compelling headlines and presentation
• Evaluate the strengths, opportunities and workloads of individual team members and deploy staff strategically across the coverage operation
• Identify gaps in coverage or team capabilities and recommend solutions, including new assignments, developmental opportunities and potential staffing needs
• Create efficient workflows and communication systems that keep writers aligned and the broader NFL operation organized
• Use audience insights, SEO principles and performance data to evaluate coverage, identify opportunities and inform future editorial decisions
• Coordinate with leaders across fantasy, betting, social, video, newsletters, programming and other editorial teams to develop cohesive, multiplatform coverage plans
• Balance immediate audience opportunities with original work designed to build authority and long-term loyalty for CBS Sports
• Represent the NFL team in broader editorial planning conversations and communicate priorities clearly to senior newsroom leadership
• Foster an environment that values creativity, urgency, accuracy, collaboration and continuous improvement

Basic Qualifications
• At least three years of professional experience in a digital editorial or newsroom environment
• Meaningful experience directly managing writers or editors, including setting goals, delivering feedback and evaluating performance
• A demonstrated record of leading editorial coverage and making high-level decisions during major news or live-event windows
• Exceptional editorial judgment and the ability to prioritize coverage in a fast-moving, high-pressure environment
• A proven ability to generate original ideas and turn them into successful stories, franchises or multiplatform coverage plans
• Excellent editing, headline-writing and story-packaging skills
• Strong organizational and operational skills, with the ability to manage people, deadlines and multiple concurrent workstreams
• Deep knowledge of the NFL, its teams and players, and the major issues and trends shaping the league
• A comprehensive understanding of the NFL calendar and news cycle, including games, roster movement, injuries, transactions, coaching changes, free agency and the NFL Draft
• Experience using SEO, audience analytics and other acquisition and engagement tools to inform editorial strategy
• Strong leadership, communication and relationship-management skills
• An undergraduate degree, preferably in journalism, communications or a related field
• Ability to work from New York
• Schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as games, news developments and editorial shifts warrant


Additional Qualifications:
• A track record of improving employee performance and helping writers produce more ambitious, distinctive work
• Experience leading a team through organizational changes, evolving priorities or demanding coverage periods
• Experience developing major editorial franchises, special packages or enterprise projects
• Demonstrated success collaborating across editorial departments and platforms
• Familiarity with NFL Draft, fantasy football, sports betting, social media and emerging audience trends
• Experience working with content-management, analytics and editorial-planning systems
• Working knowledge of Photoshop or similar visual-editing tools


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.title: Content Services Operator
job.description:
Paramount Skydance Corporation is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV, Network 10 (Australia) and Channel 5 (UK).   In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.   

 

 

We’re now looking for Content Services Operators to join our busy Sydney station on a rolling CASUAL basis, with hours and days varying depending on demand. 

 

What you’ll do in Content Services:
You’ll combine your strong attention to detail and technical skills to assist in the preparation of media assets for Programming, Promo, Commercial, News and Production across both linear and streaming platforms. Working with state-of-the-art technology in a supportive, high-morale team, you’ll have the chance to expand your skills, collaborate across business units, engage in the power of content
This is a place where variety is the norm, teamwork is strong, and learning opportunities are everywhere.

 

Functions will also include:

  • Acquisition and ingest of Programming, Promo, Commercial, News, Production and streaming assets as well as daily local and international satellite feeds.
  • Making sure media assets are readily available within our Media Asset Management system for all our internal production teams.
  • Utilising advanced workflow tools ensuring media items are prepared for transmission with appropriate workflow stages applied and monitored.
  • QC of broadcast and streaming items ensuring technical standards are met and applying play out segmentation and integration metadata where required (yes, getting paid to watch our great new content!)
  • Scheduled asset monitoring, liaising with internal and external facilities ensuring all broadcast items are ready when they need to be.
  • Raw media handling and preparation utilising high-end media processing applications and systems

 

What are we looking for in a Content Services Operator? What’s important?

•    A motivated self-starter who can thrive in a deadline driven environment
•    An effective communicator with a strong customer service focus.
•    High attention to detail.
•    Strong computer literacy and enjoy the use of new technology
•    Ability to learn and adapt to continuously evolving technology, practices and procedures.
•    Ability to work within a 24/7 rotating roster.

● Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

● Curiosity and willingness to learn AI‑driven engineering.

● Ownership of assigned features and components.


Success Metrics

● Delivery of reliable features within AI tooling platforms.

job.description:
