job.title: Principal Product Designer - Wall Street Journal Enterprise Products
job.description:
About the Team:

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.

About Dow Jones Design & Research:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year foundation while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our joint expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

About the Role:

We're seeking a Principal Product Designer to own the design strategy for our WSJ enterprise products—professional experiences that bring The Wall Street Journal and the wider Dow Jones portfolio to the businesses and institutions that rely on our journalism to make informed decisions. In this a senior individual-contributor role, you will set the direction for one of our growth areas and become a go-to design expert on how Dow Jones serves enterprise and professional customers.

Enterprise customers don’t always consume content the way consumers do. Designing for them means thinking beyond the article—how a professional finds what's relevant to their work, how an organization manages access for its employees, and how our trusted journalism earns a place in the working day of decision-makers. You'll hold enterprise design to the high bar set by our consumer products and be tightly integrated with the platforms guaranteeing these decision-makers are empowered with WSJ + Dow Jones content.

This is a role with influence and scope. You'll shape strategy with senior design, product, and business leadership, resolve the tension between enterprise requirements and consumer-grade craft, contribute to the enterprise patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across both our professional and consumer brands. You'll be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others build upon.

You will report to the SVP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for our enterprise experiences. Set a coherent, multi-year direction for how professional customers discover, read, and act on our journalism, and tie it to measurable outcomes such as seat growth, engagement, renewal, and expansion

  • Own the admin experience that powers the reader experience. Design how organizations manage seats, assign content, and understand engagement across their teams

  • Hold enterprise work to the Journal's standard of craft. Bring the typography, information design, and attention to detail that characterize our consumer products into a business environment, and help set the bar for what enterprise design quality means at Dow Jones

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your direction to senior design, product, and business leaders, and to other executives where needed, building the partnerships that move great design forward across a field of competing priorities

  • Establish further patterns in our Index Design System—the components, density, navigation, and permission-aware behavior that professional products depend on—knowing when conformity with our consumer brands serves the user and when a professional audience warrants a different approach

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain. Professional workflows, AI-assisted features users must trust, and personalization that must earn its place are problems devoid of clear precedent. You'll create clarity where none exists and develop the approaches others adopt

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and revenue, and help teams understand which measures actually matter for a professional product

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across our professional and consumer brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or audiences

  • Depth in both enterprise and consumer design. You've built products for professional users with real workflows and real constraints, and you hold that work to the standard of the best consumer experiences. This combination is the core requirement of the role.

  • Experience designing professional platforms—workspaces, dashboards, personalized feeds, admin and permissions tooling

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or audiences: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Judgment about personalization and AI-assisted experiences—when they genuinely help a professional user, when they diminish trust, and how to design for these scenarios

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility compliance standards (WCAG), with fluency in dense, information-rich interfaces

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating amid ambiguity—setting direction in your domain during shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree -or- equivalent work experience in Design, HCI, or a comparable field

Nice to Have:

  • Experience designing B2B information services, professional intelligence, or research platforms

  • Familiarity with entitlements, seat management, or permissions models at enterprise scale

  • Experience shipping AI-assisted features—summarization, recommendation, or generative content—in production products

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing productively to a design system

  • Experience partnering with external research, brand, or design agencies

  • Working knowledge of financial services, consulting, or other professional-services industries

  • An external presence through speaking or writing on design at scale

  • International or cross-cultural design experience

Dow Jones is seeking a Risk & Compliance Partners Manager to help grow and strengthen our partner ecosystem across the Risk & Compliance business. This role is responsible for managing a portfolio of channel and integration partners, deepening strategic relationships, and driving commercial growth through coordinated go-to-market execution.

  • Coordinate joint go-to-market initiatives with internal stakeholders and partner organizations, including enablement, campaigns, pipeline development, and sales support.

  • Work closely with Sales teams to support new opportunities, renewals, expansions, and complex partner-led deals.

  • Develop strong knowledge of each partner's business model, target segments, product strengths, geographic footprint, and competitive positioning.

  • Surface market feedback and partner insights to Product and Proposition teams to help inform roadmap priorities and packaging opportunities.

  • Maintain accurate partner records, opportunity visibility, and reporting disciplines across internal systems and team processes.

  • Act as a cross-functional point of coordination to resolve issues, remove blockers, and improve the overall partner experience.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel management, business development, account management, or strategic alliances.

  • Experience working in risk, compliance, financial crime, regulatory technology, data, SaaS, or B2B information services.

  • Demonstrated success growing partner-led revenue and managing strategic external relationships.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to shape business cases, prioritize opportunities, and support complex deal structures.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence across internal and external groups.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including experience managing multiple partners and initiatives at once.

  • Comfort working across global, matrixed organizations with a high degree of collaboration and accountability.

  • Ability to analyze partner performance, identify trends, and translate findings into action plans.

  • Experience with channel partnerships involving data, APIs, screening, due diligence, KYC, AML, sanctions, adverse media, or third-party risk workflows.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a priority growth region for Storyful News & Video as well as leading the global team. The role sits at the intersection of Sales, Editorial, Marketing and Product, with scope to influence how Storyful engages the North American media market.

For a commercially driven seller, it offers a strong mix of account ownership, new business development, senior client engagement and input into targeted go-to-market strategy.

Core Newswire Growth

job.title: Senior Director, Audience Growth, Distribution & Monetization
job.description:
About the Role:

Dow Jones is building something ambitious in video, rooted in the authority of The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor’s Business Daily, and designed for how audiences actually watch business news now. This is a rare opportunity to help build how this new business finds its audience, builds habits and turns that audience into a sustainable business.

We are looking for someone who understands that on YouTube and connected TV, distribution does not begin after a show is finished. The format, title, thumbnail, retention shape and publishing cadence are all creative decisions and they can determine whether an excellent episode reaches forty thousand people or four million. You are part audience strategist, part commercial architect, part creative partner to the programming team.

This role sits at the center of the network. Pre-launch, the immediate priority is YouTube: personally establishing exceptional channel architecture, publishing, packaging, optimization and performance practices before building the team that will scale them. For the larger network build, you will work as the standing counterpart to Programming on what we make, Sales on what it earns, and to Product, Editorial and Finance on everything in between. The right person is entrepreneurial, analytical and deeply hands-on and knows how to pursue reach without compromising trust.

You will:

  • Determine the YouTube channel architecture for the new network and what belongs on existing Dow Jones channels, and when a new network or show-specific channel is warranted, how the portfolio works together without fragmenting the audience.

  • Lead, and initially operate, Dow Jones’ YouTube presence, ensuring every channel and show page is exceptionally programmed, packaged and optimized. Establish best-in-class practices across channel architecture, publishing cadence, metadata, playlists, live and replay strategy, homepage organization and ongoing performance optimization.

  • Develop and execute long-term channel and platform audience growth strategy across YouTube, connected TV and FAST, podcast and vodcast platforms, social video for the new network. Build intentional pathways from open-platform viewing to deeper engagement, registration and subscription pathways.

  • Serve as the network’s primary liaison with YouTube and other strategic platforms, translating product updates, audience insights and evolving best practices into concrete programming, publishing and monetization decisions.

  • Build the audience flywheel connecting full episodes, live programming, clips, search, creator partnerships and cross-promotion across Dow Jones.

  • Establish packaging as a repeatable creative discipline, setting standards for titles, thumbnails, hooks and opening seconds. Work directly with producers, editors and talent to translate audience insight into stronger concepts, storytelling and performance.

  • Lead a rigorous testing program, including live packaging experiments and format-iteration cycles measured in days rather than quarters.

  • Partner with the Head of Programming to bring audience sizing, competitive analysis and format-market fit into the greenlight process.

  • Set and lead the video monetization strategy across platform advertising, direct-sold sponsorships and integrations, connected TV and FAST, licensing and emerging revenue models. Partner with Sales and Finance to determine how each format earns, what commercial thresholds sit in front of greenlight and how to balance near-term revenue with audience growth and long-term franchise value.

  • Build the subscription-funnel strategy from open-platform viewing into Dow Jones–owned products. Partner with Product, Marketing, Data and subscription teams to create and test pathways from viewer to registered user to paid subscriber, and measure acquisition, conversion, retention and lifetime value by show and platform.

  • Define the metrics and reporting cadence leadership uses to manage the slate. Make the data accessible and translate it into creative direction teams can act on without becoming afraid to take ambitious swings.

  • Build the audience and distribution function as the business scales remaining excited to operate hands-on before there is a large team around you.

You Have:

  • 8+ years across audience development, platform strategy, digital-video growth or monetization, or an equivalent record of exceptional results, with genuine depth in YouTube and a track record of building an audience from a standing start.

  • Experience inside a major platform, a sophisticated creator-led company or a publisher that has built meaningful digital-video scale.

  • Expert fluency in YouTube discovery and performance, plus working knowledge of connected TV and FAST.

  • Accountability for a business outcome, not simply a channel. You are as fluent in RPM, CPM and sell-through as you are in retention curves and thumbnail tests.

  • Experience working directly with on-camera talent and creator partners on positioning, packaging and performance.

  • A genuinely collaborative style, with experience building revenue models beside the people selling them and building them.

  • Fluency across the creator economy and established media, with the diplomatic skill to move between them without condescending to either.

  • An understanding of operating in an editorially serious environment. You can advocate for reach in a room full of journalists and be persuasive rather than alarming.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a clear point of view on how a trusted news organization should respond to changing audience behavior.

job.description:
About Us

Storyful is a news and intelligence agency, now part of Dow Jones. Founded in 2010, the News & Content business sources, verifies and distributes user-generated content, breaking-news footage, and viral videos to news outlets, broadcasters and media organizations. Content is available to download through Newswire by Storyful, the world’s first social media newswire.

Storyful Intelligence helps partners understand the attitudes, behaviors, and emotions shaping the world. Our mission is to provide intelligence-driven marketing and communications strategies to business leaders by delving into the nuances of social and digital media intelligence.

Storyful’s direct-to-consumer social properties have millions of subscribers and followers, generating millions of views each month. Storyful develops compelling video formats across social and digital platforms while leveraging its unique content and expertise to reach priority audiences and support marketing, brand, and commercial objectives across the business.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP, Marketing & Growth, you will be responsible for producing and executing compelling video formats, series, and content outputs to bring the Storyful brand to life across Storyful-owned channels as well as marketing and commercial touch points.

Always thinking about new and creative ways to improve video and visual storytelling to drive engagement and impact across both consumer and professional audiences, you will collaborate with stakeholders from across the company to create high-performing social-first content and marketing video assets.

Working within the broader strategy established by Marketing & Growth, you will translate business and audience priorities into compelling video content designed to reach the audiences that matter most to Storyful. Success in this role is focused on the quality and relevance of the audience reached and the impact of the content—not simply the volume of views or engagement.

Understanding that different audiences and platforms require different approaches, you will experiment with formats and creative treatments for each channel and evolve your work based on audience insights, performance data, and business priorities.

This Video Producer will work on-site in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week.

You Will

  • Produce and create video content, from start to finish, for social, marketing and owned channels - owning the production lifecycle from concept and execution through to distribution and iteration.

  • Lead production and editing of marketing video content — including talk-to-camera pieces, explainer videos, and promotional reels — optimized for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Identify new video content opportunities, based on relevant cultural or audience insights, current events, and social trends, and translate these into repeatable, scalable formats that engage priority audiences and support marketing, brand, and commercial objectives.

  • Create innovative graphics, visuals, and other video content forms to create engaging editorial and marketing materials for our Storyful owned channels and projects.

  • Work directly with key members of the social and marketing team to complete timely tasks and projects, as well as work cross functionally between other departments to create valued content that aligns with audience, brand, and commercial objectives.

  • Leverage Storyful’s Newswire assets and Intelligence outputs to identify, curate, and transform high-potential content into engaging, platform-native video formats for distribution across social and marketing channels.

  • Use industry-standard editing and production tools to rapidly create and iterate content based on performance data and audience insights.

  • Use performance data and audience insights to continually improve content and its effectiveness in reaching Storyful’s priority audiences.

You Have

  • 5+ years experience in video production and content creation with a strong focus on social and digital platforms (experience creating content for targeted professional, B2B and/or marketing audiences is a plus)

  • Ability to understand a defined audience and business objective and translate that into compelling video content and platform-appropriate creative execution

  • Video expertise and an understanding of the social media landscape as a whole, each platform's various nuances, and the latest in social trends

  • An understanding of how content can be adapted for different audience types and objectives

  • Fluency with social media platforms, marketing tools, and digital media insights

  • Video production and gifted storytelling skills with the understanding of the power of video content across both social and marketing contexts

  • Proficiency using Adobe Premiere and other editing platforms (CapCut, DaVinci Resolve) to produce and cut social-first video content

  • Hands-on experience directing and producing on-camera talent, including shoot setup, teleprompter use, and basic lighting for studio or office environments

  • Demonstrated ability to create content that effectively reaches and engages defined target audiences and supports measurable marketing, brand, or commercial objectives

  • Graphics creation proficiency

  • Initiative with a bias toward action and the ability to take ownership

  • A strong communicator and cross-functional collaborator

  • Strong organization, time and project management skills

  • Ability to work under and meet tight deadlines

  • Willingness to work in our Midtown Manhattan office three days per week

  • Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus

job.title: SVP, M&A
job.description:
SVP, M&A

About Us:

Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest news-gathering operations globally. It is home to leading publications and products including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America’s largest newspaper by paid circulation; Barron’s, MarketWatch, Mansion Global, Financial News, Investor’s Business Daily, Factiva, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dow Jones Newswires, OPIS and Chemical Market Analytics. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

About the Role

We are seeking a senior executive to lead Dow Jones’ M&A strategy. The SVP, M&A will serve as the primary driver of inorganic growth across the enterprise, identifying and executing acquisitions, investments, and strategic transactions that accelerate Dow Jones’ long-term strategic priorities.

The SVP, M&A will own the end-to-end transaction lifecycle from sourcing and evaluation through negotiation, diligence, close, and integration. The role requires a highly strategic and commercially minded leader who can operate effectively across complex markets, build trusted relationships externally and internally, and drive disciplined execution with measurable business impact.

The ideal candidate is a forward thinking corporate development executive with deep transaction expertise, strong business acumen, and the ability to translate strategic opportunities into scalable growth outcomes.

You Will:

  • Lead Dow Jones enterprise M&A strategy and execution, aligning inorganic growth initiatives to the company’s strategic priorities.

  • Own and manage the enterprise deal pipeline, proactively identifying acquisition, investment, and partnership opportunities that strengthen Dow Jones’ market position and capabilities.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO, CFO, and business leaders on growth opportunities, market dynamics, competitive positioning, and portfolio strategy.

  • Develop a disciplined operating framework for evaluating opportunities, prioritizing investments, and ensuring alignment between strategic rationale and financial outcomes.

  • Lead all phases of transactions, including opportunity sourcing and evaluation, deal structuring and negotiation, due diligence, governance, execution, and close

  • Evaluate business models, competitive positioning, customer value propositions, revenue quality, and operational performance to inform investment decisions and transaction strategy.

  • Structure and negotiate transactions that align strategic objectives with financial discipline and long-term value creation.

  • Establish clear success metrics and accountability frameworks to measure transaction performance, strategic impact, and value realization post-close.

  • Define integration strategies early in the transaction lifecycle to ensure alignment between the deal thesis, operating model, strategic objectives, and long-term value creation goals.

  • Partner with business and functional leaders to lead post-acquisition integration planning and execution across operational, commercial, technology, and organizational workstreams.

  • Establish clear governance structures, success metrics, and accountability frameworks to measure transaction performance, synergy realization, and overall business impact.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships across the M&A and investment ecosystem, including founders, CEOs, private equity and venture capital firms, investment banks, strategic partners, and industry advisors.

  • Build a robust external network to generate proprietary deal flow, surface emerging market opportunities, and strengthen Dow Jones’ position within the broader media, technology, data, and AI landscape.

  • Engage regularly with market participants, investors, and operators to identify opportunities for acquisitions, partnerships, strategic investments, and capability expansion.

  • Partner with senior leadership to assess market shifts, disruptive technologies, and competitive threats that may impact long-term portfolio strategy and growth objectives.

  • Represent Dow Jones externally in strategic discussions, industry conferences, investor meetings, and partner engagements.

  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Strategy, Product, Technology, Legal, Editorial, and Commercial teams to ensure alignment and execution excellence.

  • Influence senior stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization to drive alignment on priorities, investment decisions, and integration outcomes.

  • Foster a culture of analytical rigor, strategic thinking, collaboration, and accountability.

You Have:

  • 15+ years of experience leading complex M&A transactions and strategic growth initiatives as a senior corporate development, investment banking, private equity, or strategic finance executive.

  • Demonstrated success executing acquisitions, investments, and strategic transactions—ideally within information services, though experience in media, technology, SaaS, data, or adjacent industries is also highly valued.

  • Strong financial and strategic acumen, including expertise in valuation, financial modeling, deal structuring, investment analysis, and synergy assessment.

  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations and influence senior executives and external stakeholders

  • Experience managing cross-functional diligence and integration efforts across global organizations

  • Deep understanding of technology, data, AI, and digital business models

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to operate effectively with CEOs, Boards, investors, and business leaders

  • Proven ability to balance strategic vision with operational discipline and execution rigor
